text: Dugang pa niya, ginabulubanta 1,000 ka mga pamalay ang nagkalaguba sa diin 996 ang partially damaged samtang 89 naman ang naubos gid wasak.
english: He added that an estimated 1,000 houses were destroyed with 996 partially damaged while 89 were completely destroyed.

text: Nakaeksperyensya naman sang pagbaha ang 132 ka mga barangays,n akabatyag man sang storm surge ang pila ka mga coastal communities, kag may na-record man nga mga landslides.
english: Meanwhile, 132 barangays experienced flooding, several coastal communities experienced storm surge, and landslides were also recorded.

text: Pahayag pa ni Alejandro, pila man ka kabanwahanan sa Aurora ang isolated ukon indi makadtuan bangud sa landslides, lakip diri ang banwa sang Dipaculao, Dinalungan, Casiguran, kag Dilasag.
english: Alejandro said several towns in Aurora are also isolated or inaccessible due to landslides, including the towns of Dipaculao, Dinalungan, Casiguran, and Dilasag.

text: Base sa latest Tropical Cyclone Bulletin Number 17 sang PAGASA, naghina ang Bagyo Uwan samtang padayon nga nagahulag palayo sa pungsod sa direksyon sang West Philippine Sea.
english: Based on the latest Tropical Cyclone Bulletin Number 17 of PAGASA, Typhoon Uwan weakened as it continued to move away from the country in the direction of the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ulihi nga nasiplatan ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 135km nakatundan-naaminhan nakatundan sang Bacnotan, La Union, kag nagahulag panakatundan-naaminhan nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20km/h.
english: The center of the typhoon was last spotted 135km west-northwest of Bacnotan, La Union, and moving west-northwest at 20km/h.

text: Naglawig sang tatlo ka adlaw nga nagpalutaw-lutaw sa kadagatan antes nasalbar ang 33-anyos nga lalaki nga gin-anod sang baha sa tunga sang paglaslas sang bagyo Tino sa Balamban, Cebu.
english: It took three days of floating in the sea before a 33-year-old man was rescued from the floods in the middle of Typhoon Tino in Balamban, Cebu.

text: Ang survivor amo si Christian, residente sang Brgy.
english: The survivor is Christian, resident of Brgy.

text: Cantood, Balam­ban.
english: Cantood, Balamban.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nakit-an ang biktima sang mga manugpangisda sang San Remegio nga nagalutaw-lutaw sa kadagatan samtang nagahakos sa puno sang saging.
english: According to reports, the victim was found by fishermen of San Remegio floating in the sea while hugging a banana tree.

text: Nagapalangluya na ang biktima sang nakit-an ini.
english: The victim was already fainting when he was found.

text: Ginakabig naman sang biktima nga milagro nga nakaluwas ini.
english: The victim considers it a miracle that he survived.

text: Sa nagahilapit nga All Saints Day kag All Souls Day sa Nobyembre 1 kag 2, nagapadayon ang preparasyon sang Jaro Catholic Cemetery kag iban pa nga sementeryo sa syudad, apang wala pa sang masako nga pagpanglimpyo sa subong nga tiun.
english: With the upcoming All Saints Day and All Souls Day on November 1 and 2, the preparations of the Jaro Catholic Cemetery and other cemeteries in the city continue, but there is no busy cleaning at this time.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alejandro Ordaniel, Caretaker sang Jaro Catholic Cemetery, ginpahayag niya nga sa karon daw wala pa sang kadam-an nga tawo nga nagapaninlo sa palibot sang sementeryo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alejandro Ordaniel, caretaker of the Jaro Catholic Cemetery, said that at present there are not many people cleaning around the cemetery.

text: Suno sa iya, kadam-an sang mga bisita nagapaninlo isa ka semana antes ukon inadlaw na lang ang nabilin antes ang pista minatay.
english: He said most guests clean up a week before or days before the festival dies.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga bisan pa man kun may magapaninlo subong, ginahimo gihapon nila ang pagpanglimpyo liwat kun maglapit na ang okasyon.
english: He also expressed that even if someone cleans up now, they will still do the cleaning again when the occasion approaches.

text: Ginsiling ni Ordaniel nga ang mga pribado nga pantyon responsibilidad sang tagsa ka pamilya, samtang ang mga pantyon nga malapit sa dalan ginahatagan sang tinawo para tinluan.
english: Ordaniel said private cemeteries are the responsibility of each family, while cemeteries near the road are staffed for cleaning.

text: Ginagamit man nila ang grass cutter agud mapanipis ang mga hilamon.
english: They also use the grass cutter to thin the grass.

text: May yara na man sang pila ka tawo nga nagabisita sa nasambit nga sementeryo.
english: There are also several people who visit the said cemetery.

text: Ginsorpresa ni Pope Francis ang mga tumuluo sa Vatican matapos ini nagsulod sa St.
english: Pope Francis surprised the faithful in the Vatican after he entered St.

text: Peter’s Square sakay sa iya wheelchair kag nagtamyaw sa tanan.
english: Peter’s Square in his wheelchair and greeted everyone.

text: Ini ang una nga public appearance sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa halin sang nakaguwa ini sa ospital sa Roma duha ka semana na ang nagligad.
english: It was the 88-year-old Pope's first public appearance since he was released from a hospital in Rome two weeks ago.

text: Nagpakita ang Pope sang natapos na ang misa para sa Jubilee year sang Catholic Church nga parte sang special celebration bilang pagkilala sa healthcare workers kag mga naga-balatian.
english: The Pope appeared at the end of the mass for the Jubilee year of the Catholic Church as part of a special celebration in recognition of healthcare workers and the sick.

text:
Naghinugyaw ang mga tawo sang yara na si Pope sa main altar sang main altar, nagyuhom ini, nagbayaw ini sang kamot agud tamyawon ang tanan, kag nagsiling nga “Happy Sunday to everyone, thank you so much!”

Mahinay gihapon ang tingog kag may gamay man nga hose sa iya ilong nga nagabulig sa iya pagginhawa, apang talalupangdon nga mas mabaskog na ini ipaanggid sang nagligad nga Marso 23 sang nagpakita man siya sa publiko antes magguwa sa Gemelli Hospital.
english:
The crowd cheered when the Pope was on the main altar of the main altar, he smiled, he raised his hand to greet everyone, and said “Happy Sunday to everyone, thank you so much!”

The voice is still soft and there is also a small hose in his nose to help him breathe, but it is noticeably louder compared to last March 23 when he also appeared in public before leaving Gemelli Hospital.

text: Sa kinaandan, sang maayo pa ang iya lawas, si Pope Francis gid ang nagapanguna sa noon-time prayer sa St.
english: Traditionally, when he was in good health, Pope Francis himself led the noon-time prayer at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa kada Domingo.
english: Peter’s Square every Sunday.

text: Wala na niya ini nahimo halin sang Pebrero 9 bangud sa paglain sang iya pamatyag; gindala siya sa ospital sang Pebrero 14; kag masobra isa ka bulan nga nagpabulong bangud sa bronchitis nga sang ulihi nag-develop sa double pneumonia.
english: He has not done so since February 9 due to deteriorating health; he was taken to the hospital on Feb. 14; and more than a month of treatment for bronchitis that later developed into double pneumonia.

text: Sa 38-ka-adlaw sini nga pagtinir sa ospital, una na ginpahayag sang mga doktor nga diutayan lang ini mapatay kag ginkonsiderar na sang medical team nga untaton ang treatment agud pananglitan nga matabo gid man nga mabawian ini sang kabuhi, magabiya ini nga may kalinong.
english: During his 38-day stay in the hospital, doctors had already announced that he was dying and the medical team had considered stopping treatment so that in case he died, he would leave in peace.

text: Nakaluwas ang Pope kag nakabalik na sa Vatican apang gin-abisuhan sang mga doktor nga magpahuway sang duha ka bulan kag indi anay magbaton sang dalagku nga meetings.#
english: The Pope survived and returned to the Vatican but was advised by doctors to rest for two months and not to attend large meetings.

english: Four Filipino boxers have won gold medals at the Boxam Elite International Tournament 2024 in Spain.

Magapaidalom pa ang team sa training antes ang nagahilapit nga Olympic Qualification Tournament sa Pebrero 29 tubtub sa Marso 13 sa Busto Arsizio, Italy kag isa pa ka tournament sa Bangkok, Thailand halin sa Mayo 23 tubtub sa Hunyo 3.
english:
Yerzhan Gulsaya (KAZ)

The team will undergo training before the upcoming Olympic Qualification Tournament on February 29 to March 13 in Busto Arsizio, Italy and another tournament in Bangkok, Thailand from May 23 to June 3.

text: Pananglitan may makasulod sa Paris Games, makaupod sang mga ini ang Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist nga si Eumir Felix Marcial nga amo ang labing-una nga Pinoy boxer nga naka-qualify sa Paris Olympics.#
english: If anyone qualifies for the Paris Games, they will be joined by Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist Eumir Felix Marcial who is the first Filipino boxer to qualify for the Paris Olympics.

text: ILOILO CITY–Nagpaandaman ang Police Regional Office (PRO-6) nga mahimo nga dakpon kag presuhon ang mga pulitiko nga may police escort.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Police Regional Office (PRO-6) has warned that politicians with police escorts may be arrested and imprisoned.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay P/Supt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, P/Supt.

text: Joem Malong, taghambal sang PRO-6, iya ginpahayag nga indi lamang ang mga pulitiko ang mahimo nga mapreso kundi lakip na ang police escort kag ang hepe nga naghatag sang authority.
english: Joem Malong, spokesperson of PRO-6, said that not only politicians can be jailed but also the police escort and the chief who gave the authority.

text: Suno kay Malong, mahimo lamang nga maka-apply sang police escorts ang mga incumbent politicians.
english: According to Malong, only incumbent politicians can apply for police escorts.

text: Ang mga magakandidato naman para sa May midterm elections ang mahimo nga maka-apply sa PRO-6 sang private security nga magahalin naman sa security agency.
english: Those who will be running for the May midterm elections can apply to PRO-6 for private security from the security agency.

text: Dugang pa niya, ipa-idalom pa sa threat assessment ang mga maga-apply sang escort sa diin desisyonan pa sang pulis kun bala kinahanglanon gid man ang police escort ukon indi.
english: He added that those who apply for an escort will be subjected to a threat assessment where the police will decide whether the police escort is necessary or not.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Malong sa publiko nga kun may makita nga may police escort ang pulitiko, kuhaan gid sang laragway kag ireport sa police station.
english: Malong appealed to the public that if they see a politician with a police escort, they should take pictures and report them to the police station.

text: Naghina ang bagyo Uwan samtang ginabay-bay ang kadutaan sang La Union.
english: Typhoon Uwan weakened as it passed the coast of La Union.

text: Base sa pinakaulihi nga monitoring sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), Nakita ang sentro sang bagyo sa may bisinidad sang Bagulin, La Union.
english: Based on the latest monitoring of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the center of the typhoon was found in the vicinity of Bagulin, La Union.

text: Ginalauman nga sa adlaw sang Myerkules magaabot na ini sa Taiwan Strait antes mag-land-fall sa kadutaan sang Taiwan.
english: It is expected to reach the Taiwan Strait by Wednesday before making land-fall on Taiwanese soil.

text: Suno sa PAGASA magatuga sa gihapon sang lapnagon nga pag-ulan sa dalagkuan nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: According to PAGASA, it will still cause widespread rains in large parts of Luzon.

text: Kun may mas matunog pa nga away ipaanggid sa sambuwa sang San Miguel kag Magnolia sa Game 2 sang PBA Commissioner’s Cup Finals, ini posible ang pagbaisay sa tunga nanday Hotshots forward Calvin Abueva kag asawa sang Beermen big man Mo Tautuaa nga si Aida.
english: If there is a louder fight than the one between San Miguel and Magnolia in Game 2 of the PBA Commissioner's Cup Finals, it is likely the argument between Hotshots forward Calvin Abueva and Beermen big man Mo Tautuaa's wife, Aida.

text:
Nakuhaan gid sang video ang amo nga tensyon sa tunga nanday Abueva kag asawa sini nga si Sam batok sa mga Tautuaa samtang nga paguwa na ang players kag ang ila pamilya sa Mall of Asia Arena kagab-i.

Kun si Abueva ang pahambalon, kaupod niya ang iya mga anak sang naglabay si Aida sa ila tupad.
english:
The video captured the tension between Abueva and his wife Sam against the Tautuaa as the players and their families were leaving the Mall of Asia Arena last night.

As for Abueva, she was with her children when Aida passed by.

text: Gin-alegar sini nga gin-akusaran siya ni Aida nga naga-yuhom-yuhom sa iya.
english: He alleged that Aida accused him of smiling at her.

text: Nanginit naman si Abueva kag nagpamangkot kun sin-o gid si Aida para nga yuhom-yuhoman sini.
english: Abueva became angry and asked who Aida was so that she could smile at him.

text: “Ewan ko sa kanya.
english: “I don’t know about him.

text: Dumaan siya dito (habang) hinihintay ko ‘yung anak ko and then tinanong niya ako.
english: He passed by here (while) I was waiting for my son and then he asked me.

text: Sino ka para i-smile ko ‘yan, ha, sino ‘yon, ha?
english: Who are you to make me smile, ha, who is that, ha?

text: Tapos nandiyan ‘yung mga anak ko tapos nagga-ganyan siya?
english: Then here are my children and he's doing that?

text: Dumaan ako nang maayos,” suno kay Abueva.
english: I'm going to be fine,” Abueva said.

text: Nag-post naman si Aida kasunod sang insidente agud nga ipaathag ang iya bahin.
english: Aida posted following the incident to explain her side.

text: Pahayag sini, wala siya pisikal nga gin-atake ni Abueva.
english: He said Abueva did not physically attack him.

text: Ang natabo suno sa iya — naglabay siya sa tupad ni Abueva agud magkadto sa restroom, apang nakit-an niya nga nag-smirk ang lalaki, naga-tango-tango, kag nagakadlaw pa.
english: What happened, he said — he walked past Abueva to go to the restroom, only to see the man smirk, nodding his head, and even laughing.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa ginpamangkot niya ang player kun naano ini kag nagpadayon siya sa paglakat apang ginsundan siya ni Abueva kag ginkumpronta.
english: This is why he asked the player what was wrong and he continued walking but Abueva followed him and confronted him.

text: “I had to walk past him to go to the restroom.
english: “I had to walk past him to go to the restroom.

text: He smirked at me, nodded his head up and down and said, “yeaaa” laughing.
english: He smirked at me, nodded his head up and down and said, “yeaaa” laughing.

text: I said ‘wtf is wrong with you’ and kept walking.
english: I said ‘wtf is wrong with you’ and kept walking.

text: He walked after me and literally got in my face,” post ni Aida sa X (anay Twitter).
english: He walked after me and literally got in my face,” Aida posted on X (formerly Twitter).

text: Makit-an man sa video ang asawa ni Abueva nga si Sam nga gin-depensahan ang iya bana kag nag-lecture pa nga bilang mga asawa, indi pwede bastuson ang sin-o man nga players.
english: The video also shows Abueva's wife, Sam, defending her husband and lecturing him that as wives, they should not be rude to any players.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga ginbastos gid kag wala gintahod ni Aida ang amo nga basketball veteran.
english: He also said that Aida was very rude and disrespectful to the basketball veteran.

text: Nakit-an man nga nagpatunga pa ang MOA Arena security, PBA officials kag mangin ang active consultant sang San Miguel nga si Leo Austria agud nga indi na magsaka pa ang tensyon sang ginhangkat na ni Abueva si Tautuaa nga magtapungulay na lang bangud sa “bastos” nga ginhimo sang asawa sini.
english: MOA Arena security, PBA officials and even San Miguel's active consultant Leo Austria intervened to prevent tensions from escalating when Abueva challenged Tautuaa to fight over his wife's “rude” actions.

text: Ginahulat ang mangin statement sang PBA kasunod sang insidente.
english: The PBA's statement is awaited following the incident.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga may nakaaway si Abueva nga partner sang basketball player.
english: This is not the first time Abueva has had a fight with a basketball player's partner.

text: Sang 2019, ginmultahan man ini sang P20,000 kag ginsuspinde bangud sa ginpahayag nga bastos man nga gestures sa anay partner ni Ray Parks nga si Maika Rivera.
english: In 2019, he was also fined P20,000 and suspended for allegedly rude gestures towards Ray Parks' former partner Maika Rivera.

text: Sa Game 2 sang PBA finals kagab-i, nangibabaw ang Beermen batok sa Hotshots, 109-85, kag napasaka na sa 2-0 ang lead sa serye.#
english: In Game 2 of the PBA finals last night, the Beermen won against the Hotshots, 109-85, to take a 2-0 lead in the series.

text: ILOILO CITY–Maga-umpisa sa pagpatigayun sang COMELEC checkpoint ang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6  sa maabot nga Enero 12.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 will start conducting COMELEC checkpoints on January 12.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa pagpatuman sang COMELEC gunban sa Enero 13 sa pag-umpisa sang election period.
english: This is in connection with the implementation of the COMELEC gunban on January 13 at the beginning of the election period.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay P/Supt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, P/Supt.

text: Joem Malong, taghambal sang PRO 6, iya ginpahayag nga obligado ang tanan nga unit sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga magpatigayun sang checkpoint.
english: Joem Malong, spokesperson of PRO 6, said all units of the Philippine National Police (PNP) are obliged to conduct checkpoints.

text: Sa Enero 13 sang  aga, may yara sang patigayunon nga unity walk sa bag-o nga grandstand lakip na ang covenant signing kaupod sang mga magakandidato sa eleksyon.
english: On January 13 morning, there will be a unity walk at the new grandstand including a covenant signing with the election candidates.

text: Samtang, may yara man sang suspension sang permit to carry firearms outside residence suno kay Malong bangud sa pagpatuman sang total gunban.
english: Meanwhile, there is also a suspension of the permit to carry firearms outside residence, Malong said, due to the implementation of the total gunban.

text: Ang PNP kag ang Philippine Army ang naga-apply sang certificate of authority agud makadala sang armas.
english: The PNP and the Philippine Army are applying for a certificate of authority to carry firearms.

text: Magluwas sa uniformed personnel, ang mahimo lang maka-apply sang exemption suno kay Malong ang ginalakipan sang  security guards kag mga pulitiko.
english: Aside from uniformed personnel, those who can apply for exemption, Malong said, include security guards and politicians.

text: Nasapwan nga isa na ka bangkay ang isa ka dalagita nga duha ka adlaw na nga nadula sa Panabo, Davao del Norte.
english: A young woman who went missing for two days in Panabo, Davao del Norte has been found dead.

text: Suno sa otoridad, Hunyo 13 pa sang na-missing ang 13-anyos nga biktima nga ginapatihan nga gin-anod sa suba sa Barangay Datu Abdul.
english: According to the authorities, the 13-year-old victim, believed to have been drowned in the river in Barangay Datu Abdul, went missing on June 13.

text: Sang Domingo, gin-report sang isa ka residente sa lugar nga may nakit-an nga lawas sang babay sa suba kag nakumpirma nga ini amo ang missing nga dalagita.
english: On Sunday, a resident in the area reported that a woman’s body had been found in the river and it was confirmed that she was the missing girl.

text: Nagbuya ang English singer-songwriter nga si Ed Sheeran nga maga-untat na ini sa paghimo sang music kun mapamatud-an nga guilty sa pagkopya sang kanta nga Let’s Get In On nga gin-compose sang classic singer-songwriter nga si Marvin Gaye.
english: English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran has threatened to stop making music if found guilty of copying the song Let's Get In On composed by classic singer-songwriter Marvin Gaye.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagka-dismaya nga iya ginpabutyag samtang nagapadayon ang copyright trial sa New York matapos gin-akusaran nga gin-plagiarize ang pyesa ni Gaye kag gingamit man ni Sheeran sa kanta nga Thinking Out Loud nga nangin hit umpisa sang 2014.
english: This follows the frustration he expressed as the copyright trial continued in New York after being accused of plagiarizing Gaye's piece and also using Sheeran in the song Thinking Out Loud, which became a hit since 2014.

text: Kun malutos si Sheeran sa amo nga copyright case, may yara sang second trial nga patigayunon nga amo ang magatumod sa kantidad nga iya bayaran sa Townsend family.
english: If Sheeran loses the copyright case, there will be a second trial that will determine the amount he will pay to the Townsend family.

text: Ang nagpasaka sang kaso nga plagiarism batok sa 32-anyos nga singer-performer amo ang heirs ni Ed Townsend nga amo ang nag-upod kay Gaye nga nagsulat sang amo nga 1973 hit.
english: Filing plagiarism charges against the 32-year-old singer-performer are the heirs of Ed Townsend who co-wrote that 1973 hit with Gaye.

text: Ini amo ang anak ni Townsend nga si Kathryn Townsend Griffin, iya utod nga si Helen McDonald, kag estate sang iya anay asawa nga si Cherrigale Townsend.
english: These are Townsend’s daughter Kathryn Townsend Griffin, his sister Helen McDonald, and the estate of his ex-wife Cherrigale Townsend.

text:
“I find it really insulting to devote my whole life to being a performer and a songwriter and have someone diminish it,” pahayag ni Sheeran, kag kun mapamatud-an nga guilty siya, “I’m done — I’m stopping.”

Indi ini ang una nga bes nga napasabak sa korte si Sheeran bangud sa iya trabaho bilang singer.
english:
“I find it really insulting to devote my whole life to being a performer and a songwriter and have someone diminish it,” Sheeran said, adding that if he is found guilty, “I’m done — I’m stopping.”

This is not the first time Sheeran has been in court over his work as a singer.

text: Sang una, napasakaan man ini sang kaso sa iya nga kanta nga Shape Of You apang siya ang nagdaog sa amo nga trial.
english: In the past, he was also sued for his song Shape Of You but he won the trial.

text: Nahibaluan nga samtang yara sa tunga sang kontrobersiya sa copyright infringement, una na nga ginpahayag ni Sheeran nga ipaguwa sini ang album nga ginatig-uluhan nga Subtract sa Mayo 5.
english: It is known that while in the midst of the copyright infringement controversy, Sheeran has previously announced that he will release the album titled Subtract on May 5.

text: Mas naglapit pa ang San Miguel Beermen sa kampyonato sa PBA Commissioner’s Cup matapos sini ginkamasaan ang Magnolia Hotshots sa Game 2 sang best-of-seven finals series, 108-85, sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: The San Miguel Beermen moved closer to the PBA Commissioner's Cup championship after beating the Magnolia Hotshots in Game 2 of the best-of-seven finals series, 108-85, at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Kun sang Game 1 diutayan lang nga ma-uyang ang double-digit lead sang Beermen antes natigayon nga malutos sini ang Hotshots, mas nangin hugot ang ila pagbantay sa Game 2 tubtub gid sa tion nga ila nabatian ang final buzzer.
english: If in Game 1 the Beermen almost lost their double-digit lead before they managed to beat the Hotshots, they were more vigilant in Game 2 until the moment they heard the final buzzer.

text: Sa kadalag-an sang San Miguel kag pag-abanse sa serye, 2-0, napalawig man ang ila nga winning streak sa 11 kun isipon pati ang halin sa elimination round.
english: With the victory of San Miguel and advance in the series, 2-0, their winning streak was also extended to 11 if including those from the elimination round.

text: Nagpanguna sa team ang import nga si Bennie Boatwright nga may 34 puntos samtang ang Best Player of the Conference contender naman nga si CJ Perez ang nakabubo sang 20 puntos.
english: Import Bennie Boatwright led the team with 34 points while Best Player of the Conference contender CJ Perez poured in 20 points.

text: Naka-19 puntos man si June Mar Fajardo sa amo nga hampang.
english: June Mar Fajardo also scored 19 points in the game.

text: Kabug-usan nga 16 ka tres ang napaulan sang San Miguel kag pito naman ang iya sang Magnolia.
english: A total of 16 trees were rained in San Miguel and seven in Magnolia.

text:
Balantayan ang ikatatlo nga game sang series sa Mierkules, Pebrero 7, 7:30 PM, sa Araneta Coliseum sa Quezon City.#

(Photo: PBA)
english:
Watch the third game of the series on Wednesday, February 7, 7:30 PM, at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.#

(Photo: PBA)

text: ILOILO CITY–May yara na sang security plan ang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) bilang pagpanghanda sa maabot nga election period.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Philippine National Police (PNP) and Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) have a security plan in preparation for the upcoming election period.

text: Sa  interview sang Bombo Radyo kay  P/Supt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, P/Supt.

text: Joem Malong, taghambal sang Police Regional Office (PRO)-6 iya ginpahayag nga  may napirmahan na nga joint security plan ang PNP kag AFP.
english: Joem Malong, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office (PRO)-6, said the PNP and AFP have already signed a joint security plan.

text: Lakip man sa na-istoryahan sa ginpatigayun nga pagsinapol sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC) suno kay Malong amo ang mga comelec resolutions kag mga dapat nga  igapatuman sang PNP sa pagahiwatun nga piniliay.
english: Among the issues discussed during the meeting with the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), Malong said, were the Comelec resolutions and the implementation of the PNP in the upcoming elections.

text: May yara naman nga mga lugar nga natumod nga election hot spot kun sa diin may yara sang 23 ka na lakip sa yellow category ukon may yara sang political rivalry, apat sa red category ukon mga lugar nga may yara sang intense political rivalry, armed groups kag insurhensya, 97 sa green category  ukon areas with no concern kag siyam naman sa orange category nga may yara sang political rivalry kag presensya sang rebelde nga grupo.
english: There are also areas identified as election hot spots where there are 23 in the yellow category or there is political rivalry, four in the red category or areas with intense political rivalry, armed groups and insurgency, 97 in the green category or areas with no concern and one in the orange category. presence of the rebel group.

text: Pahayag pa ni Malong nga pagatutukan nila ang deployment agud mapasiguro nga mangin matalunsay ang pagpatigayon sang 2019 midterm elections.
english: Malong said they will focus on deployment to ensure the smooth conduct of the 2019 midterm elections.

text: Patuloy na tatahakin ng bagyo ang karagatan ng La Union hanggang umabot sa West Philippine Sea at mananatili ang lakas nito hanggang Nobyembre 11.
english: The typhoon will continue to hit La Union until it reaches the West Philippine Sea and will remain strong until November 11.

text: Inaasahan na sa araw ng Miyerkules ay maabot na ito sa Taiwan Strait bago mag-landfall sa kalupaan ng Taiwan.
english: It is expected to reach the Taiwan Strait on Wednesday before making landfall on the mainland of Taiwan.

text: Ibinabala ng PAGASA na magdudulot pa rin ng malawakang pag-ulan sa malaking bahagi ng Luzon.
english: PAGASA warned that it will continue to bring widespread rains in most parts of Luzon.

text: Wala sang daku nga epekto kag halit nga nabilin sa Western Visayas ang 7.4 magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa Manay, Davao Oriental kahapon sang aga, Oktubre 10.
english: The 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck Manay, Davao Oriental yesterday morning, October 10, did not leave much impact or damage in Western Visayas.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Office of Civil Defense (OCD) Region 6 Director Raul Fernandez sandig man sa nabaton nga mga report sang talatapan.
english: This was confirmed by Office of Civil Defense (OCD) Region 6 Director Raul Fernandez based on reports received by the office.

text: Pahayag sini, lunsay precautionary measures ang ginhimo kaangay sang kanselasyon sang klase kag mga suspension sang trabaho pareho sa ginhimo sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He said all precautionary measures were taken such as the cancellation of classes and suspensions of work as was done in Iloilo City.

text: Matandaan nga Intensity III ang nabatyagan sa Iloilo City; Intensity II sa Northern Iloilo; kag Intensity I naman sa probinsya sang Capiz.
english: Intensity III was felt in Iloilo City; Intensity II in Northern Iloilo; and Intensity I in Capiz province.

text: Nagpahanumdom ang direktor nga katungdanan sang lokal nga panguluhan nga siguruhon kag i-check nga mabakod ang mga estruktura agud makalikaw sa trahedya.
english: The director reminded that it is the duty of the local government unit to ensure and check that the structures are strong to avoid tragedy.

text: Magluwas diri, nagpanawagan man ini sang aktibo nga partisipasyon kun may yara sang Nationwide Simultaneous Earthquake Drill (NSED) nga ginahimo sa kada tatlo ka bulan sa Pilipinas.
english: In addition, he also called for active participation when there is a Nationwide Simultaneous Earthquake Drill (NSED) that is held every three months in the Philippines.

text: Ini amo ang pagpreparar sang ahensya sa mga tawo ilabi na sa posible pag-abot sang ‘The Big One’ ukon ang potensyal nga 7.2 magnitude nga linog.
english: This is to prepare the agency people especially for the possible arrival of ‘The Big One’ or the potential 7.2 magnitude earthquake.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa latest report sang DOST-PHIVOLCS, nagdangat na sa 808 aftershocks ang na-rekord kasunod sang magkasunod nga linog sa Davao Oriental.
english: According to the latest report of DOST-PHIVOLCS, 808 aftershocks were recorded following the consecutive earthquakes in Davao Oriental.

text: 13 sa sini nga aftershocks ang nabatyagan gid suno sa ahensya.
english: 13 of these aftershocks were felt, the agency said.

text: Naglab-ot naman sa 5.8 ang pinakamabaskog nga na-rekord.
english: The strongest recorded was 5.8.

text: Una na ginpahayag sang Phivolcs nga mahimo makonsiderar nga “doublet earthquake” ang natabo.#
english: Earlier, the Phivolcs said the quake could be considered a doublet earthquake.

text: Hulaton anay sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga matapos na ang harvest season sa bombay antes tun-an kun kinahanglan nga mag-import.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will wait until the end of the harvest season in Bombay before studying whether to import.

text: Marso tubtub Abril ang peak sang harvest sa sini nga produkto gani suno kay DA Spokesperson Assistant Arnel De Mesa, lantawon anay ang kabug-usan nga maani antes ang pag-rekomendar sang importasyon [kun kinahanglanon].
english: March to April is the peak harvest for this product so according to DA Spokesperson Assistant Arnel De Mesa, the total harvest will be looked at before recommending importation [if necessary].

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Philippine Chamber of Agriculture and Food Inc.
english: Earlier, the Philippine Chamber of Agriculture and Food Inc.

text: nga posible nga mag-import ang Pilipinas sang tubtub sa 60,000 metric tons sang bombay bangud daku ang halit sang harabas ukon armyworm infestation sa mga plantasyon diri sa pungsod.
english: that the Philippines is likely to import up to 60,000 metric tons of bombay because of the severe damage caused by the harabas or armyworm infestation in plantations in the country.

text: Apang suno naman sa DA, 18 ka ektarya lamang sa 10,000 hectares sang onion plantations sa Central Luzon ang nakaangkon sang total damage bangud sa harabas nga ginpalala pa sang El Niño.
english: However, according to the DA, only 18 hectares of the 10,000 hectares of onion plantations in Central Luzon suffered total damage due to the drought exacerbated by El Niño.

text: Sa latest nga monitoring sang ahensya, ang market price sang pula ka puti nga bombay ang nagatupa na sa P80 nga P20 nga mas manubo ipaanggid sa P100 nga na-monitor sang nagligad nga semana.#
english: In the latest monitoring of the agency, the market price of red and white bombay has fallen to P80 which is P20 lower compared to P100 monitored last week.

text: Mas ginpasadig sang Poland ang preparasyon sini para sa possible direkta nga gyera batok sa Russia.
english: Poland has stepped up its preparations for a possible direct war against Russia.

text: Ini ang sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga giyera sa Ukraine kag Russia.
english: This is in the middle of the ongoing war with Ukraine and Russia.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler, International correspondent sa Poland, ginkumpirma sang mga opisyal sa Warsaw nga plano sang gobyerno nga maglunsyar sang boluntaryo nga military training para sa tanan nga mga may edad nga lalaki kag padamuon ang numero sang mga soldado kag reservists sa 500,000.
english: According to Bombo Neva Intrepido Kessler, International correspondent in Poland, officials in Warsaw confirmed that the government plans to launch voluntary military training for all adult men and increase the number of soldiers and reservists to 500,000.

text: Lakip man sa plano ang pagpain sang dako nga budget sa depensa kag pagganyat sa mga kaupod nga pungsod sa North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) nga magpataas man sang ila defense budget.
english: The plan also includes allocating a large budget for defense and encouraging fellow North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) countries to increase their defense budgets as well.

text: Matandaan nga humalin sang nag-ibwal ang full-scale invasion sang Russia sa Ukraine sang Pebrero 2022, gin-umpisahan na ang Poland ang mas aktibo nga preparasyon sang militar.
english: It can be recalled that since the outbreak of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Poland has initiated more active military preparations.

text: ILOILO CITY–Nag-withdraw sang iya kandidatura sa pagka congressman sa 1st district sa probinsya sang Iloilo si incumbent Cong.
english: ILOILO CITY–Incumbent Cong.

text: Richard Garin.
english: Richard Garin.

text: Sa pinaka-ulihi nga adlaw sang withdrawal and substitution period sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC), si Cong.
english: On the last day of the withdrawal and substitution period of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), Cong.

text: Garin ang pinaka-ulihi nga nagpasa sang Statement of Cancellation and Withdrawal.
english: Garin was the last to submit a Statement of Cancellation and Withdrawal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garin, iya ginpahayag nga ang iya nangin desisyon ang ginkasugtan sanga ila pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garin said his decision was agreed upon by his family.

text: Ang opisyal nga kandidato sa pagka mamalidha sa 1st district amo ang iya tiayon nga si anay Health Sec.
english: The official candidate for lawmaker in the 1st district is his wife, former Health Sec.

text: Janette Garin sa idalom sang Nacionalista Party (NP).
english: Janette Garin under the Nacionalista Party (NP).

text: Nahibalu-an nga tatlo ka katapo sang pamilya Garin ang nagpasa sang Certificate of Candidacy (COC) sa pagkamamalidha nga ginalakipan nanday Cong.
english: It was learned that three members of the Garin family submitted their Certificate of Candidacy (COC) for the legislative seat including Cong.

text: Richard Garin, anay Health Sec.
english: Richard Garin, former Health Sec.

text: Janette Garin kag ang patriach sang Garin family nga si Guimbal Mayor Oscar Garin.
english: Janette Garin and the patriach of the Garin family, Guimbal Mayor Oscar Garin.

text: Ginreport sang World Bank nga naga-igod gihapon ang Pilipinas ipaanggid sa iban nga Southeast Asian countries kun internet connectivity ang pagahambalan.
english: The World Bank reported that the Philippines still lags behind other Southeast Asian countries when it comes to internet connectivity.

text: Sa ‘Better Internet for All Filipinos’ 2024 report, nakasaad nga ang internet sa Pilipinas ang naga-lag sa affordability kag speed kag access rason nga indi man patas ang digital participation.
english: In the 'Better Internet for All Filipinos' 2024 report, it is stated that the internet in the Philippines lags in affordability and speed and access which is why digital participation is not equal.

text: Bangud sini, ginalantaw nga nagakabalabagan ang digital potential sang mga tawo kag mga negosyo — isa ka “growth opportunity” nga nawasi sang mga Pinoy.
english: As a result, the digital potential of people and businesses is seen as being hindered — a “growth opportunity” that Filipinos have missed.

text: Sa fixed broadband, halimbawa, ang average speed sa Pilipinas ang yara lamang sa 92Mbps — mas manubo sa 264Mbps sa Singapore, 216Mbps sang Thailand, 112Mbps sang Malaysia, 105Mbps sang Vietnam, kag 94Mbps sang Brunei.
english: On fixed broadband, for example, the average speed in the Philippines is only at 92Mbps — lower than Singapore’s 264Mbps, Thailand’s 216Mbps, Malaysia’s 112Mbps, Vietnam’s 105Mbps, and Brunei’s 94Mbps.

text: Ang mas manubo naman nga speeds amo ang iya sang Indonesia, Laos, Cambodia, kag Myanmar.
english: The lower speeds are those of Indonesia, Laos, Cambodia, and Myanmar.

text: Yara naman sa 33% ang penetration sang fixed broadband access sa Pilipinas nga mas manubo sa 111 percent sa Singapore, 108 percent sa Brunei, 76 percent sa Vietnam, 58 percent sa Thailand, kag 50 percent sa Malaysia.
english: The penetration of fixed broadband access in the Philippines is 33%, lower than 111 percent in Singapore, 108 percent in Brunei, 76 percent in Vietnam, 58 percent in Thailand, and 50 percent in Malaysia.

text: Apang kun presyo sang fixed broadband ang pagahambalan, pinakamataas sa rehiyon ang Pilipinas nga yara sa 11.3 percent sang gross national income (GNI) per capita.
english: However, when it comes to the price of fixed broadband, the Philippines is the highest in the region at 11.3 percent of the gross national income (GNI) per capita.

text: Ang mobile broadband figures ang nag-report sang kaangay man nga rankings kun sa diin ang Pilipinas ang may pinakamahinay nga mobile download speed apang mas mahal ipaanggid sa iban nga mga pungsod sa Southeast Asia.
english: The mobile broadband figures reported similar rankings with the Philippines having the slowest mobile download speed but more expensive compared to other Southeast Asian countries.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Department of Information and Communication Technology (DICT) Secretary Ivan John Uy nga naga-implementar na ang ahensya sang nagkalain-lain nga mga programa agud nga madala ang libre nga internet connectivity sa nabaw-ing nga mga lugar.#
english: Earlier, DICT Secretary Ivan John Uy said the agency is already implementing various programs to bring free internet connectivity to the affected areas.

text: Wala nasaksihan sang football fans ang madugay na ginakalangkagan nga liwat nga pag-atubangay sa pitch sang duha ka all-time greatest players nga sanday Lionel Messi sang Argentina kag Christiano Ronaldo sang Portugal.
english: Football fans did not witness the long-awaited reunion on the pitch between the two all-time greatest players, Lionel Messi of Argentina and Christiano Ronaldo of Portugal.

text: Ini bangud sa pre-season friendly game sang club ni Messi nga Inter Miami batok sa Al-Nassr nga club ni Ronaldo sa Saudi Arabia kaina gid lamang sa kaagahon, Pebrero 2 (oras sa Pilipinas), wala nakahampang si Ronaldo bangud sa injury.
english: This is because in the pre-season friendly game of Messi's club Inter Miami against Ronaldo's Al-Nassr club in Saudi Arabia just yesterday morning, February 2 (Philippine time), Ronaldo did not play due to injury.

text: Ginbangko man si Messi sa masobra isa ka oras kag ginpasulod lamang sa hampang sang ika-83 nga minuto na sang match.
english: Messi was also benched for more than an hour and was only introduced in the 83rd minute.

text: Apisar pa nga nakasulod na si Messi, wala na sini nga nasapar nga luwason ang Inter Miami nga wala gid naka-skor sa bilog nga hampang.
english: Although Messi came in, he didn't manage to save Inter Miami who didn't score in the whole game.

text: 6-0 ang skor kun sa diin tatlo ang goals sang Al Nassr sa first half kag tatlo man sa second half.
english: The score was 6-0 with Al Nassr scoring three goals in the first half and three in the second half.

text: Kabahin ini sang Riyadh Season Cup kag isa ka friendly match apang nangin intense sa imbukada pa lamang rason nga tatlo gid ka players ang ginpaguwa-an sang yellow cards bangud sang kumprontasyon sa tunga sang field.
english: It was part of the Riyadh Season Cup and a friendly match but it became intense in the opening ceremony and three players were issued yellow cards due to a confrontation in the middle of the field.

text: Tatlo na ka pre-season games nga sunod-sunod ang kalutusan sang Miami.
english: Miami has lost three consecutive pre-season games.

text: Ang nauna amo anga 4-3 nga kahuy-anan sa kamot sang Al-Hilal kag ang 1-0 reverse batok sa FC Dallas.
english: The previous was a 4-3 humiliation at the hands of Al-Hilal and a 1-0 reverse against FC Dallas.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang American club ang team sang Hong Kong sa isa man ka friendly game.
english: The American club will next face the Hong Kong team in another friendly game.

text: Ang Al Nassr – nga palapit na sa mid-season break – ang maga-atubang sa Al-Hilal sa masunod nga semana.
english: Al Nassr – approaching the mid-season break – face Al-Hilal next week.

text:
LAST DANCE KUNTANI

Ini kuntani ang ginalantaw sang fans nga Last Dance kun sa diin atubangay sanday Ronaldo kag Messi.
english:
LAST DANCE WOULD BE

This was supposed to be the Last Dance where Ronaldo and Messi faced each other.

text: Kilala ang duha bilang pinakadaku nga magkasumpong sa football sa sulod sang masobra isa na ka dekada — una nga nagsambuwa sang 2008 sang ginlutos sang Manchester United ang Barcelona sa Champions League semi-finals kag nasundan pa sang 34 ka mga okasyon kun sa diin 16 ka beses nga nagdaog ang Argentine star, 10 ka beses ang Portuguese star, kag siyam ang nagtapos sa draw.
english: The two have been known as football's greatest rivals for more than a decade — they first met in 2008 when Manchester United beat Barcelona in the Champions League semi-finals and followed on 34 occasions with the Argentine stars winning 16 times, the Portuguese stars 10 times, and the Portuguese stars ending in a draw.

text: Sa prestihiyoso nga Ballon d’Or awards, walo ang gina-uyatan sang 36-anyos nga si Messi samtang may lima naman ang iya 38-anyos nga Portuguese opponent.
english: Of the prestigious Ballon d'Or awards, the 36-year-old Messi holds eight while his 38-year-old Portuguese opponent has five.

text: Matapos nakadaog sa World Cup sa Qatar sang 2022, naghalin si Messi sa French club nga Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), nagsaylo sa Inter-Miami — indi daku nga team sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika — apang natigayon nga nakadaog sa Leagues Cup nga amo ang labing-una nga tropeo sang club.
english: After winning the World Cup in Qatar in 2022, Messi left French club Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), moved to Inter-Miami — not a big team in the United States of America — but managed to win the Leagues Cup which is the club’s premier trophy.

text: Si Ronaldo naman ang nagpirma sa Al-Nassr sang Saudi Pro League matapos nga nagbiya ini sa Manchester United.
english: Ronaldo signed for Al-Nassr of the Saudi Pro League after leaving Manchester United.

text: Matandaan nga sini nga 2023, nakaatubangay man sanday Messi kag Ronaldo sa friendly match sa Saudi Pro League XI.
english: It can be recalled that this 2023, Messi and Ronaldo will also face each other in a friendly match in the Saudi Pro League XI.

text: Ipadala sang Czech Republic ang ila nga agriculture officials sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga semana agud nga maka-establisar sang mas masangkad nga kooperasyon sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod nga amo man ang makasuporta sa food security programs.
english: The Czech Republic will send its agriculture officials to the Philippines next week to establish closer cooperation between the two countries that will also support food security programs.

text: Magapanguna sa delegasyon amo si Czech Agriculture Minister Marek Výborný.
english: The delegation will be led by Czech Agriculture Minister Marek Výborný.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini kadungan sang pagkit-anay nanday President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: This was announced during a meeting between President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kag President Petr Pavel sa amo nga European country.
english: and President Petr Pavel in that European country.

text: Lakip man sa dal-on sa Pilipinas amo ang mga negosyante nga posible mangin interesado man sa pag-invest sa agrikultura kag iban pa nga sektor.
english: Also among those brought to the Philippines are businessmen who may be interested in investing in agriculture and other sectors.

text: Lakip man sa namensyonar nga mga kumpaniya amo ang involved sa defense industry, manufacturing, science, technology, energy sector, kag power sector.
english: Also among the companies mentioned are those involved in the defense industry, manufacturing, science, technology, energy sector, and power sector.

text: Suno sa Presidential Communications Office, magapakigkita si Minister Výborný kay Department of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel kag may patigayunon man nga business forum sa Makati sa Marso 21.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office, Minister Výborný will meet with Department of Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel and will also hold a business forum in Makati on March 21.

text: Magabisita man ang grupo sa Davao para sa business forum kag farm visit sa Tagum Agricultural Development Company, Inc.(Tadeco) sa Davao pagkasunod nga adlaw.
english: The group will also visit Davao for a business forum and farm visit at Tagum Agricultural Development Company, Inc. (Tadeco) in Davao the next day.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ang Czech Republic sa daku nga mga partner sang Pilipinas nga nagahatag sang assistance sa pag-analisar kag pagpaayo pa sang value chains sa dairy industry sang pungsod.
english: The Czech Republic is one of the Philippines' major partners in providing assistance in analyzing and improving value chains in the country's dairy industry.

text: Didto subong si President Marcos kag ang delegasyon sang Pilipinas sa kapital sang pungsod nga Prague para sa tatlo ka adlaw nga state visit.#
english: President Marcos and the Philippine delegation are currently in the country's capital Prague for a three-day state visit.

text: Patay ang 63-anyos nga empleyado sang House of Representatives matapos gintiro sang wala pa makilala nga mga indibidwal samtang nagatambong ini sa selebrasyon sang kaadlawan sang iya anak sa Commonwealth, Quezon City.
english: A 63-year-old employee of the House of Representatives was shot dead by unidentified individuals while attending his son's birthday celebration in Commonwealth, Quezon City.

text: Natabo ang krimen kahapon, Hunyo 15, ginabanta las-tres sang hapon.
english: The crime occurred yesterday, June 15, around 3 pm.

text: Sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, duha ka mga tawo ang nagsulod sa venue kag gintiro ang biktima.
english: According to initial investigation, two men entered the venue and shot the victim.

text: Madasig nga nalagyo ang mga suspek sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The suspects quickly fled the scene on a motorcycle.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang lalaki nga biktima apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: The male victim was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Ginapaeksplekar sang chairman sang Committee on Engineering and Public Works ang City Engineer’s Office parte sa mga materyales nga gingamit sa kontrobersyal nga proyekto sang overpass sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao kag waiting shed sa Katilingban, Molo.
english: The chairman of the Committee on Engineering and Public Works explains to the City Engineer's Office about the materials used in the controversial overpass project in Diversion Road, Mandurriao and waiting shed in Katilingban, Molo.

text: Ini nga mga proyekto ginpasuni nga overpriced, rason nga ginapaimbestigar sang konseho kag ginapareview sang alkalde.
english: These projects are allegedly overpriced, which is why the council is investigating and reviewing the mayor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Johnny Young, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadala na sila sang inquiry sa City Engineer’s Office kag nagahulat sang sabat parte sa status sang proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Johnny Young said they have already sent an inquiry to the City Engineer's Office and are waiting for a response on the status of the project.

text: Suno sa iya, ila man i-update ang publiko kun ano ang natabo, pila ang cost sang proyekto, ano ang scope of work, kag ano nga mga materyales ang gingamit.
english: He said they will also update the public on what happened, how much the project cost, what the scope of work was, and what materials were used.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga indi siya contractor ukon engineer, gani indi siya makahatag sang konklusyon kon overpriced guid ang presyo.
english: He also said that he is not a contractor or engineer, so he cannot give a conclusion if the price is overpriced.

text: Matandaan nga nagabalor 4.1-million pesos ang ‘roofing kag improvement’ sang overpass sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao.
english: It can be recalled that the roofing and improvement of the overpass in Diversion Road, Mandurriao is worth 4.1-million pesos.

text: Base sa dokumento sang proyekto, ang scope of works sang overpass nagalakip sang temporary facilities, electrical system, signages, security, kag enclosure sang site nga may kantidad nga P280,600.00.
english: Based on the project document, the scope of works of the overpass includes temporary facilities, electrical system, signage, security, and enclosure of the site in the amount of P280,600.00.

text: May yara man sang Construction Safety and Health Program nga nagabalor P195,200.00, scaffolding kag safety precaution nga P461,763.90, roof kag roof framing upod ang painting works nga P1,418,170.70, steel works nga P659,044.00, tile works nga P412,689.40, repainting sang existing steel railings nga P137,506.20, plumbing kag sanitary lines nga P100,723.20, kag electrical works para sa LED lights nga P450,000.00; para sa improvement sang overpass sa Diversion.
english: There is also a Construction Safety and Health Program worth P195,200.00, scaffolding and safety precaution worth P461,763.90, roof and roof framing along with painting works worth P1,418,170.70, steel works worth P659,044,000, tile works worth P459,040.60. repainting of existing steel railings of P137,506.20, plumbing and sanitary lines of P100,723.20, and electrical works for LED lights of P450,000.00; for overpass improvement at Diversion.

text: Padayon pa ang paghulat sang sabat halin sa City Engineer’s Office kag ang pagreview sang mga opisyal sang syudad agud masiguro nga husto kag patas ang paggamit sang pondo sang gobyerno lokal.
english: We are still waiting for a response from the City Engineer's Office and a review by city officials to ensure that the local government funds are used properly and fairly.

text: ILOILO CITY–Tuman ang kalipay nga nabatyagan ni Senador Loren Legarda sa nangin desisyon sang Election Registration Board (ERB) sang Antique nga nagapahanugot sa iya nga magkandidato sa pagkakongresista sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: ILOILO CITY – Senator Loren Legarda is very happy with the decision of the Election Registration Board (ERB) of Antique to allow her to run for congressman in the said area.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpasakaan ang Senadora sang disqualification case sang duha ka kasumpong sa pagka Congressman nga sanday anay Antique Gov.
english: This is after the senator was filed a disqualification case by two of her opponents for Congressman, former Antique Gov.

text: Exequiel “Boy Ex” Javier kag Atty. Boy Robin Rubinos.
english: Exequiel “Boy Ex” Javier and Atty. Boy Robin Rubinos.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Sen.

text: Lergarda, iya ginpahayag nga nagpabor sa iya ang ERB gani tuman gid ang iya nga pagpasalamat sa Commission on Elections (Comelec), Local Registrar kag sa Department of Education (DepEd).
english: Lergarda, he said that the ERB favored him and he is very grateful to the Commission on Elections (Comelec), Local Registrar and the Department of Education (DepEd).

text: Suno kay Sen.
english: According to Sen.

text: Legarda, napamatud-an niya nga tumandok siya sang Pandan, Antique.
english: Legarda, he proved that he is a native of Pandan, Antique.

text: Ginpanindugan man sang Senadora nga wala sang mangin upang sa iya nga pagkandidato bilang kongresista sa  Antique.
english: The senator also insisted that there will be no obstacle to her candidacy as congresswoman in Antique.

text: Una na nga nagpanawagan si Javier sa senadora nga mag-atras na lang bilang kongresista sa Antique.
english: Earlier, Javier called on the senator to step down as a congresswoman in Antique.

text: Ini bangud nga ang Senadora ang pumuluyo sang Malabon City kag indi sa Pandan, Antique.
english: This is because the Senator is a resident of Malabon City and not Pandan, Antique.

text: Ginapakakas sa pwesto ang duha ka opisyal sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 2 matapos sila nga makuhaan sang video nga nangtampa kag nangsipa sang menor de edad sang namablidad ang kaupod sini nga babaye nga singer nga magpalapit sa ila sa Tuguegarao, Cagayan.
english: Two officials of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 2 are being fired after they were caught on video slapping and kicking a minor when his female singer companion approached them in Tuguegarao, Cagayan.

text: Makit-an sa video ang duha ka lalaki nga may kaistorya nga isa pa ka lalaki nga nagapungko.
english: The video shows two men talking to another man who is sitting.

text: Hinali lang nga ginsumbag ka ginsipa sang duha ka lalaki ang lalaki nga nagapungko.
english: Suddenly you were punched by two men kicked the man sitting.

text: Isa ka babaye naman ang nagpatunga agud magtambag apang may nagbutong sa iya buhok.
english: Another woman stepped in to offer advice but someone pulled her hair.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang biktima isa ka 15-anyos nga menor de edad kag may kaupod pa gid ini nga ginsakit man sang mga suspek apang wala nakuhaan sang video.
english: The victim was reportedly a 15-year-old minor and had another companion who was also assaulted by the suspects but was not caught on video.

text: Ang mga suspek nga opisyal sang Land Transportation Office Region 2 amo sanday Assistant Regional Director Manuel Baricaua kag Chief Enforcer Charles Ursulum.
english: The suspects were identified as Assistant Regional Director Manuel Baricaua and Chief Enforcer Charles Ursulum.

text: Ginsuspend na sang LTO si Baricaua bilang kabahin sang standard operating procedure sang ahensiya.
english: The LTO has already suspended Baricaua as part of the agency's standard operating procedure.

text: Ginmando naman ni Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon nga kakson sa pwesto sanday Baricaua kag Ursulum.
english: Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon ordered the removal of Baricaua and Ursulum.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman ang DOTR kag LTO Central sa duha ka mga biktima kag buligan sila kun luyag nila nga magpasaka sang kaso.
english: The DOTR and LTO Central have reached out to the two victims and will assist them if they wish to file a case.

text: Liwat nga nakit-an ang world-class talent sang Filipino Broadway legend nga si Lea Salonga sang nag-perform ini sa prestihiyoso nga state dinner sa White House para kanday US President Joe Biden kag South Korea President Yoon Suk Yeol.
english: The world-class talent of Filipino Broadway legend Lea Salonga was once again on display when she performed at the prestigious state dinner at the White House for US President Joe Biden and South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol.

text: Kaupod sang ni Lea nga nag-serenade sa world leaders ang iban pa nga Broadway stars nga sanday Norm Lewis kag Jessica Vosk.
english: Lea was accompanied by other Broadway stars Norm Lewis and Jessica Vosk.

text: Lakip sa ila nga gin-perform amo ang tracks halin sa musicals kaangay sang Les Miserables kag Funny Girl, kag amo man ang Don McLean classic nga “American Pie” nga paborito sang South Korean president.
english: Among their performances were tracks from musicals such as Les Miserables and Funny Girl, as well as the Don McLean classic “American Pie” which is a favorite of the South Korean president.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Lea nga daku nga bugal nga ma-imbitahan ni Biden kag ni First Lady Jill Biden sa White House.
english: Lea said it was a great honor to be invited by Biden and First Lady Jill Biden to the White House.

text: Samtang nagahilapit ang Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage month, importante suno sa iya nga matiglawas sa global scale ang Asian Americans.
english: As Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage month approaches, he said it is important that Asian Americans are represented on a global scale.

text: Lakip man sa nagsaksi sa amo nga event amo ang Hollywood star nga si Angelina Jolie.
english: Also witnessing the event was Hollywood star Angelina Jolie.

text: Ang sunod nga balantayan nga performance ni Lea amo ang Broadway musical nga “Here Lies Love” nga isa ka pro-Filipino show.##
english: Lea's next performance is the Broadway musical “Here Lies Love” which is a pro-Filipino show.##

text: ILOILO CITY–Gindagdagan sang Commission on Election (COMELEC) sang perpetual disqualification to hold public office ang pila ka mga kandidato sang nagligad nga mga eleksyon bangud sa kapaslawan nga magpasa sang Statement of Contribution and Expenditures (SOCE).
english: ILOILO CITY – The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has added perpetual disqualification to hold public office to several candidates in the last elections for failing to submit Statement of Contribution and Expenditures (SOCE).

text: Sa syudad sa Iloilo, sanday Rolando Dabao, Juanito Locsin Gaje, Deo Antonio Delfin Llamas kag Jose Marte Nava ang ginpamatbatan sang nasambit  nga silot.
english: In Iloilo City, Rolando Dabao, Juanito Locsin Gaje, Deo Antonio Delfin Llamas and Jose Marte Nava were sentenced to the said punishment.

text: Sa probinsiya sang Iloilo, sanday Eduardo Adio Dalipe kag Edwin Sanches Faldas sa Bingawan; Dino Piosca Chavez kag Narciso Casonoc Jison sa Calinog; Nixon Celis Salcedo sa Concepcion; Cristito Lapating sa Lemery; Antonio Peremne Sr.
english: In Iloilo province, Eduardo Adio Dalipe and Edwin Sanches Faldas in Bingawan; Dino Piosca Chavez and Narciso Casonoc Jison in Calinog; Nixon Celis Salcedo in Concepcion; Cristito Lapating in Lemery; Antonio Peremne Sr.

text: sa Mina; Elias Monsale sa Miag-ao; Jufe Atadero sa San Rafael; Nonito Tangente kag Richard Tererife sa Tigbauan ang nalakip man sa may perpetual disqualification to hold public office.
english: in Mine; Elias Monsale in Miag-ao; Jufe Atadero in San Rafael; Nonito Tangente and Richard Tererife in Tigbauan are also among those with perpetual disqualification to hold public office.

text: Sa probinsiya sang Guimaras naman, gindagdagan sang perpetual diasqualification si Bernie Gange Miaque.
english: In the province of Guimaras, Bernie Gange Miaque was added to the perpetual disqualification.

text: Undefeated gihapon kag sulod na ang Pilipinas sa final four sang 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship matapos nga ginlutos sang Strong Group Athletics (SGA) ang Moroccan team nga A.S. Salé sa quarterfinals, 92-80.
english: The Philippines is still undefeated and entered the final four of the 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship after Strong Group Athletics (SGA) defeated Moroccan team A.S. Salé in the quarterfinals, 92-80.

text:
Yari ang statistics:

A. Roberson – 18p, 9r

D. Howard – 17p, 12r

M. Moore – 17p, 7r

K. Quiambao – 15p, 5a

Sunod nga atubangon sang SGA ang Lebanese team nga Beirut Sports Club sa semifinals nga natalana 1:15 buwas sa kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas.
english:
Here are the statistics:

A. Roberson – 6p, 9p

D. Howard – 5p, 12p

M. Moore – 5p, 7p

K. Quiambao – 3pm, 5a

SGA will next face Lebanese team Beirut Sports Club in the semifinals scheduled for 1:15 am Philippine time tomorrow.

text:
Ini nga team nga una na nga nalutos sa 22 puntos sa kamot sang Strong Group sa group phase.#

(SGA/Facebook)
english:
This team, which was previously defeated by 22 points at the hands of Strong Group in the group phase.

(SGA/Facebook)

text: Nalusutan nanday CJ Perez kag San Miguel Beermen sang duha gid lamang ka puntos ang Barangay Ginebra, 92-90, sa imbukada nga hampang sang semifinal series sa PBA 48th Season Commissioner’s Cup sa Smart-Araneta Coliseum.
english: CJ Perez and San Miguel Beermen beat Barangay Ginebra by just two points, 92-90, in the opening game of the semifinal series in the PBA 48th Season Commissioner's Cup at the Smart-Araneta Coliseum.

text: Nanguna si Perez nga may conference-high nga 26 puntos agud mabuligan ang beermen nga makuha ang 1-0 lead sa best-of-five series batok sa Gin Kings.
english: Perez led the way with a conference-high 26 points to help the beermen take a 1-0 lead in the best-of-five series against the Gin Kings.

text: Daku man ang nabulig ni Bennie Boatwright nga may 23 points, 12 rebounds, kag lima ka assists June Mar Fajardo nga may 18 points kag siyam ka rebounds.
english: Bennie Boatwright also had 23 points, 12 rebounds, and five assists June Mar Fajardo had 18 points and nine rebounds.

text: Sa Ginebra, nagpanguna si Standhardinger nga may 21 points kag 11 rebounds kag Tony Bishop nga may 20 points kag 11 rebounds.
english: In Ginebra, Standhardinger led the way with 21 points and 11 rebounds and Tony Bishop with 20 points and 11 rebounds.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, wala naman nagapakampante ang Magnolia Hotshots apisar nga nalutos sini ang Phoenix Fuel Masters sa imbukada nga hampang sa semi-finals, 82-79, sa Araneta Coliseum.
english: Meanwhile, the Magnolia Hotshots are not complacent despite beating the Phoenix Fuel Masters in the opening game of the semi-finals, 82-79, at the Araneta Coliseum.

text: Gin-ako ni Hotshots guard Paul Lee nga mabudlay na nga atubangon ang Phoenix bangud sa kadamo sang adjustments sini.
english: Hotshots guard Paul Lee admitted that it will be difficult to face Phoenix because of the number of adjustments it has made.

text: Ang kadalag-an sang Hotshots ang nagpalawig pa sang ila nga winning streak sa siyam ka mga hampang.
english: The Hotshots' victory extended their winning streak to nine games.

text: Nanguna sa Phoenix ang import nga si Tyler Bey nga may 23 points kag 10 rebounds samtang gintib-ong naman ni Jason Perkins ang Fuel Masters sa iya game-high nga 25 points, 5 rebounds, kag 2 steals.
english: Phoenix was led by import Tyler Bey with 23 points and 10 rebounds while Jason Perkins led the Fuel Masters with a game-high 25 points, 5 rebounds, and 2 steals.

text:
Patigayunon ang sunod nga pag-atubangay sang mga teams sa semis sa buwas nga adlaw, Enero 26.#

(PBA IMAGES)
english:
The next match between the teams in the semis will be held tomorrow, January 26.#

(PBA IMAGES)

text: ILOILO CITY–Gin-athag sang pamunu-an sang Traffic Management Division sa Iloilo City Hall nga may yara sang permit ang pagpasirado sang mga dalan nga gin-agyan sang para sang grupo ni Mayor Jose Espinosa III sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: ILOILO CITY – The leadership of the Traffic Management Division at Iloilo City Hall clarified that there is a permit for the closure of roads that were used by Mayor Jose Espinosa III's group yesterday.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bob Forster, pinuno sang Traffic Management Division, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagpasirado sang pila ka dalan sa syudad ang nagdugay man lang sang pila ka oras.\
Ang road closure ang ginhingyo ni certain Avanceña kag gilayon naman nga gin-aprobahan ni Mayor Espinosa.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bob Forster, head of the Traffic Management Division, said the closure of some roads in the city lasted only a few hours.\
The road closure was requested by certain Avanceña and immediately approved by Mayor Espinosa.

text: Kun wala naman ang alkalde, ginpahayag ni Forster nga mahimo maka-approve ukon disapprove ang City Administrator ukon ang officer-in-charge sang Local Government Unit.
english: If the mayor is not present, Forster said the City Administrator or the officer-in-charge of the Local Government Unit can approve or disapprove.

text: Lakip sa mga intersection nga ginpabantayan sa mga traffic auxilliary amo ang Ledesma, Mabini, Fuentes, Quezon, De Leon, Delgado sa City Proper kag ang ruta nga gin-agyan sang parada halin sa San Jose Placer Parish padulong sa talatapan sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sa ikaduha nga panalgan sang Iloilo Terminal Market.
english: Among the intersections that were monitored by the traffic auxilliary were Ledesma, Mabini, Fuentes, Quezon, De Leon, Delgado in City Proper and the route that the parade took from San Jose Placer Parish to the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) office on the second floor of the Iloilo Market Terminal.

text: Bangud nga ginpasirado ang isa ka lane sang mga nasambit nga dalan, may yara man sang gindeploy nga mga traffic auxilliary agud magmando sa dalagan sang trapiko.
english: Due to the closure of one lane of these roads, traffic auxiliaries were also deployed to direct the flow of traffic.

text: Kadungan sini, gin-athag man ni Forster nga may yara man sang permit ang patigayunon nga parada sang grupo ni Cong.
english: Meanwhile, Forster explained that there is also a permit for the parade of Cong.

text: Jerry Treñas kadungan sang ila nga pagfile sang Certificate of Candidacy (COC).
english: Jerry Treñas during their filing of Certificate of Candidacy (COC).

text: Ang nagrequest sang road closure para sa Oktubre 17 amo si Jonas Bellocello.
english: The one who requested the road closure for October 17 was Jonas Bellocello.

text: Patay ang 31-anyos nga biktima sa Brgy.
english: The 31-year-old victim was killed in Brgy.

text: San Pedro, Jaro, Leyte sang aksidente ng matiruhan sang iya nga kumpare matapos nga masal-an nga baboy talunon sa kagulangan.
english: San Pedro, Jaro, Leyte when he was accidentally shot by his cousin after being caught by a wild boar in the forest.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Jun, samtang ang suspek naman amo si alyas Haping, 43-anyos, kag pareho nga residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Jun, while the suspect was identified as Haping, 43, both residents of the said barangay.

text: Suno sa otoridad, nagpadulong sa bukid sang nasambit nga lugar ang biktima kaupod ang suspek kag isa pa sini nga kumpare para mangayam sang baboy talunon.
english: According to the police, the victim went to the mountains of the said area with the suspect and another cousin to hunt wild boar.

text: Pag-abot sang mga ini sa bukid, nagseparar sa ruta ang biktima para kuntani sa mas dako nga tyansa nga makadakop sang baboy talunon.
english: When they reached the mountain, the victim separated from the route for a better chance of catching a wild boar.

text: Pagligad sang pila ka oras, namutikan sang suspek nga may nagahulag sa kahilamunan gani iya ini gintiro sa pagdumdom nga isa ini ka baboy talunon apang sang iya na ginkadtuan, tawo ang iya natiruhan kag ini ang iya nga kumpare.
english: After a few hours, the suspect noticed something moving in the grass and shot it thinking it was a wild boar but when he went there, he shot a man and it was his cousin.

text: Improvised homemade shotgun ang gin-gamit sang suspek.
english: The suspect used an improvised homemade shotgun.

text: Igo sa liog ang naangkon sang biktima nga gindala pa sa hospital apang gindeklarar nga dead-on-arrival.
english: The victim sustained multiple gunshot wounds in the neck and was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Boluntaryo naman nga nagsungka ang suspek.
english: The suspect voluntarily surrendered.

text: Desidido naman ang pamilya sang biktima nga magpasaka sang kaso.
english: The victim's family is determined to file a case.

text: Madasig ang pagbaskog ni Typhoon Uwan sa nagligad nga 24 oras samtang nga yara ini sa Philippine Sea sa nasidlangan sang Eastern Visayas.
english: Typhoon Uwan has been intensifying rapidly in the past 24 hours while it is in the Philippine Sea east of Eastern Visayas.

text: Sa 11:00 a.m. weather bulletin subong nga Sabado, Nobyembre 8, nakabutang nga nakit-an ang mata sang bagyo sa 680 km nasidlangan sang Borongan City, Eastern Samar ukon 760 km nasidlangan sang Catarman, Northern Samar.
english: In the 11:00 a.m. weather bulletin this Saturday, November 8, it is stated that the eye of the typhoon was found at 680 km east of Borongan City, Eastern Samar or 760 km east of Catarman, Northern Samar.

text:
May dala ini nga kabaskugon sang hangin nga tubtub sa 140 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 170 km/h.

Pa-nakatundan ang hulag sini sa kadasigon nga 35 km/h.

Nagapabilin naman sa Wind Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of up to 140 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 170 km/h.

It is moving westward at a speed of 35 km/h.

Wind Signal No.

english:

text: Magahulag si Uwan pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan subong tubtub buwas antes ini magliso pa-naaminhan nakatundan sa Lunes.
english: Rain will move west northwest today through tomorrow before it turns northwest on Monday.

text: Sa track forecast, magalabay ang mata sang bagyo sa Catanduanes buwas sa aga kag mag-landfall sa southern portion sang Isabela ukon sa northern portion sang Aurora buwas sa gab-i ukon Lunes sang kaagahon.
english: According to the track forecast, the eye of the typhoon will pass through Catanduanes tomorrow morning and landfall in the southern portion of Isabela or the northern portion of Aurora tomorrow night or Monday morning.

text: Nagataas man ang posibilidad nga may gamay nga southward shift sa potensyal nga agyan sang bagyo nga mahimo mag-resulta sa pag-igu sini direkta (i.e., eyewall affecting the area without making landfall) ukon landfall scenario sa Catanduanes.
english: There is also an increased likelihood of a slight southward shift in the potential path of the typhoon that could result in it hitting the area directly (i.e., eyewall affecting the area without making landfall) or landfall scenario in Catanduanes.

text: “After landfall, UWAN will traverse the mountainous terrain of Northern Luzon and emerge over Lingayen Gulf or the coastal waters of Pangasinan or La Union on Monday morning or afternoon,” suno sa we.
english: “After landfall, UWAN will traverse the mountainous terrain of Northern Luzon and emerge over Lingayen Gulf or the coastal waters of Pangasinan or La Union on Monday morning or afternoon,” we said.

text: Mahimo ini maglab-ot sa kategorya nga super typhoon karon sa gab-i ukon buwas.#
english: It could reach the super typhoon category tonight or tomorrow.

text: Nakaagaw-atensyon ang lovey-dovey photos sang hunk actor nga si Marco Gumabao kag sang rumored girlfriend sini nga si Cristine Reyes.
english: The lovey-dovey photos of hunk actor Marco Gumabao and his rumored girlfriend Cristine Reyes have caught the attention.

text:
Gina-kwestyon man sang fans kun ano gid man ang real score sa duha matapos ang pagsapubliko sang amo nga sweet moments nga may caption pa halin kay Marco nga: “You are my home and my adventure all at once.”

Ang isa ka picture amo ang printed photo sang rumored couple kun sa diin may nakabutang nga “Love you!”

Una na nga ginpahayag sang aktor nga gina-enjoy nila ang company sang isa kag isa kag apisar wala sang ginhatag nga label sa relasyon, gin-athag man sini nga may something special sa tunga sa ila sang aktres.
english:
Fans are also questioning what the real score is between the two after the publication of those sweet moments with a caption from Marco: “You are my home and my adventure all at once.”

One picture is a printed photo of the rumored couple with the words “Love you!”

Earlier, the actor said that they enjoy each other's company and although no label was given to the relationship, he also explained that there is something special between him and the actress.

text: Nahibaluan nga kasado anay si Christine sa mixed martial artist nga si Ali Khatibi nga amo man ang amay sang iya anak nga si Amarah.
english: Christine was previously married to mixed martial artist Ali Khatibi, who is also the father of her daughter Amarah.

text: Nag-separar ang duha sang 2019.
english: The two parted ways in 2019.

text: ILOILO CITY–Politically motivated ang pagkabig ni Buenavista Mayor Eugene Reyes sa pagtuhaw sang 224 million pesos nga plunder complaint batok sa opisyal sang probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: ILOILO CITY – Buenavista Mayor Eugene Reyes is politically motivated by the emergence of a 224 million pesos plunder complaint against a Guimaras provincial official.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Reyes, iya ginpahayag nga wala siya sang nakita nga rason agud pasakaan sila sang nasambit nga kaso magluwas gid lamang sa pamulitika.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Reyes said he saw no reason to file the case against them except for politics.

text: Sunu kay Reyes, nagapangita lang  ang ila kontra sang mga isyu nga mahaboy sa ila agud nga gub-on ang ila pangalan.
english: According to Reyes, their opponents are just looking for issues to throw at them in order to tarnish their reputation.

text: Gintuad man sang alkalde nga personal siya nga pagpadulong sa talatapan sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) agud nga maathagan tuhoy sa comelec exemption kag kun ano ini ka malahalon.
english: The mayor also admitted that he personally went to the office of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) to clarify about the comelec exemption and how expensive it is.

text: Gin-athag man ni Reyes nga may yara sang pahanugot halin sa COMELEC ang paghatag sa ila sang kwarta bisan pa nga election period sang tinalikdan nga tuig 2016.
english: Reyes also explained that there is permission from the COMELEC to give them the money even during the election period of last year 2016.

text: Nakahandan naman ang alkalde nga ipakita ang mga dukomento bilang pamatud-an nga wala sang anomaliya sa amo nga pondo nga ila nabaton halin sa provincial government.
english: The mayor is ready to show the documents as proof that there is no anomaly in the fund they received from the provincial government.

text: Plastado na tanan ang magahampang nga mga team sa semifinal round sang PBA Commissioner’s Cup!
english: The teams that will play in the semifinal round of the PBA Commissioner's Cup are all set!

text: Ini matapos nagbubo sang kusog sa second half ang Phoenix Super LPG Fuel Masters kag ginlutos ang Meralco, 88-84, sa quarterfinal clash sa Mall of Asia Arena, Enero 21.
english: This comes after the Phoenix Super LPG Fuel Masters poured their energy into the second half and defeated Meralco, 88-84, in the quarterfinal clash at the Mall of Asia Arena, January 21.

text: Nanguna sa pagdaog sang Super LPG ang import nga si Jonathan Williams nga naka-rekord sang 20 points kag 16 rebounds.
english: Super LPG was led by import Jonathan Williams with 20 points and 16 rebounds.

text: Atubangon sang Fuel Masters sa best-of-five semi-finals ang top seed nga Magnolia Chicken Timplados Hotshots nga nagdaog sa 10 sa ila 12 ka mga hampang subong nga conference.
english: The Fuel Masters will face the top seed Magnolia Chicken Timplados Hotshots, who have won 10 of their 12 games this conference, in the best-of-five semi-finals.

text: Magasugod ang semifinals sa Myerkules, Enero 24, sa Araneta Coliseum, kun sa diin maga-atubangay man ang sister teams nga Barangay Ginebra kag San Miguel Beermen.#
english: The semifinals will start on Wednesday, January 24, at the Araneta Coliseum, where sister teams Barangay Ginebra and San Miguel Beermen will also face each other.

text: Nakataas na sa signal number ang maraming lugar sa bansa matapos na makapasok sa Philippine Area of Responsibility ang bagyong Uwan.
english: Many areas in the country have been raised to signal number after Typhoon Uwan entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility.

text: Ayon sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), nakita ang sentro ng bagyo sa may Silangang bahagi ng Eastern Visayas.
english: According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the center of the typhoon was found in the eastern part of Eastern Visayas.

text: May taglay pa rin ito ng lakas ng hangin ng 120 kilometers per hour at pagbugso ng hanggang 150 kph.
english: It still has winds of 120 kilometers per hour and gusts of up to 150 kph.

text: May bilis ito na 20 kph at gumagalaw sa direksyon ng West northwestward.
english: It has a speed of 20 kph and is moving in the direction of West northwestward.

text: Ang nasabing mga lugar ay makakaranas ng malalakas na pag-ulan at hanging na may banta ng storm surge.Inaasahan na magla-landfall ang bagyong Uwan sa southern Isabela o northern Aurora ng gbai ng linggo (Nobyembre 9) o madaling araw ng Lunes, Nobyembre 10.Maaring umabot sa super typhoon category ang bagyo nitong Sabado ng gabi o Linggo ng umaga Nobyembre 9.
english: These areas will experience heavy rains and winds with the threat of storm surge. Typhoon Uwan is expected to landfall in southern Isabela or northern Aurora on Sunday night (November 9) or early Monday, November 10. night or Sunday morning November 9th.

text: Patuloy na pinapaalerto ng PAGASA ang mga bayan na dadaanan ng bagyo dahil sa dulot nitong lakas ng hangin at pag-ulan.
english: PAGASA continues to alert the towns that will be affected by the typhoon due to the strong winds and rains.

text: Wala nagtaas ang kaso sang shooting incident sa Western Visayas base sa 3rd quarter report sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6.
english: The number of shooting incidents in Western Visayas did not increase based on the 3rd quarter report of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6.

text: Sa press conference nga ginhiwat subong nga adlaw sa Camp Martin Delgado, ginpahayag ni Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, Regional Director sang PRO 6, iya ginpahayag nga base sa ila datos, nga nagnubo pa ang kaso sang shooting incident subong nga 3rd quarter kumpara sang nagliligad.
english: In a press conference held today at Camp Martin Delgado, Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, Regional Director of PRO 6, said that based on their data, the number of shooting incidents decreased in the 3rd quarter compared to the previous year.
