text: May yara sang 46 ka kaso sang shooting incident sa ikaduha nga quarter kag 38 naman sa ikatlo nga quarter sang tuig, rason nga ginpahayag sini nga wala sang pagtaas sa insidente sa sulod sang nagligad nga tatlo ka bulan.
english: There were 46 cases of shooting incidents in the second quarter and 38 in the third quarter of the year, which is why he said there was no increase in incidents over the past three months.

text: Suno kay Ligan, indi drug-related ang rason sang shooting incident kundi kalabanan amo ang pagbinaisay kag mga daan nga hiligut-anon.
english: According to Ligan, the reason for the shooting incident was not drug-related but mostly a dispute and old quarrels.

text: Ginpabutyag man sang PRO 6 nga sa sulod sang ila 90 ka campaign operation nga ginpatigayon batok sa loose firearms, nagtaas sa kabug-osan nga 116 ka armas kag explosives ang narekober.
english: PRO 6 also said that during their 90 campaign operations against loose firearms, a total of 116 firearms and explosives were recovered.

text: Samtang, 388 naman
english: Meanwhile, 388

text: Patay na kag nakaluslos ang underwear sang masapwan ang isa ka 8-anyos nga bata nga babaye nga pila ka adlaw na nga missing sa Iligan City.
english: An 8-year-old girl who had been missing for several days in Iligan City was found dead with her underwear torn.

text: Nakit-an ang lawas sang bata nga nagatungtong sa bato sa Purok 13, Timoga, Barangay Buru-un.
english: The body of the child was found lying on a rock in Purok 13, Timoga, Barangay Buru-un.

text: Suno sa pulis, residente sa lugar ang bata nga missing humalin pa sang Hunyo 5, 2025.
english: According to police, the missing child has been a resident of the area since June 5, 2025.

text: Ulihi siya nga nakit-an nga buhi malapit sa ila nga balay kag nagpadulong sa sapa kaupod ang isa pa ka bata.
english: He was last found alive near his house and went to the river with another child.

text: Ginaimbestigaran sang pulis kun may foul play sa natabo bangud sa iya underwear.
english: Police are investigating whether there was any foul play in the incident due to her underwear.

text: Ginahulat pa ang resulta sang autopsy.
english: The results of the autopsy are still pending.

text: Ginlutos nanday eight-time National Basketball Association (NBA) All-Star Dwight Howard kag Strong Group Athletics ang PBA squad nga Converge, 97-64, sa nagaisahanon nga tune-up match antes ang pagbiya sang team pakadto sa United Arab Emirates agud magsaka sa 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championships.
english: Eight-time National Basketball Association (NBA) All-Star Dwight Howard and Strong Group Athletics defeated PBA squad Converge, 97-64, in the lone tune-up match before the team’s departure for the United Arab Emirates to advance to the 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championships.

text: Suno kay Filipino coach Charles Tiu, ang amo nga tune-up match ang naghanas sa ila nga “super team” kag star-studded imports nga makabuligay kaupod sa nagapanguna nga collegiate stars para sa isa ka semana nga tournament sa Dubai.
english: According to Filipino coach Charles Tiu, the tune-up match trained their “super team” and star-studded imports to work together with the top collegiate stars for the week-long tournament in Dubai.

text: Makagrupo sang Pilipinas sa Group B ang Lebanese squads nga Beirut Club kag Homenetmen; club sang Libya nga Al Ahli Tripoli; club sang Syria nga Al Wehda; kag host country nga United Arab Emirates.
english: Lebanese squads Beirut Club and Homenetmen will group the Philippines in Group B; Libyan club Al Ahli Tripoli; Syrian club Al Wehda; and host country United Arab Emirates.

text: Una nga magasabak ang Strong Group batok sa host country buwas sa gab-i oras sa Dubai kag 3:15 naman sa Sabado sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Strong Group will first fight against the host country tomorrow night Dubai time and 3:15 am Saturday morning Philippine time.

text: Magluwas kay Howard, yara man ang imports nga sanday Andre Roberson kag McKenzie Moore kag ang former Gilas Pilipinas naturalized player nga si Andray Blatche.#
english: Besides Howard, there are also imports Andre Roberson and McKenzie Moore and former Gilas Pilipinas naturalized player Andray Blatche.

text: ILOILO CITY- Sigurado na ang Team Philippines nga makapadala sang indi magnubo sa pito ka mga atleta sa nagahilapit nga 2024 Olympics sa Paris nga patigayunon anom ka bulan umpisa subong.
english: ILOILO CITY – Team Philippines is sure to send at least seven athletes to the upcoming 2024 Olympics in Paris to be held six months from now.

text: Ang pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena, nga ikaduha sa ranking sa kalibutan, ang ginalantaw nga may pinakadako nga tsansa nga makakuha sang medalya kun indi gold base sa nauna nga performances sa world stage.
english: Pole vaulter EJ Obiena, ranked second in the world, is seen as having the best chance of winning a medal if not gold based on previous performances on the world stage.

text: Ang gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo nga two-time world champion ang nagsugod naman sang iya preparasyon.
english: Two-time world champion gymnast Carlos Yulo has started his preparation.

text: Ginatan-aw man ang boxer nga si Eumir Marcial, ang 2021 Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist sa middleweight class, nga magpakita sang maayo nga performance sa light heavy division.
english: Boxer Eumir Marcial, the 2021 Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist in the middleweight class, is also being looked at to perform well in the light heavy division.

text: Suno kay Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Bambol Tolentino, mataas ang expectations sa sini nga mga atleta.
english: According to Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Bambol Tolentino, expectations are high for these athletes.

text: Mahimo naman nga magdugang sa listahan sang team nga magtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Olympics amo ang highest-ranked Filipino female swimmer nga twice Olympic medalist para sa Canada sadto nga si Kayla Noelle Sanchez nga ginahulat pa nga makuha ang isa sa duha ka mandatory slots para sa Philippine swim team sa Olympics.
english: The highest-ranked Filipino female swimmer and twice Olympic medalist for Canada, Kayla Noelle Sanchez, who is still waiting to get one of the two mandatory slots for the Philippine swim team at the Olympics, can also be added to the list of teams that will represent the Philippines in the Olympics.

text: Tatlo tubtub apat pa ka mga bagyo ang gina-forecast nga magporma ukon magsulod sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) antes magtakop ang tuig 2025.
english: Three to four more typhoons are forecast to form or enter the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) before the end of 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Nathaniel Servando, administrator sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), iya ginpahayag nga posible nga may isa ukon duha pa sa bulan sang Nobyembre, kag isa tubtub duha naman ka bagyo sa Disyembre.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Nathaniel Servando, administrator of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), said there is likely to be one or two more typhoons in November, and one to two more typhoons in December.

text: Sa Nobyembre, nakalabay na si Bagyo Tino kag nagbilin sang masobra sa 100 ka mga patay; samtang nagahana naman nga magsulod si Severe Tropical Storm Uwan nga mahimo pa mag-develop sa isa ka super typhoon.
english: By November, Typhoon Tino had passed and left more than 100 dead; while Severe Tropical Storm Uwan is expected to enter the country which could develop into a super typhoon.

text: Malapad ang sirkulasyon ni Uwan kag apisar nga sa Northern Luzon kag Central Luzon ang laslasan sini, maapektuhan pati ang Visayas kun sa diin posible ang pagluntad sang baha, mudslides, kag landslides.
english: Malapad ang sirkulasyon ni Uwan kag apisar nga sa Northern Luzon kag Central Luzon ang laslasan sini, maapektuhan pati ang Visayas kun sa diin posible ang pagluntad sang baha, mudslides, kag landslides.

text: Isa sa ginalantaw nga nakaapekto sa kakusog sang bagyo suno sa PAGASA amo ang La Niña nga nagadala sang mabaskog nga hangin kag madamol nga ulan.
english: Isa sa ginalantaw nga nakaapekto sa kakusog sang bagyo suno sa PAGASA amo ang La Niña nga nagadala sang mabaskog nga hangin kag madamol nga ulan.

text: Oktubre 10 sang gin-anunsyo sang state weather bureau nga present ang La Niña conditions sa tropical Pacific Ocean halin pa sang Septyembre.
english: On October 10, the state weather bureau announced that La Niña conditions have been present in the tropical Pacific Ocean since September.

text: Ang La Niña amo ang weather phenomenon nga characterized sang indi kinaandan nga mas malamig ipaangid sa average nga sea surface temperatures sa central kag eastern equatorial Pacific.
english: La Niña is a weather phenomenon characterized by unusually cooler than average sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific.

text: “Dahil super typhoon ito, inaasahan natin na may kalakasan ang pag-ulan,” suno kay Servando.
english: “Because it is a super typhoon, we expect heavy rains,” Servando said.

text: Ginapanawagan sini sa tanan nga magpreparar kag maghimo sang proactive measures, kag magpamati sa mga abiso sang PAGASA, local government units, kag mga concerned agencies.#
english: He called on everyone to prepare and take proactive measures, and listen to the warnings of PAGASA, local government units, and concerned agencies.

text: Ginahulat gihapon ang mangin desisyon sang FIBA para sa naturalized player sang Gilas Pilipinas nga si Justin Brownlee samtang amat-amat naman nga nagasako ang national team para sa preparasyon sa 2025 FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers nga magasugod na sa Pebrero.
english: FIBA's decision on naturalized Gilas Pilipinas player Justin Brownlee is still awaited while the national team is slowly getting busy preparing for the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers that will start in February.

text: Suno kay Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas President Al Panlilio, nakapasa na si Brownlee sang tanan nga documentation matapos ini nga naglagbong sa anti-doping test sang nagligad nga tuig kasunod sang maragtason nga pagkampyon sang Pilipinas sa Asian Games sa China.
english: According to Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas President Al Panlilio, Brownlee has passed all the documentation after he failed the anti-doping test last year following the Philippines' historic Asian Games victory in China.

text: Matandaan nga nakit-an sa test nga positibo ang 35-anyos nga basketball star sa carboxy-THC, isa ka substance nga naangot sa paggamit sang cannabis nga ginadumilian sa idalom sang World Anti-Doping Agency.
english: The 35-year-old basketball star tested positive for carboxy-THC, a substance linked to cannabis use that is banned under the World Anti-Doping Agency.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Panlilio nga maayo ang nangin desisyon ni Brownlee nga indi anay maghampang para sa Barangay Ginebra sa nagapadayon nga PBA Season 48 Commissioner’s Cup.
english: Panlilio also said that Brownlee's decision not to play for Barangay Ginebra in the ongoing PBA Season 48 Commissioner's Cup was a good one.

text: Nagalaum si Panlilio nga mangin paborable para sa Gilas star ang desisyon sang FIBA.
english: Panlilio hopes that the FIBA ​​decision will be favorable for the Gilas star.

text: Si Brownlee amo ang nagpanguna sa national team nga mabalik sa Pilipinas ang trono sa men’s basketball sa Asian Games matapos ang 61 ka tuig.
english: Brownlee led the national team to regain the Philippines' men's basketball throne at the Asian Games after 61 years.

text: Siya man ang nanguna nga maagaw liwat sang Pilipinas ang kampyonato sa SEA Games matapos nga nagsal-ot ang Indonesia sa winning streak sang pungsod sang nagligad nga edisyon.
english: He also led the Philippines to regain the SEA Games championship after Indonesia joined the country's winning streak in the previous edition.

text: Sa subong, kinahanglan pa nga magporma liwat sang team ang Gilas kasunod sang kadalag-an sa Asiad.
english: In the meantime, the Gilas still need to reshape the team following the Asiad win.

text: Kuwalipikado ang Pilipinas sa FIBA Asia Cup qualifier para sa 2025 kun sa diin makasumpong sini sa Group B ang New Zealand, Chinese Taipei, kag ang Hong Kong.
english: The Philippines is qualified for the FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifier for 2025 where it will face New Zealand, Chinese Taipei, and Hong Kong in Group B.

text: Balantayan ang qualifiers sa Pebrero 2024, Nobyembre 2024 kag Pebrero 2025 sa home-and-away format.
english: The qualifiers will be played in February 2024, November 2024 and February 2025 in the home-and-away format.

text:
May Qualifying Tournaments man para sa Paris Olympics kun sa diin makasambuwa sang Gilas ang Georgia kag Latvia sa Hulyo.#

(FIBA)
english:
There will also be Qualifying Tournaments for the Paris Olympics where Georgia and Latvia will play the Gilas in July.

(FIBA)

text: Nahulog sa pil-as ang ginasakyan sang isa ka iloy nga padulong kuntani sa ospital para magbun-ag sa Sigma, Capiz.
english: A mother's vehicle fell into a ditch on her way to the hospital to give birth in Sigma, Capiz.

text: Suno sa panaysayon sang iloy, pakadto sila sang iya nga bana sa ospital kaupod ang duha ka hinablos sang nagpundo sila sa kilid sang karsada bangud daw maggwa na gid ang bata.
english: According to the mother, she and her husband were on their way to the hospital with their two nephews when they stopped on the side of the road because the child seemed to be coming out.

text: Samtang ginabuligan siya sang iya nga mister, wala nila natalupangdan nga nagaatras ang ila nga salakyan tubtob ng nahulog ini sa pil-as.
english: While her husband was helping her, they did not notice that their car was backing up until it fell into the ditch.

text: Apang, sa maayo nga palad, nakagwa ang mga ini sa salakyan.
english: However, fortunately, they were able to get out of the vehicle.

text: Gilayon nga nagresponde ang BFP Sigma kag Sigma RHU kag gin-asikaso ang iloy kag iya lapsag nga nagakonekta pa ang pusod sa iloy.
english: BFP Sigma and Sigma RHU immediately responded and took care of the mother and her baby whose umbilical cord was still connected to the mother.

text: Lunsay yara na sa mayo nga kahimtangan ang mag-iloy.
english: The mother and daughter are both in good condition.

text: Nagalab-ot sa P50 ang gin-nubo sa presyo sang kada kilo sang tamudyos sa mga merkado.
english: The price of each kilo of turkey in the markets has been reduced by P50.

text: Ginaangot ini sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) sa pagpahanugot na sa commercial fishers nga mag-operate liwat sa Visayan Sea, Zamboanga peninsula kag Palawan matapos nga nagtakop na ang closed fishing season sang nagligad nga Pebrero 15.
english: The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) is linking this to the allowance of commercial fishermen to resume operations in the Visayan Sea, Zamboanga peninsula and Palawan after the closed fishing season ended last February 15.

text: Pahayag pa ni BFAR spokersperson Nazario Briguera, ang hulag sa presyo sang isda ukon ang pagsaka ang ginalauman lamang sa Semana Santa bangud ginalikawan sang mga tawo ang pagkaon sang karne.
english: BFAR spokesperson Nazario Briguera said the movement in fish prices or the increase is only expected during Easter because people avoid eating meat.

text: Apang ang importante suno sa iya, bastante katama ang suplay subong.
english: But the important thing, he said, is that there is enough supply now.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga naga-import lamang sang isda ang Pilipinas kun may yara sang fishing ban.
english: He also said that the Philippines only imports fish when there is a fishing ban.

text: Nabiktima sang sextortion ang isa ka 17-anyos nga babaye sa Pampanga matapos ginpakay-o ang naguba nga cellphone.
english: A 17-year-old girl in Pampanga became a victim of sextortion after repairing her broken cellphone.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang pulis, 2024 sang ginpakay-o sang dalagita sa suspek ang iya nga cellphone sang 2024.
english: According to police investigation, in 2024, the girl asked the suspect to repair her cellphone in 2024.

text: Ang cellphone nagaunod sang mga sensitibo niya nga video kag pictures.
english: The cellphone contained his sensitive videos and pictures.

text: Sang damlag lang, nakabaton siya sang mensahe nga nagapamahog nga ipalapta ang mga pictures kun indi ini magpasugot nga magpakighilawas sa iya.
english: Recently, he received a message threatening to spread the pictures if she did not agree to have sex with him.

text: Suno pa sa pulis, sa kahadlok sang biktima, nagpasugot ini sa gusto sang suspek.
english: According to the police, the victim was afraid and agreed to the suspect's wishes.

text: Samtang nagapakighilawas, may tabon ang nawong sang suspek samtang wala sang tabon ang nawong sang dalagita nga ginkuhaan pa gid sang lalaki sang video kag pictures.
english: While having sex, the suspect had a cover on his face while the girl had no cover on her face.

text: Apang liwat nga namahog ang suspek kag ginhagad liwat ang biktima gani nanugid ini sa iya iloy kag nangayo sang bulig sa otoridad para maaresto ang suspek.
english: However, the suspect again threatened and invited the victim again so she told her mother and asked for help from the authorities to arrest the suspect.

text: Didto na ginplano ang operasyon kag naaresto ang 26-anyos nga suspek sa isa ka hotel sa Arayat, Pampanga.
english: The operation was planned and the 26-year-old suspect was arrested at a hotel in Arayat, Pampanga.

text: Nagatampi lang sang tuwalya ang suspek sang naabtan sang mga pulis samtang ginahulat ang dalagita.
english: The suspect was just wrapping a towel when the police found him waiting for the girl.

text: Nagapangatubang sang sampaw-sampaw nga reklamo ang suspek.
english: The suspect is facing multiple complaints.

text: Samtang naga-hanas pa para updan ang team sang Pilipinas sa nagahilapit nga 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship sa United Arab Emirates, bukas ang National Basketball Association (NBA) star nga si Dwight Howard nga makahampang pa para sa pungsod kun kuhaon siya sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).
english: While still training to join the Philippine team in the upcoming 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship in the United Arab Emirates, National Basketball Association (NBA) star Dwight Howard is open to playing for the country if he is picked up by the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).

text: Apang pananglitan kuhaon siya sang PBA, naglahog kag naghingyo ang former three-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year nga kuntani may adjustment lamang sa kataason sang player.
english: But if the PBA takes him, the former three-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year has requested that there be an adjustment to the player's height.

text: Suno sa 38-anyos nga basketball star, 6-foot-9 lamang ang iya nga height nga amo man ang maximum height nga gin-set agud makahampang ang import sa premier basketball league sa Pilipinas.
english: According to the 38-year-old basketball star, he is only 6-foot-9 which is the maximum height set for the import to play in the premier basketball league in the Philippines.

text: “Guys like Dray can come back and play here as well.
english: “Guys like Dray can come back and play here as well.

text: I know he wanted to play here in the PBA so you know, if they change the height requirements, maybe we’ll see twin towers in the Philippines,” pahayag sini nga nagatumod kay Andray Blatche.
english: I know he wanted to play here in the PBA so you know, if they change the height requirements, maybe we’ll see twin towers in the Philippines,” he said, referring to Andray Blatche.

text: Antes ang pag-upod sa Strong Group-Philippines sa Dubai, nakahampang si Howard sa T1 League sa Taiwan kasunod sang iya malawig man nga karera sa NBA halin sang 2004 tubtub sang 2022.
english: Before joining the Strong Group-Philippines in Dubai, Howard played in the T1 League in Taiwan following his long career in the NBA from 2004 to 2022.

text: Sa amo nga mga tinuig, madamo man nga teams ang iya nasudlan apang naglawig ini sang siyam ka tuig sa Orlando Magic.
english: During those years, he also joined many teams but it lasted nine years with the Orlando Magic.

text: Sa subong, todo-hanas anay si Howard para sa pasakupan sang Pilipinas nga tournament sa Dubai nga magasugod sa Enero 19.
english: Howard is currently fully trained for the Philippine tournament in Dubai which starts on January 19.

text: Pamunuan sini ang team nga may yara sang mga beterano kag rising stars agud nga makatimalos kag ma-redeem ang kaugalingon halin sa quarterfinal exit sang pungsod sang nagligad nga edisyon.
english: He will lead a team of veterans and rising stars to take revenge and redeem itself from the country's quarterfinal exit in the previous edition.

text:
Lakip sa magaupod sa UAE amo ang naturalized Filipino nga si Blatche, McKenzie Moore, kag Andre Roberson, samtang ang locals naman amo sanday MPBL MVP Justine Baltazar, UAAP MVP Kevin Quiambao, kag former Gilas member Jordan Heading.#

(Photo: Strong Group Athletics)
english:
Among those joining the UAE are naturalized Filipinos Blatche, McKenzie Moore, and Andre Roberson, while locals will be MPBL MVP Justine Baltazar, UAAP MVP Kevin Quiambao, and former Gilas member Jordan Heading.

(Photo: Strong Group Athletics)

text: Target sang Pilipinas kag Japan nga i-revisit ang pagtuon sang 2014 angot sa epekto sang mabaskog nga linog halin sa West Valley Fault.
english: The Philippines and Japan target to revisit the 2014 study on the impact of the strong earthquake from the West Valley Fault.

text: Suno kay Dr. Teresito Bacolcol, director sang Philippines Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), plano liwat nga buksan ang amo nga pagtuon sa tunga nila sang Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) sa masunod nga tuig.
english: According to Dr. Teresito Bacolcol, director of the Philippines Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), plans to reopen the study between them and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) next year.

text: Ang amo nga pagtuon ang 20 na ka tuig kag madamo pa ang populasyon sa Metro Manila.
english: The study is 20 years old and there is still a large population in Metro Manila.

text: Suno kay Dr. Bacolcol, ginpatigayon sang 2004 pa ang pagtuon nga ginatawag nga Metro Manila Earthquake Impact Reduction study nga ginpondohan sang Japan, kun sa diin naplastar diri ang risk assessment sa possible nga magnitude 7.2 nga linog halin sa West Valley Fault.
english: According to Dr. Bacolcol, the Metro Manila Earthquake Impact Reduction study, funded by Japan, was conducted in 2004, which included a risk assessment of a possible magnitude 7.2 earthquake from the West Valley Fault.

text: Pahayag pa sang opisyal nga kun maghulag na ang West Valley Fault, ang bug-os nga rehiyon ang makabatyag sang yara sa Intensity 8 nga pagtay-og.
english: The official said that when the West Valley Fault moves, the entire region will feel an Intensity 8 earthquake.

text: Heads up, pageant fans!
english: Heads up, pageant fans!

text: Mangin special guest sa Miss Universe Philippines 2023 ang reigning Miss Universe nga si R’Bonney Gabriel!
english: Reigning Miss Universe R’Bonney Gabriel will be a special guest at Miss Universe Philippines 2023!

text: Updan sang Filipino-American beauty queen ang isa pa ka Miss Universe titleholder nga si Zozibini Tunzi nga amo ang guest host sa coronation night.
english: The Filipino-American beauty queen will be joined by another Miss Universe titleholder, Zozibini Tunzi, who will be the guest host at the coronation night.

text: Si Gabriel amo ang pinakaulihi nga gin-anunsyo sang organisasyon nga nalakip sa “sensational hosts, world-class performers, kag queens” nga magapatahum pa sang sini nga edisyon sang national pageant.
english: Gabriel is the latest to be announced by the organization among the “sensational hosts, world-class performers, and queens” who will further grace this edition of the national pageant.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo nga mangin main pageant hosts ang mga aktor nga sanday Alden Richards kag Xian Lim samtang mangin in-charge naman sa backstage sanday Miss Globe 2021 Maureen Montagne kag si Tim Yap.
english: It was earlier announced that actors Alden Richards and Xian Lim will be the main pageant hosts while Miss Globe 2021 Maureen Montagne and Tim Yap will be in-charge backstage.

text: Yara man sa star-studded event ang South Korean idol nga si Nam Woo-hyun kag Filipino American singer nga si Jessica Sanchez.
english: Also at the star-studded event were South Korean idol Nam Woo-hyun and Filipino American singer Jessica Sanchez.

text: Patigayunon sa Mayo 13 ang coronation night kun sa diin ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City amo si Chloei Darl Gabales nga halin sa distrito sang Jaro.
english: The coronation night will be held on May 13 where the representative of Iloilo City is Chloei Darl Gabales from Jaro district.

text: Nagpaandam ang state weather bureau sang posible nga mga pagbaha kag pagtiphag sang duta sa Visayas apisar nga sa Northern kag Central Luzon magalaslas si Super Typhoon Uwan kun makasulod na ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: The state weather bureau has warned of possible floods and landslides in the Visayas although Super Typhoon Uwan will hit Northern and Central Luzon when it enters the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Nathaniel Servando, administrator sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ginlaragway sini ang Bagyo Uwan bilang “very intense” kag “enormous” nga sahi sang bagyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Nathaniel Servando, administrator of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), described Typhoon Uwan as a “very intense” and “enormous” type of typhoon.

text: “Kun ibutang naton ang bagyo sa Metro Manila, masakop ya ang Batanes at sa south maabot ya hanggang Zamboanga.
english: “If we put the typhoon in Metro Manila, it will cover Batanes and in the south it will reach Zamboanga.

text: Basically, masakop ya ang bilog nga Pilipinas, except ang sa southernmost portion.
english: Basically, it covers the whole Philippines, except the southernmost portion.

text: Ganon kalawak ang sirkulasyon,” suno kay Servando.
english: That's how wide the circulation is,” Servando said.

text: Bangud sang kalaparon sang sirkulasyon sang bagyo, ginalantaw sang PAGASA nga magadala ini sang ulan sa mga area sa Visayas nga bag-o lang gin-agyan ni Bagyo Tino.
english: Due to the wide circulation of the typhoon, PAGASA expects it to bring rain to areas in the Visayas that were recently hit by Typhoon Tino.

text: Ginpaathag man sini nga bangud “saturated” na ukon tuman na ka basa ang duta bangud sa naglabay nga bagyo, dapat nga mag-alerto gid ang mga pumuluyo.
english: He also explained that since the ground is already “saturated” or very wet due to the past typhoon, residents should be very alert.

text: “Dahil nga saturated na ang duta, posibleng magdala [ng hiindi lang baha] but of course landslides and mudslides,” dugang sini.
english: “Because the soil is saturated, it is possible to bring [not only floods] but of course landslides and mudslides,” he added.

text: Panawagan pa ni Servando — nga tumandok man sang Iloilo — nga mag-aligmat gid kag magpamati sa mga abiso sang DOST-PAGASA kag sa mga kaangot nga ahensya.
english: Servando — who is also a native of Iloilo — urged the public to be vigilant and listen to the warnings of DOST-PAGASA and relevant agencies.

text: Alas singko kaina sang hapon, bisan nga yara pa sa guwa sang PAR, ginhatagan na ang bagyo sang local name nga Uwan kag nag-anunsyo naman ang PAGASA sang wind signals.
english: At 5 pm yesterday, although still outside the PAR, the typhoon was given the local name Uwan and PAGASA announced wind signals.

text: Lakip sa Signal No.
english: Including Signal No.

text: 1 amo ang northeastern portion sang Iloilo lakip ang Carles, Estancia, Balasan, San Dionisio, Concepcion, Batad, Sara, kag Ajuy.
english: 1 is the northeastern portion of Iloilo including Carles, Estancia, Balasan, San Dionisio, Concepcion, Batad, Sara, and Ajuy.

text: “Malawak ang kaniyang sirkulasyon.
english: “It has a wide circulation.

text: May radius ito na about 700 kilometers yung rainband niya… kaya nag-announce na ng wind signals,” pahayag ni Servando.
english: It has a radius of about 700 kilometers rainband... so it announced wind signals,” Servando said.

text: Sa track forecast, ini nga bagyo ang magasulod sa PAR karon sa gab-i ukon sa buwas sa kaagahon.
english: According to the track forecast, this storm will enter the PAR tonight or tomorrow morning.

text: Gina-forecast sang PAGASA nga maga-landfall ini sa southern portion sang Isabela ukon sa northern portion sang Aurora sa Domingo sang gab-i ukon sa Lunes sang kaagahon.
english: PAGASA forecasts that it will landfall in the southern portion of Isabela or the northern portion of Aurora on Sunday night or Monday morning.

text: Pagkatapos sang landfall, magaagi si Uwan sa kabukiran sang Northern Luzon kag magatuhaw sa West Philippine Sea sa Lunes sang aga ukon sa hapon.
english: After landfall, Uwan will pass through the mountains of Northern Luzon and emerge in the West Philippine Sea on Monday morning or afternoon.

text: Sa bahin sang kabaskugon sini, gina-forecast nga mas magabaskog ini kag magadangat sa typhoon category sa masunod nga 24 oras kag super typhoon category buwas sa gab-i ukon sa Domingo sa aga.
english: In terms of its strength, it is forecast to intensify and reach the typhoon category in the next 24 hours and super typhoon category tomorrow night or Sunday morning.

text: Posible man ini nga mag-landfall kun yara na ukon malapit na sa peak lifetime intensity.
english: It is also likely to landfall when at or near peak lifetime intensity.

text: Base pa sa PAGASA, ang paglabay sini sa Luzon ang makapahina sa pwersa sini, apang ginalantaw nga magapabilin bilang typhoon samtang yari ini sa Pilipinas.
english: According to PAGASA, its passage through Luzon will weaken its strength, but it is expected to remain as a typhoon while it is in the Philippines.

text: Si Uwan amo ang ika-duha nga bagyo sa PAR subong nga Nobyembre kasunod sang paglaslas ni Tino.
english: Uwan is the second typhoon in the PAR this November following the outbreak of Tino.

text: (Photo from Himawari-8/9 satellite of Japan Meteorological Agency)
english: (Photo from Himawari-8/9 satellite of Japan Meteorological Agency)

text: Nagaplano si US President Donald Trump nga magbisita sa Saudi Arabia sa tunga-tunga sang Mayo.
english: US President Donald Trump plans to visit Saudi Arabia in mid-May.

text: Ini ang iya mangin una nga overseas trip halin sang nag-umpisa ang iya nga ikaduha nga termino sang Enero.
english: This will be his first overseas trip since his second term began in January.

text: Ginalauman nga lakip sa madiskusyunan amo ang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera sang Russia sa Ukraine, ang gyera sang Israel kag Hamas sa Gaza, kag ang investments.
english: Among the topics expected to be discussed are Russia's three-year war in Ukraine, Israel's war with Hamas in Gaza, and investments.

text: Nahibaluan nga daku ang nangin papel sang Saudi sa U.S. foreign policy lakip na ang pagbulig kag pagpatigayon sang U.S. ceasefire talks sa Russia kag Ukraine.
english: Saudi Arabia has played a major role in U.S. foreign policy, including assisting and facilitating U.S. ceasefire talks with Russia and Ukraine.

text: Suno naman kay Trump sa una sini nga statement, gusto sini maselyuhan ang agreement sa Riyadh nga mag-invest sang tubtub sa $1 trillion sa U.S. economy lakip na ang purchases sang military equipment.#
english: Trump said in his first statement that he wants to seal an agreement with Riyadh to invest up to $1 trillion in the U.S. economy including purchases of military equipment.

text: Nagpadala sang relief goods ang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) District Western Visayas sa mga apektado sang magnitude 6.9 nga linog sa Cebu.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) District Western Visayas sent relief goods to the victims of the magnitude 6.9 earthquake in Cebu.

text: Ini kabahin sang donation campaign nga ginhimo sang PCG District Western Visayas kaupod ang mga local stakeholders, volunteers, civic partners kag government agencies agud makabulig sa mga biktima sang 6.9 magnitude nga linog.
english: This is part of the donation campaign conducted by the PCG District Western Visayas together with local stakeholders, volunteers, civic partners and government agencies to help the victims of the 6.9 magnitude earthquake.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Commander Richard Gura, Station Commander sang Coast Guard Station Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ginkarga ang goods sa BRP Corregidor.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Commander Richard Gura, Station Commander of the Coast Guard Station Iloilo, said the goods were loaded at BRP Corregidor.

text: Lakip diri ang food packs, bottled water, hygiene kits, kag medical supplies.
english: This includes food packs, bottled water, hygiene kits, and medical supplies.

text: Nagapanawagan man si Commander Gura sa publiko nga kun may yara pa sang luyag maghatag sang bulig ukon donasyon, mahimo lang nga makipag-angot sa opisina sang Coast Guard District Western Visayas sa Bo.
english: Commander Gura also appealed to the public that if anyone wants to donate, they can contact the office of the Coast Guard District Western Visayas in Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City ukon sa Coast Guard Station Iloilo sa Fort San Pedro, Brgy.
english: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City or at the Coast Guard Station Iloilo at Fort San Pedro, Brgy.

text: Concepcion, Iloilo City.
english: Concepcion, Iloilo City.

text: Sa latest report sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), nagdangat na sa 68 ang patay bangud sa linog sa Cebu.
english: According to the latest report of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), the death toll from the earthquake in Cebu has risen to 68.

text: Sa subong, naka-record na ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) sang 4,581 aftershocks nga may kabaskugon humalin sa 1.0 tubtob 5.1.
english: So far, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) has recorded 4,581 aftershocks with magnitudes ranging from 1.0 to 5.1.

text: Padayon naman nga gin-abisuhan sang ahensya ang publiko nga mangin alerto bangud apisar nga ginalauman nga maghagan-hagan na masami nga aftershocks, posible sa gihapon maka-record sang mabaskog nga aftershocks.
english: The agency continues to advise the public to remain alert because although the aftershocks are expected to ease, it is still possible to record strong aftershocks.

text: Gintalana na sa Abril 20 subong nga tuig ang petsa sang liwat nga pagsaka sa ring sang Filipino boxing legend nga si Manny “Pacman” Pacquiao.
english: Filipino boxing legend Manny “Pacman” Pacquiao is scheduled to return to the ring on April 20 this year.

text: Atubangon sang 45-anyos nga eight-division world champion ang 41-anyos nga Muay Thai superstar nga si Buakaw Banchamek sa amo nga exhibition match nga ginatawag nga “The Match of Legends”.
english: The 45-year-old eight-division world champion will face 41-year-old Muay Thai superstar Buakaw Banchamek in the exhibition match called “The Match of Legends”.

text: Suno sa event organizers, may pondo ang boxing event nga nagadangat sa $25 million ukon P1.36 billion.
english: According to event organizers, the boxing event has a budget of $25 million or P1.36 billion.

text: Ang hampang ang pagabug-usan sang anum ka tag-tres minutos nga round, may duha ka minutos nga breaks, kag magasunod sa boxing rules.
english: The fight will consist of six three-minute rounds, with two-minute breaks, and will follow boxing rules.

text: Si Pacquaio ang may yara sang professional record nga 62 wins lakip na ang 39 knockouts, walo ka kalutusan kag duha ka draws.
english: Pacquaio has a professional record of 62 wins including 39 knockouts, eight defeats and two draws.

text: Magluwas sa hampang kay Buakaw, una na nga gin-anunsyo sang Pinoy ring icon ang iya natalana nga rematch sa undefeated boxer nga si Floyd Mayweather subong nga tuig.
english: Aside from the bout with Buakaw, the Pinoy ring icon has already announced his scheduled rematch with undefeated boxer Floyd Mayweather this year.

text: Retirado na si Pacquiao sa boksing apang ulihi ini nga nakahampang sa exhibition bout sang Disyembre 2022 sang ginlutos sini ang South Korean mixed martial artist nga si DK Yoo.
english: Pacquiao is retired from boxing but last fought in an exhibition bout in December 2022 when he defeated South Korean mixed martial artist DK Yoo.

text: Naglain na naman ang tono ni United States President Donald Trump samtang padayon ang diskusyon sa kun paano tapuson ang gyera sang Ukraine kag Russia.
english: US President Donald Trump's tone has changed again as discussions continue on how to end the war between Ukraine and Russia.

text: Sa latest interview kay Trump, ginsiling sini nga tuman ang iya kaakig kay Russian leader Vladimir Putin bangud ginakwestyon sini ang kredibilidad ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
english: In the latest interview with Trump, he said that he is very angry with Russian leader Vladimir Putin because he questions the credibility of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

text: Ginsiling sini nga naugot siya bangud sa ginapanghambal ni Putin nga kakason si Zelensky bilang lider sang Ukraine bilang parte sang peace process.
english: He said he was angered by Putin's talk of removing Zelensky as Ukraine's leader as part of the peace process.

text: Suno pa kay Trump, kun indi sila makalab-ot sa kasugtanan kun paano tapuson ang gyera sa Ukraine kag kun sa pamatyagan niya sala ini sang Russia, magadagdag siya sang taripa sa langis nga halin sa Moscow.
english: Trump said that if they cannot reach an agreement on how to end the war in Ukraine and if he feels it is Russia's fault, he will increase tariffs on oil from Moscow.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginaduso ni Trump ang madasig nga pagtapos sang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera sa Ukraine, apang wala pa gihapon sang daku nga development sa negosasyon matapos ginbasura ni Putin ang joint US-Ukrainian plan sa 30-day ceasefire.
english: Trump has been pushing for a quick end to the three-year war in Ukraine, but there has still been little development in the negotiations after Putin scrapped the joint US-Ukrainian plan on a 30-day ceasefire.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga si Trump kag si Zelensky ang nagbaisay man mismo sa Oval Office sa White House sang naistoryahan ang gyera.
english: Earlier, Trump and Zelensky had an argument in the Oval Office at the White House when the war was discussed.

text: Nasaksihan pa ini sang bilog nga kalibutan bangud natabo ang pagbaisay kag pagpang-insulto sang US president kay Zelensky sa atubang mismo sang media.
english: The whole world witnessed this because the US president argued and insulted Zelensky in front of the media.

text: Gilayon nga ginpatuman sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang automatic price freeze sa tanan nga mga balaklon matapos gindeklarar ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) immediately implemented an automatic price freeze on all commodities after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. declared a freeze on all commodities.

text: ang state of national calamity bangud sang halit nga gintuga ni Bagyo Tino sa Visayas kag Mindanao.
english: the state of national calamity due to the damage caused by Typhoon Tino in the Visayas and Mindanao.

text: Suno sa DTI, magapadayon ang price freeze sulod sang 60 ka adlaw agud masiguro nga indi magtaas ang presyo sang mga balaklon sa mga apektado nga lugar.
english: According to the DTI, the price freeze will continue for 60 days to ensure that the prices of goods in the affected areas do not rise.

text: Pahayag pa sang ahensya, padayon sila nga makigsapol sa mga manufacturer, retailer, kag distributor agud mamentenar ang enough nga suplay sang mga balaklon kag prime commodities.
english: The agency said it will continue to meet with manufacturers, retailers, and distributors to maintain sufficient supply of goods and prime commodities.

text: Ginsiguro man sang DTI nga ang ila mga regional kag provincial offices ang naka-alerto kag nakahanda sa pagpatuman kag pagbantay sa pagsunod sang mga establisimyento sa price freeze.
english: The DTI also ensured that its regional and provincial offices are alert and ready to implement and monitor the compliance of establishments with the price freeze.

text: Naghatag sang inspirasyon ang istorya ang isa ka Ilongga nga wala nag-surrender sa pihak sang mga pagtilaw nga iya ginpangatubang antes naangkon ang kadalag-an bilang isa ka manunudlo sa Thailand.
english: The story of an Ilongga who did not surrender despite the trials he faced before achieving success as a teacher in Thailand gave inspiration.

text: Ini amo si Emelyn Faeldonia, sang Barangay Quinolpan, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: This is Emelyn Faeldonia, of Barangay Quinolpan, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Si Faeldonia ang nagtapos sa kurso nga Bachelor of Elementary Education with Specialization in Early Childhood Education sa West Visayas State University kag nangin kabahin sang Sea-Teacher Exchange Program sa Chiang Mai Rajabhat University sa Thailand.
english: Faeldonia graduated with a Bachelor of Elementary Education with Specialization in Early Childhood Education from West Visayas State University and was part of the Sea-Teacher Exchange Program at Chiang Mai Rajabhat University in Thailand.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Faeldonia, iya ginpahayag nga wala nangin mahapos ang iya paglab-ot sa iya mga handom.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Faeldonia said it was not easy for her to achieve her dreams.

text: Nagkuha ini sang Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET) sang 2019, apang napaslawan ini nga makapasar.
english: She took the Licensure Examination for Teachers (LET) in 2019, but failed to pass.

text: Sa pihak sang kapaslawan sini, wala siya nag-surrender.
english: Despite its failure, he did not surrender.

text: Sang 2023, liwat ini nga nagkuha sang LET kag sa amo nga tion, nakapasar na siya.
english: In 2023, he will again take the LET and by then, he will have passed.

text: Gin-umpisahan sini ang iya career bilang preschool teacher sa College of St.
english: She began her career as a preschool teacher at the College of St.

text: John-Roxas, sa diin nagtudlo ini sang apat ka tuig, antes nagdesisyon nga magpadulong sa Thailand sang Hulyo 2023.
english: John-Roxas, where she taught for four years, before deciding to head to Thailand in July 2023.

text: Bangud sa iya paghimakas, sang Agosto 2023, nabaton siya sa isa ka international school bilang manunudlo sang mga kabataan nga may special needs.
english: Because of her struggle, in August 2023, she was accepted into an international school as a teacher of children with special needs.

text: Sang Hunyo 2024, nabaton naman siya bilang preschool teacher sa isa ka Catholic school, sa diin siya nagatudlo tubtob subong.
english: In June 2024, she was rehired as a preschool teacher at a Catholic school, where she still teaches.

text: Sulod na ang 18-anyos nga Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa semifinals sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) Canberra International doubles tournament sa Australia.
english: 18-year-old Filipino tennis star Alex Eala is now in the semifinals of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) Canberra International doubles tournament in Australia.

text: Nadag-an nanday Eala kag sang iya partner nga si Laura Pigossi sang Brazil ang quarterfinal match paagi sa walkover batok kanday Anna Bondar sang Hungary kag Celine Naef sang Switzerland.
english: Eala and partner Laura Pigossi of Brazil won the quarterfinal match via walkover against Anna Bondar of Hungary and Celine Naef of Switzerland.

text: Antes ang quarterfinals, nakahimo sang upset sanday Eala sang ginlutos nila ang anay world No.
english: Before the quarterfinals, Eala caused an upset when they defeated former world No.

text: 1 doubles player nga si Sara Errani sang Italy kag Renata Zarazua sang Mexico sa round of 16.
english: 1 doubles player Sara Errani of Italy and Renata Zarazua of Mexico in the round of 16.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga hampang sang Pinay tennis ace matapos nga nalab-ot ang career-best ranking nga number 185 sa WTA standings sang New Year’s Day.#
english: This is the Filipina tennis ace's first match after reaching a career-best ranking of number 185 in the WTA standings on New Year's Day.

text:
Nagmandu ang Regional Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (RDRRMC) Region VI nga mag-implementar sang pre-emptive evacuation sa tanan nga high-risk areas bangud sang ginalantaw nga mangin epekto sang Super Typhoon “Uwan.”

Gin-address ang Memorandum No.
english:
The Regional Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (RDRRMC) Region VI has ordered the implementation of pre-emptive evacuation in all high-risk areas due to the expected impact of Super Typhoon “Uwan.”

Memorandum No.

text: 89, Series of 2025 sa tanan nga Provincial, City, kag Municipal DRRMCs sa Western Visayas.
english: 89, Series of 2025 to all Provincial, City, and Municipal DRRMCs in Western Visayas.

text: Base sa order ni Office of Civil Defense Region 6 Director Raul Fernandez nga amo ang chairman sang Regional Council, dapat nga i-activate man ang tanan nga Emergency Operations Centers kag siguraduhon nga may yara sang maayo nga koordinasyon sa Regional DRRMC Operations Center.
english: Based on the order of Office of Civil Defense Region 6 Director Raul Fernandez who is the chairman of the Regional Council, all Emergency Operations Centers should also be activated and ensure that there is good coordination with the Regional DRRMC Operations Center.

text: Dapat man suno kay Fernandez nga handa ang mga evacuation centers kag dapat nga may napreparar nga bastante nga pagkaon, tubig, bulong, kag health supplies.
english: Fernandez said evacuation centers should be ready and have enough food, water, medicine, and health supplies prepared.

text: Ginapahanumdom man ang pagpaguwa sang mga timely nga warnings sa mga komunidad ilabi na sa vulnerable nga mga grupo.
english: Timely warnings are also reminded to be issued to communities especially vulnerable groups.

text: Tuyo sini nga direktiba nga mapagamay ang casualties kag damage nga mahimo i-tuga sang super tyhoon.
english: The directive aims to minimize the casualties and damage that can be caused by a super typhoon.

text: Base sa forecast sang state weather bureau, magasulod si Uwan sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) karon sa gab-i ukon buwas sa kaagahon kag magadala sang pag-ulan kag makusog nga hangin sa madamo nga parte sang Pilipinas.
english: Based on the forecast of the state weather bureau, Uwan will enter the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) tonight or tomorrow morning and will bring rain and strong winds to many parts of the Philippines.

text: Ginalaragway man nga malapad ang sakop sang bagyo nga magasakop halin Batanes tubtub Bohol kag maka-apekto mangin sa areas nga malayo sa mata sang bagyo.
english: The typhoon is also described as having a wide range from Batanes to Bohol and will affect even areas far from the eye of the typhoon.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga bagyo subong nga Nobyembre sunod kay Bagyo Tino nga nagbilin sang masobra 100 ka mga patay ilabi na sa Central Visayas.#
english: This is the second typhoon this November after Typhoon Tino which left more than 100 dead especially in Central Visayas.

text: Patay ang amay kag duha niya ka mga anak nga sakay sang motorsiklo matapos sila mabungguan sang nagadalagan nga bus samtang nagatabok sa Maharlika National Highway sa Brgy.
english: A father and his two children were killed when they were hit by a speeding bus while crossing the Maharlika National Highway in Brgy.

text: Laboy, Matnog, Sorsogon.
english: Laboy, Matnog, Sorsogon.

text: Dead-on-the-spot ang 41-anyos nga amay nga si Noel, nga amo ang nagamaneho sang motorsiklo kag nagtabug ini sa sulod sang compound sang isa ka gasoline station, samtang ang 2-anyos niya nga anak patay nga nakit-an sa drainage canal sa kilid sang highway, kag ang 17-anyos nga si Angelica, duguan kag lipong nga nasapwan man sa kilid sang highway.
english: Dead-on-the-spot was 41-year-old father Noel, who was driving a motorcycle and it crashed into the compound of a gasoline station, while his 2-year-old son was found dead in a drainage canal on the side of the highway, and 17-year-old Angelica, bleeding and bruised on the side of the highway.

text: Suno sa report, nagasakay ang mag-amay sa ila motorsiklo kag nagpatughong sang gasolina sa amo nga lugar.
english: According to the report, the father and son were riding their motorcycle and filled up with gasoline in the area.

text:
Apang paghalin nila sa gasolinahan kag manugtabok sa highway, ginbungguan sila sang de-pampasahero nga bus sang Elavil Bus Lines nga may plakang NFU-5001 kag ginamaneho ni alyas “Caloy.”

Bangud sa kabaskug sang pagkabunggo, nagtabog sa malayo ang tatlo kag gin-arado pa sang bus ang ila motorsiklo sang kapin 20 ka metros.
english:
But when they left the gas station and crossed the highway, they were hit by a passenger bus of Elavil Bus Lines with license plate NFU-5001 and driven by alias “Caloy.”

Due to the force of the collision, the three fled far away and the bus plowed their motorcycle more than 20 meters.

text: Gindala naman sa pinakamalapit nga ospital ang bata nga si Angelica apang ginbawian man sang kabuhi samtang ginabulong.
english: Angelica was rushed to the nearest hospital but died while undergoing treatment.

text: Nahibaluan nga magakuha kuntani si Angelica sang medical certification para sa iya pag-eskwela sa kolehiyo sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: It was learned that Angelica was about to get a medical certification for her college studies when the accident happened.

text: Ginhunong na sang Matnog Police ang driver sang bus kag magaatubang sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide kag damage to property.
english: The driver of the bus has been arrested by Matnog Police and will face charges of reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide and damage to property.

text: Pat-od nga mabakod gid ang Strong Group sang Pilipinas nga ipadala sa 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship subong nga Enero bangud sa eight-time NBA All-Star kag three-time Defensive Player of the year nga si Dwight Howard, anay Oklahoma City Thunder guard nga si Andre Roberso, kag Gilas Pilipinas naturalized player nga si Andray Blatche.
english: The Strong Group of the Philippines will certainly be very strong to send to the 33rd Dubai International Basketball Championship this January thanks to eight-time NBA All-Star and three-time Defensive Player of the year Dwight Howard, former Oklahoma City Thunder guard Andre Roberso, and Gilas Pilipinas naturalized player Andray Blachet.

text: Ginkumpirma sang head coach nga si Charles Tiu ini nga development para sa team samtang nagahilapit na ang hinampang nga nakatalana sa Enero 19-28.
english: Head coach Charles Tiu confirmed this development for the team as the game scheduled for January 19-28 approaches.

text: Suno kay Tiu, magaabot sa masunod nga semana si Howard.
english: Tiu said Howard will arrive next week.

text: Antes ang paghampang para sa Pilipinas, nakaagi ang nasambit nga one-time NBA champion sa Taoyuan Leopards sa T1 League sa Taiwan.
english: Before playing for the Philippines, the one-time NBA champion played for the Taoyuan Leopards in the T1 League in Taiwan.

text: Kilala man siya sa iya stints sa Orlando Magic, Los Angeles Lakers kag Houston Rockets sa NBA kag nakasulod man sa Atlanta, Charlotte, Washington kag Philadelphia.
english: He is also known for his stints with the Orlando Magic, Los Angeles Lakers and Houston Rockets in the NBA and has also been in Atlanta, Charlotte, Washington and Philadelphia.

text: Magluwas anay NBA players, featured man sa hampang sang Pilipinas sa Dubai ang local talents kaangay sang UAAP Season 86 Most Valuable Player nga si Kevin Quiambao kag Francis Escandor sang La Salle kag si JD Cagulangan sang University of the Philippines.
english: Besides former NBA players, local talents such as UAAP Season 86 Most Valuable Player Kevin Quiambao and Francis Escandor of La Salle and JD Cagulangan of the University of the Philippines also featured in the Philippines game in Dubai.

text: Ang Former Bay Area Dragons head coach nga si Brian Goorjian ang mangin kabahin man sang coaching staff.
english: Former Bay Area Dragons head coach Brian Goorjian will also be part of the coaching staff.

text: Sang 2023, nagtapos ang kampanya sang Strong Group sa quarterfinals sang tournament sa bulig sang former NBA players nga sanday Nick Young kag Shabazz Mohammad.
english: In 2023, Strong Group’s campaign ended in the quarterfinals of the tournament with the help of former NBA players Nick Young and Shabazz Mohammad.

text: Ginkilala ang Filipino-American actress nga si Vanessa Hudgens bilang Global Tourism Ambassador for the Philippines.
english: Filipino-American actress Vanessa Hudgens has been recognized as the Global Tourism Ambassador for the Philippines.

text: Ginhatag ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.

text: ang honorary title kay Hudgens agud ma-promote sini ang turismo sang Pilipinas kag matib-ong ang global status sang pungsod.
english: the honorary title to Hudgens to promote Philippine tourism and enhance the country's global status.

text: Lakip sa nagsaksi sa conferment sa Malacañan Palace amo sanday Presidential Adviser on Creative Communications Paul Soriano kag Department of Tourism Secretary Christina Frasco.
english: Among those who witnessed the conference at Malacañan Palace were Presidential Adviser on Creative Communications Paul Soriano and Department of Tourism Secretary Christina Frasco.

text: Isa sa initiatives sang Office of the Presidential Adviser on Creative Communications kag DOT amo ang documentary project nga naga-highlight sang Filipino roots ni Hudgens.
english: One of the initiatives of the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Creative Communications and DOT is a documentary project highlighting Hudgens’ Filipino roots.

text: Lakip sa historical landmarks nga makit-an diri amo Intramuros kag ang National Museum sa Manila kag El Nido sa Palawan.
english: Among the historical landmarks that can be found here are Intramuros and the National Museum in Manila and El Nido in Palawan.

text: Popular si Hudgens nga isa ka High School Musical star nga subong may masobra 49 million followers sa Instagram; 6.5 million sa Twitter; 17 million sa Facebook; kag 239,000 sa YouTube.
english: Popular Hudgens is a High School Musical star who now has over 49 million followers on Instagram; 6.5 million on Twitter; 17 million on Facebook; and 239,000 on YouTube.

text: Naghingyo si Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga magtukod sang special body agud nga imbestigaran ang linibo ka kabuhi nga nadula bangud sang drug war sang nagligad nga administrasyon.
english: to establish a special body to investigate the thousands of lives lost due to the drug war of the previous administration.

text: Nakabutang ini sa iya sulat nga napetsahan nga Nobyembre 7, 2025.
english: It was contained in his letter dated November 7, 2025.

text: Suno kay Cardinal David nga amo man ang presidente sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), kun may tukuron nga “National Truth and Reconciliation Commission”, makabulig ini nga mabalik ang dignidad sang mga pamilya sang biktima nga subong padayon nga nagapangita sang hustisya.
english: According to Cardinal David, who is also the president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), if a “National Truth and Reconciliation Commission” is established, it will help restore the dignity of the families of the victims who are now continuing to seek justice.

text: Pahayag ni Cardinal David, ang tukuron nga komisyon amo ang magabukad sang kamatuoran, magasiguro sang accountability, kag makabulig man sa pungsod nga magbangon nga may katampad kag moral clarity.
english: Cardinal David said the commission will uncover the truth, ensure accountability, and help the country rise with integrity and moral clarity.

text: Ini nga special body suno sa Cardinal amo ang makahatag sa mga biktima kag mga testigo sang safe venue, ma-repaso ang mga wala naresolba na kaso, kag maka-rekomendar sang reparations, support, kag institutional reforms agud malikawan ang mga masunod pa nga pagpang-abuso.
english: This special body, according to the Cardinal, will provide victims and witnesses with a safe venue, review unresolved cases, and recommend reparations, support, and institutional reforms to prevent further abuses.

text: “Truth-telling is not an act of reopening wounds– it is the only path by which wounds can finally heal,” kabahin sang sulat ni Cardinal David.
english: “Truth-telling is not an act of reopening wounds– it is the only path by which wounds can finally heal,” Cardinal David’s letter reads.

text:
“Silence breeds resentment and fear, truth restores dignity, trust, and moral coherence to our democracy.”

Suno pa sa iya, ang pagtukod sini nga komisyon amo ang magapakita sang gamhanan nga mensahe nga ginapili sang Pilipinas ang kaisog sa baylo sang kahadlok; accountability sa baylo sang impunity; kag reconciliation sa baylo sang paghipos.
english:
“Silence breeds resentment and fear, truth restores dignity, trust, and moral coherence to our democracy.”

He said the establishment of this commission will show the powerful message that the Philippines chooses courage over fear; accountability instead of impunity; and reconciliation instead of silence.

text: “It would reaffirm a principle that lies at the heart of our democracy and our shared faith traditions: that every human life has dignity and worth,” pahayag pa sini.
english: “It would reaffirm a principle that lies at the heart of our democracy and our shared faith traditions: that every human life has dignity and worth,” it said.

text: Subong nga adlaw sang ginsapubliko ni Cardinal David ang panawagan nga ini sang nag-atubang siya sa media kaupod ang mga pamilya sang biktima sang war on drugs, miyembro sang simbahan, civil society groups, kag youth organizations.
english: Today, Cardinal David made this call public when he appeared before the media with the families of victims of the war on drugs, church members, civil society groups, and youth organizations.

text: Nahibaluan nga si David ang nagapungko man nga bishop sang Caloocan kag sakop sang iya Diocese ang Caloocan kag Navotas amo ang ginakabig nga “ground zero” sang drug war ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.#
english: David is also the incumbent bishop of Caloocan and his diocese includes Caloocan and Navotas, which are considered the “ground zero” of former President Rodrigo Duterte's drug war.

text: Isa ka 13-anyos nga dalagita ang nagbusong matapos nga pila ka beses nga ginhimuslan sang isa ka 19-anyos nga lalaki sa Calamba, Laguna.
english: A 13-year-old girl became pregnant after being raped several times by a 19-year-old man in Calamba, Laguna.

text: Suno sa pulis,makapila ka beses nga ginhimuslan sang suspek ang biktima nga nagresulta sa pagbusong sini.
english: According to police, the suspect raped the victim several times which resulted in her becoming pregnant.

text: Sang gin-aresto ang suspek nga construction worker, hinali lang ini nga nagdalagan samtang ginabasahan sang Miranda Rights.
english: When the suspect, a construction worker, was arrested, he suddenly ran away while being read his Miranda Rights.

text: Makaligad ang pila ka minutos nga lagsanay, nadakpan ini.
english: After a few minutes of chasing, he was caught.

text: Ginpamilit naman sang lalaki nga isa ka construction worker nga pareho nila nga gin-gusto ang ila sekswal nga aktibidad.
english: The man, a construction worker, insisted that they both enjoyed their sexual activity.

text: Natalana nga pasakaan sang nagakaigo nga kaso ang suspek.
english: The suspect is scheduled to face appropriate charges.

text: Tuman ang kalisod sang isa ka babaye sa Cebu matapos napatay ang iya bana kag tatlo ka kabataan sa tunga paglaslas sang Bagyo Tino.
english: A woman in Cebu is in dire straits after her husband and three children were killed in the middle of Typhoon Tino.

text: Napatay ang mga ini matapos narusdak ang ginsakaan nila nga balay kag gin-anod sang baha sa Liloan, Cebu.
english: They died after their house collapsed and was swept away by floods in Liloan, Cebu.

text: Suno kay Krizza Espra, nagsaka sila sa atop sang isa ka balay apang wala masarangan ang ila bug-at rason nga nawasdak.
english: According to Krizza Espra, they climbed onto the roof of a house but could not support their weight and collapsed.

text: Ang mga napatay nga kabataan ang nagaedad sang isa, tatlo, kag walo.
english: The children who died were ages one, three, and eight.

text: Napatay man ang iya amay kag hinablos.
english: His father and nephew were also killed.

text: Missing naman ang iya iloy, tiya kag duwa ka hinablos.
english: His mother, aunt and two nephews are missing.

text: Naka-recover na ang banana exports sang Pilipinas bangud sa mas madamo nga shipments sang 2023.
english: Philippine banana exports have recovered due to more shipments in 2023.

text: Ini ang nagtapos sang apat ka tuig gid nga pagsarurot sang exports kun sa diin isa sa ginalantaw nga rason amo ang mga produkto nga apektado sang Panama disease.
english: This ended a four-year decline in exports where one of the reasons is believed to be products affected by Panama disease.

text: Suno sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), naka-export ang Pilipinas sang 2.354 million metric tons sang fresh bananas sang 2023 nga 3.5 percent nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa 2.275 million MT nga napaguwa sang 2022.
english: According to data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the Philippines exported 2.354 million metric tons of fresh bananas in 2023 which is 3.5 percent higher compared to the 2.275 million MT released in 2022.

text: Kun balor naman ang paga-isipon, naka-rekord man ang Pilipinas sang three-year high export receipt sang 2023 kun sa diin naglab-ot ini sa $1.22 billion nga 11 percent nga mas mataas sa $1.097 billion sang 2022.
english: In terms of value, the Philippines also recorded a three-year high export receipt in 2023 of $1.22 billion, 11 percent higher than $1.097 billion in 2022.

text: Lakip sa ginpasalamatan sang Pilipino Banana Growers and Exporters Association (PBGEA) sa recovery sang exports amo ang padayon nga rehabilitasyon sang mga uma nga apektado anay sang Panama disease.
english: Among the things that the Philippine Banana Growers and Exporters Association (PBGEA) thanked for the recovery of exports is the continuous rehabilitation of farms that were previously affected by Panama disease.

text: Ang ginatan-aw naman subong nga makaapekto sa produksyon kag sa exports amo ang natabo nga pagbaha sa Mindanao kun sa diin indi maayo ang operasyon sang pila ka mga plantasyon sa rehiyon.
english: What is expected to affect production and exports is the flooding in Mindanao where some plantations in the region are not operating properly.

text: “Fingers crossed that despite the flooding, we will still produce more than what we produced in 2023 by continuously rehabilitating (areas) and containing the further spread of Panama disease,” suno kay PBGEA executive director Stephen Antig.
english: “Fingers crossed that despite the flooding, we will still produce more than what we produced in 2023 by continuously rehabilitating (areas) and containing the further spread of Panama disease,” according to PBGEA executive director Stephen Antig.

text: Nagakahangawa man ang banana industry nga buslan na sang Guatemala ang Pilipinas bilang ikaduha nga pinakadaku nga banana exporters sa kalibutan.
english: The banana industry is also concerned that Guatemala will replace the Philippines as the second largest banana exporter in the world.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa 2023 banana market review sang Food and Agriculture Organizations sang United Nations, nagapangaduha ang Pilipinas sa Ecuador sa pinakadaku nga exporter sang saging sa bilog nga kalibutan samtang nagapang-tatlo naman ang Guatemala.
english: Based on the 2023 banana market review of the Food and Agriculture Organizations of the United Nations, the Philippines is the second largest exporter of bananas in the world after Ecuador while Guatemala is the third.

text: Kun sa Asya lamang ang pagahambalan, ang Pilipinas amo ang top exporter kun sa diin ang mga ka-kumpetisyon sini nga banana producers amo ang Vietnam, Cambodia kag India.#
english: In Asia alone, the Philippines is the top exporter while its competitors are Vietnam, Cambodia and India.

text: Tatlo ka pelikula ang kasakuan sang aktres nga si Kathryn Bernardo lakip na ang reunion project kaupod sa iya boyfriend nga amo ang singer-actor nga si Daniel Padilla.
english: Actress Kathryn Bernardo is busy with three films including a reunion project with her boyfriend singer-actor Daniel Padilla.

text: Sa ika-27 nga kaadlawan ni Kathryn, gin-anunsyo man nga maga-bida siya sa “A Very Good Girl” film kaupod kay Golden Globe nominee Dolly De Leon kag iga-direct ni Petersen Vargas.
english: On Kathryn’s 27th birthday, it was also announced that she will star in the film “A Very Good Girl” alongside Golden Globe nominee Dolly De Leon and will be directed by Petersen Vargas.

text: Isa ini ka dark comedy genre kag yara man si Marionne Dominique Mancol bilang screenwriter, Carmi Raymundo bilang creative manager, kag Daniel Saniana bilang creative supervisor.
english: It is a dark comedy genre and also features Marionne Dominique Mancol as screenwriter, Carmi Raymundo as creative manager, and Daniel Saniana as creative supervisor.

text: Maga-reunite man si Kath sa veteran filmmaker nga si Olivia Lamasan matapos ang ila madinalag-on nga pag-updanay sa proyekto sa “Barcelona: A Love Untold” sang 2016.
english: Kath will also reunite with veteran filmmaker Olivia Lamasan after their successful project collaboration on “Barcelona: A Love Untold” in 2016.

text: Ang ila nga reunion project amo ang historical action-drama film nga “Elena 1944” nga amo ang istorya sang comfort women sang tion sang Japanese occupation sa Pilipinas.
english: Their reunion project is the historical action-drama film “Elena 1944” which is the story of comfort women during the Japanese occupation of the Philippines.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Kath nga ang iya nga reunion film upod kay Daniel ang iga-shoot pagkatapos sang “A Very Good Girl”, apang wala pa sini gin-detalye ang iban nga bahin sang pelikula.
english: Kath also confirmed that her reunion film with Daniel will be shot after “A Very Good Girl”, but did not elaborate on the other parts of the film.

text: Napuhag sang bomb threat ang University of The Philippines Visayas- Iloilo City Campus kaina sang aga.
english: The University of the Philippines Visayas-Iloilo City Campus was rocked by a bomb threat this morning.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Gerthrode Charlotte Tan Mabilog, information section head kag faculty man sang unibersidad, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton sang mensahe sa messenger ang pila ka mga estudyante.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gerthrode Charlotte Tan Mabilog, information section head and faculty of the university, said some students received messages on messenger.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, ang threat nagsugod bilang isa ka spam message nga nag-circulate paagi sa isa ka gin-hack nga Facebook account sang isa ka UP High School nga estudyante.
english: According to Mabilog, the threat started as a spam message that circulated through a hacked Facebook account of a UP High School student.

text:
Pahayag niya, ang amo nga estudyante ang ginapahayag nga nadulaan sang access sa iya account antes naglapta ang mensahe.(UPV 333)

Madasig nga naglapta ang amo nga mensahe kag nagresulta sang kabalaka sa mga estudyante.
english:
He said the student allegedly lost access to his account before the message spread. (UPV 333)

Such a message spread quickly and caused concern among students.

text: Bangud sa insidente, gilayon gin-suspend ang face-to-face classes.
english: Due to the incident, face-to-face classes were immediately suspended.

text: Natigayon naman nga ma-clear sang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag sang bomb squad ang bilog nga campus.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) and the bomb squad managed to clear the entire campus.

text: Performer slash fangirl ang Filipino-British singer-songwriter nga si Beatrice Kristi Laus ukon mas kilala nga beabadoobee sang nag-upod ini sa second show ni Taylor Swift sa Las Vegas.
english: Filipino-British singer-songwriter Beatrice Kristi Laus or better known as beabadoobee was a performer slash fangirl when she joined Taylor Swift's second show in Las Vegas.

text: Gin-share sang Ilongga singer ang iya clips kag pictures sa “Eras” concert kun sa diin siya ang nagkanta kag nag-play sang guitar sa opening act.
english: The Ilongga singer shared his clips and pictures from the “Eras” concert where he sang and played guitar in the opening act.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga indi pa sya gihapon maka-recover nga makaupod ang 33-anyos nga Shake It Off icon nga iya gintawag nga queen.
english: He said he still can't recover from being with the 33-year-old Shake It Off icon whom he called a queen.

text: “I will never recover from this.
english: “I will never recover from this.

text: 2nd Vegas show tn w the queen herself @taylorswift,” caption sini sa iya Instagram post.
english: 2nd Vegas show tn w the queen herself @taylorswift,” she captioned her Instagram post.

text: Nabun-ag sa Iloilo City si beabadoobee kag nagsaylo sa London ang pamilya sang siya ang naga-edad sang tatlo ka tuig.
english: Beabadoobee was born in Iloilo City and the family moved to London when he was three years old.

text: Kilala siya sa iya debut studio album nga “Fake It Flower” nga ginpaguwa sang 2020, kag second album “Beatopia” sang 2022.
english: She is best known for her debut studio album “Fake It Flower” released in 2020, and second album “Beatopia” in 2022.

text: Magluwas sa Las Vegas, yara man si beabadoobee sa show ni Taylor sa Arlington, Texas; Tampa, Florida; Houston; kag Atlanta.
english: In addition to Las Vegas, beabadoobee was also at Taylor’s show in Arlington, Texas; Tampa, Florida; Houston; and Atlanta.

text: Natalana pa nga ianunsyo kun may Asian stops para sa “Eras” tour ni Taylor.
english: Any Asian stops for Taylor’s “Eras” tour are yet to be announced.

text: Indi kuntento ang kalabanan nga mga Pinoy kun paano gina-handle sang Marcos Jr.
english: Most Filipinos are not satisfied with how Marcos Jr. is handling the situation.

text: administration ang problema sa inflation kag kapigaduhon sa pungsod.
english: administration the problem of inflation and poverty in the country.

text: Ini apisar nga nakit-an nga nagnubo na ang inflation rate halin sang nagliligad nga binulan.
english: This is despite the fact that the inflation rate has decreased since last month.

text: Sa resulta sang Disyembre 10- 14 nga survey sang Octa Research kag ginpaguwa kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 17, record-high nga 75 percent sang respondents ang nagsiling nga wala sila nanamian sa performance sang gobyerno sa pagtapna sa nagasaka nga presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: In the results of the December 10-14 survey by Octa Research and released yesterday, February 17, a record-high 75 percent of respondents said they were not satisfied with the government's performance in curbing rising commodity prices.

text: Sais porsyento lamang ang nagsiling nga kuntento sila samtang 19% naman ang indi maka-desisyon.
english: Only six percent said they were satisfied while 19% were undecided.

text: Sang Oktubre 2023, matandaan nga sa amo man nga survey nga ginpatigayon sa reaksyon kun paano gin-kontrol sang gobyerno ang inflation, 11% nga mas mataas ang indi kuntento subong nga period bangud 65% lamang ang na-rekord sang amo nga bulan.
english: In October 2023, it can be recalled that in the same survey conducted in reaction to how the government has controlled inflation, 11% higher dissatisfaction this period as only 65% ​​was recorded that month.

text: Matandaan nga gin-report sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) nga naghinay sa 2.8 percent ang inflation sang Enero 2024 nga amo ang pinakamanubo sa nagligad nga tatlo ka tuig.
english: The Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) reported that inflation will slow to 2.8 percent in January 2024, the lowest in three years.

text:
Mas manubo ini ipaanggid sa 4.9 percent sang Oktubre, 4.1 percent sang Nobyembre kag 3.9 percent sang Disyembre.#



(Photo: EDD GUMBAN)
english:
This is lower than 4.9 percent in October, 4.1 percent in November and 3.9 percent in December.



(Photo: EDD GUMBAN)

text: Ginpaidalom sa Alert level 1 ang pila ka mga kabanwahanan sa probinsya matapos ang nag-igo nga magnitude 6.9 nga linog sa Cebu nga nabatyagan man sa Iloilo.
english: Several towns in the province were placed under Alert level 1 after a magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck Cebu and was also felt in Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr Alfonso Baldonado III, Deputy incident Commander kag Division Head sang Admin and Training sang Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), iya ginpahayag nga nalakip diri ang Alimodian, Leon, kag Maasin bangud ginatan-aw ang posible paghulag sang duta base man sa data sang PHIVOLCS.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dr Alfonso Baldonado III, Deputy Incident Commander and Division Head of Admin and Training of the Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), said Alimodian, Leon, and Maasin are included because they are looking at possible landslides based on PHIVOLCS data.

text: Lakip sa rekord ang ginaconsider nga critical facilities amo ang Jibolo Bridge sa banwa sang Janiuay, Iloilo matapos nakitaan sang minor cracks ang taytay apang fit sa gihapon nga agyan.
english: Among the recorded critical facilities is the Jibolo Bridge in Janiuay, Iloilo after the bridge was found to have minor cracks but is still fit for passage.

text: Padasigon sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) ang pag-review kag paghatag sang approval sa aplikasyon para sa generic drugs.
english: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) will expedite the review and approval of applications for generic drugs.

text: Suno sa opisina, halin sa nakaandan nga 120 ka adlaw, himuon na lamang nga 45 ka adlaw ang processing period.
english: According to the office, from the usual 120 days, the processing period will be reduced to 45 days.

text: Apang gin-athag man nga magapabilin ang amo gihapon nga requirements para sa aplikasyon.
english: However, it was also clarified that the same requirements for the application will remain.

text: Ang mas ginpanubo nga processing period ang sandig man sa mandu ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The reduced processing period is also based on the order of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: sa tuyo nga ma-improve ang public access sa generic kag mas barato nga bulong.
english: with the aim of improving public access to generic and cheaper medicine.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni FDA director general Dr. Samuel Zacate nga nagmandu si Marcos nga i-streamline ang drug application kag regulatory processes sa Pilipinas.
english: Earlier, FDA director general Dr. Samuel Zacate said Marcos ordered to streamline drug application and regulatory processes in the Philippines.

text: Ginmandu ni Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil Billones nga magpatigayon sang structural integrity assessment sa tanan nga mga simbahan sa idalom sang Archdiocese of Jaro.
english: Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil Billones ordered a structural integrity assessment to be conducted in all churches under the Archdiocese of Jaro.

text: Ini kasunod sang magnitude 6.9 nga linog nga natabo sa Bogo, Cebu nga nabatyagan man sa isla sang Panay.
english: This follows the magnitude 6.9 earthquake that occurred in Bogo, Cebu which was also felt on the island of Panay.

text: Suno sa Commission on Social Communications sang Archdiocese of Jaro, ang ini nga tikang ang magapasiguro nga hilway ang mga tumuluo sa ila pagpadulong sa mga simbahan.
english: According to the Commission on Social Communications of the Archdiocese of Jaro, this move will ensure that the faithful are free to go to churches.

text: Angot sini, gin-reschedule ang Diaconal Ordination nga natalana kuntani nga hiwaton subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 2, 2025.
english: In this regard, the Diaconal Ordination which was scheduled to be held today, October 2, 2025, has been rescheduled.

text: Ginsaylo ini sa Oktubre 27, las-2:00 sang hapon sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: It was moved to October 27, 2:00 pm at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Wala sang nakabutang nga rematch sa fight contract nanday Japanese boxing superstar Naoya Inoue kag Pinoy boxer Marlon Tapales.
english: There is no rematch in the fight contract between Japanese boxing superstar Naoya Inoue and Pinoy boxer Marlon Tapales.

text: Apang suno kay Sean Gibbons, presidente sang Manny Pacquiao (MP) Promotions, wala sang mangin problema sa ila pananglitan pabalikon sila sa Japan para sa ikaduha nga pagkitaay sang duha ka boksidor.
english: But according to Sean Gibbons, president of Manny Pacquiao (MP) Promotions, there will be no problem with them if they are sent back to Japan for a second meeting between the two boxers.

text: Nagapati man si Gibbons nga si Tapales ang mangin labing-una nga unified Filipino champion pagkatapos sang sambuwa.
english: Gibbons also believes that Tapales will be the first unified Filipino champion after the fight.

text: Ginpahayag dugang sang Filipino boxer nga excited na siya nga makaatubang sa ring si Inoue nga amo ang current pound-for-pound king.
english: The Filipino boxer said he is excited to face Inoue, the current pound-for-pound king.

text: 1:00 karon sa hapon, Disyembre 25, patigayunon ang official weigh-in.
english: 1:00 pm today, December 25, the official weigh-in will be held.

text: Lauman nga makit-an sa hampang sa Martes sang gab-i sa Tokyo si Bob Arum — ang top rank chief kag world’s greatest salesman sa boxing kag promoter sang Hall-of-Fame boxers kaangay kanday Muhammad Ali, Sugar Ray Leonard, Marvin Hagler, kag Manny Pacquiao.
