english: Bob Arum — the top rank chief and world’s greatest salesman in boxing and promoter of Hall-of-Fame boxers like Muhammad Ali, Sugar Ray Leonard, Marvin Hagler, and Manny Pacquiao — is expected to be seen in Tuesday night’s match in Tokyo.

text: Undefeated si Inoue (25-0 nga may 22 knockouts) kag amo ang naga-uyat sang World Boxing Organization (WBO) kag World Boxing Council (WBC) titles.
english: Inoue is undefeated (25-0 with 22 knockouts) and holds the World Boxing Organization (WBO) and World Boxing Council (WBC) titles.

text: Si Tapales naman ukon kilala nga “Nightmare” (37-3 nga may 19 knockouts) amo ang nagauyat sang korona sa World Boxing Association (WBA) kag International Boxing Federation (IBF).#
english: Tapales, also known as “Nightmare” (37-3 with 19 knockouts), holds the crown in the World Boxing Association (WBA) and International Boxing Federation (IBF).#

text: “Unbothered” ang Malacañang sa resulta sang isa ka survey nga nagapakita nga nagnubo ang trust kag performance ratings ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: Malacañang is “unbothered” by the results of a survey showing that President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr.'s trust and performance ratings have declined.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, nagapati ini nga kalabanan ukon mayorya sang mga Pilipino ang may salig gihapon sa presidente.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, she believes that the majority of Filipinos still have confidence in the president.

text: Mataas ukon manubo man ang numero suno kay Castro, magapadayon si Marcos kag ang gobyerno sa pag-trabaho para sa mga pulumuyo.
english: Whether the number is high or low, Castro said, Marcos and the government will continue to work for the people.

text: “Sabi nga po natin, ano man ang numero, mataas, mababa at hangga’t nagtatrabaho ang ating Pangulo at ang gobyerno o para sa taumbayan tuluy-tuloy pa rin po, at hindi po tayo maaapektuhan ng anuman pong numero,” suno sa iya.
english: “We said, whatever the number, high, low and as long as our President and the government are working or for the people, it will continue, and we will not be affected by any number,” he said.

text: Kaangot ini sa latest Tugon ng Masa survey sang OCTA Research kun sa diin nag-us-os sang 7% ang trust ratings ni Marcos halin sa 64% sang Hulyo 2025.
english: This is in line with the latest Tugon ng Masa survey by OCTA Research where Marcos' trust ratings fell by 7% from 64% in July 2025.

text: Nagnubo naman sang 8% ang performance ratings sini halin sa 62% sang Hulyo 2025.
english: Its performance ratings fell 8% from 62% in July 2025.

text: Pareho man ang natabo kay Vice President Sara Duterte nga may gamay apang padayon nga pagnubo sa trust and performance ratings.
english: The same thing happened to Vice President Sara Duterte with a slight but steady decline in trust and performance ratings.

text: Nagpadala ang North Korea sang 3,000 ka dugang nga mga soldado sa Russia subong nga tuig agud ipakita ang ila suporta sa gyera sang Moscow sa Ukraine.
english: North Korea has sent 3,000 additional troops to Russia this year to show its support for Moscow’s war in Ukraine.

text: Ini nga report ang nagikan sa South Korean military nga ginpaguwa sa tunga sang balita nga ginahandaan naman ang pagbisita mismo ni North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sa teritoryo ni President Vladimir Putin.
english: The report came from the South Korean military amid news that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is preparing to visit President Vladimir Putin's territory.

text: Ang reinforcements nga ginapahayag ginpadala sang Enero kag Pebrero amo ang nagdugang sa 11,000 nga una naman nga gin-deploy sang North Korea sa Moscow suno sa South Korea Joint Chiefs of Staff.
english: The reinforcements reportedly sent in January and February are in addition to the 11,000 that North Korea had previously deployed in Moscow, according to the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff.

text: Sa amo nga numero sang tropa, 4,000 ang napatay kag nasamaran sa away suno pa sa Seoul.
english: Of those troops, 4,000 were killed and wounded in the fighting, Seoul said.

text: Pahayag pa sang South, naggamit man ang Pyongyang sang madamo nga short-range ballistic missiles kag ginabanta 220 pieces sang 170-millimeter self-propelled howitzers kag 240-millimeter multiple rocket launchers.
english: The South said Pyongyang also used a large number of short-range ballistic missiles and an estimated 220 pieces of 170-millimeter self-propelled howitzers and 240-millimeter multiple rocket launchers.

text: Base pa sa Seoul, posible pa nga magdaku ang kontribusyon sang North depende sa dalagan sang sitwasyon sa Ukraine.
english: Based on Seoul, the North's contribution is likely to increase depending on the situation in Ukraine.

text: Nahibaluan nga natalana naman nga magkitaay ang mga European leaders kag allies sa Paris, France agud nga diskusyunan ang gyera sa Ukraine kag agud nga malab-ot ang long-term stability sa rehiyon bangud wala pa sang kasiguruhan kun madayon ang ceasefire nga ginduso sang White House.
english: European leaders and allies are scheduled to meet in Paris, France to discuss the war in Ukraine and to achieve long-term stability in the region as there is still uncertainty whether the ceasefire proposed by the White House will continue.

text: Gin-ako sang Japanese boxing superstar nga si Naoya Inoue nga may ginakakulbaan man ini sa ila nagahilapit nga sambuwa sang Pinoy champion nga si Marlon Tapales.
english: Japanese boxing superstar Naoya Inoue admitted that he is also nervous about their upcoming fight with Pinoy champion Marlon Tapales.

text: Si Inoue ang heavy favorite nga magdaog sa amo nga super bantamweight unification bout apang suno sa iya, ang iya ginakabalak-an amo ang pagkumpyansa ilabi na bangud madamo nga tawo ang nagapati nga mangin mahapos lang para sa iya ang away.
english: Inoue is the heavy favorite to win that super bantamweight unification bout but he said his concern is confidence especially since many people believe the fight will be easy for him.

text: Nagapati ang team sang “The Monster” nga delikado nga kontra si Tapales gani nagdala sila sang sparring partners halin sa iban nga mga pungsod agud nga mahandaan niya ang nagkalain-lain nga istilo sa away.
english: The team of “The Monster” believes that Tapales is a dangerous opponent so they brought sparring partners from other countries to prepare him for different fighting styles.

text: “For this fight I am dealing with a different training regiment, making adjustments, and building up an image in my mind of myself as a boxer who is dexterous and can do anything,” suno sa Japanese boxer.
english: “For this fight I am dealing with a different training regiment, making adjustments, and building up an image in my mind of myself as a boxer who is dexterous and can do anything,” according to the Japanese boxer.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga magahalong siya bangud posible nga makahimo matuod sang upset ang Pinoy boxer.
english: He also said that he will be careful because it is possible that the Filipino boxer will cause an upset.

text: “I improved a lot, and worked on counters against Tapales.
english: “I improved a lot, and worked on counters against Tapales.

text: We had very good training sessions and we have made it to this point,” dugang pa sini.
english: We had very good training sessions and we have made it to this point,” he added.

text: Undefeated si Inoue (25-0 nga may 22 knockouts), current pound-for-pound king, kag amo ang naga-uyat sang World Boxing Organization (WBO) kag World Boxing Council (WBC) titles.
english: Inoue is undefeated (25-0 with 22 knockouts), current pound-for-pound king, and is the holder of the World Boxing Organization (WBO) and World Boxing Council (WBC) titles.

text: Si Tapales naman ukon kilala nga “Nightmare” (37-3 nga may 19 knockouts) amo ang nagauyat sang korona sa World Boxing Association (WBA) kag International Boxing Federation (IBF).
english: Tapales, also known as “Nightmare” (37-3 with 19 knockouts), holds the crown in the World Boxing Association (WBA) and International Boxing Federation (IBF).

text: Balantayan ang sambuwa sa Martes sang gab-i, Disyembre 26, sa Ariake Arena sa Tokyo, Japan.
english: Watch the fight on Tuesday night, December 26, at the Ariake Arena in Tokyo, Japan.

text: Magahampang man sa undercard sang unification showdown ang Cebuano boxer nga si John Paul Gabunilas nga maga-atubang kay Kanamu Sakama sang Japan sa eight-rounder non-title bout.#
english: Cebuano boxer John Paul Gabunilas will also play in the undercard of the unification showdown against Kanamu Sakama of Japan in an eight-rounder non-title bout.

text: Tuman nga pagkanugon ang nabatyagan sang mga himata sang soltero nga nasapwan nga patay sa Aglalana, Passi City.
english: The relatives of a young man who was found dead in Aglalana, Passi City are in shock.

text: Ang biktima amo si certain Roland, 23-anyos, residente Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as certain Roland, 23, resident of Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vanesa Cataluna, magulang sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga nagabuligay sila nga mag-utod para mahatag ang kinahanglanon sang ila ginikanan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vanesa Cataluna, the victim's elder sister, said they work together to provide for their parents.

text: Suno kay Cataluna, sang damlag lang sang naoperahan ang ila iloy bangud sa ginasuprir nga balatian nga cancer samtang ang ila amay naman ang isa ka stroke survivor nga indi pa normal ang hulag bangud paralisado gihapon ang isa ka kamot.
english: According to Cataluna, their mother recently underwent surgery due to cancer while their father is a stroke survivor whose movements are not normal because one hand is still paralyzed.

text: Pahayag ni Cataluna, maayo gid nga utod kag anak sa ila ginikanan ang biktima.
english: Cataluna said the victim was a good brother and son to their parents.

text: Sa subong, hustisya ang ila ginasinggitan bangud sa pagpati nga hungod nga gintiro ang ila himata.
english: They are now crying out for justice because they believe their relative was deliberately shot.

text: Magapauli sa labing-una nga tion sa Pilipinas ang Filipino-American actress nga si Vanessa Hudgens agud mag-film sang travel documentary sa Manila kag Palawan subong nga Marso.
english: Filipino-American actress Vanessa Hudgens will return to the Philippines for the first time to film a travel documentary in Manila and Palawan this March.

text: Ini nga documentary film ang magapakita sang family history kag Filipino roots ni Vanessa lakip na ang iya relasyon sa iya iloy nga si Gina kag iya utod nga si Stella.
english: This documentary film will show Vanessa's family history and Filipino roots as well as her relationship with her mother Gina and her sister Stella.

text: “I feel like ours is such a relatable story to so many women all over the world.
english: “I feel like ours is such a relatable story to so many women all over the world.

text: The more that we can share, the more we can lift each other up,” suno sa aktres.
english: The more that we can share, the more we can lift each other up,” according to the actress.

text: Sang 2022, matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Vanessa nga nagalaum siya nga mahimo nga isa ka pelikula ang immigrant story sang iya Filipina mother.
english: In 2022, Vanessa said she hoped to turn her Filipina mother's immigrant story into a movie.

text: Wala pa sang titulo ang project kag wala pa sang distributor apang natalana na nga i-direct ni Paul Soriano nga amo ang Presidential Adviser for Creative Communications.
english: The project has no title and no distributor but is scheduled to be directed by Paul Soriano who is the Presidential Adviser for Creative Communications.

text:
Kilala si Vanessa mga pelikula nga “High School Musical”, “Bad Boys for Life”, “Spring Breakers”, “The Princess Switch” series, kag “Tick, Tick…Boom!”

Engaged siya sa baseball player nga si Cole Tucker.
english:
Vanessa is known for the films “High School Musical”, “Bad Boys for Life”, “Spring Breakers”, “The Princess Switch” series, and “Tick, Tick…Boom!”

She is engaged to baseball player Cole Tucker.

text: Hustisya ang ginasinggitan sang pamilya sang soltero nga nasapwan nga patay sa Aglalana, Passi City.
english: The family of a young man found dead in Aglalana, Passi City is crying for justice.

text: Ang biktima amo si certain Roland, 23-anyos, residente Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as certain Roland, 23, resident of Barangay Danao, Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vanesa Cataluna, utod sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga hugot ang ila pagpati nga ginpatay ang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vanesa Cataluna, the victim's sister, said they firmly believe that the victim was killed.

text: Nahibaluan nga apisar una nga naggwa nga nagpanginmatay ang biktima sa sulod sang isa ka balay sa Aglalana, palaligban kun ngaa sa kawayanan sa gwa sang balay nakit-an ang gin-gamit nga pusil.
english: Although the victim initially committed suicide inside a house in Aglalana, it is questionable why the gun was found in the bamboo outside the house.

text: Ginklaro sang Iloilo Provincial Engineer’s Office nga makasarang magbato sang tubtub 7-8 magnitude nga linog ang Iloilo Provincial Capitol building.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Engineer's Office clarified that the Iloilo Provincial Capitol building can withstand up to 7-8 magnitude earthquakes.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Romeo Andig iya ginpahayag nga apisar nga may nakit-an nga mga litik sa building, non-structural defect lamang ini kag wala sang delikado sa kabug-usan nga istruktura.
english: Romeo Andig said that although there were cracks in the building, it was a non-structural defect and there was no danger to the overall structure.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Andig nga yara sa safe nga kondisyon ang kapitolyo kag wala sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga empleyado.
english: Andig said the capitol is in safe condition and the employees have nothing to worry about.

text: Text by:Lyka Sandiego
english: Text by:Lyka Sandiego

text: Target sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) nga malab-ot ang 100% fish sufficiency sa Pilipinas sa pagtakop sang Marcos administration sa 2028.
english: The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) targets to achieve 100% fish sufficiency in the Philippines by the end of the Marcos administration in 2028.

text: Ini nga sufficiency level target sa 2028 ang nalakip naman sa Strategic Plan sang ahensya para sa 2023-2028.
english: This sufficiency level target for 2028 is included in the agency's Strategic Plan for 2023-2028.

text: Ang plano sang ahensya amo ang makabig nga comprehensive roadmap kun sa diin nadetalye ang plano sang bureau para sa development, improvement, management, kag conservation sang fishery kag aquatic resources sang Pilipinas sa masunod nga lima ka tuig.
english: The agency's plan is a comprehensive roadmap that details the bureau's plan for the development, improvement, management, and conservation of the Philippines' fisheries and aquatic resources over the next five years.

text: Agud malab-ot ang target, pasangkaron suno sa BFAR ang produksyon sa fisheries sector kag buhinan man ang post-harvest losses sang isda kag iban pa fishery products.
english: To achieve the target, the BFAR said it will increase production in the fisheries sector and reduce post-harvest losses of fish and other fishery products.

text: Tuyo man sang Strategic Plan sang BFAR nga buhinan sang 5% ang poverty incidence sang mga manugpangisda sa masunod nga lima ka tuig.
english: The BFAR's Strategic Plan also aims to reduce the poverty incidence of fisherfolk by 5% in the next five years.

text: Kun matabo ini, mahimo na lamang ini nga 26% sa 2028 halin sa 30.6% as of 2021.
english: If this happens, it will be only 26% in 2028 from 30.6% as of 2021.

text: Sang 2022, sandig sa datos sang ahensya, may yara sang fish sufficiency level nga 92.5% ang pungsod lakip na ang imports kag exports.
english: In 2022, according to the agency's data, the country had a fish sufficiency level of 92.5% including imports and exports.

text: Gin-share sang aktres nga si Trina Legaspi nga nabun-ag na sini ang iya baby girl, ang ila una nga anak sang iya bana nga si Ryan Jarina.
english: Actress Trina Legaspi shared that she has given birth to her baby girl, their first child with her husband Ryan Jarina.

text: Gin-welcome sang mag-asawa ang ila baby nga si Kaela sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The couple welcomed their baby daughter Kaela last week.

text: Walo ka oras ang labor suno kay Trina gani amo na lang ang pasalamat sini sa medical team kag sa iya pamilya nga nagbulig sa iya agud nga mapaguwa ang baby.
english: Trina said the labor lasted eight hours and she is grateful to the medical team and her family who helped her get the baby out.

text: “Last week at 5:09 pm, our lives changed forever!
english: “Last week at 5:09 pm, our lives changed forever!

text: 8 hours of labor and 1 hour of pushing, thank you Lord for giving me the strength!,” suno sa first-time mom.
english: 8 hours of labor and 1 hour of pushing, thank you Lord for giving me the strength!,” according to the first-time mom.

text: “Welcome to the world, Baby Kaela!
english: “Welcome to the world, Baby Kaela!

text: Parang nag-slow mo ‘nung narinig ko na iyak niya, sobrang surreal, ‘di ko mapigilan umiyak.
english: It was like you slowed down when I heard her cry, it was so surreal, I couldn't help but cry.

text: You are worth all the pain our baby girl.
english: You are worth all the pain our baby girl.

text:
Daddy and I love you so much!”

Nobyembre 2021 sang nagpasakal sanday Trina kag Ryan.
english:
Daddy and I love you so much!”

Trina and Ryan got engaged in November 2021.

text: Kilala si Trina bilang child star nga si Hopia nga produkto sang sketch comedy kaupod sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Julia Montes.
english: Trina is best known as child star Hopia who is a product of sketch comedy alongside Kathryn Bernardo and Julia Montes.

text: Nag-untat siya anay sa showbiz agud pasulabihon ang iya pagtuon, nag-gradwar nga may degree sa communications sang 2016, kag nagbalik sa spotlight nga may screen name nga Trina Legaspi.
english: She once quit showbiz to prioritize her studies, graduated with a degree in communications in 2016, and returned to the spotlight with the screen name Trina Legaspi.

text: Nagpain ang Office of the President sang PhP760 milyon nga bulig pinansyal sa 38 ka syudad kag probinsya bilang sabat sa dako nga kahalitan nga dala sang Bagyong Tino.
english: The Office of the President has allocated PhP760 million in financial assistance to 38 cities and provinces in response to the massive damage caused by Typhoon Tino.

text: Ang pondo gamiton para sa madasig nga pagbangon sang mga nabiktima nga mga pamilya kag rehabilitasyon sang mga apektado nga lugar.
english: The fund will be used for the speedy recovery of the victimized families and rehabilitation of the affected areas.

text: Sa Iloilo Province, P50 million ang ginpain nga bulig nga amo ang pinakadako nga financial assistance.
english: In Iloilo Province, P50 million was allocated which is the largest financial assistance.

text: Pareho man nga kantidad ang ginpain para sa Cebu, Capiz, Surigao del Norte, Bohol, kag Negros Oriental.
english: The same amount was allocated for Cebu, Capiz, Surigao del Norte, Bohol, and Negros Oriental.

text: P40 million naman kada isa ang batunon sang Eastern Samar, Surigao del Sur, Southern Leyte, Antique, kag Aklan.
english: Eastern Samar, Surigao del Sur, Southern Leyte, Antique, and Aklan will receive P40 million each.

text: Ang Leyte kag Masbate may yara sang P30 million kada isa.
english: Leyte and Masbate have P30 million each.

text: Ang Guimaras, Agusan del Norte, kag Dinagat Islands, may yara sang P20 million kada isa.
english: Guimaras, Agusan del Norte, and Dinagat Islands, have P20 million each.

text: Tag-P10 million naman ang batunon sang Biliran, Camarines Sur, Sorsogon, Misamis, Oriental, kag Palawan.
english: Biliran, Camarines Sur, Sorsogon, Misamis, Oriental, and Palawan will receive P10 million each.

text: Tag-P5 million naman ang ginpain sa Albay,Batangas, Northern Samar, Siquijor, Quezon, Samar, Agusan del Sur, Laguna, Zamboanga City, Camiguin, Occidental Mindoro, Camarines Norte, Zamboanga del Norte, Iligan City, Romblon kag City of Manila.
english: P5 million each was allocated to Albay, Batangas, Northern Samar, Siquijor, Quezon, Samar, Agusan del Sur, Laguna, Zamboanga City, Camiguin, Occidental Mindoro, Camarines Norte, Zamboanga del Norte, Iligan City, Romblon and City of Manila.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong man nga adlaw gin-aprubahan ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: It is known that today President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. approved the

text: ang rekomendasyon sa pagdeklarar sang state of national calamity kasunod sang kalamidad bangud sang Typhoon Tino.
english: the recommendation to declare a state of national calamity following the disaster caused by Typhoon Tino.

text: Ginasuguran na ang konstruksyon sang P4.1 milyon sa pagpakay-o sang overpass sa Diversion Road, Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao; apang pila ka residente nagapahayag sang kabalaka kag pamangkot kun mapuslan gid ini nga pag-reconstruct kag kun dapat bala i-prioritize ang amo nga proyekto.
english: Construction of the P4.1 million overpass on Diversion Road, Barangay San Rafael, Mandurriao; however, some residents express concern and question whether the reconstruction is really useful and whether the project should be prioritized.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Erson, isa ka umalagi sa nasambit nga overpass, suno sa iya indi siya pabor nga panamion pa ang overpass bangud maayo pa man ini kag mas may kinahanglan nga tutukan sang budget pareho sang drainage areas, problema sa baha, kag kalimpyo sang palibot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alyas Erson, a passerby on the overpass, said he is not in favor of improving the overpass because it is still good and needs more budget focus such as drainage areas, flood problems, and environmental cleanliness.

text: Base sa pagpangusisa, ginpatuman sang Stone Built Construction Services ang nasambit nga proyekto kag nagsugod ini sang Agosto 11, 2025.
english: Based on the investigation, Stone Built Construction Services implemented the project and it started on August 11, 2025.

text: Lakip sa mga ginaobra amo ang pagbutang sang atop, tiles, kag pagrepaint sang grills.
english: Work includes installing the roof, tiles, and repainting the grills.

text: Bisan pa nga may mga scaffoldings nga ginplastar sa overpass, bukas gihapon ini sa publiko kag wala sang sira sa dalom, sa duha ka side kag wala man sang ‘barricade’ nga nagapugong sa mga nagalabay.
english: Although scaffoldings have been placed on the overpass, it is still open to the public and there is no closure at the bottom, on both sides and there is no barricade to stop passers-by.

text: Makita man ang elevator nga naguba nga ginpahayag naigu sang kilat sang Hunyo 20, 2025, base sa papel nga nakatapik nga may sulat: “Sorry, Elevator is under repair.
english: Also seen is the elevator that was damaged that was reportedly struck by lightning on June 20, 2025, based on a piece of paper attached with a note: “Sorry, Elevator is under repair.

text:
Cause of Damage: Lightning Strike, last June 20, 2025.”

Suno naman sa mga otoridad, padayon ang proyekto kag ginahingyo ang kooperasyon sang publiko samtang ginakay-o ukon ginapanami ang overpass.
english:
Cause of Damage: Lightning Strike, last June 20, 2025.”

According to the authorities, the project is ongoing and the cooperation of the public is requested while the overpass is being repaired or improved.

text:
ILOILO CITY- Kadungan sang ika-42  ka tuig sang Queenbank, ini magapatigayun sang  Top Level Management Conference nga magaumpisa sa Pebrero 7 tubtub 9 sa Dr. Rogelio M. Florete Leadership Center, Queenbank Building sa Valeria Street, Iloilo City nga may tema “Customer Focus – Breaking Barriers.”

Pangunahan ang tatlo ka adlaw nga event sang Chairman Emeritus sang Queenbank nga si Dr. Rogelio M. Florete.
english:
ILOILO CITY- In conjunction with the 42nd anniversary of Queenbank, it will hold a Top Level Management Conference starting on February 7 to 9 at Dr. Rogelio M. Florete Leadership Center, Queenbank Building at Valeria Street, Iloilo City with the theme “Customer Focus – Breaking Barriers.”

The three-day event will be led by Chairman Emeritus of Queenbank Dr. Rogelio M. Florete.

text: Humalin sang gin-umpisahan ang Mobile Banking Services sang 2021, nagtanyag ang Queenbank sang bag-o nga mga produkto kaangay sang PESONet – isa ka electronic fund transfer service halin sa Queenbank pakadto sa iban nga bangko kag ang QR Ph Person-to-Merchant mobile phone facility agud matigayon ang digital payments.
english: Since the launch of Mobile Banking Services in 2021, Queenbank has offered new products such as PESONet – an electronic fund transfer service from Queenbank to another bank and the QR Ph Person-to-Merchant mobile phone facility to enable digital payments.

text: Nagatanyag man ang Queenbank sang nagkalain-lain nga deposit products kag services kaangay sang Peso & Dollar Savings, Checking and Time Deposit, ATM, Business Payroll kag Deposit Pick Up services.
english: Queenbank also offers various deposit products and services such as Peso & Dollar Savings, Checking and Time Deposit, ATM, Business Payroll and Deposit Pick Up services.

text: Available man ang facilities kaangay sang Post-Dated Check Warehousing, Electronic Statement of Account, Bills Payment, Mobile Banking, Western Union lakip na ang dollar denominated pay-out kag Bayad Center Services.
english: Facilities such as Post-Dated Check Warehousing, Electronic Statement of Account, Bills Payment, Mobile Banking, Western Union as well as dollar denominated pay-out and Bayad Center Services are also available.

text: Lakip man sa ginatanyag nga loan services sang Queenbank amo ang Business Loan, Business Line of Credit, Term Loan, Back-to-Back Loan, Industrial Loan, Small and medium-sized enterprise Loans, Receivables Rediscounting, Check Rediscounting, Standby Letters of Credit, Agricultural kag Consumption Loans nga ginalakipan sang Real Estate, Housing, Multi-Purpose kag Car Financing.
english: Also among the loan services offered by Queenbank are Business Loan, Business Line of Credit, Term Loan, Back-to-Back Loan, Industrial Loan, Small and medium-sized enterprise Loans, Receivables Rediscounting, Check Rediscounting, Standby Letters of Credit, Agricultural and Consumer Loans, Housing Estate, Real Estate Multi-Purpose and Car Financing.

text: Agud mas mapasangkad ang banking network, naghatag na sang approval ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nga ma-merge ang Queenbank kag Queen City Rural Bank, Inc., kag sa subong yara na sa final stage sa pag-acquire sang isa pa gid ka rural bank.
english: In order to further expand the banking network, the Central Bank of the Philippines has given approval to merge Queenbank and Queen City Rural Bank, Inc., and is now in the final stage of acquiring another rural bank.

text: Sang tuig 2023, ang deposit liabilities sang Queenbank ang nagdangat sa P2.52 Billion kag ang loan portfolio ang naglab-ot sa P1.234 billion.
english: In 2023, Queenbank's deposit liabilities will reach P2.52 billion and its loan portfolio will reach P1.234 billion.

text: Ini ang bunga sang ‘trust and confidence’ nga ginhatag sang publiko.
english: This is the result of the trust and confidence given by the public.

text: Padayon ang Queenbank nga nagasanyog – pamatuod diri ang gross revenue nga P191.0 million kag total resources nga P3.27 billion.
english: Queenbank continues to grow – evidenced by gross revenue of P191.0 million and total resources of P3.27 billion.

text: Diri sa Iloilo ang Queenbank ang may branches sa Valeria, La Paz, Mapa, Plazuela, Alimodian, Leon kag San Miguel.
english: Here in Iloilo, Queenbank has branches in Valeria, La Paz, Mapa, Plazuela, Alimodian, Leon and San Miguel.

text: Queenbank is a member of PDIC, Bancnet and Florete Group.
english: Queenbank is a member of PDIC, Bancnet and Florete Group.

text: Queenbank is regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
english: Queenbank is regulated by the Central Bank of the Philippines.

text: Nadakpan sang Bureau of Immigration (BI) ang isa ka lalaki nga nagpakuno-kuno nga pastor kag gintuyo nga ipadala sa Cambodia ang tatlo ka mga Pilipino.
english: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) arrested a man who pretended to be a pastor and tried to send three Filipinos to Cambodia.

text: Ang suspek amo ang nagpakilala nga si “Pastor Falcon” nga plano kuntani ipadala ang mga biktima sa Cambodia paagi sa pagsulod sa Thailand.
english: The suspect identified himself as “Pastor Falcon” who was planning to send the victims to Cambodia by entering Thailand.

text: Suno kay BI Commissioner Joel Anthony Viado, napunggan ang suspek sa Clark International Airport kaupod ang mga biktima bag-o pa nakasakay sa eroplano padulong sa Bangkok.
english: According to BI Commissioner Joel Anthony Viado, the suspect was stopped at Clark International Airport with the victims before boarding a plane to Bangkok.

text: Pahayag niya, nabuko ang pastor kag ang mga kaupod sini bangud wala nagasanto ang ila mga pahayag.
english: He said the pastor and his companions were confused because their statements did not match.

text: Gin-ako sang tatlo nga ang ila nga destinasyon amo ang Cambodia kag indi sa Thailand.
english: The three admitted that their destination was Cambodia and not Thailand.

text: Suno sa ila, ginpromisahan sila nga makabaton sang sweldo nga tubtob P50,000 kada bulan.
english: According to them, they were promised a salary of up to P50,000 per month.

text: Nakumpirma naman nga ang peke nga pastor ang nakabiyahe sadto pagwa sang Pilipinas kaupod ang isa ka tawo nga may record nga “tourist” apang ini ang wala pa nakabalik sa pungsod.
english: It was confirmed that the fake pastor had traveled outside the Philippines with a man with a tourist record but had not yet returned to the country.

text: Nagpasa ang grupo nga AKBAYAN kaupod ang pila ka civil society kag youth leaders sang sulat kay Ombudsman Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla agud piliton ini nga isapubliko ang Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth ukon SALN sang mga matag-as nga opisyal sang pungsod.
english: The group AKBAYAN together with some civil society and youth leaders submitted a letter to Ombudsman Jesus Crispin 'Boying' Remulla to force him to make public the Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth or SALN of the country's top officials.

text: Hingyo sang grupo nga masapubliko ang SALN partikular nanday President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr, Vice President Sara Duterte, former Ombudsman Samuel Martires kag iban pa.
english: The group requested that the SALN be made public particularly to President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos Jr, Vice President Sara Duterte, former Ombudsman Samuel Martires and others.

text: Pangsipaon sa ila trabaho ang kapin 10,000 full-time employees sa tanan nga health agencies sa idalom sang administrasyon ni President Donald Trump.
english: More than 10,000 full-time employees in all health agencies will be laid off under President Donald Trump's administration.

text: Ini ang gin-anunsyo sang US Department of Health and Human Services.
english: This was announced by the US Department of Health and Human Services.

text: Kasunod man ini sang una na nga boluntaryo nga paghalin sa trabaho sang 10,000 employees.
english: This follows the earlier voluntary layoffs of 10,000 employees.

text: Magakahulugan ini nga ang workforce sang 82,000 full-time employees ang mangin 62,000 na lang.
english: This will mean a workforce of 82,000 full-time employees will be reduced to 62,000.

text: Kalakip sa mg pahalinon sa trabaho amo ang 3,500 full-time employees sa US Food and Drug Administration; 2,400 employees sa US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; 1,200 employees sa National Institutes of Health; kag 300 employees sa Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.
english: Among the layoffs are 3,500 full-time employees at the US Food and Drug Administration; 2,400 employees at the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; 1,200 employees at the National Institutes of Health; and 300 employees at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.

text: Ini nga tikang sang Department of Health and Human Services ginakabig nila nga “dramatic restructuring” nga nagatuyo nga makakinot sang $1.8 billion.
english: This move by the Department of Health and Human Services is being billed as “dramatic restructuring” that aims to save $1.8 billion.

text: Ipaguwa na ni Ed Sheeran ang iya comeback single nga Eyes Closed sa Marso 24.
english: Ed Sheeran will release his comeback single Eyes Closed on March 24.

text: Suno sa English singer-songwriter, may heartbreaking inspiration ini nga kanta.
english: According to the English singer-songwriter, this song has a heartbreaking inspiration.

text: Na-mensyonar sa announcement sang four-time Grammy winner ang iya best friend nga si Jamal Edwards, isa ka music entrepreneur nga napatay sa edad nga 31 sang February 2022 bangud sa cardiac arrest.
english: The four-time Grammy winner’s announcement mentioned his best friend Jamal Edwards, a music entrepreneur who died at the age of 31 in February 2022 from cardiac arrest.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Sheeran nga ang iya latest album “-” ang ipaguwa sa May 5.
english: Sheeran previously announced that his latest album “-” will be released on May 5.

text: Ikaanum na ini nga iya album.
english: This is his sixth album.

text: Ang iban amo ang “+” sang 2011, “x” sang 2014, “÷” sang 2017, “No.
english: Others are “+” in 2011, “x” in 2014, “÷” in 2017, “No.

text: 6 Collaborations Project” sang 2019, kag “=” sang 2021.
english: 6 Collaborations Project” in 2019, and “=” in 2021.

text: Nagsaka na sa 24 ang numero sang nagkalamatay bangud sa pagkasunog sang kagulangan sa southeastern region sang South Korea.
english: The death toll from a forest fire in South Korea's southeastern region has risen to

text: Lakip sa kumpirmado nga napatay amo ang piloto sang helicopter nga nagtibusok samtang naga-responde man sa lapnagon nga sunog.
english: Among the confirmed dead was the pilot of a helicopter that crashed while responding to a widespread fire.

text: Gina-deploy sang gobyerno ang amo nga fire-fighting helicopters agud mapatay ang forest fires bangud delikado ang lugar, mataas, kag may mga pil-as.
english: The government is deploying such fire-fighting helicopters to put out the forest fires because the area is dangerous, high, and steep.

text: Madasig ang paglapta sang kalayo nga nagpwersa man sang ginabanta 27,000 ka mga tawo nga magbiya anay sa ila nga mga balay.
english: The fire spread quickly and forced an estimated 27,000 people to leave their homes.

text: Nadalahig man ang mga puluy-an bangud sa mabaskog nga hangin, ginsirado ang mga eskwelahan, kag ginpangsaylo man ang ginatos ka mga preso halin sa apektado nga mga jail facilities.
english: Homes were also affected by the strong winds, schools were closed, and hundreds of inmates were also evacuated from affected jail facilities.

text: Suno kay Acting President Han Duck-soo, indi pa gid maayo ang sitwasyon apisar nga na-deploy na ang tanan nga available nga personnel kag equipment pati na ang US military nga naka-base sa Korea.
english: According to Acting President Han Duck-soo, the situation is not yet good despite the deployment of all available personnel and equipment including the US military based in Korea.

text: Sa 24 nga napatay, una na nga ginpahayag sang Safety Ministry nga 14 ang halin sa Uiseong county, samtang apat naman ang konektado sa Sancheong county.
english: Of the 24 deaths, the Safety Ministry had earlier said 14 were from Uiseong county, while four were connected to Sancheong county.

text: Kadam-an sa mga napatay ang naga-edad sang 60-70 anyos.
english: Most of those killed were in their 60-70 years.

text: Antes sini nga insidente, nauna naman nga ginkumpirma nga may technical issues sa 48 Russian helicopters sang Korea Forest Service.
english: Before this incident, it was previously confirmed that there were technical issues with 48 Russian helicopters of the Korea Forest Service.

text: Walo ang wala na naga-operate halin sang nagligad nga tuig bangud sa sanctions nga naangot sa Ukraine war; buot silingon, indi maka-import ang South Korea sang kinahanglanon nila nga mga parte sang aircraft.
english: Eight have been out of operation since last year due to sanctions linked to the Ukraine war; that is, South Korea cannot import the aircraft parts it needs.

text: Sa latest nga insidente, may nabatian pa ang mga residente nga indi kinaandan nga gahod halin sa helicopter antes ini nagtibusok sa duta kag nagsigabong nga ginkamatay sang piloto.
english: In the latest incident, residents heard an unusual noise from the helicopter before it crashed into the ground and caught fire, killing the pilot.

text: Masobra na 10,000 nga mga bumbero ang napadala sa apat ka separado nga mga lugar as of Wednesday lakip na ang ginatos ka pulis kag military units samtang 87 naman ka helicopters ang ginagamit suno pa sa record sang Safety Ministry.
english: More than 10,000 firefighters have been deployed to four separate areas as of Wednesday including hundreds of police and military units while 87 helicopters are being used, according to Safety Ministry records.

text: Nagpangatubang sang problema ang mga mangunguma sa Barangay Botong, Banwa sang Oton bangud sang baha nga nag-apekto sa ila mga talamnan, kag ang problema sa kanal nga wala nakay-o, kag wala lutsan ang tubig.
english: Farmers in Barangay Botong, Oton Town faced problems due to floods that affected their fields, and the problem of the canal that was not repaired, and did not drain the water.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cedrick Corbett, Farmers Assistant President sa Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Cedrick Corbett, Farmers Assistant President in Brgy.

text: Botong, Oton, ginpahayag niya nga ang pila ka mga mangunguma napilitan mag-harvest sang ila humay antes pa man mag-abot ang Bagyong Opong agud indi ini maapektuhan sang baha.
english: Botong, Oton, he said some farmers were forced to harvest their rice before the arrival of Typhoon Opong to avoid being affected by the floods.

text: May mga talamnan nga lubog na sa tubig, kag ang masubo pa, may mga humay nga bag-o pa lang ginsab-og nga posible malu-o kag kan-on sang mga kuhol kun magpabilin pa ini nga mahulom sa sulod sang duha ukon tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Some fields are already submerged in water, and unfortunately, there are newly sown rice fields that are likely to be eaten by snails if they remain wet for two or three days.

text: Ginsiling pa ni Corbett nga ang iban nga mangunguma, magsab-og pa kuntani sang humay, pero bangud sang baha kag kanal nga wala lutsan sang tubig, indi sila makapadayon.
english: Corbett said some farmers were planning to plant rice, but due to floods and canals that were not filled with water, they could not continue.

text: Ginpanawagan man niya nga tani mabuligan sila sang mga otoridad sa pagkay-o sang kanal agud indi na magbalik-balik ang problema.
english: He also appealed to the authorities to help them repair the canal so that the problem will not happen again.

text: Sa Barangay Botong, may sobra 75 ka hectare nga talamnan nga pirme ginabaha kun may ulan.Nagapanawagan ang mga mangunguma sang tikang halin sa lokal nga panguluhan agud masolusyunan ang problema sa kanal kag maprotektahan ang ila pangabuhian.
english: In Barangay Botong, there are more than 75 hectares of fields that are always flooded when it rains. Farmers are calling for action from the local government to solve the canal problem and protect their livelihoods.

text: Magadeklarar sang state of national calamity si Presidente Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr. will declare a state of national calamity.

text: matapos ang halit nga dala sang Bagyo Tino kag sang ginalauman nga manugsulod nga Bagyo Uwan kag ang epekto sini.
english: after the damage caused by Typhoon Tino and the expected incoming Typhoon Uwan and its impact.

text: Wala gani na-orasan kag nahubas na ang tickets para sa mga luyag maglantaw sang hampang sang 36-anyos nga Argentine football superstar nga si Lionel Messi sa Hong Kong.
english: Tickets were sold out for those who wanted to watch 36-year-old Argentine football superstar Lionel Messi play in Hong Kong.

text: Atubangon ni Messi kag sang iya American club nga Inter Miami ang team sang Hong Kong sa Hong Kong Stadium sa Pebrero 4 kun sa diin lab-ot lamang sa 40,000 ang mahimo ma-akomodar nga tumalan-aw.
english: Messi and his American club Inter Miami will face Hong Kong at the Hong Kong Stadium on February 4 where only 40,000 spectators can be accommodated.

text: Suno sa organizers, halos duha ka milyon ang naghingagaw sa ticketing app agud makakuha sang pass sa balor nga $110-$625 ukon P6,100-P34,800.
english: According to organizers, nearly two million people rushed to the ticketing app to get passes for $110-$625 or P6,100-P34,800.

text:
Dismayado naman ang iban nga football fans bangud sang error message sa application nga nagsiling “traffic overload.”

Katapusan nga naghampang ang nasambit nga World Cup champion kag eight-time Ballon D’or Winner sa Hong Kong sang 2014 nga isa man ka friendly game.
english:
Some football fans are disappointed with the error message in the application that says “traffic overload.”

The World Cup champion and eight-time Ballon D'or Winner last played in Hong Kong in 2014, which was also a friendly.

text: Ang atubangon nanday Messi kag Inter Miami nga club ang ginabug-usan sang players halin sa top division sang Hong Kong.
english: Messi and Inter Miami will face players from Hong Kong's top division.

text: Magluwas sa Argentine great, featured man sa amo nga football match ang iya Miami kag former Barcelona teammates nga sanday Sergio Busquets kag Jordi Alba.
english: Besides the Argentine great, his Miami and former Barcelona teammates Sergio Busquets and Jordi Alba were also featured in the football match.

text: Madamo man ang reports nga nagasiling nga Miami player na ang Uruguayan ex-Barcelona striker nga si Luis Suarez sa tion nga mag-abot ang MLS club sa Hong Kong.# (Photo: Stacy Revere/Getty Images)
english: Reports also abound that Uruguayan ex-Barcelona striker Luis Suarez will already be a Miami player by the time the MLS club arrives in Hong Kong.# (Photo: Stacy Revere/Getty Images)

text: Nagpirma ang Department of Agriculture(DA), Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), kag National Irrigation Administration (NIA) sang memorandum of understanding (MOU) para masigurado ang tayuyon kag bastante nga suplay sang bugas.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA), Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), and National Irrigation Administration (NIA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to ensure a steady and sufficient supply of rice.

text: Sa statement sang DA, ginpahayag nga target sang memorandum nga maghimo sang alternatibo nga market para sa bugas kun sa diin pareho nga maka-benepisyo ang mangunguma kag ang consumers.
english: In a statement, the DA said the memorandum targets to create an alternative market for rice where both farmers and consumers can benefit.

text: Iga-promote man sini ang Integrated Rice Supply Chain Development Program kag i-develop ang business-to-business online market platform.
english: It will also promote the Integrated Rice Supply Chain Development Program and develop the business-to-business online market platform.

text: Dugang pa diri, magahatag ini sang alternative market access sa nagabakal kag nagabaligya, paayuhon ang income sang mga mangunguma, i-promote ang husto nga rice branding kag classification, kag himuon nga kasarangan ang presyo sang bugas para sa consumers.
english: In addition, it will provide alternative market access to buyers and sellers, improve farmers' income, promote proper rice branding and classification, and make rice prices moderate for consumers.

text: Nagapati man si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. also believes.

text:
nga ang kooperasyon sa produksyon, klasipikasyon, marketing, kag pag-distribute sang domestic rice ang makapasaka pa sang status sang agricultural products sang pungsod sa global stage.#

(Department of Agriculture)
english:
that cooperation in the production, classification, marketing, and distribution of domestic rice will further raise the status of the country's agricultural products on the global stage.

(Department of Agriculture)

text: Gindakop paagi sa entrapment operation sang mga katapo sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) ang isa ka opisyal sang Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Batangas.
english: An official of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Batangas was arrested in an entrapment operation by members of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG).

text: Ginpahayag nga involved ini sa pagpangkilkil.
english: He was allegedly involved in extortion.

text: Ang arestado amo si “Rommel”, Officer-in-Charge sang CENRO Calaca.
english: The arrested was identified as “Rommel”, Officer-in-Charge of CENRO Calaca.

text: Sa operasyon, naaktuhan ini nga ginabaton ang kwarta nga ginaalegar ginpangayo niya halin sa tagreklamo.
english: During the operation, he was caught accepting the money he allegedly demanded from the complainant.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga nangayo angopisyal sang P7 milyon sa complainant kabaylo sang pag-isyu sang Alienable and Disposable Zones Certificate.
english: The investigation revealed that the official demanded P7 million from the complainant in exchange for the issuance of the Alienable and Disposable Zones Certificate.

text: Una nga nagpangayo sang P1 milyon ang suspek kag kun indi mabayaran ini, indi ma-release ang certificate.
english: The suspect first demanded P1 million and if he does not pay, the certificate will not be released.

text: Bangud sini, nagpatigayon sang follow-up operation ang otoridad nga nagresulta sa pagdakop sa opisyal.
english: As a result, the authorities conducted a follow-up operation that resulted in the arrest of the officer.

text: Ginsugata sang kapaslawan ang Choco Mucho Flying Titans sa labing-una sini nga pagtapak sa finals sang Premier Volleyball League (PVL).
english: The Choco Mucho Flying Titans were met with disappointment in their first appearance in the finals of the Premier Volleyball League (PVL).

text: Nalutos ang team sa Game 1 sa kamot sang defending champions nga Creamline Cool Smashers, 25-23, 19-25, 26-24, 25-22, sa 2023 Second All-Filipino Conference sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: The team lost Game 1 at the hands of defending champions Creamline Cool Smashers, 25-23, 19-25, 26-24, 25-22, in the 2023 Second All-Filipino Conference at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Nanguna sa Creamline sanday Tots Carlos kag Jema Galanza nga may tag-16 puntos samtang may 11 puntos naman si Alyssa Valdez nga amo ang nagpalawig pa sang winning streak sang Cool Smashers sa 14 subong nga conference.
english: Creamline was led by Tots Carlos and Jema Galanza with 16 points each while Alyssa Valdez had 11 points, extending the Cool Smashers' winning streak to 14 in the current conference.

text: Sa Flying Titans, may 17 puntos si Sisi Rondina samtang nanguna naman sa scorers si Maddie Madayag nga may 18 puntos.
english: For the Flying Titans, Sisi Rondina had 17 points while Maddie Madayag led the scorers with 18 points.

text: Naka-schedule ang Game 2 buwas, Disyembre 16, sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: Game 2 is scheduled for tomorrow, December 16, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text: Ginkibot sang F2 Logistics ang Filipino sports fans matapos sini gin-anunsyo ang pag-untat na sang Cargo Movers women’s volleyball team matapos ang walo ka tuig nga dalayawon nga performance sa professional kag amateur scenes.
english: F2 Logistics shocked Filipino sports fans after it announced the retirement of the Cargo Movers women’s volleyball team after eight years of outstanding performance in the professional and amateur scenes.

text: Sa statement nga ginpaguwa kasunod sang ila kapaslawan sa ila kampanya sa 2023 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Second All-Filipino Conference, ginpahayag sini nga magasaylo na lamang ang focus sini sa “grassroots” development sang volleyball.
english: In a statement issued following the failure of their campaign in the 2023 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Second All-Filipino Conference, it said it will shift its focus to the “grassroots” development of volleyball.

text: Gin-cite man sini ang sunod-sunod nga injuries nga naangkon sang players sang nagliligad nga bulan rason nga kinahanglan hatagan sang prayoridad ang ikaayong lawas ipaanggid sa mga kadalag-an nga ila nalab-ot sang nagligad nga mga tinuig.
english: He also cited the series of injuries suffered by the players in the past month as a reason why health should be given priority compared to the victories they achieved in previous years.

text: Ginpasalamatan sang team ang ila nga fans kag nagpasalig nga padayon ini nga maga-suporta sa paghampang sang volleyball sa Pilipinas partikular na sa De La Salle Lady Spikers kag magahatag man sang bulig sa University of Perpetual Help.
english: The team thanked their fans and assured that they will continue to support the game of volleyball in the Philippines particularly the De La Salle Lady Spikers and will also provide assistance to the University of Perpetual Help.

text: Sa duha ka tuig sini nga pagpasakop sa Premier Volleyball League, ang makabig nga best ending amo ang pagpangatlo sini sa una nga All-Filipino Conference.
english: In its two years of participation in the Premier Volleyball League, the best ending was its third place in the first All-Filipino Conference.

text: Naglagbong ini sa 4-7 record sa ikaduha nga All-Filipino Conference kag bangud wala ang nagapanguna nga stars nga sanday Kianna Dy, Myla Pablo, kag Jolina dela Cruz, nagpanaog lamang ini sa ikawalo nga pwesto.
english: It fell to a 4-7 record in the second All-Filipino Conference and without top stars Kianna Dy, Myla Pablo, and Jolina dela Cruz, it only dropped to eighth place.

text: Sa masunod nga season sang PVL sa 2024, bangud sa disbandment sang six-time Philippine Superliga champions, nabutang man sa kwestyon kun sa diin magasulod ang players lakip sanday Dy, Pablo, Dela Cruz, Dawn Macandili-Catindig, Ivy Lacsina, Ara Galang, kag Aby Maraño.
english: In the next season of the PVL in 2024, due to the disbandment of the six-time Philippine Superliga champions, it is also in question where players including Dy, Pablo, Dela Cruz, Dawn Macandili-Catindig, Ivy Lacsina, Ara Galang, and Aby Maraño will enter.

text: Mangin si PVL President Ricky Palou ang nagsiling nga wala man sang maathag nga rason nga ginhatag ang F2 Logistics management sa ila anunsyo sa ila nga disbandment.
english: Even PVL President Ricky Palou said that the F2 Logistics management did not give a clear reason in their announcement of their disbandment.

text: Ginakonsiderar ang posibilidad nga magabukas ang pwerta sang PVL para sa panibag-o nga team.
english: The possibility of opening the door of the PVL for the new team is being considered.

text: (Photo is from F2 Logistics.)
english: (Photo is from F2 Logistics.)

text: Ginpaiway anay ang pagbisita nanday King Charles kag asawa nga si Queen Camilla kay Pope Francis sa Vatican.
english: King Charles and his wife Queen Camilla have postponed their visit to Pope Francis at the Vatican.

text: Ini bangud gin-abisuhan ang santo papa nga magpahuway ini bangud bag-o lang ini nakagwa ini sa ospital matapos ang pila ka semana nga gin-admit ini.
english: This is because the pope was advised to rest because he had just been discharged from the hospital after several weeks of admission.

text: Nahibaluan nga natalana kuntani nga magbyahe ang British royals padulong sa Vatican sa Abril 7 kag makigkita kay Pope Francis  pagkasunod nga adlaw para sa makabig kuntani nga historic visit.
english: The British royals were scheduled to travel to the Vatican on April 7 and meet with Pope Francis the next day for what would have been considered a historic visit.

text: Pila ka adlaw matapos gin-anunsyo ang plano sang nagligad nga bulan, gin-admit ang 88-anyos nga santo papa bangud sa severe respiratory infection.
english: Days after the plan was announced last month, the 88-year-old pope was admitted with a severe respiratory infection.

text: Suno sa royal source, naglaum sanday Charles kag Camilla nga mag-improve ang ikaayong lawas sang santo papa apang bangud sa advice sang iya doktor, indi madayon ang ila meeting.
english: According to a royal source, Charles and Camilla hoped that the pope's health would improve but on the advice of his doctor, their meeting was cancelled.

text: Madayon naman ang state visit sang royal couple apang may pagbag-o lang sa ila mga aktibidad sa Italya.
english: The royal couple's state visit will continue but there will be a change in their activities in Italy.

text: Love month matuod ang Pebrero apang indi para sa bulsa sang mga motorista nga pat-od nga masakitan gid bangud sa panibag-o nga saka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo nga ipatuman sa masunod nga semana.
english: February is a love month but not for the pockets of motorists who will surely be hurt by the new increase in the price of petroleum products that will be implemented next week.

text: Ginbasehan sang Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau ang oil tradong sa nagligad nga apat ka adlaw.
english: The Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau based the oil tradong on the past four days.

text:
Yari ang posible nga adjustment:

Gasoline – magasaka sang P0.75 tubtub sa P0.95 per literDiesel – magasaka sang P1.50 tubtub sa P1.70 per literKerosene – magasaka sang P1.05 tubtub sa P1.15 per liter

Suno sa ahensya, ang saka sa presyo ang posible maangot sa drone attacks kag pagpangsunog sa mga oil facilities sa Russia agud nga hungod nga maguba ang linya sang suplay kag logistics.
english:
Here’s a possible adjustment:

Gasoline – to rise by P0.75 to P0.95 per literDiesel – to rise by P1.50 to P1.70 per literKerosene – to rise by P1.05 to P1.15 per liter

The agency said the price increase could be linked to drone attacks and burning of oil facilities in Russia to deliberately disrupt supply and logistics lines.

text: Pananglitan ipatuman na ang saka-presyo, ini na ang ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may price increase sa produktong petrolyo.
english: If the price increase is implemented, this will be the fifth consecutive week of price increases in petroleum products.

text: Masami nga Lunes gina-anunsyo sang oil firms ang ila pinal nga price adjustments kag ipatuman naman epektibo sa kada Martes.
english: Oil firms usually announce their final price adjustments on Monday and implement them effective every Tuesday.

text: Nagakabalaka si anay House Committee on Appropriations Chairman kag resigned nga si anay AKO Bicol Partylist Rep.
english: Former House Committee on Appropriations Chairman and resigned AKO Bicol Partylist Rep.

text: Elizaldy “Zaldy” Co nga patyon ini kaangot sa seryoso nga death threats nga iya nabaton kun magpauli siya sa Pilipinas.
english: Elizaldy “Zaldy” Co to kill him in connection with the serious death threats he received if he returned to the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag ni Atty. Ruy Rondain, legal counsel ni Co, seryoso kag credible ang mga pamahog sa kabuhi sang anay mamalidha.
english: Atty. Ruy Rondain, Co's legal counsel, said the threats to the former lawmaker's life were serious and credible.

text: Gin-athag man niya kun wala sang pamahog, tuyo gid sang iya nga kliyente nga mag-atubang sa imbestigasyon matapos na-involve ini sa isyu sang budget insertions nga balor P13 bilyon para sa infrastructure programs sa idalom sang 2025 national budget.
english: He also explained that if there is no threat, his client intends to face the investigation after he was involved in the issue of budget insertions worth P13 billion for infrastructure programs under the 2025 national budget.

text: Si Co ang ginapahayag nga may kaangtanan man sa P285.5 milyon nga insertion sang pondo sa ghost flood control projects sa Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.
english: Co is also allegedly involved in the P285.5 million insertion of funds into ghost flood control projects in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.

text: Suno pa sa abogado, paghugpa pa lang ni Co sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA), may mga hired killers kag vigilante groups na nga magapauna-una nga patyon ini.
english: According to the lawyer, as soon as Co landed at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA), there were hired killers and vigilante groups who would kill him first.

text: Dugang niya, may organisado man nga grupo sa Europe nga luyag man magpatay sa anay mamalidha.
english: He added that there is also an organized group in Europe that also wants to kill the former lawmaker.

text: Nanghakot sang pasidungog ang pelikula nga “Everything Everywhere All at Once” sa Independent Spirit Awards isa ka semana antes an ginakalangkagan nga Oscars.
english: The film “Everything Everywhere All at Once” won the award at the Independent Spirit Awards a week before the much-anticipated Oscars.

text: Ang Independent Spirit Awards isa ka major Hollywood ceremony nga nagakilala sa best sa independent film kag television.
english: The Independent Spirit Awards is a major Hollywood ceremony that recognizes the best in independent film and television.

text: Lakip sa nadag-an sang nasambit nga trippy sci-fi film amo ang Best Film, Best Director kag Best Editing.
english: Among the winners of the trippy sci-fi film were Best Film, Best Director and Best Editing.

text: Ginpatigayon ang star-studded event sa Santa Monica Beach, California.
english: The star-studded event was held in Santa Monica Beach, California.

text: Ang “Everything Everywhere All At Once” isa ka part sci-fi martial arts film, part absurdist comedy, part family drama kag full-on awards season darling.
english: “Everything Everywhere All At Once” is part sci-fi martial arts film, part absurdist comedy, part family drama and full-on awards season darling.

text: Nominated ini para sa 11 Oscars subong nga tuig lakip na ang best picture, director, actress, supporting actor, duha para sa supporting actress, original screenplay, costumes, editing, original score kag original song.
english: It was nominated for 11 Oscars this year including best picture, director, actress, supporting actor, two for supporting actress, original screenplay, costumes, editing, original score and original song.

text: Nagguwa na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang bagyo kag padayon nga nagahulag palayo sa pungsod, suno sa 5 a.m. weather update sang DOST-PAGASA subong nga Huwebes, November 6.
english: The typhoon has already left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) and continues to move away from the country, according to the 5 a.m. weather update of DOST-PAGASA this Thursday, November 6.

text: Ulihi ini nasiplatan sa kalayuon nga 265km naaminhan sang Pag-asa Isaland, Kalayaan sa Palawan.
english: It was last spotted 265km north of Pag-asa Isaland, Kalayaan in Palawan.

text: May nakataas sa gihapon nga storm signal sa Kalayaan Islands bangud sa bagyo.
english: There is still a raised storm signal in the Kalayaan Islands due to the typhoon.

text: Posible man may yara pa san paglapta-lapta nga ulan sa pila ka bahin sang pungsod subong nga adlaw bangud sa epekto sini.
english: There is also likely to be scattered rain in some parts of the country today due to its effects.

text: Magapanghakroy na naman ang mga motorista sa masunod nga semana bangud sa ginapanan-aw nga ipatuman nga big-time nga oil price hike!
english: Motorists will be struggling again next week due to the expected big-time oil price hike!

text:
Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, base sa pagbanta sang oil industry nga nagbase sang datos sa oil trading sa nagligad nga apat ka adlaw, yari ang posible nga hulag sa presyo:

* Diesel- magasaka sang P0.65 – P0.85 kada litro

*Gasolina – magasaka sang P1.95 – P2.10 kada litro

* Kerosene – magasaka P0.20 – P0.30 kada litro.
english:
According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, based on the oil industry’s estimate based on data on oil trading in the past four days, here is the likely price movement:

* Diesel- will rise by P0.65 – P0.85 per liter

*Gasoline – will rise by P1.95 – P2.10 per liter

* Kerosene – will increase by P0.20 – P0.30 per liter.

text: Ginaangot gihapon ini nga adjustments sa presyo sa nagatabo ukon developments sa international oil market.
english: These price adjustments are still linked to developments in the international oil market.

text: Pananglitan ipatuman na ini sa Martes, Enero 30, ini na ang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may saka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.#
english: If it is implemented on Tuesday, January 30, it will be the fourth consecutive week that the price of petroleum products will rise.

text: Duha na naman ka journalists ang napatay sang nagbalik sa pagpang-atake ang Israel sa Hamas militants sa Gaza.
english: Two more journalists were killed when Israel resumed its attacks on Hamas militants in Gaza.

text: Ang isa ka biktima amo si Hossam Shabat nga naga-trabaho sa Al Jazeera Mubasher, samtang ang isa naman amo si Mohammad Mansour nga empleyado sang Palestine Today.
english: One victim was Hossam Shabat who worked for Al Jazeera Mubasher, while the other was Mohammad Mansour employee of Palestine Today.

text: Napatay si Shabat sa northern Gaza sang gin-alegar nga gin-target sang Israeli forces ang iya salakyan.
english: Shabat was killed in northern Gaza when Israeli forces allegedly targeted his vehicle.

text: Antes siya napatay, napilasan man ini anay sa separado nga atake apang nagsiling ang mga kaupdanan sini nga nagpamilit gid ini nga padayunon ang pagbalita.
english: Before his death, he was also wounded in a separate attack but his colleagues said he insisted on continuing the news.

text: Sa Khan Younis sa southern Gaza naman napatay si Mansour samtang yara sa ila balay kaupod ang iya asawa kag anak bangud gin-alegar nga wala man lang sang warning nga natabo antes ang strike sang Israel.
english: In Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Mansour was killed while at home with his wife and son because there was allegedly no warning before the Israeli strike.

text: Sunod man nga ginkondena sang Committee to Protect Journalists ang natabo nga pagpatay sa Palestinian reporters kag nagpanawagan sang independent international investigation kun hungod bala sila nga gin-target sang Israel Defense Forces.
english: The Committee to Protect Journalists also condemned the killing of Palestinian reporters and called for an independent international investigation into whether they were deliberately targeted by the Israel Defense Forces.

text: “CPJ is appalled that we are once again seeing Palestinians weeping over the bodies of dead journalists in Gaza,” suno kay CPJ Program Director Carlos Martinez de la Serna samtang yara sa New York.
english: “CPJ is appalled that we are once again seeing Palestinians weeping over the bodies of dead journalists in Gaza,” said CPJ Program Director Carlos Martinez de la Serna while in New York.

text: “This nightmare in Gaza has to end.
english: “This nightmare in Gaza has to end.

text: The international community must act fast to ensure that journalists are kept safe and hold Israel to account for the deaths of Hossam Shabat and Mohammed Mansour, whose killings may have been targeted.
english: The international community must act fast to ensure that journalists are kept safe and hold Israel to account for the deaths of Hossam Shabat and Mohammed Mansour, whose killings may have been targeted.

text:
Journalists are civilians and it is illegal to attack them in a war zone.”

Kasunod sang amo nga insidente, nagsaka na sa 208 ang napatay nga media workers halin sang nag-umpisa ang gyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023 santo sa record sang Government Media Office (GMO) sa amo nga teritoryo sa Palestine.
english:
Journalists are civilians and it is illegal to attack them in a war zone.”

Following the incident, the death toll of media workers since the war in Gaza began in October 2023 has risen to 208, according to the records of the Government Media Office (GMO) in the Palestinian territory.

text: Sa edad nga 38, naghimo na naman sang panibag-o nga rekord sa NBA ang basketball superstar nga si LeBron James kadungan sang paglutos sang Los Angeles Lakers sa New Orleans Pelicans sa semifinals, 133-89, kag pagmartsa sa finals sang labing-una nga In-Season Tournament.
english: At the age of 38, basketball superstar LeBron James set another NBA record as the Los Angeles Lakers defeated the New Orleans Pelicans in the semifinals, 133-89, and marched to the finals of the first-ever In-Season Tournament.

text: Sa amo nga semi-final game, nagpanguna si James nga may 30-puntos, lima ka rebounds, kag walo ka assists.
english: In that semi-final game, James led the way with 30-points, five rebounds, and eight assists.

text: Ini nga statistics ang nagguba sang rekord sa liga kag amo ang ginkabig nga pinakauna nga pinakadamo nga puntos, assists, kag rebounds sa sulod lamang sang 23 minutos nga hampang sini sa court.
english: This statistic broke a league record and was considered the first-ever most points, assists, and rebounds in just 23 minutes of play on the court.

text: Sa sini nga kadalag-an, nag-saka na ang Lakers sa 14-9 sa ila nauna nga 23 games kag amo ang fourth seed sa Western Conference.
english: With the win, the Lakers improve to 14-9 in their previous 23 games and are the fourth seed in the Western Conference.

text: Ini naman ang ika-21 nga season ni James sa NBA kag ika-anum kaupod sa Los Angeles.
english: This is James' 21st season in the NBA and his sixth with Los Angeles.

text: Daog ang Lakers sa 2020 NBA Championship, kag nakadangat sa Western Conference Finals sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The Lakers won the 2020 NBA Championship, and reached the Western Conference Finals last year.

text: Balantayan ang hampang sa championship sa tunga sang Lakers kag Indiana Pacers 9:30 sa aga buwas, Disyembre 10, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Watch the championship game between the Lakers and Indiana Pacers at 9:30 am tomorrow, December 10, Philippine time.

text: Nagtukod na sang kaugalingon nga investigation team ang National Bureau of Investigation Region 6 bilang sabat sa direktiba sang Department of Justice nga magausisa sa mga ginadudahan nga anomaliya sa mga flood control projects sa rehiyon.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation Region 6 has set up its own investigation team in response to the Department of Justice's directive to investigate suspected anomalies in flood control projects in the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Arnold Diaz, Assistant Regional Director sang NBI Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga siya ang magapanguna sa imbestigasyon kag subong yara pa lang sila sa stage sang pagtipon sang ebidensya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Arnold Diaz, Assistant Regional Director of NBI Region 6, said he will lead the investigation and they are still in the stage of gathering evidence.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga kUn malocate na ang ginatawag nga ghost projects, magapatigayon sila sang ocular inspection kag mas madalum nga imbestigasyon.
english: He said that once the so-called ghost projects are located, they will conduct ocular inspection and deeper investigation.

text: Ginsiling man ni Atty. Diaz nga may koordinasyon sila sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno para sa mas epektibo nga pag-usisa.
english: He also said that Atty. Diaz said they are coordinating with government agencies for more effective investigation.

text: Suno sa iya, sakop sang ila hurisdiksyon ang mga kaso nga may kalabutan sa Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act kag posible nga plunder kun may nagakaigo nga ebidensya.
english: He said cases related to the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act and possible plunder if there is proper evidence are within their jurisdiction.

text: Gindugang pa ni Diaz nga indi lang sila magatutok sa ginpangalanan nga 15 ka contractors nga ginmention ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., kundi apil man ang mga local contractors kon makumpirmar nga may ghost projects kag substandard nga mga obra.
english: Diaz added that they will not only focus on the named 15 contractors mentioned by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., but also local contractors if they are confirmed to have ghost projects and substandard works.

text: Nagpangayo man siya sang bulig sa publiko nga kon may nahibaluan sila nga impormasyon parte sa mga proyekto, magkoordinar lang sa NBI agud ini maimbestigaran.
english: He also asked the public to help if they know any information about the projects, just coordinate with the NBI so that it can be investigated.

text: Padayunon sang Filipina weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz ang iya target nga makasulod sa ikalima na nga sunod-sunod nga Olympiada paagi sa pagpasakop sa International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) Grand Prix II sa Doha, Qatar subong nga semana.
english: Filipina weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz will continue her target of qualifying for her fifth consecutive Olympiad by competing in the International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) Grand Prix II in Doha, Qatar this week.

text: Maga-compete si Diaz sa women’s -59 kgs buwas nga adlaw, Disyembre 6, kag nagalaum nga mapabilin niya ukon mapasaka pa ang iya world ranking nga No.
english: Diaz will compete in the women’s -59 kgs tomorrow, December 6, and hopes to maintain or improve her world ranking of No.

text: Ang Top 10 sa amo nga kategorya matapos ang lima ka qualifying meets amo ang maga-abanse sa Paris Summer Games sa France sa 2024.
english: The Top 10 in that category after five qualifying meets will advance to the Paris Summer Games in France in 2024.

text: Si Diaz ang labing-una kag naga-isahanon nga Filipino nga nakahatag sang Olympic gold medal sa Pilipinas kag tuyo sini nga madugangan ang amo nga medalya kun makasaka siya sa Olympiada sa France sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Diaz is the first and only Filipino to win an Olympic gold medal in the Philippines and aims to add to that medal when he qualifies for the Olympics in France next year.

text: Pahayag sini, ini na ang iya ikaapat nga qualifier gani nagatutok siya sa kumpetisyon kag ginalikawan ang tanan nga distractions.
english: He said this is his fourth qualifier so he is focusing on the competition and avoiding all distractions.

text: Antes nagkadto sa Doha, naghanas siya sa Bahrain kaupod ang iya bana kag coach nga si Julius Naranjo.
english: Before going to Doha, she trained in Bahrain with her husband and coach Julius Naranjo.

text: Indi lamang siya ang naga-isahanon nga weightlifter sang Pilipinas nga malapit na makakuha sang Olympic spot.
english: He is not the only Philippine weightlifter who is close to earning an Olympic spot.

text: Sanday anay Asian champion Vanessa Sarno kag Rosegie Ramos ang pareho nga nagapang-siyam sa 49kg kag 71kg kag nagakinahanglan sang isa pa ka tournament kasunod sang grand prix agud nga makatapak sila sa Paris.
english: Former Asian champion Vanessa Sarno and Rosegie Ramos are both ranked ninth at 49kg and 71kg respectively and need another tournament following the grand prix for them to set foot in Paris.

text: Ini nga grand prix sa Doha nga magalawig tubtub sa Disyembre 14 ang makabig nga crucial sa Olympic qualifying rankings sa men’s and women’s division kun sa diin 382 lifters halin sa 72 ka mga pungsod ang nagapaindis-indis agud makakuha sang ticket pakadto sa France.
english: The grand prix in Doha, which runs until December 14, is crucial in the Olympic qualifying rankings in the men's and women's divisions where 382 lifters from 72 countries are competing for a ticket to France.

text: Nagbalik na sa Vatican si Pope Francis matapos ang lima ka semana nga pagpakigbato sa double pneumonia sa ospital kun sa diin pila ka beses pa nga nangin kritikal ang iya kondisyon.
english: Pope Francis has returned to the Vatican after five weeks of battling double pneumonia in hospital where his condition became critical several times.

text: Sa labing-una nga tion halin sang Pebrero 14, naghimo man ang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa sang public appearance.
english: For the first time since February 14, the 88-year-old Pope also made a public appearance.

text: Natabo ini sa balkonahe sang Gemelli Hospital sa Roma kun sa diin siya gin-admit.
english: It happened on the balcony of the Gemelli Hospital in Rome where he was admitted.

text: Sakay sa wheelchair, nagyuhom kag nagtamyaw si Pope sa mga tumuluo nga nagahinugyaw kag nagasinggit sang iya pangalan sa idalom, makapila ka beses man ini nag-senyas sang “okay”, kag naghambal man sang iya pagpasalamat sa mahinay nga tingog.
english: Riding in a wheelchair, Pope smiled and greeted the faithful who were cheering and shouting his name below, he also gestured several times “okay”, and also spoke his gratitude in a low voice.

text: Nagkinasadya naman ang mga tawo sang nag-special shoutout ang Pope sa 79-anyos nga babaye nga may dala nga yellow nga bulak bangud adlaw-adlaw gid ini nga nagakadto sa ospital samtang didto nagapaayo ang Pope.
english: People were delighted when the Pope gave a special shoutout to the 79-year-old woman with a yellow flower because she went to the hospital every day while the Pope was recovering.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, ginbyahe na si Pope, gin-updan sang police vehicles sa Roma, apang naghapit anay agud maghalad sang bulak sa Basilica of Saint Mary Major nga isa ka simbahan kun sa diin may espesyal nga debosyon si Pope Francis kag masami man niya gina-bisita.
english: After that, the Pope was traveled, accompanied by police vehicles to Rome, but stopped to lay flowers at the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, a church where Pope Francis has a special devotion and often visits.

text: Talalupangdon man nga sang yara na si Pope sa salakyan, may gintakod na naman nga gamay nga hose sa iya ilong agud nga maka-bulig sa iya nga makaginhawa sang maayo.
english: It is also worth noting that when Pope was in the car, a small hose was attached to his nose to help him breathe better.

text: Una na ginsiling sang medical team nga nag-ayo na ang Pope sa double pneumonia, apang may yara gihapon sang complex infection kag madugayan pa nga dalayon nga mag-ayo bangud man sa iya edad.
english: Earlier, the medical team said the Pope had recovered from double pneumonia, but still had a complex infection and would take a long time to recover due to his age.

text: Suno kay Sergio Alfieri, head sang medical team sang Pope, kinahanglan nga magpahuway ang Santo Papa sa sulod sang duha ka bulan kag maglikaw anay sa dalagku nga meetings samtang yara sa Vatican.
english: According to Sergio Alfieri, head of the Pope's medical team, the Pope needs to rest for two months and avoid large meetings while in the Vatican.

text: Matandaan nga sa masobra isa ka bulan ni Pope sa ospital, isa ka picture gid lamang ang gin-release sang Vatican kag ini amo ang laragway sang Santo Papa samtang nagapangamuyo ini sa chapel.
english: It can be recalled that in more than a month of Pope's hospitalization, the Vatican released only one picture and this is the picture of the Pope while he was praying in the chapel.

text: Sinisi ng Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) si dating Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan sa umano’y sabwatan ng ilang inhenyero ng DPWH at pribadong kontratista sa P72.4-milyong “ghost” flood control project sa Plaridel, Bulacan.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) has accused former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan of allegedly colluding with DPWH engineers and private contractors in the P72.4-million “ghost” flood control project in Plaridel, Bulacan.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng ICI na isinumite sa Office of the Ombudsman, naganap umano ang “paglustay ng pondo ng bayan” sa ilalim mismo ng pamumuno ni Bonoan.
english: According to the ICI report submitted to the Office of the Ombudsman, the “embezzlement of public funds” allegedly took place under the leadership of Bonoan.

text: Iminungkahi ng komisyon na sampahan siya ng mga kasong administratibo gaya ng grave misconduct, gross dishonesty, at paglabag sa Code of Conduct for Public Officials.
english: The commission recommended that he be charged with administrative offenses such as grave misconduct, gross dishonesty, and violation of the Code of Conduct for Public Officials.

text: Kasama rin sa mga pinapanagot ang dating undersecretaries ng DPWH na sina Roberto Bernardo at Maria Catalina Cabral.
english: Also among those held accountable are former DPWH undersecretaries Roberto Bernardo and Maria Catalina Cabral.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, lumabas na walang naitayong flood control structure sa lugar kahit buong bayad na ng mahigit P72 milyon sa kontratistang Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.
english: Investigation revealed that no flood control structure was erected in the area despite the full payment of more than P72 million to the contractor Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc.

text: Ayon sa ICI, ang kapabayaan ni Bonoan ay “katumbas ng pandaraya” at malaking pagkakanulo sa tiwalang ibinigay sa kanya ng publiko.
english: According to the ICI, Bonoan's negligence is “amounting to fraud” and a serious breach of the trust placed in him by the public.

text: Ang ulat na ito ay bahagi ng mas malawak na imbestigasyon sa mga umano’y ghost at overpriced projects ng DPWH na binanggit ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This report is part of a broader investigation into the alleged ghost and overpriced projects of the DPWH mentioned by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa kanyang SONA.
english: in his SONA.

text: Kun wala ka pa naka-get over sa Super Bowl performance ni Rihanna, there’s more!
english: If you haven’t gotten over Rihanna’s Super Bowl performance yet, there’s more!

text: Maga-perform ang pop superstar sa Oscars ukon ang top awards show sa film industry sa Hollywood sa masunod nga bulan!
english: The pop superstar will perform at the Oscars or the top awards show in the film industry in Hollywood next month!

text: Suno sa organizers, i-perform sang Barbados-born singer ang iya Academy Award-nominated song nga “Lift Me Up” nga halin sa “Black Panther: Wakanda Forever”.
english: According to organizers, the Barbados-born singer will perform her Academy Award-nominated song “Lift Me Up” from “Black Panther: Wakanda Forever”.
