text: Matandaan nga sa sulod sang pito ka tuig, wala naka-perform ang 35 anyos nga singer sa live show antes ang iya performance sa Super Bowl subong nga Pebrero.
english: It can be recalled that for seven years, the 35-year-old singer did not perform in a live show before his performance at the Super Bowl this February.

text: Sang tion nga wala siya sa live shows, nagtutok si Rihanna sa makeup, lingerie kag high-fashion brands nga naghimo sa iya nga isa ka billionaire.
english: During her time away from live shows, Rihanna focused on the makeup, lingerie and high-fashion brands that have made her a billionaire.

text: Nagtutok man siya sa pagpadaku sa iya anak.
english: She also focused on raising her son.

text: Sa Super Bowl performance, nakumpirma man nga nagabusong si Rihanna sa iya ikaduha nga anak.
english: During the Super Bowl performance, it was also confirmed that Rihanna was pregnant with her second child.

text: Ang “Lift Me Up” amo ang first Oscar nomination para kay Rihanna, apang antes sini, nakahimo siya sang rekord bilang nine-time Grammy winner nga may walo ka multi-platinum albums.
english: “Lift Me Up” was the first Oscar nomination for Rihanna, but before that, she set a record as a nine-time Grammy winner with eight multi-platinum albums.

text: Patigayunon ang 95th Academy Awards sa Dolby Theatre sa Los Angeles sa Marso 12.
english: The 95th Academy Awards will be held at the Dolby Theater in Los Angeles on March 12.

text: Mapahuway lang sang gamay ang Pilipinas kun makaguwa na si Bagyo Tino bangud magabulos naman ang isa ka tropical depression nga pangalanan nga Uwan.
english: The Philippines will only get a little rest when Typhoon Tino leaves because a tropical depression called Uwan will take its place.

text: Sandig sa latest weather bulletin sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ginsiling nga nakit-an ang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 1,830 km nasidlangan sang Southern Mindanao.
english: According to the latest weather bulletin of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the typhoon was spotted at a distance of 1,830 km east of Southern Mindanao.

text:
May dala ini nga kabaskugon sang hangin nga 55 km/h kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 70 km/h. Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan nabagatnan nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 20 km/h.

Gina-forecast nga magasulod ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) bilang isa ka Typhoon sa Byernes sang gab-i ukon sa Sabado sang aga.
english:
It has wind speeds of 55 km/h and gusts of up to 70 km/h. It is moving west southwest at a speed of 20 km/h.

It is forecast to enter the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) as a Typhoon on Friday night or Saturday morning.

text: Sa sulod sang PAR, mahimo ini magbaskog kag mahimo nga super typhoon.
english: Within the PAR, it can intensify and become a super typhoon.

text: Mas nagasaka man ang tyansa nga maka-landfall si Uwan apang indi pa matumod subong sang weather bureau kun diin gid ang eksakto nga lokasyon.
english: The chances of Uwan landfall are also increasing but the weather bureau has not yet determined the exact location.

text: Magahatag sila sang update paagi sa masunod nga advisories.
english: They will provide an update through the following advisories.

text: Kun makasulod na sa PAR, ini ang pang-21 nga bagyo sa Pilipinas subong nga tuig kag pangaduha naman sa Nobyembre.
english: If it enters the PAR, it will be the 21st typhoon in the Philippines this year and the second in November.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang weather bureau nga duha tubtub tatlo ka tropical cyclones ang magasulod ukon magaporma sa PAR sa Nobyembre.
english: Earlier, the weather bureau said two to three tropical cyclones will enter or form in the PAR in November.

text: Nag-utoy-utoy na lang sang kadlaw ang isa ka babaye matapos nga ginlupad sang hangin ang atop sang ila balay bangud sa Bagyo Tino.
english: A woman laughed after the wind blew the roof of her house due to Typhoon Tino.

text: Sa isa ka facebook post, makit-an nga ginakuhaan sini sang video ang atop sang ila balay samtang ginaamat-amat tuklap sang mabaskog nga hangin.
english: In a facebook post, he can be seen taking a video of the roof of their house as it is slowly being blown away by strong winds.

text: Sang dalayon na nga napalid, didto na ini nag-utoy-utoy kadlaw.
english: When it was immediately blown away, it started to laugh.

text: Madamo naman nga mga netizens ang nalingaw bangud sa baylo nga maghibi, baliskad ang ginpakita sini nga emosyon.
english: Many netizens were amused because instead of crying, she showed the opposite emotion.

text: Wala nagahinulsol ang Golden State Warriors star nga si Draymond Green sa ginhimo sini sa player sang Minnesota Timberwolves nga si Rudy Gobert apisar gin-suspend pa siya sang NBA sa sulod sang lima ka hampang.
english: Golden State Warriors star Draymond Green has no regrets about what he did to Minnesota Timberwolves player Rudy Gobert despite being suspended for five games by the NBA.

text: Kun matandaan, duha ka minutos pa lamang ang hampang sang Timberwolves kag Warriors sa San Francisco sang natabo ang headlock incident.
english: The Timberwolves and Warriors were only two minutes into the game in San Francisco when the headlock incident occurred.

text: Una nga nagkumpruntahanay sanday Klay Thompson kag Jaden McDaniels, kag sang nagpalapit si Gobert sa duha, madasig man nga nagpalapit si Green, gin-liab si Gobert kag madugay pa nga ginbuy-an apisar madamo ang nagabulag sa ila lakip na si Coach Steve Kerr.
english: Klay Thompson and Jaden McDaniels first confronted each other, and when Gobert approached the two, Green quickly approached, liab Gobert and took a long time to let go despite many separating them including Coach Steve Kerr.

text:
via NBA Sports Bay Arena

Ginpaguwa sa hampang sanday Thompson, McDaniels kag Green kag ginmultahan man sanday Gobert, Thompson kag McDaniels sang tag-P1.3-million bangud sa insidente.
english:
via NBA Sports Bay Arena

Thompson, McDaniels and Green were ejected from the game and Gobert, Thompson and McDaniels were also fined P1.3-million each for the incident.

text: Pahayag ni Green, gindepensahan lamang niya ang iya nga teammate bangud suno sa iya, 12-anyos na niya nga teammate si Thompson kag ginakabig na niya ini nga utod.
english: Green said he only defended his teammate because he said Thompson has been his teammate for 12 years and he considers him a brother.

text: “I’ll come to a teammate’s defense any time that I’m in a position to come to a teammate’s defense.
english: “I’ll come to a teammate’s defense any time that I’m in a position to come to a teammate’s defense.

text: … What matters to me is how the people that I care about feel, first and foremost.
english: … What matters to me is how the people that I care about feel, first and foremost.

text: How are the people that I care about affected?
english: How are the people that I care about affected?

text: How are the people I care about, what do they have to deal with?
english: How are the people I care about, what do they have to deal with?

text:
That’s it for me.”

Ginsiling pa sini nga indi patas para sa iya nga gin-cite pa sang NBA ang iya history sang “unsportsmanlike acts” sang ginpapanaog ang suspensyon bangud suno sa iya, nabayaran na niya ang iya una nga mga sala.
english:
That’s it for me.”

He said it was unfair for him that the NBA cited his history of “unsportsmanlike acts” when issuing the suspension because he said he had already paid for his previous sins.

text: Mahimo na makabalik si Green sa hampang sang Warriors batok sa Sacramento Kings sa NBA In-Season Tournament nga naka-schedule buwas, 11:00 sa aga, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Green could return for the Warriors' game against the Sacramento Kings in the NBA In-Season Tournament scheduled for tomorrow, 11:00 am, Philippine time.

text: First runner-up sa Mister Culture World International 2023 sa Đà Lạt, Vietnam ang Bachelor of Science in Criminology student sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) Lambunao Campus nga si Mark Lexon Operio.
english: First runner-up in the Mister Culture World International 2023 in Đà Lạt, Vietnam is Bachelor of Science in Criminology student of West Visayas State University (WVSU) Lambunao Campus Mark Lexon Operio.

text: Ang 23-anyos nga tumandok sang Janiuay, Iloilo ang nagtapos man anay bilang third runner-up sa Mr. WVSU 2023.
english: The 23-year-old native of Janiuay, Iloilo also finished third runner-up in the Mr. WVSU 2023.

text: Sang March 2022, nagpasakop man si Operio sa Man of the Globe Philippines sa Angeles City, Pampanga kun sa diin iya nakuha ang second runner-up title.
english: In March 2022, Operio also participated in the Man of the Globe Philippines in Angeles City, Pampanga where he won the second runner-up title.

text: Ang kumpetisyon sa Vietnam amo ang iya labing-una nga international pageant.
english: The competition in Vietnam was her first international pageant.

text: Nakuha naman sang isa pa ka Pinoy nga si Hari ng Pilipinas – Lakan Ng Kultura 2022 Kevin Claud Beray ang titulo nga Mister Culture World International 2023.##
english: Another Filipino, Hari ng Pilipinas – Lakan Ng Kultura 2022 Kevin Claud Beray, won the title of Mister Culture World International 2023.##

text: Nagalaum naman ang mga Ilonggo nga nag-upod sa rally subong nga adlaw nga mamurag-muragan ang gobyerno kasunod sang dako nga hublag-protesta nga ginpatigayon sang mga Pilipino.
english: Ilonggos who joined the rally today hope that the government will be relieved following the massive protest by Filipinos.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Herman Lagon, Master of Education, kag kabahin sang Alumni Association sang University of the Philippines-Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga indi na normal ang nagakatabo nga kurapsyon kag ini nga hublag subong nga hapon ang nagapakita kun ano na ka akig ang mga tawo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Herman Lagon, Master of Education, and part of the Alumni Association of the University of the Philippines-Visayas, said that corruption is not normal and this afternoon's movement shows how angry the people are.

text: Nagalaom naman ini nga indi lang pagpadayaw-dayaw ang rason sang iban kun ngaa nag-upod sila sa rally ilabi na bangud anibersaryo subong sang deklarasyon ang martial law.
english: He hoped that the reason why others joined the rally was not just to brag especially since it is the anniversary of the declaration of martial law.

text: Pahayag sini, nakit-an niya sa mga kabataan kag sa organizers nga sinsero sila, kag ini nga protesta ang pamuno pa lamang sang mas madamo pa nga mga hublag.
english: He said he saw in the children and the organizers that they are sincere, and this protest is just the beginning of more movements.

text: Para naman kay Earl John Lopez, alumnus sang University of the Philippines-High School, nag-upod siya sa protesta bangud nakit-an sini ang paglala sang kurapsyon paagi sa expose nga natabo sa Kongreso.
english: For Earl John Lopez, an alumnus of the University of the Philippines-High School, he joined the protest because he saw the worsening of corruption through the expose that took place in Congress.

text: Paagi man ini suno sa iya nga magkampanya para sa mga pumuluyo nga magpili sang mayo nga mga lider nga magarepresentar sang husto sa mga Pilipino.
english: He said this is also a way to campaign for the people to elect good leaders who will represent the Filipinos properly.

text: Lakip man sa nag-upod sa rally amo si former Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon.
english: Also joining the rally was former Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon.

text: Pahayag sini, intact ang iya nga integridad bilang anay opisyal sang gobyerno, gani nga wala siya nahuya nga mag-upod sa panawagan batok sa kurapsyon.
english: He said his integrity as a former government official is intact, so he is not ashamed to join the call against corruption.

text: Maka-guwa na sa presuhan ang South African Paralympic champion nga si Oscar Pistorius matapos ini nahatagan sang parole.
english: South African Paralympic champion Oscar Pistorius will be released from prison after being granted parole.

text: Bantog si Pistorius bilang “Blade Runner” bangud sa iya carbon-fibre prosthetic legs kag ginkilala man nga public hero sang nangin isa ini ka kampyon sa Paralympics apang sang ulihi, labi ini nga nangin kilala indi bilang sports figure kundi bilang murderer.
english: Pistorius was known as the “Blade Runner” for his carbon-fibre prosthetic legs and was also recognized as a public hero when he became a Paralympic champion but later became known not as a sports figure but as a murderer.

text: Valentine’s Day sang 2013 sang ginpatay sini ang iya nobya nga si Reeva Steenkamp.
english: Valentine’s Day in 2013 when he killed his girlfriend Reeva Steenkamp.

text:
PHOTO: DUIF DU TOIT/GALLO IMAGES/GETTY; GIANLUIGI GUERCIA/AFP VIA GETTY (via People)

Apat ka beses niya ini nga gintiro kag una gin-claim nga nasal-an lamang niya ini nga kawatan.
english:
PHOTO: DUIF DU TOIT/GALLO IMAGES/GETTY; GIANLUIGI GUERCIA/AFP VIA GETTY (via People)

He shot him four times and initially claimed he only mistook him for a thief.

text: Una siya nga nasentensyahan sang lima ka tuig nga pagka-preso sang 2014 bangud sa culpable homicide apang sang ulihi, nangin guilty ini sa murder kag ginpalawig sang anum ka tuig ang sentensya.
english: He was initially sentenced to five years in prison in 2014 for culpable homicide but later pleaded guilty to murder and had the sentence extended by six years.

text: Sang 2017, gindoble sang Korte Suprema sa 13 ka tuig kag lima ka bulan ang iya kabug-usan nga sentensya bangud nanubuan ang korte sa anum lamang ka tuig.
english: In 2017, the Supreme Court doubled his total sentence to 13 years and five months because the court reduced it to just six years.

text: Apang sang sini lang, gin-anunsyo sang Department of Correctional Services nga iga-release na sa Enero 5 ang amo nga South African star bangud sa parole nga ginhatag.
english: However, the Department of Correctional Services recently announced that the South African star will be released on January 5 due to parole.

text: Kun balikan, 29 anyos pa lamang ang girlfriend kag tatlo ka bulan pa lamang nga may relasyon kay Blade Runner sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The girlfriend was only 29 years old and had been in a relationship with Blade Runner for three months when the incident occurred.

text: Isa siya ka law graduate kag model nga naga-trabaho man bilang TV presenter.
english: She is a law graduate and model who also works as a TV presenter.

text: Kasagsagan man ang amo nga tion sang pagkabantog ni Blade Runner bangud sa sampaw-sampaw nga bulawan nga medalya nga nadag-an sa Paralympics kag nangin labing-una man nga amputee runner nga naka-compete batok sa non-disabled athletes sa London 2012 Olympics.
english: Blade Runner's rise to fame was also at the height of his Paralympic gold medals and becoming the first amputee runner to compete against non-disabled athletes at the London 2012 Olympics.

text: Nagbayluhanay ang Russia kag Ukraine sang tag-175 ka mga preso nga amo ang pinakadaku nga numero nga ila napaguwa halin sang natabo ang Russian full-scale invasion sa Kyiv tatlo ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: Russia and Ukraine have exchanged 175 prisoners each, the largest number they have released since the Russian full-scale invasion of Kyiv three years ago.

text: Natabo ang prisoner swap kasunod sang pag-istoryahanay nanday U.S. President Donald Trump kag Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: The prisoner swap took place following talks between U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Pareho man nga ginkumpirma sang Kyiv kag Moscow nga ginbalik man sang Russia sa Ukraine ang 22 ka dugang nga Ukrainian prisoners nga lunsay pilason.
english: Both Kyiv and Moscow also confirmed that Russia had also returned to Ukraine 22 additional Ukrainian prisoners, all of whom were wounded.

text: Suno sa Russian Defence Ministry, ini nga 22 ang nagakinahanglan sang insigida nga pagbulong kag ginbalik sila bilang palatandaan sang goodwill gesture.
english: According to the Russian Defense Ministry, these 22 need immediate medical treatment and they were returned as a sign of goodwill gesture.

text:
Ginkumpirma ini ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy kag nagdugang pa nga ang nasamaran nga mga soldado ang ginpreso anay sang Russia bangud sa fabricated crimes.”

Ginsiling man nga nagpatunga ang United Arab Emirates agud nga ma-facilitate ang pagpauli sang mga preso sa ila tagsa ka pungsod.
english:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy confirmed this and added that the wounded soldiers were previously imprisoned by Russia for fabricated crimes.”

The United Arab Emirates was also said to have intervened to facilitate the return of the prisoners to their respective countries.

text: Ang Russian soldiers naman nga nalakip sa amo nga swap ang yara sa Belarus para sa medical and psychological care antes dal-on sa Moscow para sa dugang nga treatment.
english: The Russian soldiers included in the swap are in Belarus for medical and psychological care before being taken to Moscow for further treatment.

text: Naga-imbitar ang Archdiocese of Jaro sa tanan nga mag-upod sa patigayunon nga “Trillion Peso March” bwas nga hapon, nga maga-umpisa alas 3:00 sa Jaro Plaza kag maga-padayun padulong sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro invites everyone to join the “Trillion Peso March” tomorrow afternoon, which will start at 3:00 pm at Jaro Plaza and proceed to the Iloilo Provincial Capitol.

text: Maga-upod man sa rally si Most Rev.
english: Most Rev. Fr.

text: Midyphil Billones, ang Arsobispo sang Jaro, kaupod ang mga miyembro sang simbahan, mga eskwelahan, kag iban pa nga sektor sang katilingban.
english: Midyphil Billones, the Archbishop of Jaro, along with members of the church, schools, and other sectors of society.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, Director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, iya ginpahayag nga madamo na ang nagsabat sa ila panawagan, labi na ang mga pamatan-on kag mga eskwelahan nga nagpakita sang suporta sa nasambit nga aktibidad.
english: Meliton Oso, Director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, said many have already responded to their call, especially the youth and schools who have shown support for the activity.

text: Suno kay Msgr.
english: According to Msgr.

text: Oso, nabatyagan sang pumuluyo ang kabudlay bangud sa halos isa ka trilyon pesos nga ginapatihan nga na-kurakot sang mga opisyal halin sa kaban sang bayan.
english: Oso, the people felt the hardship because of the nearly one trillion pesos believed to have been corrupted by officials from the public coffers.

text: Dugang pa niya, ang rally kabahin sang mas dako nga panawagan sa gobyerno nga dapat pabayron, pasabton kag presuhon ang mga korap nga opisyal.
english: He added that the rally is part of a larger call to the government to hold corrupt officials accountable and imprisoned.

text: Ginkalipay gid ni Msgr.
english: Msgr. was very pleased.

text: Oso ang aktibo nga partisipasyon sang mga tumuluo apisar pa nga naghalin pa ini sila sa malayo nga mga lugar, bilang pamatuod sang ila kahangawa sa nagakatabo sa pungsod.
english: Oso praised the active participation of the faithful despite coming from far away places, as proof of their concern over what is happening in the country.

text: Ginapanagabay man sini nga kuntani mangin malinong lang kag matalunsay ang rally bwas nga adlaw, Setyembre 21.
english: He also urged that the rally tomorrow, September 21, be peaceful and orderly.

text: Nagalaom man ini nga pamatian sang gobyerno ang panawagan sang katawhan, agud mapasabata na ang mga responsable sa korapsyon kag makabangon liwat ang pungsod Pilipinas.
english: He also hopes that the government will listen to the call of the people, so that those responsible for corruption can be held accountable and the Philippines can rise again.

text: Ginbida sang Filipino-British singer-songwriter nga si Beabadobee ang Iloilo sa official music video sang iya bag-o nga love-themed single nga Glue Song.
english: Filipino-British singer-songwriter Beabadobee stars Iloilo in the official music video of his new love-themed single Glue Song.

text: Sa music video, makit-an ang katahum sang Port San Pedro amo man ang kaanyag sang kaumhan sa hometown sang 22-anyos nga singer nga Beatrice Kristi Laus ang matuod nga pangalan.
english: In the music video, you can see the beauty of Port San Pedro as well as the beauty of the countryside in the hometown of the 22-year-old singer Beatrice Kristi Laus real name.

text: Ginsulat niya ini samtang naga-tour sa Asia kag Australia.
english: He wrote it while on tour in Asia and Australia.

text: Inspired ini nga kanta sa iya bag-o nga relasyon kag nagaistorya man sa isa ka “pure and blissful” nga sahi sang gugma.
english: This song is inspired by her new relationship and also speaks to a “pure and blissful” kind of love.

text: Upod niya sa pag-trabaho sa amo nga music video ang iya boyfriend nga si Jacob Erland nga isa man ka guitarist kag producer.
english: She worked with her boyfriend Jacob Erland, who is also a guitarist and producer, on the music video.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabun-ag si Beabadobee sa Iloilo apang nagdaku sa London.
english: Beabadobee was born in Iloilo but grew up in London.

text: Una siya nga nangin popular bangud sa iya kanta nga Coffee nga nangin global hit matapos gin-reinterpret sang rapper nga si Powfu.
english: He first became popular for his song Coffee which became a global hit after being reinterpreted by rapper Powfu.

text: Sa edad nga 22, may yara na siya sang duha ka albums kag lima ka EPs sa iya nga pangalan kag may yara man sang nominasyon sa BRIT Award nga amo ang pinakamataas nga pop music honours sa Britanya.
english: At the age of 22, she already has two albums and five EPs to her name and a nomination for the BRIT Award, Britain's highest pop music honours.

text: Sang Septyembre, nagpatigayon siya sang iya una nga show sa Manila.
english: In September, he held his first show in Manila.

text: Ginmanduan na ni Pres.
english: He has already ordered Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: anh iya gabinete nga bisitahon kag hibaluon ang sitwasyon sang mga apekatdo sang bagyo Tino.
english: his cabinet to visit and find out the situation of the victims of typhoon Tino.

text: Suno kay Communication Undersecretary Claire Castro, magluwas sa Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) nga nagapanguna sa paghatag sang food packs, nagbulig man ang Department of Energy (DOE) sa mga nadulaan sang suplay sang kuryente.
english: According to Communication Undersecretary Claire Castro, besides the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) which is leading the distribution of food packs, the Department of Energy (DOE) also helped those who lost their electricity supply.

text: Naghatag man sang bulig ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) nga maglimpyo saang mga dalanon.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) also provided assistance to clean the roads.

text: Dugang pa sini, ginapasiguro sang gobyerno nga madasig ang paghulag sang mga ahensya para sa madasig nga pagbangon sang mga lugar nga naapektuhan sang bagyo.
english: In addition, the government is ensuring that the agencies act quickly for the speedy recovery of the areas affected by the typhoon.

text: Magalab-ot sa P1.5-billion ang mapierde sa mga negosyo sa syudad sa tatlo ka adlaw nga power interruptions.
english: Up to P1.5-billion will be lost to businesses in the city during the three-day power interruptions.

text: Base ini sa “rough estimates” sang Local Economic Development & Investment Promotion (LEDIP) nga gin-post ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: This is based on the “rough estimates” of the Local Economic Development & Investment Promotion (LEDIP) posted by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Suno sa alkalde, sandig sa amo nga opisina, kun pahat-pahaton, yara sa P400-million tubtub sa P500-million ang madula sa income sang syudad bangud sa pagsindi-patay sang kuryente sa syudad.
english: According to the mayor, based on the office, if divided, about P400-million to P500-million will be lost in the city's income due to the power outages in the city.

text: “In three days, we would have lost 1.5 b .
english: “In three days, we would have lost 1.5 b .

text: What a way to start the new year!!!,” post sang alkalde.
english: What a way to start the new year!!!,” the mayor posted.

text: Naghingyo man ang alkalde sa national government nga unahon sa pagbalik ang suplay sang kuryente sa syudad.
english: The mayor also urged the national government to prioritize the restoration of electricity supply in the city.

text: “The lgus are told by the national government to process business permits in 10 minutes.
english: “The lgus are told by the national government to process business permits in 10 minutes.

text: I ask the national government give us electricity first.
english: I ask the national government give us electricity first.

text: We cannot process the applications ang print the permits if we do not have electricity,” pahayag sini.
english: We cannot process the applications and print the permits if we do not have electricity,” he said.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang lead specialist sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines nga posible buwas pa, Enero 5, magabalik sa normal ang operasyon sang tanan nga mga power plants sa Panay.#
english: Earlier, the lead specialist of the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines said that it is possible that tomorrow, January 5, the operation of all power plants in Panay will return to normal.

text: Nagpasugot na si Russian President Vladimir Putin nga temporaryo nga mag-untat sa pag-atake sa Ukraine.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has already agreed to a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine.

text: Ini ang resulta sang sugilanon nanday Putin kag US President Donald Trump paagi sa telepono.
english: This was the result of a conversation between Putin and US President Donald Trump over the phone.

text: Suno sa White House, indi anay pag-atakehon sang Russia ang mga energy infrastructure sang Ukraine.
english: According to the White House, Russia will not attack Ukraine’s energy infrastructure in the first place.

text: Sa Marso 20, may patigayunon man nga bayluhanay sang 175 prisoners of war.
english: On March 20, there will also be an exchange of 175 prisoners of war.

text: Ginhingyo man ni Putin nga dapat wala sang mangin paghulag ang mga suldado sang Ukraine sa sulod sang 30 ka adlaw nga ceasefire.
english: Putin also demanded that Ukrainian troops be immobilized during the 30-day ceasefire.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, may pagsugilanon ang tiglawas sang US kag si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sa Saudi Arabia may kaangtanan sa ceasefire sa duha ka pungsod.
english: Last week, the US envoy and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky held talks in Saudi Arabia regarding the ceasefire between the two countries.

text: Natapos na ang ceasefire sa Gaza kasunod sang makakilibot kag makamamatay nga pag-atake sang Israel sa gintawag nga “extensive strikes” sa Hamas targets.
english: The ceasefire in Gaza has ended following Israel’s surprising and deadly attacks in what it called “extensive strikes” on Hamas targets.

text: Sa amo nga pag-atake nga natabo Martes nga adlaw sa Gaza, indi magnubo sa 400 ang patay kalakip na ang madamo nga kabataan.
english: In the attack that took place on Tuesday in Gaza, at least 400 people were killed, including many children.

text: Ini ang pinakamakamamatay nga pag-atake sang Israel sa sulod sang 17 ka bulan nga giyera batok sa Hamas.
english: It was Israel’s deadliest attack in its 17-month war against Hamas.

text: Si Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ang nagmando sang amo nga strikes, matapos namalibad ang Hamas sa demands sang Israel nga bag-uhon ang ceasefire agreement kaangot sa pag- release sang hostages.
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the strikes after Hamas refused Israel's demands to change the ceasefire agreement regarding the release of hostages.

text: Suno sa mga officials, ang operasyon ang ginalauman nga magsangkad pa.
english: Officials said the operation is expected to expand further.

text: Nagsiling naman ang White House nga ginkonsulta ini sang Israel kag nagpahayag ang Washington sang suporta sa tikang sang Israel.
english: The White House said it was consulted by Israel and Washington expressed support for Israel's move.

text: Samtang, ginpakamalaot naman sang mga pungsod sa Europa ang ginhimo sang Israel nga pag-atake sa Gaza.
english: Meanwhile, European countries have condemned Israel's attack on Gaza.

text: Matunog sa gihapon ang nagkalain-lain nga reaksyon sa Super Bowl comeback sang pop superstar nga si Rihanna, apang isa sa agaw-atensyon amo ang pagpanghikay nga ginahimo ni former United States President Donald Trump.
english: There are still various reactions to the Super Bowl comeback of pop superstar Rihanna, but one of the things that caught the attention is the arrangements being made by former United States President Donald Trump.

text: Gintawag ni Trump ang 15-minute half-time performance ni Rihanna nga “epic fail” kag “worst halftime show” sa maragtas sang amo nga sporting event.
english: Trump called Rihanna’s 15-minute half-time performance an “epic fail” and the “worst halftime show” in the history of that sporting event.

text: Apisar ginkumpirma nga nagabusong sa iya Baby Number 2 si Rihanna sang tion sang iya performance, wala gihapon sang preno ang former president sa pag-insulto sa singer.
english: Although it was confirmed that Rihanna was pregnant with her Baby Number 2 at the time of her performance, the former president still had no brakes in insulting the singer.

text: Sang Agusto 2020, gin-atake man ni Trump ang Grammy-winning singer kag nagsiling nga indi ini dapat pagtugutan sang National Football League nga mag-perform sa Super Bowl.
english: In August 2020, Trump also attacked the Grammy-winning singer and said the National Football League should not have allowed him to perform at the Super Bowl.

text: Wala nagsabat ang Barbadian multibillionaire musician kag business entrepreneur sang amo nga tion, apang antes pa man sini, kilala na siya nga kritiko sang former president.
english: The Barbadian multibillionaire musician and business entrepreneur did not respond at the time, but even before that, he was a well-known critic of the former president.

text: Gintawag sini anay si Trump nga “the most mentally ill human being in America.” ##
english: It once called Trump “the most mentally ill human being in America.” ##

text: Nagpaulan si LeBron James sang 32 puntos kag ginpangunahan ang Los Angeles Lakers nga tapuson ang three-game losing streak paagi sa paglutos kay Kevin Durant kag Phoenix Suns, 122-119, sa NBA In-Season Tournament.
english: LeBron James poured in 32 points and led the Los Angeles Lakers to end a three-game losing streak by defeating Kevin Durant and the Phoenix Suns, 122-119, in the NBA In-Season Tournament.

text: Sa edad nga 38-anyos, wala sang paghinay sa pwersa sang four-time NBA champion kag four-time MVP sa iya performance sa iya 21st season sa liga sang ginbuy-an man sini ang 11 rebounds kag anum ka assists batok sa Suns nga gindugangan pa ni D’Angelo Russell sang 19 puntos.
english: At 38-years-old, there was no slowing down in the force of the four-time NBA champion and four-time MVP in his performance in his 21st season in the league when he also unleashed 11 rebounds and six assists against the Suns with D’Angelo Russell adding 19 points.

text:
Rick Scuteri-USA TODAY Sports

Dalayawon man ang performance ni Anthony Davis nga may 18 puntos, 11 rebounds, kag apat ka assists apisar wala ini nakapakita sa isa ka sambuwa bangud sa hip injury.
english:
Rick Scuteri-USA TODAY Sports

Anthony Davis also had a commendable performance with 18 points, 11 rebounds, and four assists despite missing a game with a hip injury.

text: Ginpangunahan naman ni Durant ang Suns nga may 38 puntos kag ginsundan ni Bradley Beal sang 24 — 20 sa first half.
english: Durant led the Suns with 38 points and Bradley Beal followed with 24 — 20 in the first half.

text: Wala nakapakita si Devin Booker sa iya ikaaapat na nga sunod-sunod nga hampang bangud sa injury.
english: Devin Booker missed his fourth straight game with an injury.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Lakers ang Portland Trail Blakers samtang makasambuwa naman sang Suns ang Oklahoma City.
english: The Lakers will next face the Portland Trail Blakers while the Suns will face Oklahoma City.

text: Apisar sang season-high nga 54 points nga ginbubo sang two-time NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo, ginkabos pa ang Milwaukee Bucks kag nalutos sa kamot sang Indiana Pacers, 126-124.
english: Despite a season-high 54 points poured in by two-time NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP) Giannis Antetokounmpo, the Milwaukee Bucks were still poor and lost to the Indiana Pacers, 126-124.

text: Nagpanguna sa Pacers si Tyrese Haliburton nga may 29 points kag 10 assists; Bennedict Mathurin nga may 26 points kag 11 rebounds; kag Myles Turner nga may 21 points kag 6 rebounds.
english: Tyrese Haliburton led the Pacers with 29 points and 10 assists; Bennedict Mathurin with 26 points and 11 rebounds; and Myles Turner with 21 points and 6 rebounds.

text:
Photo: Giannis Antetokounmpo/FB

Ini man ang ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga hampang nga lapaw sa 120-puntos ang gin-skor sang Indiana.
english:
Photo: Giannis Antetokounmpo/FB

It was also the fifth straight game Indiana has scored over 120-points.

text: Ika-pito nga tion naman ini sa karera ni Antetokounmpo nga nakapaulan ini sang 50-points pasaka sa hampang sa regular season.
english: This is the seventh time in Antetokounmpo's career that he has rained 50-plus points in a regular season game.

text: Sa nagligad nga sambuwa sang Bucks batok sa Detroit Pistons, ginpaguwa ang Greek superstar kasunod sang duha ka “unsportsmanlike technical fouls”.
english: In the Bucks' previous game against the Detroit Pistons, the Greek superstar was ejected following two “unsportsmanlike technical fouls”.

text: Sa sini nga match, nagbawi ang Milwaukee superstar kag bug-os kusog sini nga ginhakwat ang team paagi sa 26 puntos sa first half kag 20 sa sulod lamang sang third quarter.
english: In this match, the Milwaukee superstar recovered and fully lifted the team with 26 points in the first half and 20 in the third quarter alone.

text: Sa ulihi nga bahin sang hampang, nagmato-mato ang Bucks nga wala ang head coach nga si Adrian Griffin matapos gin-eject man ini sa third quarter.
english: Late in the game, the Bucks struggled without head coach Adrian Griffin after he was also ejected in the third quarter.

text: Apisar sang 10 puntos pa nga abanse nanday Antetokounmpo sa pagsugod sang fourth quarter, nagdasig kag nakalagas ang Pacers lakip na ang tres ni Haliburton sang 1:29 na lamang ang nabilin sa oras.
english: Despite Antetokounmpo's 10-point lead at the start of the fourth quarter, the Pacers picked up speed and chased including Haliburton's three with 1:29 left on the clock.

text: Magluwas sa Greek Freak, nakabubo man si Khris Middleton sang 19 puntos para sa Bucks kag nagdugang si Malik Beasley sang 13, samtang wala naman nakabulig hakwat sa Bucks si Damian Lillard bangud sa iya nga calf injury.
english: In addition to the Greek Freak, Khris Middleton also poured in 19 points for the Bucks and Malik Beasley added 13, while Damian Lillard was unable to help lift the Bucks due to his calf injury.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Bucks, 5-3 na subong nga season, ang Orlando Magic, samtang makasumpong naman sang Pacers (6-3) ang Philadelphia 76ers.
english: The Bucks, 5-3 this season, will next face the Orlando Magic, while the Pacers (6-3) will face the Philadelphia 76ers.

text: Ginlunsar sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) ang task force nga magatutok sa problema sa Avian Influenza ukon bird flu sa Pilipinas.
english: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has launched a task force to focus on the problem of Avian Influenza or bird flu in the Philippines.

text: Ini ang ginhingadlan nga Task Force Alectryon nga pangunahan ni Director General Samuel Zacate.
english: It is named Task Force Alectryon to be led by Director General Samuel Zacate.

text: Tuyo sini nga magbalay sang proactive approach batok sa bird flu paagi sa pagpatuman sang control strategies kaangay sang pagbakuna.
english: It aims to outline a proactive approach against bird flu by implementing control strategies such as vaccination.

text: Ini man nga task force ang maga-evaluate kag maga-assess sang bulong kag bakuna nga safe kag dekalidad agud matapna ang paglapta sang virus.
english: The task force will also evaluate and assess the safety and quality of drugs and vaccines to prevent the spread of the virus.

text: Gin-enggayo man sang FDA ang veterinary pharmaceutical industry nga magpasa sang aplikasyon para sa Avian Influenza vaccines agud masuportahan ang mga tikang nga matapna ini nga problema sa populasyon sang domestic kag wild birds.
english: The FDA also encouraged the veterinary pharmaceutical industry to submit applications for Avian Influenza vaccines to support measures to curb this problem in domestic and wild bird populations.

text: Buksan na subong nga Nobyembre 2023 ang museum nga ginadedikar sa kabuhi, karera, kag legasiya sang NBA great nga si LeBron James!
english: The museum dedicated to the life, career, and legacy of NBA great LeBron James will open this November 2023!

text: Lakip sa mga makit-an sa “LeBron James’ Home Court” sa iya hometown sa Akron, Ohio amo ang mga items nga importante sa kabuhi sang Los Angeles Lakers superstar halin sa Akron pakadto sa NBA, Olympics, business, philanthropy, kag iban pa.
english: Among those found in “LeBron James’ Home Court” in his hometown of Akron, Ohio are items that were important in the Los Angeles Lakers superstar’s life from Akron to the NBA, Olympics, business, philanthropy, and more.

text:
Jasen Vinlove-USA TODAY Sports

Igabalik man sini ang fans sa tion nga yara pa lamang si James sa 2003 NBA Draft, sa iya championship halin sa Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat kag Los Angeles Lakers kag mangin sa pagdaog sang gold-medal sa Olympiada.
english:
Jasen Vinlove-USA TODAY Sports

It will also take fans back to a time when James was still in the 2003 NBA Draft, to his championship from the Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat and Los Angeles Lakers and even to winning a gold-medal at the Olympiada.

text: Pormal nga buksan sa Nobyembre 25 ini nga museum nga makit-an sa House Three Thirty, isa ka pasilidad nga gintukod sang foundation ni James agud maka-serbe sa komunidad kun sa diin siya nagdaku.
english: The museum, located at House Three Thirty, will be formally opened on November 25, a facility built by James' foundation to serve the community where he grew up.

text: Magakadto ang tanan nga proceeds sang ticket sales sa amo man nga komunidad.
english: All proceeds from ticket sales will go to the same community.

text: Si James, isa ka four-time NBA champion, four-time Most Valuable Player, kag all-time NBA scoring leader, ang nagahampang gihapon subong sa liga para sa iya ika-21 nga NBA season.
english: James, a four-time NBA champion, four-time Most Valuable Player, and all-time NBA scoring leader, is still currently playing in the league for his 21st NBA season.

text: Siyam ang kumpirmado nga napatay sa Cebu City bangud sa Bagyo tino base sa datos sang Cebu City Government as of 4:52 p.m. subong nga adlaw, Nov.
english: Nine people were confirmed dead in Cebu City due to Typhoon Tino based on data from the Cebu City Government as of 4:52 p.m. today, Nov.

text: Isa ka one-month-old baby sa Brgy.
english: A one-month-old baby in Brgy.

text: Talamban kag isa ka four-month-old sa Poblacion Pardo ang pinakabata nga fatalities.
english: Talamban and a four-month-old in Poblacion Pardo were the youngest fatalities.

text: Lakip man sang duha ka mga minors nga yara sa edad nga 17 kag 11 sa mga napatay .
english: Two minors aged 17 and 11 were also among the dead.

text: May pagtaas sa power rates sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation para sa bulan sang Septyembre.
english: There is an increase in the power rates of MORE Electric and Power Corporation for the month of September.

text: Suno sa MORE Power, ini bangud sa pagnipis sang supply sang kuryente nga amo man ang rason nga nagdeklarar ang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines sang Yellow Alert Status sang Agosto.
english: According to MORE Power, this is due to the thinning of electricity supply which is also the reason why the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines declared a Yellow Alert Status in August.

text: Ang pagnipis sang suplay sang kuryente ilabi na sa Visayad grid ang bangud sa pag-shutdown sang 14 ka mga generation plants sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: The thinning of power supply especially in the Visayas grid is due to the shutdown of 14 generation plants last month.

text: Sa subong nga bulan, nagsaka sa ₱12.44 per kWh ang residential rate halin sa ₱10.88 per kWh ukon may pagdugang nga ₱1.56 per kWh.
english: This month, the residential rate rose to ₱12.44 per kWh from ₱10.88 per kWh or an increase of ₱1.56 per kWh.

text: Yara naman sa ₱11.76 per kWh ang commercial rate halin sa ₱10.19/kWh.
english: The commercial rate is at ₱11.76 per kWh from ₱10.19/kWh.

text: Suno sa MORE Power, ang pagtaas sang rate ang bangud sa nagtaas sang generation cost kag ang pagtaas man sang presyo sang kuryente sa Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).
english: According to MORE Power, the rate increase is due to the increase in generation cost and the increase in the price of electricity in the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto, nagpagwa sang serye sang paandam ang NGCP angot sa Yellow Alert Status sa Visayas Grid.
english: It can be recalled that in August, NGCP issued a series of warnings regarding the Yellow Alert Status in the Visayas Grid.

text: Ang rates sang kuryente sa WESM subong ang yara sa ₱6.1437 per kWh halin sa ₱4.9128 per kWh sang Hulyo.
english: Electricity rates in WESM now stand at ₱6.1437 per kWh from ₱4.9128 per kWh in July.

text: Sa pihak sang pagsaka sa balaydan sa kuryente, ginsiling sang MORE Power nga ginapangitaan nila sang paagi nga mahagan-hagan ang epekto sini sa mga konsumidor.
english: Despite the increase in electricity bills, MORE Power said they are looking for ways to mitigate the impact on consumers.

text: Pila ka tulog na lang antes ang Paskwa kag antes ang Bag-ong Tuig gani ginpasigurado sang grupo sang hog farmers nga wala sang dapat nga kabalak-an sa suplay sang baboy sa Pilipinas samtang wala-tuo ang handaanay.
english: With only a few days left before Christmas and New Year, the group of hog farmers assured that there is nothing to worry about the supply of pigs in the Philippines while the preparations are in full swing.

text: Suno kay National Federation of Hog Farmers Inc.
english: According to the National Federation of Hog Farmers Inc.

text: president Chester Warren Tan, buot silingon sini, wala sang nakit-an nga rason sa pagsaka sa retail price sang karne sang baboy.
english: president Chester Warren Tan, this means that he saw no reason to increase the retail price of pork.

text: Suno kay Tan, bilog nga Disyembre ang ma-cover sang suplay sa pungsod kag sa pagkamatuod subong, manubo ang demand bangud manubo man ang purchasing power sang consumers bangud ginatinguhaan nila nga indi maggasto.
english: According to Tan, the supply in the country will cover the whole of December and in fact now, the demand is low because the purchasing power of consumers is also low because they are trying not to spend.

text: Ginsaad man sini ang ila problema nga bisan madamo ang suplay sang locally produced nga mga karne sang baboy, padayon gihapon nga ginatugutan sang Department of Agriculture ang imported meat products.
english: He also addressed their problem that despite the abundant supply of locally produced pork, the Department of Agriculture continues to allow imported meat products.

text: Nagpaguwa ang Vatican sang laragway ni Pope Francis sa labing-una nga tion halin sang na-ospital ini masobra isa ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english: The Vatican has released a picture of Pope Francis for the first time since he was hospitalized more than a month ago.

text: Sa picture, nagatalikod ang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa samtang nagapungko ini sa chapel sang Gemelli Hospital sa Roma.
english: In the picture, the 88-year-old Pope turns away as he sits in the chapel of the Gemelli Hospital in Rome.

text: Wala sang nakit-an nga nakatakod kay Pope agud nga makabulig sa iya pagginhawa, apisar nga base sa nauna nga reports sang Vatican, ginagamitan si Pope sang oxygen sa iya treatment bangud sa na-eksperyensyahan anay nga breathing crisis.
english: Nothing was found infected with Pope to help him breathe, although based on previous reports from the Vatican, Pope was being treated with oxygen due to a previously experienced breathing crisis.

text: Suno sa Holy See Press Office, nag-upod ang Santo Papa sa misa kaupod sa iban nga mga pari sa amo nga chapel sang Domingo oras didto sa Roma.
english: According to the Holy See Press Office, the Pope attended mass with other priests at the chapel on Sunday while in Rome.

text: Sa guwa sang ospital naman, madamo sang kabataan ang nagkadto kag nagtipon para ipangamuyo ang Pope nga padayon nga naga-recover sa double pneumonia.
english: Outside the hospital, many children came and gathered to pray for the Pope who is still recovering from double pneumonia.

text: Kalabanan ang may dala nga yellow balloons, drawings, mga placard nga may mensahe para sa Pope, kag may mga bulak.
english: Most carried yellow balloons, drawings, placards with messages for the Pope, and flowers.

text: Kahapon, kadungan sang Second Sunday of Lent, may yara sang mensahe si Pope nga gin-publish sang Vatican nga nagsiling nga maluya siya kag nagapangatubang sang tion sang pagpanghangkat.
english: Yesterday, coinciding with the Second Sunday of Lent, the Pope had a message published by the Vatican that said he was weak and facing a time of challenge.

text: Bisan maluya ang iya lawas suno kay Pope kaangay sa iban nga nagamasakit, wala sang makapugong sa pagpalangga kag pagpangamuyo para sa isa kag isa.
english: Although his body is weak, Pope said, like others who are sick, nothing can stop them from loving and praying for each other.

text: Kahapon amo ang ika-lima nga sunod-sunod nga Domingo nga wala personal nga nakapanguna si Pope sa Angelus Prayer nga nakaandan niya himuon sa St.
english: Yesterday was the fifth consecutive Sunday that the Pope did not personally lead the Angelus Prayer that he usually does at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican kun matapos na ang misa.
english: Peter’s Square in the Vatican after the mass.

text: Nag-abot na sa Vietnam ang pambato sang Pilipinas sa Miss Charm 2023 pageant nga si Annabelle McDonnell.
english: Philippine Miss Charm 2023 pageant contestant Annabelle McDonnell has arrived in Vietnam.

text: Suno sa 22-anyos nga beauty queen nga tumandok sang Misamis Oriental, “beyond grateful and excited” siya nga itiglawas ang Pilipinas sa Miss Charm International.
english: The 22-year-old beauty queen, a native of Misamis Oriental, said she is “beyond grateful and excited” to represent the Philippines in Miss Charm International.

text: Nag-umpisa naman ang pre-pageant activities lakip na ang official sashing ceremony.
english: Pre-pageant activities including the official sashing ceremony have already begun.

text: Halin si Annabelle sa pageant camp nga Aces and Queens kag nagtapos nga first runner-up sa Miss Universe Philippines 2022 antes gin-appoint bilang Miss Charm Philippines 2023 sang November 2022.
english: Annabelle comes from the pageant camp Aces and Queens and finished first runner-up in Miss Universe Philippines 2022 before being appointed as Miss Charm Philippines 2023 in November 2022.

text: Patigayunon ang Miss Charm 2023 coronation sa February 16 sa Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam kun sa diin 40 tanan ka mga matahum nga kandidata halin sa nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod ang maga-agaway para sa korona.
english: The Miss Charm 2023 coronation will be held on February 16 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam where 40 beautiful contestants from different countries will compete for the crown.

text: Nagahingyo ang lehitimo nga fireworks industry stakeholders sa gobyerno nga indi pag-ipatuman ang ginaduso nga nationwide ban sa firecrackers.
english: Legitimate fireworks industry stakeholders are urging the government not to implement the proposed nationwide ban on firecrackers.

text: Ini kasunod sang proposal ni Interior and Local Government Secretary Benhur Abalos sa local government units (LGUs) nga magpasar sang mga ordinansa nga nagadumili sa paggamit kag display sang fireworks sa ila tagsa ka lokalidad.
english: This follows the proposal of Interior and Local Government Secretary Benhur Abalos to local government units (LGUs) to pass ordinances prohibiting the use and display of fireworks in their respective localities.

text: Suno naman kay Philippine Fireworks Association president Jovenson Ong, kun may ipatuman nga ban, magasirado man ang tanan nga legal manufacturers apisar nga ang matuod nga balasulon sa mga aksidente amo ang mga iligal nga manufacturers.
english: Philippine Fireworks Association president Jovenson Ong said that if a ban is implemented, all legal manufacturers will also be closed despite the fact that the real culprits in the accidents are the illegal manufacturers.

text: Bisan may ban nga iimplementar suno sa iya, maga-operate gihapon ang iligal nga fireworks stakeholders kag sa pagkamatuod, may tyansa pa nga mas magadaku ang ila income bangud maga-sira na kag magatuman sa ban ang legal nga mga manufacturers.
english: Even if a ban is implemented, he said, illegal fireworks stakeholders will still operate and in fact, there is a chance that their income will increase because legal manufacturers will close and comply with the ban.

text: Nagpangabay ini nga indi pagpatandugon sang regulated chemicals nga ginagamit sa paghimo sang pyrotechnics ang tanan nga illegal manufacturers nga wala sang lisensya ukon Philippine Standard (PS) marks sa ila produkto.
english: He urged all illegal manufacturers who do not have licenses or Philippine Standard (PS) marks on their products not to touch the regulated chemicals used in the production of pyrotechnics.

text: Ang PS MARKs nagapatuhoy sa Philippine Standard Quality and/or Safety Mark kag Import Commodity Clearance sticker.
english: PS MARKs refers to the Philippine Standard Quality and/or Safety Mark and Import Commodity Clearance sticker.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang smuggled fireworks halin sa China kag online sale sang illegal fireworks kag regulated chemicals amo ang naga-compete sa legally manufactured nga fireworks halin pa sang nagliligad nga tinuig.
english: He also said that smuggled fireworks from China and online sale of illegal fireworks and regulated chemicals have been competing with legally manufactured fireworks since last year.

text: Ginkilala si June Mar Fajardo bilang Most Valuable Player (MVP) sa 47th season sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA)!
english: June Mar Fajardo was recognized as the Most Valuable Player (MVP) in the 47th season of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA)!

text: Ini na ang ika-pito nga MVP award sang nasambit nga San Miguel Beermen star matapos nga nakuha man ini nga pasidungog sa sunod-sunod nga tuig halin sang 2014-2019.
english: This is the seventh MVP award for the San Miguel Beermen star after winning the award in consecutive years from 2014-2019.

text: Si Fajardo, 6’10 center halin sa Cebu, amo man ang naga-uyat sang pinakadamo nga MVP titles sa bug-os nga maragtas sang PBA.
english: Fajardo, a 6’10 center from Cebu, also holds the most MVP titles in the entire history of the PBA.

text:
(PBA Image)

Sa ika-46 nga season, naghinay ang performance sini bangud sa naangkon nga injury kag sa amo nga season, nakuha ni Scottie Thompson sang Barangay Ginebra San Miguel ang korona nga amo ang nag-utod sang winning streak sang Cebuano basketball star.
english:
(PBA Image)

In the 46th season, his performance slowed down due to injury and in that season, Scottie Thompson of Barangay Ginebra San Miguel won the crown which broke the winning streak of the Cebuano basketball star.

text: Apang nagbalik ang pwersa ni Fajardo sa 47th season (2022-2023) kag ginpangunahan ang lowest-seeded nga Beermen sang amo nga tion agud makadaog sa 2022 PBA Philippine Cup tatlo ka tuig matapos ang ila nga five-peat sang 2019.
english: But Fajardo returned to force in the 47th season (2022-2023) and led the lowest-seeded Beermen at the time to win the 2022 PBA Philippine Cup three years after their five-peat in 2019.

text: Ang iya nangin performance sa 2022 PBA Cup ang naghatag sa iya sang iya ikaapat nga Finals MVP award kag ika-siyam nga titulo bilang Best Player of the Conference.
english: His performance in the 2022 PBA Cup earned him his fourth Finals MVP award and ninth Best Player of the Conference title.

text: Sa sini nga season, may yara ang Kraken sang per game average nga 17.7 points, 15.5 rebounds, 2.9 assists, 1.3 blocks, kag 0.7 steals sa 46 ka mga sambuwa nga amo ang rason nga nagbalik sa iya ang korona.
english: This season, the Kraken has a per game average of 17.7 points, 15.5 rebounds, 2.9 assists, 1.3 blocks, and 0.7 steals in 46 contests which is why the crown is back to him.

text: Ginlubog sang halos lampas-tuhod nga baha ang dalanun sa Brgy.
english: Almost knee-high floods submerged the road in Brgy.

text: Oñate de Leon, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, partikular sa atubang sang Mandurriao public cemetery kag subdivision, matapos ang mamunog nga ulan.
english: Oñate de Leon, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, particularly in front of the Mandurriao public cemetery and subdivision, after heavy rains.

text: Ang nasambit nga lugar ginabaha na bisan pa sa gamay lang nga pag-ulan, nga nagahatag sang kabudlayan sa mga residente kag nagapadulong nga mga estudyante.
english: The area is already flooded even with light rainfall, causing inconvenience to residents and incoming students.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Flordeliza Regalado, isa ka residente sang barangay, ginpahayag niya nga kada mag-ulan, ginabaha gid ang ila lugar bisan pa gamay lang ang ulan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Flordeliza Regalado, a resident of the barangay, said that every time it rains, their area is flooded even though there is little rain.

text: Suno sa iya, palpak ang pag-ubra sang drainage system sang mga contractor, kag kada mag-ilis ang mga lider, ginabakbak naman ang dalan.
english: He said the contractors failed to build the drainage system, and every time the leaders change, the road is dug up.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga makapila na ini ka beses ginkay-o ang drainage system, apang wala sa gihapon sang pagbag-o sa sitwasyon.
english: He also said that the drainage system has been repaired several times, but there is still no change in the situation.

text: May yara sang ongoing nga konstruksyon sang dalan sa lugar nga ginapatigayon sang Department of Public Works and Highways District Engineering Office kag ang proyekto ginadumala sang 5S Construction and Supply kag may balor nga masobra 9 ka milyon.
english: There is ongoing road construction in the area being carried out by the Department of Public Works and Highways District Engineering Office and the project is being managed by 5S Construction and Supply and is worth more than 9 million.

text: Apang wala ginpahayag kun san-o nag-umpisa ang konstruksyon kag kun san-o ini matapos.
english: However, it was not disclosed when construction began and when it will be completed.

text: Dugang pa sang mga residente, mabudlay ang paglabay sa nasambit nga lugar ilabi na sa mga estudyante nga nagapadulong sa eskwelahan.
english: Residents said it is difficult to pass through the area especially for students on their way to school.

text: Bangud sa tubig nga mahigko, posible nga magresulta ini sa mga masakit pareho sang leptospirosis, nga ginakabalak-an nila para sa ila mga kabataan.
english: Because of the contaminated water, it is possible to cause diseases such as leptospirosis, which they are worried about for their children.

text:
/JDS



(Reported by Bombo Lyka Sandiego via Bombohanay Bigtime)
english:
/JDS



(Reported by Bombo Lyka Sandiego via Bombohanay Bigtime)

text: Gintukod sang Iloilo City Government ang Infrastructure Coordination Committee agud nga mangin klaro, maayo ang plano, kag wala sang pag-usik sang pondo para sa mga proyekto nga pang-imprastraktura nga ginahimo sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City Government established the Infrastructure Coordination Committee to ensure transparency, well-planning, and no waste of funds for infrastructure projects being implemented in the city.

text: Nakasaad ini sa Executive Order No.
english: This is stated in Executive Order No.

text: 084, Series of 2025 nga ginpaguwa ni Mayor Raisa Treñas subong nga Martes, Septyembre 16.
english: 084, Series of 2025 issued by Mayor Raisa Treñas this Tuesday, September 16.

text: Sa idalom sini nga order, gina-require ang tanan nga infrastructure projects sa syudad nga magkuha anay sang Certificate of Coordination antes ang implementasyon.
english: Under this order, all infrastructure projects in the city are required to obtain a Certificate of Coordination before implementation.

text: Sa Section 5 sang EO, nakabutang nga iga-isyu lamang sang alkalde ang Certificate of Coordination kun may yara na sang endorsement sang committee.
english: In Section 5 of the EO, it is stated that the mayor will only issue the Certificate of Coordination if there is already the endorsement of the committee.

text: Ini nga certificate amo ang igalakip sa aplikasyon para sa mandatory permits kag clearances halin sa nanuhay-tuhay nga city departments.
english: This certificate will be included in the application for mandatory permits and clearances from various city departments.

text: “No infrastructure projects, either horizontal or vertical, shall proceed without the certificate of coordination,” kabahin sang order.
english: “No infrastructure projects, either horizontal or vertical, shall proceed without the certificate of coordination,” part of the order.

text: Nakabutang sa order nga sakop sini ang tanan nga proyekto nga pang-imprastraktura sa syudad, temporaryo man ukon permanente, kag bisan pa nga ang nag-implementar sini amo ang national government agencies, offices, kag government corporations.
english: The order states that it covers all infrastructure projects in the city, whether temporary or permanent, and even if the implementers are national government agencies, offices, and government corporations.

text:
Sa statement sang alkalde sa iya pagpaguwa sang EO, ginsiling sini nga tuyo sang order nga organisado ang mga proyekto kag wala naga-doble ang trabaho; mangin transparent kag accountable ang mga ahensya kag proyekto; protektado ang mga pumuluyo kag ang palibot; kag mas mangin madasig kag matalunsay ang implementasyon.#

(Photo: Raisa Treñas/FB)
english:
In a statement, the mayor said the order aims to ensure that projects are organized and that work is not duplicated; make agencies and projects transparent and accountable; protected citizens and the environment; and implementation will be faster and smoother.#

(Photo: Raisa Treñas/FB)

text: Nahibaluan nga yara sa masobra 7,000 ka mga barangay sa bug-os nga pungsod ang delikado sa landslide kag pagbaha tuga sang mga pag-ulan bangud sa lapnagon nga halit sang bagyo Tino.
english: More than 7,000 barangays nationwide are at risk of landslides and flooding caused by heavy rains due to the widespread damage caused by Typhoon Tino.

text: Suno kay Office of the Civil Defense (OCD) spokesperson Junie Castillo, ginpanugyanan na nila ang bug-os nga 7,864 ka barangay nga nalakip sa listahan sang rain-induced landslide kag flooding.
english: According to Office of the Civil Defense (OCD) spokesperson Junie Castillo, they have already advised all 7,864 barangays that are included in the list of rain-induced landslides and flooding.

text:
Yara sa 100mm tubtob 150mm ang ginabulubanta nga maeksperyensyahan nga pag-ulan sa nasambit nga barangay

Ini ang base sa data halin sa Department of Environment and Natural Resources’ Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR- MGB).
english:
100mm to 150mm of rainfall is expected in the said barangay

This is based on data from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources’ Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR-MGB).

text: Samtang, epektibo man ang forced evacuation sa mga malapit sa baybayon sang Eastern Visayas bangud sa pamahog sang storm surge.
english: Meanwhile, forced evacuation is also effective in those near the coast of Eastern Visayas due to the threat of storm surge.

text: Ginhatok-hatok sang buno sang isa ka bana ang iya asawa gamit ang screwdriver sa Barangay Bagong Barrio, Guimba, Nueva Ecija.
english: A husband stabbed his wife with a screwdriver in Barangay Bagong Barrio, Guimba, Nueva Ecija.

text: Ang biktima amo si Zynnel Joy Pagaling, 34, isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker nga apat ka adlaw pa lang naakabot sa Pilipinas halin sa Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
english: The victim was identified as Zynnel Joy Pagaling, 34, an Overseas Filipino Worker who arrived in the Philippines four days ago from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

text: Samtang ang suspek naman amo si Manuel Diaz-Mendoza, 40, residente sang Sta.
english: The suspect was identified as Manuel Diaz-Mendoza, 40, resident of Sta.

text: Rosa, Nueva Ecija.
english: Rosa, Nueva Ecija.

text: Suno kay Ferly Pagaling, iloy sang biktima, ginaalegar ginbaid pa ni Mendoza ang screwdriver nga gin-gamit sa krimen.
english: According to Ferly Pagaling, the victim's mother, Mendoza allegedly sharpened the screwdriver used in the crime.

text: Sa atubang mismo sang ila tatlo ka kabataan ginbuno sang suspek ang biktima sa dughan kag sa kilid nga bahin sang lawas sini.
english: In front of their three children, the suspect stabbed the victim in the chest and side of her body.

text: Pahayag ni Ferly, nagsinggitan pa ang ila mga anak kag nagapakitluoy sa ila amay nga untaton ang ginahimo sa ila nga iloy.
english: Ferly said their children even screamed and begged their father to stop what they were doing to their mother.

text: Matapos ang krimen, ginkuha man sang suspek ang kwarta sang iya asawa nga yara sa P100,000.
english: After the crime, the suspect also took his wife's money amounting to P100,000.

text: Wala naman sang ihibalo ang pamilya sang biktima kun ano ang rason sa pagpatay sang bana sa iya nga asawa.
english: The victim's family does not know the reason why the husband killed his wife.

text: Natigayon naman nga maaresto ang suspek kag napreso subong sa Guimba Municipal Police Station.
english: The suspect was arrested and detained at the Guimba Municipal Police Station.

text: Bag-o lang naka-recover sa Covid-19 ang winningest coach sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) nga si Tim Cone.
english: Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) winningest coach Tim Cone has just recovered from Covid-19.

text: Suno kay Cone, nagbakasyon siya sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika pagkatapos nakuha niya kag sang Gilas Pilipinas ang gold medal sa Asian Games sa China, apang nagpositibo siya sa virus sang nag-abot na sa Manila.
english: Cone said he went on vacation to the United States of America after he and Gilas Pilipinas won the gold medal at the Asian Games in China, but he tested positive for the virus when he arrived in Manila.

text:
Photo: Philippine Sports Commission

Pito ka adlaw ini nga nagpaidalom sa isolation kag wala gilayon nakaupod sa Gin Kings sa ila nga practice.
english:
Photo: Philippine Sports Commission

He spent seven days in isolation and did not immediately join the Gin Kings in their practice.

text: “I finally got back to the team and started coaching Ginebra on Monday.
english: “I finally got back to the team and started coaching Ginebra on Monday.

text: It’s only been one week since I’ve been back to Ginebra,” pahayag sini sa pagbukas sang 48th season sang PBA.
english: It’s only been one week since I’ve been back to Ginebra,” he said at the opening of the 48th season of the PBA.

text: “People keep asking for interviews that time I kept saying I’m under protocol without saying the word COVID,” pahayag pa sini.
english: “People kept asking for interviews that time I kept saying I’m under protocol without saying the word COVID,” he said.

text: “Now I’m good.
english: “Now I’m good.

text: Anybody can kiss me now if you want.”#
english: Anyone can kiss me now if you want.”#

text: Merry matuod ang mangin Christmas sang mga motorista bangud may lauman nga pagnubo sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: It will be a Merry Christmas for motorists as there is an expected drop in the price of petroleum products next week.

text: Suno kay Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, kun basehan ang trading sang nagliligad nga adlaw, posible nga masobra sa piso ang ibuhin sa presyo sang kada litro sang tanan nga oil products.
english: According to Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau Assistant Director Rodela Romero, based on the trading of the previous day, it is possible that the price of all oil products will be reduced by more than a peso per liter.

text:
Yari ang projected price adjustments base sa oil industry estimates:

Diesel – maganubo sang P1.70 to P1.95 per literGasoline – maganubo sang P1.60 to P1.80 per literKerosene – maganubo sang P1.35 to P1.45 per liter

Ini nga adjustments ang magalain pa depende sa resulta sang trading sang Mean of Platts Singapore kahapon nga adlaw.
english:
Here are the projected price adjustments based on oil industry estimates:

Diesel – to fall by P1.70 to P1.95 per literGasoline – to fall by P1.60 to P1.80 per literKerosene – to fall by P1.35 to P1.45 per liter

These adjustments will vary depending on the trading results of the Mean of Platts Singapore yesterday.

text: Ang Mean of Platts Singapore amo ang basehan sang presyo sang refined petroleum products sa Southeast Asia.
english: The Mean of Platts Singapore is the basis for the pricing of refined petroleum products in Southeast Asia.

text: Ini amo ang daily average sang tanan nga trading transactions sa tunga sang buyers kag sellers sang petroleum products kag gina-assess kag gina-summarize sang Standard and Poor’s Platts.
english: It is the daily average of all trading transactions between buyers and sellers of petroleum products and is assessed and summarized by Standard and Poor’s Platts.

text: Nagsaka pa sa 71 ang arestado nga gun ban violators sa Western Visayas.
english: The number of arrested gun ban violators in Western Visayas has risen to 71.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLt.

text: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga 70 ka mga firearms kag apat ka mga gun replica ang nakumpiskar.
english: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said 70 firearms and four gun replicas were confiscated.

text: Suno kay Solis, mga sibilyan ang kalabanan sa naaresto nga mga violators apang may yara man sang mga government employees.
english: Solis said most of the arrested violators were civilians but there were also government employees.

text: Pahayag ni Solis, napasakaan na man sang kaso nga paglapas sa firearms law kag COMELEC gun ban ang mga arestado.
english: Solis said the suspects have also been charged with violation of the firearms law and COMELEC gun ban.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman si Solis nga kutob pa sa Hunyo 11 ang ginapatuman nga gun ban.
english: Solis reminded that the gun ban is in force until June 11.

text: Indi na ‘friends’, kundi confirmed nga couple na sanday Paolo Contis kag ang sexy actress nga si Yen Santos!
english: No longer 'friends', but confirmed couple Paolo Contis and sexy actress Yen Santos!

text:
Suno pa sa aktor, “what you see is what you get.”

“Ang sa amin kasi, what you see is what you get naman.
english:
According to the actor, “what you see is what you get.”

“For us, what you see is what you get.

text: Hindi namin puwede ipilit ‘yung tao to be happy for us.
english: We can't force people to be happy for us.

text: Hindi namin puwede ipilit ‘yung mga tao na paniwalaan ‘yung gusto nilang paniwalaan.
english: We can't force people to believe what they want to believe.

text: Sana lang isipin nila na kung ano lang ‘yung nakikita nilang naka-post, iyon lang ‘yung truth na alam nila,” paglaragway sini sa ila relasyon.
english: I just hope they think that whatever they see posted, that's the truth they know,” he described their relationship.

text: Gin-athag man ni Paolo nga sang nag-trending ang “Baguio as a friend” nga picture nila nga duha, indi pa sila magka-relasyon ni Yen kag matuod nga mag-abyan pa gid lamang sila sang amo nga tion.
english: Paolo also explained that when the “Baguio as a friend” picture of the two of them became trending, they were not in a relationship with Yen and it was true that they were just friends at that time.

text: Suno pa kay Paolo, nangin sila lang ni Yen sang nagbiya na ang iya nga former partner nga si LJ Reyes agud magtinir sa New York.
english: According to Paolo, Yen became friends when her former partner LJ Reyes left to stay in New York.

text: Gin-clarify man sini nga madugay na nga indi maayo ang ila relasyon ni LJ, masami nga naga-away, kag wala sang labot si Yen sa ila nga separasyon.
english: He also clarified that he and LJ have been in a bad relationship for a long time, often fighting, and Yen has nothing to do with their separation.

text: “Medyo matagal na kaming hindi okay ni LJ.
english: “LJ and I haven't been okay for a while.

text: Pero we were together of course.
english: But we were together of course.

text: Napapadalas ‘yung away.
english: The fight is getting worse.

text: I think it’s, kumbaga, combination na ng stress sa pandemic and everything.
english: I think it’s, like, a combination of the stress of the pandemic and everything.

text: One of my biggest mistakes was hindi ko inalala ‘yung mental health ni LJ.
english: One of my biggest mistakes was not taking LJ's mental health into account.

text: Isa ‘yun sa feeling ko naging simula ng downfall namin, na hindi ko inisip ‘yun.
english: That's one of the things I feel was the beginning of our downfall, that I didn't think about.

text: Kapag nahihirapan siya during pandemic, ang utak ko, ‘Four times a day tayo kumain, chill ka diyan’ — which was one of my biggest mistakes,” paathag sang aktor.
english: When he was in trouble during the pandemic, my brain was, 'Let's eat four times a day, chill there' — which was one of my biggest mistakes,” the actor explained.

text: Matandaan nga magkaupod sanday Paolo kag Yen sa isa ka movie shot sang 2021 sa Faroe Islands nga sakop sang Kingdom of Denmark.
english: It can be recalled that Paolo and Yen were together in a movie shot in 2021 in the Faroe Islands that belong to the Kingdom of Denmark.

text: Sang amo man nga tuig, nagbulagay sanday Paolo kag LJ kag sunod nga nagpadulong ang aktres sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kaupod ang iya mga anak nga sanday Aki kag Summer.
english: In the same year, Paolo and LJ parted ways and the actress subsequently headed to the United States of America with her children Aki and Summer.

text: Nangin unod sang huring-huring sadto si Yen kag ginpasibangdan sang publiko nga third party sa relasyon nanday LJ kag Paolo.
english: Yen was the subject of rumors and was blamed by the public third party for the relationship between LJ and Paolo.

text: Puspusan ang Philippine Red Cross (PRC) sa pagbibigay ng tulong sa mga nasalanta ng Bagyong Tino sa malaking parte ng Visayas.
english: The Philippine Red Cross (PRC) is working hard to provide assistance to the victims of Typhoon Tino in most parts of the Visayas.

text: Umabot na sa libu-libong katao ang natulungan sa Southern Leyte, Gingoog City, at Cebu.
english: Thousands of people have been helped in Southern Leyte, Gingoog City, and Cebu.

text: Nagpatayo ang PRC ng mga first aid stations at ligtas na naihatid ang isang emergency childbirth case sa Cebu.
english: The PRC set up first aid stations and safely delivered an emergency childbirth case in Cebu.

text: Nagsagawa rin sila ng disease prevention sessions sa Capiz at namahagi ng gamot, face masks, at tubig.
english: They also conducted disease prevention sessions in Capiz and distributed medicines, face masks, and water.

text: Nagbigay pa ang humanitarian body ng psychological first aid, welfare support, at mahigit 1,600 hot meals sa mga apektadong pamilya.
english: The humanitarian body also provided psychological first aid, welfare support, and more than 1,600 hot meals to the affected families.

text: Isinagawa ang hygiene promotion sessions sa Capiz upang maiwasan ang mga sakit sa evacuation centers.
english: Hygiene promotion sessions were held in Capiz to prevent diseases in evacuation centers.

text: Ayon kay PRC Chairman Richard Gordon, ang bawat taong natutulungan ay nabibigyan ng pag-asa.
english: According to PRC Chairman Richard Gordon, every person who is helped is given hope.

text: Handa ang PRC na palawakin pa ang operasyon upang masigurong walang komunidad ang mapag-iiwanan, mula sa mga syudad hanggang sa mga coastal areas na nasalanta ng bagyo.
english: The PRC is ready to expand its operations to ensure that no community is left behind, from the cities to the coastal areas affected by the typhoon.

text:
Samtang ginapadayon ang protesta sang pila ka transport groups batok sa korapsyon sa gobyerno, nagapabilin nga committed sa serbisyo publiko ang mga transport cooperatives sa Iloilo, kag indi mag-upod sa ginaplano nga ‘nationwide transport strike.’

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, Chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, ginpahayag niya nga bisan pa nga naga simpatiya sila sa mga grupo nga naga rally, mas ginaprayoridad nila ang modernisasyon sang transportasyon kag ang padayon nga serbisyo sa mga pasahero sa Iloilo.
english:
While some transport groups continue to protest against corruption in the government, transport cooperatives in Iloilo remain committed to public service, and will not join the planned 'nationwide transport strike.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said that although they sympathize with the rallying groups, they prioritize the modernization of transportation and the continuous service to passengers in Iloilo.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga kontra sila sa korapsyon, apang indi man sila mag-untat pagbyahe.
english: He said they are against corruption, but they will not stop traveling.

text: Suno sa iya, yara sila subong sa proseso sang modernisasyon kag ginapangayo ang bulig sang lokal nga gobyerno para sa seguridad sang mga pasahero kag drayber.
english: He said they are currently in the process of modernization and are seeking the help of the local government for the safety of passengers and drivers.

text: Magaabot sa bulan sang Disyembre subong nga tuig ang 21,000 metriko tonelada sang bombay nga gin-import sang Pilipinas.
english: The 21,000 metric tons of bombay imported by the Philippines will arrive in December this year.

text: 17,000 metric tons (MT) diri ang red onions samtang 4,000 MT naman ang white onions.
english: 17,000 metric tons (MT) of this are red onions while 4,000 MT are white onions.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture-Bureau of Plant Industry Director Gerald Glenn Panganiban, katuyuan sang importasyon nga mapadamo ang suplay sang bombay sa Pilipinas kag indi magsaka ang presyo sa merkado sa tion sang Christmas holidays.
english: According to Department of Agriculture-Bureau of Plant Industry Director Gerald Glenn Panganiban, the purpose of the importation is to increase the supply of bombay in the Philippines and prevent market prices from rising during the Christmas holidays.

text:
Image by Hans Braxmeier from Pixabay

Suno pa sa opisyal, nagatupa na subong sa P140-P180 ang presyo sang kada kilo sang pula nga bombay.
english:
Image by Hans Braxmeier from Pixabay

According to the official, the price of red bombay is now falling to P140-P180 per kilo.

text: Dugang sini, kun mag-abot na ang suplay sang imported onions subong nga semana, maganubo na ini nga presyo.
english: He added that when the supply of imported onions arrives this week, the price will come down.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala sang plano nga magpatuman sang suggested retail price (SRP) sa amo nga produkto.
english: He also said there are no plans to implement a suggested retail price (SRP) on the product.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad lamang nga bulan, nangin kontrobersyal ang nasambit nga bureau sang ginmanduan sang Kamara ang mga opisyal sini nga ipaathag kun ngaa nagdamo ang imported nga sibuyas sa local markets.
english: Last month, the bureau became controversial when the House of Representatives ordered its officials to explain why imported onions increased in local markets.

text: Nagpatigayon man ang DA sang imbestigasyon sa Bureau of Plant Industry kag nagpasa sang sabat sa show-cause order nga ginpapanaog sang House committee on agriculture and food.#
english: The DA also conducted an investigation with the Bureau of Plant Industry and submitted a response to the show-cause order issued by the House committee on agriculture and food.

text: Natukiban nga indi matuod nga doktor ang nag-paltak sa isa ka 10-anyos nga bata nga lalaki nga napatay matapos ang operasyon sa Tondo, Maynila.
english: A 10-year-old boy who died after surgery in Tondo, Manila was discovered to be a fake doctor.

text: Suno sa otoridad, isa ka babaye nga senior citizen nga isa ka midwife ang nagpakuno-kuno nga doctor.
english: According to authorities, a female senior citizen who is a midwife pretended to be a doctor.

text: Naaresto na ini sang 2023 matapos ginsulod sang Philippine National Police-Criminal Investigation and Detection Group ang isa ka lying-in clinic sa Balut, Tondo, Maynila matapos nakabaton sila sng reklamo nga nagapakuno-kuno lang nga doctor ang naga-operate sa clinic.
english: He was arrested in 2023 after the Philippine National Police-Criminal Investigation and Detection Group raided a lying-in clinic in Balut, Tondo, Manila after they received a complaint that a doctor was operating in the clinic.

text: Ginagamit sang suspek ang ngalan kag license number sang isa ka lehitimo nga doktor nga nakaupod niya sa trabaho sadto.
