english: The suspect uses the name and license number of a legitimate doctor who worked with him in the past.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nakapiyansa ang suspek.
english: At that time, the suspect was released on bail.

text: Sang damlag lang, siya ang nagpakilala nga doktor kag nagpaltak sa biktima.
english: Recently, he introduced himself as a doctor and stabbed the victim.

text: Nagpasugot si Russian President Vladimir Putin sa gina-proponer sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga isa ka bulan nga ceasefire sa gyera sa Ukraine.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed to the United States' proposed one-month ceasefire on the war in Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Putin, suportado niya ang ideya sang Estados Unidos, apang may mga bagay pa nga kinahanglan klaruhon paagi sa pagpungko kaupod ang American officials kag pag-istorya kaupod kay US President Donald Trump.
english: Putin said he supports the US idea, but there are still things that need to be clarified by sitting down with American officials and talking with US President Donald Trump.

text: “The idea is right – and we support it – but there are questions that we need to discuss,” pahayag sini.
english: “The idea is right – and we support it – but there are questions that we need to discuss,” it said.

text: “We need to negotiate with our American colleagues and partners,” pahayag ni Trump.
english: “We need to negotiate with our American colleagues and partners,” Trump said.

text:
“Maybe I’ll have a call with Donald Trump.”

Kasunod ini sang pahayag man ni Trump nga may maayo nga mga signal halin sa Moscow.
english:
“Maybe I’ll have a call with Donald Trump.”

This follows Trump's statement that there are good signals from Moscow.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga handa siya makig-istorya kay Putin bangud tion na ini nga tapuson ang gyera.
english: He also said he was ready to talk to Putin because it was time to end the war.

text: Lakip sa gusto hambalan ni Putin amo mga posible nga paglapas sa ceasefire.
english: Among the issues Putin wants to discuss are possible violations of the ceasefire.

text: Gusto sini siguruhon nga indi paghingalitan sang Ukraine ang 30 ka adlaw agud nga mag-tipon sang ila armadong kusog kag magpadayon sa mobilization.
english: It wants to ensure that Ukraine does not waste 30 days to build up its armed forces and continue mobilization.

text: Matandaan nga masobra tatlo ka tuig na ang nagligad halin sang ginmandu sang Russian leader ang full-scale invasion sa Kyiv.
english: It can be recalled that more than three years have passed since the Russian leader ordered a full-scale invasion of Kyiv.

text: Nag-abot naman didto sa Moscow ang special envoy ni Trump nga si Steve Witkoff para maistoryahan sang dugang ang ceasefire nga una naman nga ginbaton sang Ukraine.#
english: Trump's special envoy, Steve Witkoff, arrived in Moscow to discuss the ceasefire, which Ukraine had already accepted.

text: Ginkanselar ni James Reid ang iya North American concert tour nga maga-umpisa na kuntani sa masunod nga semana.
english: James Reid has canceled his North American concert tour that was due to start next week.

text: Suno sa singer-actor, masubo man ini para sa iya, apang halinon ang lovescene tour sa later date subong nga tuig.
english: The singer-actor said it was also sad for him, but the lovescene tour will be moved to a later date this year.

text: Ginrason sini nga tuman ang epekto sa iya sang nagkalatabo sang nagligad nga tuig rason kag apektado ang iya pisikal, emosyonal, kag mangin mental nga aspeto.
english: He argued that the events of the past year have affected him so much that his physical, emotional, and mental aspects are affected.

text: Dugang pa ni James, nagapanguna sa iya prayoridad ang iya fans apang indi niya ini mahimo subong sa iya nga performance.
english: James added that his fans are his priority but he can't do that now with his performance.

text: Ginpasalig sini nga dal-on ang mas maayo nga musika kag mas daku nga show sa iya nga pagbalik para sa iya fans.
english: He promised to bring better music and a bigger show in his return for his fans.

text: Masami talalupangdon si James sang nagliligad nga mga binulan bangud sa iya collaboration sa international artists kag producers.
english: James has often been noticed in recent months for his collaborations with international artists and producers.

text: Ginselebrar ni Pope Francis ang ika-12 nga anibersaryo sang iya pagka-Santo Papa samtang yara sa ospital.
english: Pope Francis celebrated the 12th anniversary of his papacy while in the hospital.

text: Suno sa Holy See Press Office, gindal-an siya sang medical staff sang cake sa sulod sang iya hulot sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma, Italya bangud espesyal ini nga adlaw sang iya pagpungko bilang lider sang Roman Catholic Church sadtong 2013.
english: According to the Holy See Press Office, medical staff brought him a cake inside his room at the Gemelli Hospital in Rome, Italy because it was a special day of his inauguration as leader of the Roman Catholic Church in 2013.

text: Sa update sang Vatican, nag-upod man ang Pope sa pagpangamuyo kag meditations paagi sa videolink, kag ginpadayon man ang iya kinaandan nga treatments kag physiotherapy.
english: In the Vatican's update, the Pope also joined in prayer and meditations via videolink, and continued his usual treatments and physiotherapy.

text: Matapos ang pagpangamuyo, nagbalik ini sa iya breathing exercises.
english: After the prayer, he went back to his breathing exercises.

text: Magluwas sa cake, wala na sang na-mensyonar nga special events sa anniversary, apang suno sa Vatican, ginpakita kay Pope ang ginatos ka messages of goodwill nga ginpadala halin sa mga eskwelahan, religious institutions, kag mga kabataan nga suod sa iya.
english: Apart from the cake, no special events were mentioned on the anniversary, but the Vatican said the Pope was shown hundreds of messages of goodwill sent from schools, religious institutions, and children close to him.

text: Natalana nga mag-isyu sang bulletin ang Vatican press office sa Byernes sang gab-i oras sa Roma kag Sabado sang kaagahon naman oras diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The Vatican press office is scheduled to issue the bulletin on Friday night Rome time and Saturday morning Philippine time.

text:
Yari ang post sang Vatican News:

“Pope Francis celebrated the 12th anniversary of his pontificate with the medical staff of Rome’s Gemelli Hospital, who brought a cake with candles to his room.
english:
Here is the Vatican News post:

“Pope Francis celebrated the 12th anniversary of his pontificate with the medical staff of Rome’s Gemelli Hospital, who brought a cake with candles to his room.

text: According to the Holy See Press Office, the Pope also followed the Spiritual Exercises for the Roman Curia via video link with the Paul VI Hall, and resumed respiratory therapy.
english: According to the Holy See Press Office, the Pope also followed the Spiritual Exercises for the Roman Curia via video link with the Paul VI Hall, and resumed respiratory therapy.

text: He continues to alternate between non-invasive mechanical ventilation at night and high-flow oxygenation with nasal cannulas during the day.
english: He continues to alternate between non-invasive mechanical ventilation at night and high-flow oxygenation with nasal cannulas during the day.

text: His clinical situation remains stable within a complex condition.
english: His clinical situation remains stable within a complex condition.

text:
A new medical bulletin is expected on Friday evening.”

Nahibaluan nga gina-istoryahan na subong kun san-o makabalik sa Vatican si Pope.
english:
A new medical bulletin is expected on Friday evening.”

It is known that discussions are now underway on when the Pope will return to the Vatican.

text: Pebrero 14 siya sang gindala sa ospital kag na-diagnose nga may double pneumonia.
english: He was taken to the hospital on February 14 and diagnosed with double pneumonia.

english: The shining moment has arrived for Miss Universe Philippines 2020 and Ilongga beauty queen Rabiya Mateo who has just founded her own house.

english: It is known that the Ilongga beauty queen does not have a permanent home and she moves around.

text: Suno kay Rabiya, naghalin sa pagbaka-baka kag kinabudlayan niya ang pagpatindog sang bag-o nga puluy-an.
english: According to Rabiya, she came from farming and worked hard to build a new home.

english: This is after Rabiya has been successful in her career for more than two years.

text: Tuman man pagpasalamat sini sa Miss Universe Organization kag sa iya management nga naghatag sang kahigayunan sa iya agud nga malab-ot niya ang iya nga handum.
english: She is also very grateful to the Miss Universe Organization and her management for giving her the opportunity to achieve her dream.

text: Gin-ulan naman sang pagdayaw si Rabiya halin sa iya showbiz friends kaangay nanday Miss Universe Philippines Organization National Director Shamcey Supsup nga nagpabutyag sang iya pagpabugal matapos nga na-achieve sang Ilongga beauty queen ang handom sini.
english: Rabiya was showered with praise from her showbiz friends such as Miss Universe Philippines Organization National Director Shamcey Supsup who expressed her pride after the Ilongga beauty queen achieved her dream.

text: Nagpanago na lang sa tamburong ang magpamilya sa Purok 3, Gomez, Dinagat Islands sa Cebu sa tunga sang paglaslas ni bagyo Tino.
english: A family in Purok 3, Gomez, Dinagat Islands in Cebu took refuge in a tamburong amid the onslaught of Typhoon Tino.

text: Ini matapos nga naguba ang ila balay bangud sa bagyo.
english: This was after their house was destroyed by the typhoon.

english: An estimated 14 family members stayed inside the tamburong that served as their temporary shelter

text: Ginpasidunggan kag ginpasalamatan ni President Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos, Jr. honored and thanked the

text: ang Filipino athletes nga nagbulsa sang mga medalya para sa Pilipinas sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 19th Asian Games sa Hangzhou, China.
english: the Filipino athletes who pocketed medals for the Philippines at the recently concluded 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China.

text: Ginpatigayon ang “Gabi ng Parangal at Pasasalamat para sa mga Bayaning Atletang Pilipino” sa Rizal Memorial Coliseum kun sa diin ginpasalamatan man ang pagpaninguha sang coaches kag staff.
english: The “Night of Honor and Thanksgiving for the Heroic Filipino Athletes” was held at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum where the efforts of the coaches and staff were also appreciated.

text: “On behalf of a proud and a grateful nation, I salute and I recognize the excellent performance that you displayed in the 19th Asian Games…But more than just a personal feat, your victory has boosted our people’s morale,” kabahin sang speech sang presidente.
english: “On behalf of a proud and a grateful nation, I salute and I recognize the excellent performance that you displayed in the 19th Asian Games…But more than just a personal feat, your victory has boosted our people’s morale,” part of the president’s speech.

text: Nagpasalig man ang presidente nga labi nga hatagan sang igtalupangod ang mga atleta nga masamaran ukon makaangkon sang injury sa training kag sa kumpetisyon.
english: The president also assured that more attention will be given to athletes who are injured in training and competition.

text: “So I direct the Philippine Sports Commission, work with PAGCOR and other agencies to strengthen our medical scientific athlete services unit.
english: “So I direct the Philippine Sports Commission, work with PAGCOR and other agencies to strengthen our medical scientific athlete services unit.

text: We need to help our injured athletes so that they recover quickly and they can get back in the game,” dugang sini sa iya speech.
english: We need to help our injured athletes so that they recover quickly and they can get back in the game,” he added in his speech.

text: Sa seremonya, ang kada medalist ang nahatagan sang Presidential Citation bilang pagkilala sa ila nga achievement.
english: During the ceremony, each medalist was awarded a Presidential Citation in recognition of their achievement.

text: Ginhatag man ang insentibo paagi sa Philippine Sports Commission kag Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation nga nagdangat sa kabug-usan nga P19.1 million, samtang ang insentibo naman halin sa Office of the President ang naglab-ot sa P22.8 million.

english: 15 years after her participation in Binibining Pilipinas, the controversial beauty queen former Bb.Pilipinas – World Janina San Miguel returned to the pageantry.

english: It can be recalled that Janina was crowned Miss Pilipinas World of the Miss Pilipinas 2008 beauty pageant, but she resigned in September 2008 due to personal reasons.

english:
I’m so sorry.”

english: Para swimmers Ernie Gawilan and Gary Bejino bagged the first two medals for the Philippines in the ongoing Asian Para Games in Hangzhou, China.

english: The Asian Para Games will continue until October 28.

text: Nagalaum ang punong barangay sang Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City nga mapadayon kag matapos ang pag-trabaho sa flood mitigation project sa ila nga barangay.
english: The barangay captain of Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City hopes to continue and complete the work on the flood mitigation project in their barangay.

text: Ini nga proyekto ang sa idalom sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office kag gina-obra sang kontraktor nga Alpha and Omega General Contractor and Development Corporation.
english: This project is under the Iloilo City District Engineering Office and is being carried out by the contractor Alpha and Omega General Contractor and Development Corporation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Joseph Poral, iya ginpahayag nga temporaryo anay nga nag-untat ang konstruksyon sang proyekto kag ginsiling sang mga trabahahor nga nagahulat sila sang mandu nga magpadayon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Joseph Poral said the construction of the project was temporarily halted and the workers said they were waiting for an order to continue.

text: Pahayag ni Poral, importante gid para sa ila flood control project para nga maprotektahan sila sa baha kun magbubo ang mamunog nga ulan kag kun mag-bagyo.
english: Poral said it is important for their flood control project to protect them from flooding during heavy rains and typhoons.

text: “Kun indi mapadayon obra [maapektuhan gid kami.] Halimbawa, kun magkipot ang suba, ang flow sang tubig halin sa babaw pakadto diri sa Tacas, Jaro palusot sa Balabago, maninit ang tubig sa paguwa kag may tendency nga magbaha,” suno sa barangay official.
english: “If the work does not continue [we will be affected.] For example, if the river narrows, the flow of water from the surface to Tacas, Jaro through Balabago, the water outside will be hot and have a tendency to flood,” the barangay official said.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga proyekto ang isa sa natukiban sang Iloilo City Government nga wala sang mayor’s permit.
english: It is known that this project is one of the discoveries of the Iloilo City Government without the mayor's permit.

text: Saulugon ni Pope Francis sa ospital ang ika-12 nga anibersaryo sang iya pagpungko bilang lider sang Roman Catholic Church nga ginabug-usan sang 1.4-billion nga mga Katoliko.
english: Pope Francis will celebrate in the hospital the 12th anniversary of his accession as leader of the Roman Catholic Church, which is made up of 1.4-billion Catholics.

text: Gin-eleher sang mga cardinal si Pope sang Marso 13, 2013 kag siya ang labing-una nga Santo Papa halin sa Americas.
english: The cardinals elected Pope on March 13, 2013 and he is the first Pope from the Americas.

text: Nabun-ag siya bilang si Jorge Mario Bergoglio sa Argentina.
english: He was born Jorge Mario Bergoglio in Argentina.

text: Suno kay Cardinal Michael Czerny, isa ka senior Vatican official nga suod kay Pope, isa ka rason ang petsa nga ini agud nga magpasalamat.
english: According to Cardinal Michael Czerny, a senior Vatican official close to the Pope, the date is a reason to give thanks.

text: Bisan nagamasakit si Pope Francis suno sa iya, dapat nga magpasalamat sa Ginuo, kag doblehon pa gid ang pagpangamuyo para sa iya nga full recovery.
english: Even though Pope Francis is sick, he said, we should thank the Lord, and double our prayers for his full recovery.

text: Wala na sa immediate danger of death ang Pope kag indi naman kritikal ang kondisyon sini suno sa Vatican, apang nagapabilin ini sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma, Italya matapos na-diagnose nga may double pneumonia.
english: The Pope is no longer in immediate danger of death and is not in critical condition, according to the Vatican, but he remains at the Gemelli Hospital in Rome, Italy after being diagnosed with double pneumonia.

text: Yari ang latest update sang Holy See Press Office.
english: Here is the latest update from the Holy See Press Office.

text: “The clinical condition of the Holy Father has remained stable in the context of an overall complex medical picture.
english: “The clinical condition of the Holy Father has remained stable in the context of an overall complex medical picture.

text: The chest X-ray performed yesterday has radiologically confirmed the improvements observed in the previous days.
english: The chest X-ray performed yesterday has radiologically confirmed the improvements observed in the previous days.

text: The Holy Father continues to undergo high-flow oxygen therapy during the day and non-invasive mechanical ventilation during nighttime rest.
english: The Holy Father continues to undergo high-flow oxygen therapy during the day and non-invasive mechanical ventilation during nighttime rest.

text: This morning, after following the spiritual exercises in a link-up with the Paul VI Hall in the Vatican, he received the Eucharist, dedicated time to prayer, and then continued with physical therapy.
english: This morning, after following the spiritual exercises in a link-up with the Paul VI Hall in the Vatican, he received the Eucharist, dedicated time to prayer, and then continued with physical therapy.

text:
In the afternoon, after joining the spiritual exercises of the Curia, he continued with prayer, rest, and respiratory physiotherapy.”

Pebrero 14 sang gindala sa amo nga pasilidad ang Pope.
english:
In the afternoon, after joining the spiritual exercises of the Curia, he continued with prayer, rest, and respiratory physiotherapy.”

The Pope was taken to the facility on February 14.

text: Espesyal ang pagpasalamat ni newly-crowned Miss Universe R’bonney Gabriel sa tanan nga Filipino fans nga nagbulig sa iya kag nagsuporta sa iya nga Miss Universe journey.
english: Newly-crowned Miss Universe R’bonney Gabriel expressed her special gratitude to all Filipino fans who helped and supported her in her Miss Universe journey.

text: Si Gabriel amo ang una nga Filipino-American nga nagdaog bilang Miss USA, kag gintib-ong sini ang amo nga pungsod kag nakuha man ang korona sa global pageant nga ginpatigayon sa New Orleans, Louisiana out of 84 lovely women nga nag-compete para sa amo nga crown.
english: Gabriel is the first Filipino-American to win Miss USA, and she uplifted the country and also won the crown in the global pageant held in New Orleans, Louisiana out of 84 lovely women who competed for the crown.

text: Sa Miss Universe pageant, ginrampa sang 28-anyos nga beauty queen sa stage ang “Woman on the Moon” para sa National Costume portion nga creation ni Patrick Isorena, isa ka Filipino designer nga amo man anay ang nag-design sang Miss Texas costume ni Gabriel.
english: At the Miss Universe pageant, the 28-year-old beauty queen ramped up the stage with “Woman on the Moon” for the National Costume portion created by Patrick Isorena, a Filipino designer who also designed Gabriel’s Miss Texas costume.

text: Ang iya naman nga evening gown sa finals sang kumpetisyon ang gin-desinyo man sang isa pa ka Filipino designer nga si Rian Fernandez.
english: Her evening gown in the finals of the competition was also designed by another Filipino designer, Rian Fernandez.

text: Si R’Bonney man ang una nga nagsuksok sang “Force for Good” nga korona nga ginhimo sang Mouawad pinaagi sa partnership sang Miss Universe Organization sa idalom sang bag-o nga tag-iya sini nga si Anne Jakrajutatip.
english: R’Bonney was also the first to wear the “Force for Good” crown created by Mouawad in partnership with the Miss Universe Organization under its new owner Anne Jakrajutatip.

text: Wala sang lauman nga daku nga pagsaka sa presyo sang agricultural commodities pag-abot sang Christmas holidays!
english: No significant increase in the price of agricultural commodities is expected when the Christmas holidays arrive!

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) spokesperson kag Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa, wala ini ginalauman bangud maayo ang suplay subong sang mga produkto bangud stable man ang local production kag nagapadayon ang pagsulod sang imported products sa pungsod.
english: According to Department of Agriculture (DA) spokesperson and Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa, this is not expected because the supply of products is good because local production is stable and imported products continue to enter the country.

text:
PNA photo by Ben Briones

Sa karne sang baboy kag manok suno kay De Mesa, wala man sang dapat problemahana sa local production.
english:
PNA photo by Ben Briones

For pork and chicken, De Mesa said, there is nothing to worry about in local production.

text: Sa baboy pa lamang suno sa natungdan, may dugang nga 300,000 metric tons nga ma-produce subong lamang nga quarter.
english: In pork alone, he said, an additional 300,000 metric tons will be produced this quarter alone.

text: Sa bugas naman suno sa natungdan, estable man ang presyo halin sang nabawi na ang ginpatuman nga price ceiling sa well-milled kag regular-milled varieties.
english: In rice, he said, the price has been stable since the price ceiling was withdrawn for well-milled and regular-milled varieties.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan kasunod sang resulta sang survey sang Social Weather Stations (SWS) kun sa diin 48% ukon 13.2 million ka Filipino families ang nag-rate sang ila kaugalingon nga pigado man gihapon sang Septyembre nga mas mataas sa 45%, ukon sang 12.5 million households sang Hunyo.
english: National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan said this following the results of the Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey where 48% or 13.2 million Filipino families rated themselves as still poor in September, higher than 45%, or 12.5 million households in June.

text:
(Photo: AFP)

Suno sa NEDA, nagapabilin nga nagatutok ang gobyerno sa prayoridad sini nga buhinan ang kapigaduhon paagi sa ila nga nagkalain-lain nga stratehiya kag whole-of-society approach.
english:
(Photo: AFP)

According to the NEDA, the government remains focused on its priority of poverty reduction through its various strategies and whole-of-society approach.

text: Kun basehan ang 2021 record sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), yara sa 18.1% ang poverty incidence sa Pilipinas ukon halos 20 million ka Filipinos.
english: Based on the 2021 record of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the poverty incidence in the Philippines is 18.1% or nearly 20 million Filipinos.

text: Lakip sa nalawagan nga programa sang gobyerno nga ginapatuman subong amo ang rollout sang food stamp program, pagkakas sa pass-through fees para sa vehicles nga nagadala sang partikular nga mga produkto, kag distribution sang cash aid paagi sa Rice Farmers Financial Assistance program.
english: Among the government's long-term programs being implemented are the rollout of the food stamp program, the abolition of pass-through fees for vehicles carrying specific products, and the distribution of cash aid through the Rice Farmers Financial Assistance program.

text: Ginpahayag man nga ginahatagan sang prayoridad ang mga polisa kag programa nga maka-generate sang dugang kag dekalidad nga mga trabaho nga amo ang pinaka-epektibo sa pagpapas sang kapigaduhon.
english: He also said that priority is given to policies and programs that will generate more and quality jobs that are the most effective in eradicating poverty.

text: “This will involve expanding our markets, improving our infrastructure, and attracting more strategic investments, while also preparing the workforce with the necessary skills for the jobs that will be created,” dugang sang tiglikom.
english: “This will involve expanding our markets, improving our infrastructure, and attracting more strategic investments, while also preparing the workforce with the necessary skills for the jobs that will be created,” the secretary added.

text: Sa ika-anum nga tion subong nga 2023, magahampang ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa main draw sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) event.
english: For the sixth time this 2023, Filipina tennis star Alex Eala will play in the main draw of the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) event.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos sini ang 2020 French Open girls’ singles champion nga si Elsa Jacquemot sang France, 6-1, 5-7, 6-1, sa final qualifying match sang Jasmin Open sa Magic Hotel Skanes hard court sa Monastir, Tunisia.
english: This after she defeated 2020 French Open girls’ singles champion Elsa Jacquemot of France, 6-1, 5-7, 6-1, in the final qualifying match of the Jasmin Open at the Magic Hotel Skanes hard court in Monastir, Tunisia.

text:
Photo: Alex Eala/Facebook

Sa first round sang qualifiers, ginpierde man ni Eala si Feryel Ben Hassen sang Tunisia, 6-1, 6-0.
english:
Photo: Alex Eala/Facebook

In the first round of qualifiers, Eala also defeated Feryel Ben Hassen of Tunisia, 6-1, 6-0.

text: Sa imbukada sang main draw ukon sa Round of 32 match subong nga Martes, atubangon sang 18-anyos nga Pinay ang second seed nga si Elise Mertens sang Belgium nga anay world No.
english: In the opening of the main draw or Round of 32 match on Tuesday, the 18-year-old Filipina will face second seed Elise Mertens of Belgium, former world No.

text: 1 nga doubles player.
english: 1 doubles player.

text: Mabudlay ang kinahanglan agyan ni Eala bangud nagapang-41 si Mertens sa singles rankings apang naga-uyat man sang doubles titles sa Australian Open, Wimbledon, kag US Open.
english: Eala has had to go through a tough time as Mertens is ranked 41st in the singles rankings but also holds doubles titles at the Australian Open, Wimbledon, and US Open.

text: Magahampang man si Eala sa doubles tournament kaupod sa iya Romanian partner nga si Oana Gavrila batok sa second-seeded pair nga sanday Cristina Bucsaa kag Bibiane Schoofs.
english: Eala will also play in the doubles tournament alongside her Romanian partner Oana Gavrila against second-seeded pair Cristina Bucsaa and Bibiane Schoofs.

text: Katapusan nga nasaksihan sang mga Pinoy ang hampang ni Eala sa 19th Asian Games sa Hangzhou, China kun sa diin bronze medalist siya sa women’s singles kag sa mixed doubles kaupod kay Niño Alcantara.#
english: Filipinos last witnessed Eala's performance at the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China where she was a bronze medalist in women's singles and mixed doubles alongside Niño Alcantara.

text: Nagpahayag ang mga senador nga temprano pa agud maghimo sang konklusyon kaangot sa anunsyo sang International Testing Agency (ITA) nga nagpositibo sa drug test ang naturalized player sang Gilas Pilipinas nga si Justin Brownlee sang naghampang ini sa 19th Asian Games sa China.
english: The senators said it is too early to draw conclusions regarding the announcement of the International Testing Agency (ITA) that naturalized Gilas Pilipinas player Justin Brownlee tested positive for drugs when he played in the 19th Asian Games in China.

text: Suno kay Senator Francis Tolentino, mas maayo nga hulaton anay kun ano ang resulta sang proseso ilabi na bangud pwede pa man nga mag-apelar sa amo nga kaso.
english: According to Senator Francis Tolentino, it is better to wait for the outcome of the process especially since the case can still be appealed.

text:
PHOTO COURTESY OF POC-PSC MEDIA GROUP

Positibo naman si Senator Jinggoy Estrada nga may nagakaigu nga tikang nga himuon agud ma-address ang problema kay Brownlee.
english:
PHOTO COURTESY OF POC-PSC MEDIA GROUP

Senator Jinggoy Estrada is positive that there are appropriate steps to be taken to address the problem of Brownlee.

text: Nagpabutyag naman si Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva nga indi siya makapati sa announcement bangud personal gid niya nga kilala si Brownlee.
english: Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva said he could not believe the announcement because he personally knows Brownlee.

text: Suno pa sa senador, indi ini una nga bes nga natabo sa maragtas sang sports, apang pananglitan nagsala lang, pat-od nga indi na mapanas ang halit nga natuga sini.
english: The senator said this is not the first time in the history of sports, but if it goes wrong, the damage caused by it will certainly not be erased.

text: Matandaan nga base sa anunsyo sang testing agency, positibo si Brownlee sa paggamit sang Carboxy-THC, isa ka substance nga nalakip sa mga ginadumilian sang World Anti-Doping Agency.
english: According to the testing agency's announcement, Brownlee tested positive for Carboxy-THC, a substance banned by the World Anti-Doping Agency.

text: Na-kolekta ang amo nga sample sang Oktubre 7, isa ka adlaw matapos nagkampyon ang Gilas sang ginlutos sini ang Jordan sa final match.
english: The sample was collected on October 7, a day after the Gilas won the championship by defeating Jordan in the final match.

text: Magluwas kay Browlee, nag-positibo man sa test ang player sang Jordan nga si Sami Bzai.
english: Besides Browlee, Jordan player Sami Bzai also tested positive.

text: Ang sample collection authority ukon ang nagkuha sang sample amo ang China Anti-Doping Agency.
english: The sample collection authority or the sample collector was the China Anti-Doping Agency.

text: Pareho nga may kinamatarong ang duha ka players nga mag-request para sa analysis sang samples.
english: Both players have the right to request for analysis of the samples.

text: Di maagwantahan nga baho sang hangin nga daw kanal ukon patay nga sapat, upod pa ang nagatumpok nga basura kag wala pa natapos nga plaza; ini ang ginareklamo sang mga pumuluyo nga nagaagi, nagabisita, kag nagausar sang Mandurriao Plaza.
english: Unbearable smell of air like sewer or dead animals, along with piles of garbage and unfinished plaza; this is complained by residents who pass, visit, and use the Mandurriao Plaza.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Albert Labrador, isa ka residente kag regular nga nagahampang sa basketball court sa plaza, ginpahayag niya nga sila sang iya mga kaupdanan, indi na makabatas sa baho nga nagadapya sa hangin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Albert Labrador, a resident and regular player at the basketball court in the plaza, said he and his companions could no longer stand the smell that was wafting through the air.

text: Suno sa iya, masami nila mapanimahuan ang mabaho nga hangin samtang nagahampang, kag tungod sini ginadulaan sila sang gana nga magpaliwa-liwa sa plaza.
english: He said they often smell the foul air while playing, and this makes them lose interest in hanging out in the plaza.

text: Gindugang pa ni Labrador nga madamo man sang mga tawo nga nagasimba, mga estudyante, kag mga nagapadulong sa merkado publiko ang nagalikaw sa lugar bangud sang baho nga nagagikan sa basura.
english: Labrador added that many people who go to church, students, and those who go to the public market also avoid the area because of the smell coming from the garbage.

text: Nagpagwa naman sang pahayag ang opisyal sang barangay may kaangtanan sa isyu sang baho sa Mandurriao Plaza.
english: The barangay official issued a statement regarding the issue of smell in Mandurriao Plaza.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Ricardo Juanillo Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Kagawad Ricardo Juanillo Jr.

text: sang Barangay Oñate de Leon, Mandurriao, ginpahayag niya nga ang basura nga nagatumpok sa plaza naghalin sa relocation sang Mandurriao public market kag bangud sang konstruksyon sang bag-o nga merkado.
english: of Barangay Oñate de Leon, Mandurriao, he said that the garbage piled up in the plaza came from the relocation of the Mandurriao public market and due to the construction of the new market.

text: Dugang pa ni Juanillo nga ginakuha man sang J.S. Layson ang basura sa pick-up point kag may ginapatigayon nga pagpaninlo sa lugar.
english: Juanillo added that J.S. The garbage will be disposed of at the pick-up point and a clean-up is being conducted in the area.

text: Apang ginsambit man niya nga may mga basura nga posible ginahaboy sang mga pumuluyo sa likod sang cage sang drop-point area.
english: However, he also mentioned that there is garbage that may be thrown by the residents behind the cage of the drop-point area.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Juanillo nga may clean-up operation nga pagahiwaton sa lugar, apang wala pa sang klaro nga desisyon kun sa diin isaylo ang drop-point sang basura nga subong nahamtang mismo sa Mandurriao public plaza.
english: Juanillo said there will be a clean-up operation in the area, but there is no clear decision on where to move the garbage drop-point which is now located in the Mandurriao public plaza.

text: (Reported by Bombo Lyka Sandiego via Bombohanay Bigtime)
english: (Reported by Bombo Lyka Sandiego via Bombohanay Bigtime)

text: Nagtuga sang daku nga sunog ang pagbungguanay sang isa ka oil tanker nga may karga nga jet fuel kag isa ka cargo ship sa northeast coast sang England.
english: An oil tanker loaded with jet fuel and a cargo ship collided off the northeast coast of England.

text: Ang mga barko nga involved amo ang U.S.-flagged chemical tanker nga Stena Immaculate kag ang Portuguese-flagged container ship nga Solong.
english: The ships involved were the U.S.-flagged chemical tanker Stena Immaculate and the Portuguese-flagged container ship Solong.

text: Isa ang padayon nga ginabulong sa ospital, samtang ginkumpirma man sang local member sang parliament sa London nga hilway na sa katalagman ang 36 ka crew members halin sa duha ka mga barko.
english: One is undergoing treatment in hospital, while a local member of parliament in London confirmed that the 36 crew members from the two ships are safe.

text: Nagbulig sa pag-rescue ang helicopter sang coast guard, lifeboats kag fire-fighting vessels halin sa malapit nga mga lugar.
english: A coast guard helicopter, lifeboats and fire-fighting vessels from nearby areas assisted in the rescue.

text: Ginapahayag nga halin ang container ship sa Grangemouth, Scotland kag pakadto kuntani sa Rotterdam sa The Netherlands.
english: The container ship was reportedly from Grangemouth, Scotland and was bound for Rotterdam in The Netherlands.

text: Ang Stena Immaculate naman ang parte sang 10 ka tankers nga iya sang Tanker Security Program sang Estados Unidos agud nga mag-suplay sang fuel sa ila nga militar.
english: The Stena Immaculate is part of 10 tankers belonging to the US Tanker Security Program to supply fuel to their military.

text: Indi pa klaro subong kun ano ang rason sang natabo nga collision.
english: The cause of the collision is still unclear.

text: ILOILO CITY- Ipatuman ang signal jamming sa Iloilo City sa tion sang Dinagyang Festival 2023 celebration.
english: ILOILO CITY- Signal jamming will be implemented in Iloilo City during the Dinagyang Festival 2023 celebration.

text: Apang ini ang limitado lamang sa mga areas nga venue sang major events kag indi ang bilog nga syudad kaangay sang ginpatuman sang mga selebrasyon sang nagliligad nga tinuig.
english: However, this is limited to the areas that are the venue of major events and not the entire city as implemented during the celebrations last year.

text: Ini ang magasakop sang Iloilo Freedom Grandstand, Plaza Libertad, Plazoleta Gay, Provincial Capitol, Delgado kag Quezon Streets, kag sa Central Market kag amo man sang University of Iloilo kun sa diin patigayonon ang “Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan” kag Ati Tribes Competition.
english: It will cover the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand, Plaza Libertad, Plazoleta Gay, Provincial Capitol, Delgado and Quezon Streets, and the Central Market as well as the University of Iloilo where the “Kasadyahan sa Babanwahanan” and Ati Tribes Competition will be held.

text: Ini ang ipatuman umpisa sa alas-sais sa aga tubtob alas-dos sa hapon sa Enero 21 kag 22.
english: It will be implemented from 6 am to 2 pm on January 21 and 22.

text: Ang isa ka signal shutdown ang ipatuman sa ILOmination Tribes Competition kag Parade of Lights sa Enero 21,alas-sais tubtob alas-nueve sa gab-i sa Mandurriao.
english: A signal shutdown will be implemented during the ILOmination Tribes Competition and Parade of Lights on January 21, from 6:00 to 9:00 pm in Mandurriao.

text:
Nagpahanumdom naman ang Iloilo City Police Office angot sa ipatuman nga gun ban umpisa sa Enero 13, alas 12:01 sang kaagahon tubtob Enero 22, alas 12:00 sang tungang gab-i.

Dumilian man ang pagdala sang makahulubog nga ilimnon kun nagalakat ukon nagalibot sa syudad sa tion sang festival ukon activities,indi man mahimo maggamit sang drone kun indi accredited sang Iloilo Festivals Foundation Inc., kag dumilian man ang pagpalupok sang firecrackers ukon paggamit sang pyrotechnics kun indi accredited.Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Rommel Duron, nga amo man ang nagduso sa konseho sang resolusyon sa nga nagaayo sa National Telecommunications Commission kag Philippine National Police sa pag-shutdown sang signal para sa Dinagyang 2023, iya ginpahayag nga para man ini sa seguridad sang publiko agud ma-minimize ang risgo sang posibilidad sang pagpangsabotahe.
english:
The Iloilo City Police Office reminded the public of the gun ban from January 13, 12:01 am to January 22, 12:00 pm.

It is also prohibited to carry alcoholic beverages when walking or touring the city during festivals or activities, it is also prohibited to use drones without being accredited by the Iloilo Festivals Foundation Inc., and it is also prohibited to fire firecrackers or use pyrotechnics if not accredited. also proposed to the council a resolution asking the National Telecommunications Commission and the Philippine National Police to shutdown the signal for Dinagyang 2023, he said it is also for public safety to minimize the risk of sabotage.

text: Ang naga-isahanon naman nga konsehal nga nagpamatok sa resolusyon amo si Councilor Rex Sarabia.
english: The only councilor who opposed the resolution was Councilor Rex Sarabia.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kulangon sang baboy ang probinsya sang Iloilo sa nagahilapit nga holiday season.
english: ILOILO CITY – There will be a shortage of pigs in Iloilo province during the upcoming holiday season.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Iloilo Provincial Veterinarian Dr. Darel Tabuada kasunod sang pagnubo sang swine inventory sang probinsya.
english: This was confirmed by Iloilo Provincial Veterinarian Dr. Darel Tabuada following the decline in the province's swine inventory.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Tabuada, iya ginpahayag nga nagnubo sang 72.57 percent ang swine inventory sang probinsya — buot silingon 200,504 ka mga baboy ang nadula kag 76,917 na lang ang nabilin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Tabuada, he said the province's swine inventory decreased by 72.57 percent — meaning 200,504 pigs were lost and only 76,917 remained.

text: Bangud sa pagnubo sang swine inventory suno sa iya, nagnubo man ang sufficiency level sini.
english: Due to the decrease in swine inventory, he said, its sufficiency level has also decreased.

text: Apang may yara sang iban nga probinsya kag rehiyon nga nagapasulod sang baboy sa Iloilo Province kag humalin sang Enero tubtob subong nga bulan, may yara sang 14,614 heads ang ginpadala sa probinsya.
english: However, there are other provinces and regions that import pigs into Iloilo Province and from January until this month, there are 14,614 heads sent to the province.

text: Pahayag pa ni Dr. Tabuada, yara lang sa 33.75 percent ang sufficiency level sang probinsya kag tuman ini ka kulang bisan pa nga ipain ini sa pangkonsumo na lang sang mga tawo.
english: According to Dr. Tabuada said the province's sufficiency level is only 33.75 percent and it is very low even if it is separated from the consumption of the people.

text: Ginalantaw sang natungdan nga madamo man ang nagasulod nga frozen products halin sa iban nga lugar kag may posibilidad nga mapun-an sini ang gap sa shortage sa inventory sang baboy.
english: He expects that there are also many frozen products coming in from other areas and there is a possibility that this will fill the gap in the shortage in the inventory of pork.

text: Pabor man si Dr. Tabuada sa nangin pahayag sang Department of Agriculture nga mag-import sang baboy agud nga madugangan ang kulang sa probinsya tubtob nga maka-umoisa sa recovery program.
english: Dr. Tabuada in the Department of Agriculture's statement to import pigs to meet the shortage in the province until it can join the recovery program.

text: Sa tion nga maka-umpisa na sa recovery program dugang sang natungdan, amat-amat na nga i-regulate ini agud mabuhi ang farmers kag para sa ulihe magdamo ang supply sang baboy kag magbarato ang baligyaanay.
english: Once the recovery program starts, he added, it will be gradually regulated so that farmers can survive and eventually increase the supply of pigs and make them cheaper.

text: Nagtapos sa technical draw ang sambuwa sang anay three-division world champion nga si John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero batok sa anay International Boxing Federation (IBF) world super bantamweight champion nga si Yukinori Oguni sa Koto-Ku, Japan.
english: Former three-division world champion John Riel “Quadro Alas” Casimero’s fight against former International Boxing Federation (IBF) world super bantamweight champion Yukinori Oguni ended in a technical draw in Koto-Ku, Japan.

text: Sa amo nga junior featherweight bout, tuman ang pagdugo sa tuo nga mata ni Oguni nga rason kun ngaa ginpa-check sang referee sa ringside doctor kag ginpauntat ang hampang 27 segundos pa lang sa ikaapat nga round bangud sang ginpahayag nga “accidental headbutt”.
english: In that junior featherweight bout, Oguni bled so much from his right eye that the referee had him checked by a ringside doctor and stopped the fight just 27 seconds into the fourth round due to an alleged “accidental headbutt”.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent direkta sa Ariake Arena sa Koto-Ku, antes pa man ginpauntat ang hampang, agresibo na si Quadro Alas apisar nga mas mataas ang iya kasumpong halin sa host country.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent directly at the Ariake Arena in Koto-Ku, even before the match was stopped, Quadro Alas was aggressive despite his taller opponent from the host country.

text: Bangud sa amo nga draw, naguba ang rekord sang 34-anyos nga boksidor sa sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an sa siyam ka sambuwa.
english: The draw broke the 34-year-old boxer's record of consecutive victories in nine fights.

text:
Photo: Quadro Alas It’s My Boy/Facebook

Si Casimero man ang naga-uyat sang rekord bilang former IBF junior flyweight, IBF flyweight kag World Boxing Organization (WBO) bantamweight kag tatlo ka beses nga nakahampang bilang junior featherweight matapos nakakasan sang 118-pound belt sang wala sini naatubang ang mandatory challenger nga si Paul Butler sang 2022.
english:
Photo: Quadro Alas It’s My Boy/Facebook

Casimero also holds the record as a former IBF junior flyweight, IBF flyweight and World Boxing Organization (WBO) bantamweight and has fought three times as a junior featherweight after losing the 118-pound belt when he lost to mandatory challenger Paul Butler in 2022.

text: Ini naman ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga hampang sang 35-anyos nga si Oguni nga nagtapos sa four-round technical draw nga sang tinalikdan nga Mayo 2022, natabo man sa iya away batok sa isa man ka Japanese boxer.
english: This is the second consecutive fight of the 35-year-old Oguni who ended in a four-round technical draw which last May 2022, also happened in his fight against another Japanese boxer.

text: May tatlo ka iban pa nga hampang sa tunga sang Pilipinas batok sa Japan sa amo nga card.
english: There are three other matches between the Philippines against Japan on that card.

text: Daog ang Filipino veteran nga si Froilan Saludar sang gintumba sini si Keita Kurihara isa ka minuto sa pagtungtong sini sa Oriental and Pacific Boxing Federation bantamweight title fight.
english: Filipino veteran Froilan Saludar won when he knocked out Keita Kurihara one minute into the Oriental and Pacific Boxing Federation bantamweight title fight.

text: Si Vince Paras naman sang General Santos City ang nagdaog man via split decision batok kay Kai Ishizawa sa flyweight battle.
english: Vince Paras of General Santos City also won via split decision against Kai Ishizawa in the flyweight battle.

text: Samtang, ang former title challenger naman nga si Jeo Santisima ang nalutos paagi sa unanimous decision batok sa Japanese boxer nga si Kenji Fujita.
english: Meanwhile, former title challenger Jeo Santisima lost by unanimous decision to Japanese boxer Kenji Fujita.

text: Ginpa-hold ang payment sa Amethyst Horizon Builders and General Contractor, Inc., contractor sang Phase II sang Iloilo City District Jail sa Buntatala, Leganes, bangud konektado ini sa gin-ban nga listahan sang DPWH suno kay kay Rica Jane D. Gardose, Regional Public Information Officer sang DPWH 6.
english: The payment was withheld from Amethyst Horizon Builders and General Contractor, Inc., contractor of Phase II of the Iloilo City District Jail in Buntatala, Leganes, because it is connected to the banned list of the DPWH, said Rica Jane D. Gardose, Regional Public Information Officer of DPWH 6.

text: Sa pagpangusisa kag pagpakig-angut sang Bombo Radyo ginpahayag ni Gardose nga maapektuhan gid ang proyekto kag magapadayon sila sa pagsunod sang mga direktiba halin sa mas mataas nga ahensya.
english: When contacted by Bombo Radyo, Gardose said the project will be severely affected and they will continue to follow the directives from the higher agency.

text: Matandaan nga gin-revoke ang lisensiya sang kompanya nga konektado sa pamilya Discaya, nga may kalabutan sa mga maanomalya nga flood control projects.
english: It can be recalled that the license of a company connected to the Discaya family, in connection with anomalous flood control projects, was revoked.

text: Ang Phase II sang pasilidad may kabug-usan nga pondo nga P154.4 milyon kag kabahin sang mas daku nga plano sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP)-6.
english: Phase II of the facility has a total budget of P154.4 million and is part of a larger plan of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP)-6.

text: Gin-groundbreaking ini sang Hunyo 6, 2024, kag ginlauman nga matapos sa Oktubre 5, 2025, apang subong, ginpahayag nga suspendedo ang kontrata sang Amethyst Horizon Builders tubtob sa dugang nga pahibalo.
english: It was groundbreaking on June 6, 2024, and was expected to be completed by October 5, 2025, but now, Amethyst Horizon Builders’ contract has been announced as suspended until further notice.

text: Samtang padayon man ang konstruksyon sang Phase I sang pasilidad nga ginapangunahan sang J.E. Tico Construction Co., Inc., kag wala ini naapektuhan sang isyu.
english: Meanwhile, the construction of Phase I of the facility is underway led by J.E. Tico Construction Co., Inc., and it was not affected by the issue.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara na sa 48% ang progreso sang regional office sang BJMP nga ginatukod sa atubang sang district jail.
english: It was reported that the progress of the BJMP regional office being built in front of the district jail is already at 48%.

text: Ang Iloilo City District Jail Building ginlantaw nga maka-accommodate sang 2,000 ka inmates kag magahatag sang mas maayo nga pasilidad para sa mga persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), upod ang edukasyon kag livelihood programs sa bulig sang TESDA kag DOLE.
english: The Iloilo City District Jail Building is expected to accommodate 2,000 inmates and will provide better facilities for persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), along with education and livelihood programs with the assistance of TESDA and DOLE.

text: Ang proyekto ginpondohan paagi sa Republic Act No.
english: The project was funded through Republic Act No.

text: 11975, General Appropriations Act of 2024, nga ginpangunahan ni Uswag Ilonggo Party-list Representative James ‘Jojo’ Ang Jr., nga amo man ang chief sponsor sang funding.
english: 11975, General Appropriations Act of 2024, led by Uswag Ilonggo Party-list Representative James ‘Jojo’ Ang Jr., who is also the chief sponsor of the funding.

text: Mahatagan liwat sang tyansa ang Pinoy boxer nga si Jerwin Ancajas nga mabawi ang iya nga titulo nga world champion sa iya pag-atubang sa World Boxing Association bantamweight champion nga si Takuma Inoue sa Nobyembre 15 sa Ryogoku Kokugikan Arena sa Tokyo, Japan.
english: Filipino boxer Jerwin Ancajas will be given another chance to regain his world championship title when he faces World Boxing Association bantamweight champion Takuma Inoue on November 15 at the Ryogoku Kokugikan Arena in Tokyo, Japan.

text: Si Takuma amo ang manghod sang pound-for-pound king nga si Naoya Inoue nga isa ka boxing superstar sa Japan.
english: Takuma is the younger brother of pound-for-pound king Naoya Inoue who is a boxing superstar in Japan.

text:
Photo: Getty Images/AFP

Ini ang ikaduha nga tion nga tinguhaan ni Ancajas nga makuha ang world title matapos nga nalutos sa kamot sang Argentine nga si Fernando Martinez sang Pebrero 2022 sang yara pa lang sa super flyweight.
english:
Photo: Getty Images/AFP

This will be the second time Ancajas will attempt to win the world title after losing at the hands of Argentine Fernando Martinez in February 2022 when still at super flyweight.

text: Nalutos man ang Pinoy boxer kay Martinez paagi sa unanimous decision sa ila nga rematch walo ka bulan matapos ang una nga pagkit-anay sa ring.
english: The Filipino boxer also defeated Martinez by unanimous decision in their rematch eight months after their first meeting in the ring.

text: Ang sambuwa sa Nobyembre 15 amo ang una nga tion nga nagsaka sang weight class ang 31-anyos nga Filipino pride halin sang napaslawan ini nga mabawi ang iya nga world champion status.
english: The fight on November 15 is the first time the 31-year-old Filipino pride has moved up a weight class since he failed to regain his world champion status.

text: Preska si Ancajas gikan sa paglutos sa Colombian boxer nga si Wilner Soto sa super bantamweight paagi fifth-round stoppage sa Minneapolis, Minnesota.
english: Ancajas is fresh off beating Colombian boxer Wilner Soto at super bantamweight via fifth-round stoppage in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

text: Si Inoue naman ang naga-uyat sang rekord nga 18-1, 4 knockouts kag nakalutos sa lima ka Filipino fighters apang wala pa ini nakaagi-atubang sa kalibre ni Ancajas nga naka-depensa sa iya super flyweight strap sang siyam ka beses halin sang 2017 tubtub sang 2021.
english: Inoue holds a record of 18-1, 4 knockouts and has defeated five Filipino fighters but has never faced the caliber of Ancajas who defended his super flyweight strap nine times from 2017 to 2021.

text: Namintinar sang bagyo “TINO” ang kabaskugon sini samtang yara sa gihapon sa Philippine Sea.
english: Typhoon “TINO” maintained its strength while still in the Philippine Sea.

text: Sandig sa latest monitoring sang PAGASA, nasiplatan ang sentro sang bagyo sa ginabanta 235 km East Southeast sang Guiuan, Eastern Samar.
