text: Ginguba sang Russia ang energy kag gas infrastructure sang Ukraine paagi sa pagpatigayon sang missile attack.
english: Russia destroyed Ukraine’s energy and gas infrastructure by conducting a missile attack.

text: Suno sa Ukrainian air force, 67 missiles kag 194 drones ang ginpalupad sang Moscow sa overnight attack apang natigayon nga ma-sagang ang 34 sa missiles kag 100 sa drones.
english: According to the Ukrainian air force, Moscow launched 67 missiles and 194 drones in the overnight attack but managed to intercept 34 of the missiles and 100 of the drones.

text: Lakip sa nag-report sa halit nga natuga sang atake amo ang regional officials sa northeastern city sang Kharkiv pakadto sa western city sang Ternopil.
english: Among those reporting damage caused by the attack were regional officials in the northeastern city of Kharkiv to the western city of Ternopil.

text: Walo ka mga tawo ang nasamaran sa Kharkiv kag duha naman lakip ang isa ka bata sa Poltava.
english: Eight people were injured in Kharkiv and two others including a child in Poltava.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapuntariya sang Russia ang Ukrainian cities kag mga lugar nga malayo sa front lines kada gab-i gamit ang ila nga drones.
english: Russia is targeting Ukrainian cities and areas far from the front lines every night with its drones.

text: Ini nga atake amo ang ila labing-una nga large-scale assault halin sang gin-suspend ni US President Trump ang military aid kag pag-share sang intel subong nga semana kasunod sang pagbaisay nila ni Zelensky sa White House.
english: The attack was their first large-scale assault since US President Trump suspended military aid and intel sharing this week following an argument with Zelensky at the White House.

text: Sa pihak sang nagasaka nga tensyon sa tunga nanday Trump kag Zelensky, nagpaguwa sang bag-o nga statement ang American leader nga nagapaandam sa Russia nga dagdagan ini sang bag-o nga sanctions kag mga taripa.
english: Despite rising tensions between Trump and Zelensky, the American leader issued a new statement warning Russia to increase it with new sanctions and tariffs.

text:
Bangud ginapudpod sang Russian ang Ukraine sa patag-awayan suno kay Trump, ginakonsiderar niya subong ang large scale Banking Sanctions, Sanctions, kag taripa sa Russia tubtub nga may matabo nga ceasefire kag “FINAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT ON PEACE”

Gin-address man sini ang Moscow kag Kyiv nga magplastar na sa lamesa kag hambalan ang ceasefire antes pa maulihi ang tanan.#

Photo: Ukrainian Emergency Service via AP
english:
Because Russia is crushing Ukraine on the battlefield, Trump said he is now considering large scale banking sanctions, sanctions, and tariffs on Russia until there is a ceasefire and a “FINAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT ON PEACE”

He also addressed Moscow and Kyiv to come to the table and discuss a ceasefire before it is too late.

Photo: Ukrainian Emergency Service via AP

text: Padayon ang konstruksyon sang bag-o nga opisina sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology Region 6 nga nahamtang sa atubang sang ginapatindog man nga Iloilo City District Jail Building sa Barangay Buntatala, Leganes, Iloilo, kag ginpahayag nga wala ini naapektuhan sang isyu sa contractor nga konektado sa maanomalya nga proyekto.
english: The construction of the new office of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology Region 6 located in front of the also under construction Iloilo City District Jail Building in Barangay Buntatala, Leganes, Iloilo, is underway, and it was reported that it was not affected by the issue with the contractor connected to the anomalous project.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Juniven Rey S. Umadhay, tagpamaba sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology 6, suno sa iya nga ang konstruksyon sang regional office padayon kag wala sang problema sa subong, kag ginpasiguro niya nga ang contractor nga J.E. Tico Construction Co., Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Juniven Rey S. Umadhay, spokesperson of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology 6, said that the construction of the regional office is continuing and has not been affected so far, and he assured that the contractor J.E. Tico Construction Co., Inc.

text: wala naupod sa listahan nga ginpabuyagyag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: not included in the list unveiled by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Umadhay nga yara na sa 48% ang progreso sang proyekto sang opisina.
english: Umadhay also said that the progress of the office project is now at 48%.

text: Matandaan nga na-revoke ang lisensiya sang Amethyst Horizon Builders and General Contractor, Inc., nga konektado sa pamilya Discaya, bangud sang maanomalya nga flood control projects.
english: It can be recalled that the license of Amethyst Horizon Builders and General Contractor, Inc., connected to the Discaya family, was revoked due to anomalous flood control projects.

text: Samtang padayon man ang konstruksyon sang Iloilo City District Jail Building sa Barangay Buntatala, Leganes, apang wala pa ini natapos bisan pa nga ginplano nga matapos sa Oktubre 2025.
english: Meanwhile, the construction of the Iloilo City District Jail Building in Barangay Buntatala, Leganes is ongoing, but it has not been completed despite being scheduled to be completed in October 2025.

text: Nagpaguwa sang audio message si Pope Francis sa labing-una nga tion halin sang na-ospital siya sa Roma bangud sa ginasuprer nga double pneumonia.
english: Pope Francis released an audio message for the first time since he was hospitalized in Rome suffering from double pneumonia.

text: Ginpabati ang message broadcast sa St.
english: The message broadcast was broadcast on St.

text: Peter’s Square kadungan sang Holy Rosary nga ginhimo sang Vatican para man ipangamuyo ang pag-recover sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: Peter's Square in conjunction with the Holy Rosary held by the Vatican to pray for the recovery of the 88-year-old Pope.

text: Sa mensahe sini, ginpasalamatan sini ang tanan nga nagpangamuyo para sa iya.
english: In her message, she thanked everyone who prayed for her.

text: Nagsiling man ini nga ginapangabay niya nga proteksyunan man sang Diyos ang mga tumuluo.
english: He also said that he asks God to protect the believers.

text: Mahinay ang tingog sang Pope kag daw kaangay nga nabudlayan ini sa pagginhawa samtang nga ginagamit ang iya native language nga Spanish.
english: The Pope's voice was low and he seemed to have difficulty breathing while using his native language, Spanish.

text: “I thank you from the bottom of my heart for your prayers for my health from the Square, I accompany you from here,” suno sa Argentine Pope.
english: “I thank you from the bottom of my heart for your prayers for my health from the Square, I accompany you from here,” according to the Argentine Pope.

text: “May God bless you and the Virgin protect you.
english: “May God bless you and the Virgin protect you.

text:
Thank you.”

Ini ang una nga direkta nga mensahe sang Pope halin sang na-admit siya sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma sang Pebrero 14.
english:
Thank you.”

It was the first direct message from the Pope since he was admitted to the Gemelli Hospital in Rome on February 14.

text: Antes sini nga message sang Santo Papa, ginsiling sang Vatican nga magahatag sila sang masunod nga update sa ikaayong lawas sang Santo Papa sa Sabado oras sa Roma.
english: Prior to the Pope's message, the Vatican said it would provide the next update on the Pope's health on Saturday Rome time.

text: Huwebes sang gab-i sang gin-anunsyo ini sang Holy See Press Office kadungan sang ila kumpirmasyon nga stable gihapon ang kondisyon sang Pope, wala sang hilanat, kag wala sang bag-o nga episode.
english: The Holy See Press Office made the announcement on Thursday night alongside its confirmation that the Pope's condition is still stable, with no fever, and no new episodes.

text: Bangud ginkonsiderar nga stable ang clinical picture, ginsiling sang mga doctor nga ipaiway anay ang pag-isyu sang medical bulletin sa Byernes kag bantayan sa Sabado nga masami gab-i ginapaguwa sa Roma kag Domingo sang kaagahon naman diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Because the clinical picture is considered stable, the doctors said to postpone the issuance of the medical bulletin on Friday and watch on Saturday which is usually released at night in Rome and Sunday morning here in the Philippines.

text: Ginsiling man sang Vatican nga kaangay sa nagligad nga mga inadlaw, nasarangan sang pope nga masal-ot ang iya trabaho sa ospital samtang nga nagapadayon sa pagpaaayo kag samtang nga nagapahuway.
english: The Vatican also said that as in previous days, the pope was able to continue his work in the hospital while continuing to recover and while resting.

text: Ginausisa sa subong nga himuon nga parking area ang barangay gym sa Brgy.
english: The barangay gym in Brgy.

text: Alalasan, Distrito sang Lapuz, bangud sang padayon nga pagdamo sang mga traysikad kag tricycle nga naga-agi kag naga-parking sa palibot sang lugar.
english: Alalasan, Lapuz District, due to the continuous increase in tricycles and tricycles passing and parking around the area.

text: Ini nga mga salakyan ginakabig nga nagapugok kag nagaginutok sa dalan, nga nagadul-ong sang seryoso nga traffic congestion, ilabi na subong nga may proyekto ang DPWH sa nasambit nga karsada.
english: These vehicles are considered to be crowding the road, causing serious traffic congestion, especially now that the DPWH has a project on the said road.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Jofel Ladiet, ginpahayag niya nga ang mayor nga problema sa ila barangay amo ang pagparking nga wala sang sistema sang mga salakyan sa duha ka kilid sang dalan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Jofel Ladiet said the main problem in their barangay is parking without a system of vehicles on both sides of the road.

text: Suno sa iya, ini nagadugang pa gid sang kabudlay sa paglabay sang mga tawo kag salakyan, labi na subong nga may ongoing nga konstruksyon sa lugar.
english: He said this further complicates the passage of people and vehicles, especially now that there is ongoing construction in the area.

text: Ginsugid pa ni PB Ladiet nga nagsuggest siya kay Retired PCol.
english: PB Ladiet said he suggested to Retired PCol.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos nga, tungod nga national road ini, dapat wala sang may magpark nga e-trayk, tricycle, motorcycle kag 4-wheels sa kilid sang dalan.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos said that, since it is a national road, no one should park e-trayks, tricycles, motorcycles and 4-wheels on the side of the road.

text: Apang ginpaathag man niya nga ang palangabuhian sang kadam-an nga residente sa Brgy.
english: However, he also explained that the livelihood of most residents in Brgy.

text: Alalasan nagasandig sa pagbiyahe sang tricycle, gani nagapangayo siya sang konsiderasyon nga ma-allow ang one-side parking para sa 3-wheel vehicles lang.
english: Alalasan relies on tricycle travel, so he asks for consideration to allow one-side parking for 3-wheel vehicles only.

text: Ginpasiguro man ni PB Ladiet nga ginakonsiderar nila ang covered area sang gym, apang gin-ako niya nga indi gid sini ma-accommodate ang tanan nga salakyan, kag limitado lang ini para sa mga traysikad kag tricycle.
english: PB Ladiet also assured that they are considering the covered area of ​​the gym, but he admitted that it cannot accommodate all vehicles, and it is limited to tricycles and tricycles.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang isa ka driver nga pabor siya nga gamiton bilang parkingan ang barangay gym para sa mga traysikad kag tricycle.
english: A driver said he is in favor of using the barangay gym as a parking lot for tricycles.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alex Tinder, isa ka driver, ginpabutyag niya nga mas maayo kuno nga gamiton ang gym bilang parking area agud magligwa man ang dalan kag mangin hapos ang pag-agi sang mga tawo kag salakyan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alex Tinder, a driver, said it is better to use the gym as a parking area so that the road will be wider and easier for people and vehicles to pass.

text: Suno sa iya, makabulig ini sa pagpaayo sang traffic flow kag malikawan ang pagginutok sa karsada.
english: He said this will help improve traffic flow and avoid congestion on the road.

text: (Reported by Bombo Bryan Gonzales, with Anchor Bombo Donnie Degala, via Bombo Reports 2nd edition)
english: (Reported by Bombo Bryan Gonzales, with Anchor Bombo Donnie Degala, via Bombo Reports 2nd edition)

text: Apisar may pageant fans nga indi kumporme sa pagbalik kay Miss Universe 2012 Olivia Culpo bilang main host sang 71st Miss Universe Competition, daku gihapon ang pagpasalamat sang beauty queen sa Miss Universe Organization kag gindayaw man ang padayon sini nga evolution.
english: Although there are pageant fans who are not satisfied with the return of Miss Universe 2012 Olivia Culpo as the main host of the 71st Miss Universe Competition, the beauty queen is still very grateful to the Miss Universe Organization and praised its continuous evolution.

text: Suno kay Olivia, daku ang iya nga respeto sa iya Miss Universe Family kag sa mga pagbag-o diri lakip na ang bag-o nga female ownership nga labing-una sa maragtas sang amo nga pageant organization.
english: According to Olivia, she has great respect for her Miss Universe Family and the changes here including the new female ownership which is the first in the history of the pageant organization.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2021, nangin co-host man si Olivia sang amo nga prestihiyoso nga beauty pageant kaupod si Mario Lopez, apang nangin trending ang iya hosting skills bangud sa iya maluya nga delivery.
english: In 2021, Olivia also co-hosted the prestigious beauty pageant with Mario Lopez, but her hosting skills became trending due to her poor delivery.

text: Mangin si Miss Universe 2014 Top 10 finisher Mary Jean Lastimosa ang nagpahayag nga tion na ini agud makabawi si Olivia kag ipakita ang energy nga kinahanglan sang pageant fans sa amo sini kadaku nga event.
english: Even Miss Universe 2014 Top 10 finisher Mary Jean Lastimosa said it was time for Olivia to recover and show the energy that pageant fans need at such a big event.

text: Mangin co-host ni Olivia ang American TV host nga si Jeannie Mai Jenkins.
english: Olivia will be co-hosted by American TV host Jeannie Mai Jenkins.

text: Girl power ini bangud mangin backstage commentators naman sanday Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray kag Access Hollywood correspondent Zuri Hall.
english: It's girl power because Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray and Access Hollywood correspondent Zuri Hall will be backstage commentators.

text: Balantayan ang Miss Universe 2022 sa January 14 sa New Orleans Morial Convention Center sa New Orleans, Louisiana kun sa diin 85 ka mga kandidata ang maga-compete matapos nag-withdraw ang tiglawas sang Latvia bangud na-infect sang Covid-19.
english: Watch Miss Universe 2022 on January 14 at the New Orleans Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, Louisiana where 85 contestants will compete after the representative of Latvia withdrew due to being infected with Covid-19.

text: Nagapawanagan si president Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. calls for

text: sang matalunsay nga protesta sa mga magatambong sang nakatalana nga Trillion Peso March sa palaabuton nga Nobyembre 30.
english: of a smooth protest to those who will attend the scheduled Trillion Peso March on November 30.

text: Dugang pa sini, nadugangan lamang sang mga indi lakip sa kilos protesta rason nga may yara sang kinagamo.
english: He added that the protest was only increased by those who were not involved in the protest.

text: Bangud sang nagligad nga insidente sang kinagamo ang gina-engganyo sini ang mga nagapatigayon sang kilos protesta nga likawan ang gamo.
english: Due to past incidents of violence, he urged protesters to avoid violence.

text: Matandaan nga pila ka mga kabataan ang gin-aresto bangud sa pagguba sang pila ka mga kagamitan kag pagpanakit sa mga kapulisan sa ginpatigayon nga una nga Trillion peso march sang Setyembre 21 bilang pagkontra sa mga nagakalatabo nga korapsyon sa pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that several children were arrested for destroying some equipment and assaulting the police during the first Trillion peso march held on September 21 in opposition to corruption in the country.

text: Nagpaguwa si US President Donald Trump sang “last warning” sa Hamas militants nga paguwa-on na ang tanan nga nabilin nga hostages nga yara pa sa Gaza.
english: US President Donald Trump has issued a “last warning” to Hamas militants to release all remaining hostages still in Gaza.

text: Suno kay Trump, wala sang bisan isa ka miyembro sang Hamas nga hilwayon sa katalagman kun indi pa gid pagsundon ang iya mandu.
english: According to Trump, not a single member of Hamas will be safe unless his orders are followed.

text: “Release all of the Hostages now, not later, and immediately return all of the dead bodies of the people you murdered, or it is OVER for you,” suno sa US President.
english: “Release all of the Hostages now, not later, and immediately return all of the dead bodies of the people you murdered, or it is OVER for you,” according to the US President.

text:
“Only sick and twisted people keep bodies, and you are sick and twisted!”

Nagpahayag man ini nga ipadala sini sa Israel ang tanan nga kinahanglanon para matapos na ang trabaho.Ginmanduan man ni Trump ang liderato sang Hamas nga magbiya na sa Gaza samtang may tiyempo pa.
english:
“Only sick and twisted people keep bodies, and you are sick and twisted!”

He also said he would send Israel all the necessary supplies to finish the job. Trump also ordered the Hamas leadership to leave Gaza while there is still time.

text:
“Not a single Hamas member will be safe if you don’t do as I say.”

Mangin ang mga tawo sa Gaza ang ginpalagtikan man sini nga matahum ang ila buwasdamlag, apang kun nagabulig sila nga magtago sang mga bihag, pamatyon man sila.
english:
“Not a single Hamas member will be safe if you don’t do as I say.”

Even the people of Gaza were promised a beautiful future, but if they helped hide the hostages, they would be killed.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga nagpaandam si Trump sa Hamas bangud sang Disyembre, ginsilingan man sini ang Hamas nga mamalayran gid sila kun indi pa mapaguwa ang mga bihag antes siya magpungko sa pwesto.
english: This is not the first time Trump has warned Hamas because in December, he also told Hamas that they would pay if the hostages were not released before he took office.

text: Ginapatihan sang Israel nga may 59 pa ka hostages nga nabilin sa Gaza kag 24 diri ang ginapatihan nga bangkay na.
english: Israel believes there are still 59 hostages left in Gaza and 24 of them are believed to be dead.

text: Natabo ang statement ni Trump matapos ginkumpirma sang White House nga direkta na sila nga nagapakig-istorya sa Hamas para nga ma-release ang nabilin nga US-Israeli hostages kag tapuson na ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Trump's statement came after the White House confirmed that it is in direct talks with Hamas to release the remaining US-Israeli hostages and end the war in the Middle East.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga direct engagement sa tunga sang US kag Hamas halin sang 1997, tuig kun san-o gin-designate sang State Department ang amo nga grupo bilang isa ka foreign terrorist organization.
english: This is the first direct engagement between the US and Hamas since 1997, the year the State Department designated the group as a foreign terrorist organization.

text: Ipinagpatuloy na lamang ni Davao City frist district Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte ang taunang tradisyon ng ama na si dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte tuwing panahon ng Undas.
english: Davao City first district Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte is continuing the annual tradition of his father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, during Undas.

text: Gaya ng ginagawa ng ama ay namahagi ang mambabatas ng pagkain noong ito ay bumisita sa Roman Catholic Cemetery sa Davao City.
english: Like his father, the lawmaker shared food when he visited the Roman Catholic Cemetery in Davao City.

text: Nag-alay ito ng bulaklak at kandila sa puntod ng kaniyang lolo na sina Vicente at Soledad.
english: He offered flowers and candles to the graves of his grandfathers Vicente and Soledad.

text: Ito ang unang pagkakataon na hindi nakadalaw ang dating pangulo dahil sa nakapiit siya sa International Criminal Court facility sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: This is the first time that the former president was not able to visit because he was stuck in the International Criminal Court facility in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Nagpang-17 ang Pilipinas sa opisyal nga pagtakop sang 19th Asian Games sa Hangzhou, China –pinakamataas nga ranking sang pungsod halin sang nagpang-14 sang 1994 nga edisyon sa Hiroshima, Japan.
english: The Philippines finished 17th at the official closing ceremony of the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China – the country's highest ranking since the 14th edition of the 1994 edition in Hiroshima, Japan.

text: Sa 41 ka mga pungsod nga nagpasakop, nabulsa sang mga atletang Pinoy ang apat ka bulawan nga medalya, duha ka silver, kag 12 ka bronze medals.
english: Of the 41 countries that participated, Filipino athletes pocketed four gold medals, two silver, and 12 bronze medals.

text: Ini nga edisyon sang Asiad ang ginpatigayon halin sang Septyembre 23 tubtub Oktubre 8 kun sa diin 391 ka mga atleta ang ginpadala sang Pilipinas agud mag-compete sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: This edition of Asiad was held from September 23 to October 8 where 391 athletes were sent by the Philippines to compete in other countries.

text: Apat ka tuig ang nagligad, sa 18th Asian Games sa Indonesia, nagpang-19 ang Pilipinas sa 37 ka pungsod matapos nakuha ang apat ka golds, duha ka silvers, kag 15 ka bronze medals.
english: Four years ago, at the 18th Asian Games in Indonesia, the Philippines finished 19th out of 37 countries after winning four golds, two silvers, and 15 bronze medals.

text: Ang pinakamataas nga Asiad rankings sang Pilipinas ang natabo sa sunod-sunod nga edisyon sang 1954 kag 1958 sang pareho nga nagpang-duha ang Filipino athletes.
english: The Philippines' highest Asiad rankings occurred in consecutive editions in 1954 and 1958 when both Filipino athletes finished second.

text: Nagpanguna sa Pilipinas ang gold medalists nga sanday EJ Obiena sa pole vault; Meggie Ochoa kag Annie Ramirez sa jiu-jitsu; kag ang Gilas Pilipinas nga nagbulsa sang gold medal sa basketball matapos ang 61 ka tuig nga paghulat sang mga Pinoy.
english: Gold medalists EJ Obiena led the Philippines in the pole vault; Meggie Ochoa and Annie Ramirez in jiu-jitsu; and Gilas Pilipinas who pocketed the gold medal in basketball after 61 years of waiting for Filipinos.

text: Sa amo nga tournament, silver medalist man ang Pinoy boxer nga si Eumir Marcial apang nakakuha man ini sang ticket para sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: In the tournament, Pinoy boxer Eumir Marcial was also a silver medalist but he also got a ticket for the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Nagpanguna sa medal tally ang host country nga China nga may 201 ka gold medals, 111 ka silver, kag 71 ka bronze.
english: Topping the medal tally was host country China with 201 gold medals, 111 silver, and 71 bronze.

text: Kaangay sa nagligad nga edisyon sang Asiad, nagpangaduha ang Japan nga may 52 golds, 67 silvers, kag 69 bronzes, samtang ang South Korea ang nagpangatlo nga may 42 golds, 59 silvers, kag 89 bronzes.#
english: As in the previous edition of the Asiad, Japan came second with 52 golds, 67 silvers, and 69 bronzes, while South Korea came third with 42 golds, 59 silvers, and 89 bronzes.

text: Nagrekomenda si University of the Philippines Chancellor-Dr. Clement Camposano nga mas maayo kun may ara sang Independent Truth Commission nga maga-imbestiga sang mga flood control projects para sa kredibilidad sang resulta sini.
english: University of the Philippines Chancellor-Dr. Clement Camposano said it would be better if there is an Independent Truth Commission to investigate flood control projects for the credibility of its results.

text: Ang amo nga commission ang mahimo bug-usan sang civil society, academia kag non-political institutions.
english: The commission could be composed of civil society, academia and non-political institutions.

text: Ginplastar man niya nga kung ang kongreso lang ang mag-imbestiga, indi ini matuod-tuod nga imbestigasyon kag ini nagakinahanglan sang grupo nga wala sang mga pulitiko nga involve kun ang tinutuyo ang makuha kag mahibaluan kun sin o gid ang sa likod sang mga palpak kag ghost projects.
english: He also argued that if only Congress investigates, it is not a real investigation and it requires a group without politicians involved if the purpose is to get and find out who is behind the failed and ghost projects.

text: Nagpaandam man ini sa mga mahimo matabo inkaso nga indi maimbestigahan sang maayo.
english: It also warned of what could happen if it is not properly investigated.

text:
“𝘐𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘨𝘦𝘴 𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘦𝘮𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘭𝘢𝘸𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘸𝘢𝘺 𝘱𝘰𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘤𝘴 𝘰𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘴, 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘢𝘭𝘭 𝘦𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨”

Dugang diri, nagpahanumdom man si Camposano sa publiko nga indi pagkalimtan ang matuod-tuod nga rason sang pagbaha amo ang—climate change, poor urban planning kag korapsyon.
english:
“I 𝘐𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘯𝘰 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘯𝘨𝘦𝘴 𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘦𝘮𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘭𝘢𝘸𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘦𝘺 𝘱𝘰𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘤𝘴 𝘰𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘴, 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘭 𝘦𝘯𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘯𝘰𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨”

Camposano also reminded the public not to forget the real causes of flooding are climate change, poor urban planning and corruption.

text: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: By: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Indi na pagpasakaan sang kaso ang amay nga ginatudlo nga nagpatay sa iya anak nga lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The father who allegedly killed his son in Brgy.

text: Sta.
english: Sta.

text: Rita.
english: Rita.

text: Oton, Iloilo.
english: Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang suspek amo si Raymundo Sarad, Sr.
english: The suspect was identified as Raymundo Sarad, Sr.

text: samtang ang biktima amo si Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36-anyos, pareho nga residente sang amo nga lugar.
english: while the victim was identified as Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36, both residents of the same place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-execute na sang affidavit of non-interest ang kabataan sang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police of Oton Municipal Police Station, said the suspect's children have already executed an affidavit of non-interest.

text: Suno kay Talamillo, nakagwa naman sa presuhan ang suspek.
english: According to Talamillo, the suspect was released from jail.

text: Apisar nga wala nag-ako ang amay sa otoridad nga siya ang nakabuno sa iya anak, nagtuad naman ini sa iya kabataan sa nahimo nga krimen.
english: Although the father did not admit to the authorities that he stabbed his son, he confessed to his children the crime.

text: Matandaan nga nasapwan ang biktima nga yara na sa kanal kag may pilas nga tuga sang pagkabuno.
english: The victim was found lying in a ditch with gunshot wounds.

text: Sang gab-i antes ang insidente, ginpahayag nga pareho nga hubog ang mag-amay kag masami man sila nga nagainaway kun makainom santo man sa pagkumpirma sang ila nga mga kasilingan.
english: The night before the incident, the father and son were both drunk and often fought when they drank, according to their neighbors.

text: Napatay na ang Grammy-winning singer nga si Anita Pointer sa edad nga 74 kasunod sang iya pagpakig-away sa cancer.
english: Grammy-winning singer Anita Pointer has died at the age of 74 following a battle with cancer.

text: Isa si Anita sa founding members sang R&B group nga The Pointer Sisters kag may world hits nga “I’m So Excited,” “Jump” kag “Fire”, “Slow Hand,” kag “Neutron Dance.
english: Anita is one of the founding members of the R&B group The Pointer Sisters and has world hits “I’m So Excited,” “Jump” and “Fire”, “Slow Hand,” and “Neutron Dance.

text: Utod ni Pointer sanday June kag Ruth nga taga Oakland, California, kag gin-release nila ang ila una nga album sang 1973 antes nakadaog sang tatlo ka Grammy Awards.
english: Pointer is sister to June and Ruth from Oakland, California, and they released their first album in 1973 before winning three Grammy Awards.

text: Nadag-an sang grupo ang ila una nga Grammy Award sa ila crossover hit nga “Fairytale” sang 1974.
english: The group won their first Grammy Award with their crossover hit “Fairytale” in 1974.

text: May 13 man sila ka US Top hits halin sang 1973 tubtub 1985.
english: They also had 13 US Top hits from 1973 to 1985.

text: Tuyo sang Filipino Olympian nga si Carlo Paalam nga maupdan ang isa pa ka Pinoy Olympian nga si Eumir Marcial sa semifinals subong nga Asian Games apang indi basta-basta ang iya agyan subong nga adlaw.
english: Filipino Olympian Carlo Paalam aims to join another Pinoy Olympian Eumir Marcial in the semifinals of this Asian Games but his journey today is not easy.

text:
Photo: REUTERS/Ueslei Marcelino

7:30 karon sa gab-i, atubangon ni Paalam ang reigning world champion nga si Abdumalik Khalokov sang Uzbekistan sa quarterfinal round sa Hangzhou gymnasium.
english:
Photo: REUTERS/Ueslei Marcelino

7:30 tonight, Paalam will face reigning world champion Abdumalik Khalokov of Uzbekistan in the quarterfinal round at the Hangzhou gymnasium.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion nga nagsaka si Paalam sa men’s 57kg weight class sa boxing.
english: This is the first time Paalam has moved up to the men’s 57kg weight class in boxing.

text: Sang Tokyo Olympics 2020 sang nangin silver medalist si Paalam, nag-compete lamang ini sa men’s 52kg apang kinahanglan niya nga magsaka sa mas mataas nga weight class bilang preparasyon sa Paris Olympics sa 2024.
english: At the Tokyo Olympics 2020 when Paalam became a silver medalist, he only competed in the men’s 52kg but had to move up to a higher weight class in preparation for the Paris Olympics in 2024.

text: Pananglitan malutos ni Paalam ang world champion kag siya ang maga-abanse sa semifinals, sigurado na ang iya bronze medal sa Asian Games nga pareho man kay Marcial.
english: If Paalam beats the world champion and advances to the semifinals, he is sure to win a bronze medal at the Asian Games just like Marcial.

text: Duha lamang ka finalists sa kada weight category ang makakuha sang ticket para sa Olympic Games sa Paris.#
english: Only two finalists in each weight category will earn a ticket to the Olympic Games in Paris.

text: Nadugangan ang medalya sang Pilipinas sa 19th Asian Games matapos nagpangatlo ang Pinoy Olympian nga si Elreen Ando sa women’s 64kg weight class sa weightlifting.
english: The Philippines added to its medal haul at the 19th Asian Games after Pinoy Olympian Elreen Ando finished third in the women’s 64kg weight class in weightlifting.

text: Nahakwat ni Ando ang 96kg sa snatch kag 126kg sa clean and jerk nga may total nga 222kg.
english: Ando lifted 96kg in the snatch and 126kg in the clean and jerk for a total of 222kg.

text: Nagpanguna sa kumpetisyon ang tiglawas sang North Korea nga si Rim Un-sim nga nakahimo sang bag-o nga Asiad record nga 251kg; kag ginsundan ni Pei Xinyi sang China nga may 234kg.
english: North Korean representative Rim Un-sim led the competition with a new Asiad record of 251kg; followed by Pei Xinyi of China with 234kg.

text: Ini man ang labing-una nga medalya sang Pilipinas sa weightlifting subong nga Asian Games matapos nga nagpang-apat lamang ang Olympic champion nga si Hidilyn Diaz sa women’s 59kg weight class kahapon, Oktubre 2.
english: It is also the Philippines' first medal in weightlifting at the Asian Games after Olympic champion Hidilyn Diaz finished fourth in the women's 59kg weight class yesterday, October 2.

text: Antes ang Asiad, pamilyar na si Ando sa 64kg nga weight class bangud nga nakadaog man siya sang silver sa amo nga division sa Asian Weightlifting Championships sang 2020.
english: Before the Asiad, Ando was familiar with the 64kg weight class as he also won silver in that division at the Asian Weightlifting Championships in 2020.

text: Photo by Ishara S. KODIKARA / AFP
english: Photo by Ishara S. KODIKARA / AFP

text: Ginmanduan ni Police Regional Office VI director Brigadier General Josefino Ligan ang mga pulis sa Western Visayas nga magbantay gid ilabi na sa mga establisyemento komersyal kadungan sang pagsugod sang ber months.
english: Police Regional Office VI director Brigadier General Josefino Ligan has ordered police officers in Western Visayas to be vigilant especially in commercial establishments during the beginning of the ber months.

text: Ini agud malikawan ang economic crimes kaangay sang pagpangawat kag pagpang-hold-up.
english: This is to prevent economic crimes such as theft and hold-up.

text: Kasunod sang hold-up incident sa parking area sang isa ka mall sa Mandurriao, nauna naman ini naghatag sang direktiba nga magpatigayon sang security conference kaupod sa mall guards kag security managers para nga malikawan ang kaangay sini nga mga krimen sa holiday season.
english: Following the hold-up incident in the parking area of ​​a mall in Mandurriao, he earlier directed to hold a security conference with mall guards and security managers to prevent such crimes during the holiday season.

text: Kabahin man ini suno sa iya sang preparasyon na sang kapulisan para sa Paskuwa.
english: He said this is also part of the police's preparations for Easter.

text: “Huwag nating ilagay sa ating isip na pagka-ber month, dadami din yan [ang economic crimes.] Anong gagawin natin?
english: “Let's not put it in our minds that being a ber month, it will also increase [economic crimes.] What will we do?

text: Ibubuhos natin ang tao natin sa mga possible places na magkakaroon ng krimen especially doon sa mga business establishments,” suno sa police official.
english: We will deploy our personnel to possible places where there will be crime especially in business establishments,” the police official said.

text: Nauna naman nga ginpahayag pareho sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) kag Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga ginpasangkad na ang ila nga visibility sa mga mall, transport terminals, tourist spots, kag iban pa nga mga matawo nga mga lugar.
english: Earlier, both the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) and the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) said they have expanded their visibility in malls, transport terminals, tourist spots, and other crowded places.

text: Padayunon sang Police Regional Office (PRO) VI ang five-minute response policy nga isa sa mga ginplastar nga pagsulundan sang yara pa sa pwesto si former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO) VI will continue the five-minute response policy which was one of the rules put in place when former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III.
english: Nicolas Torre III.

text: Suno kay PRO 6 Regional Director Police Brig.
english: According to PRO 6 Regional Director Police Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Josefino Ligan, ang madasig nga pagresponde ang nakabutang man gihapon sa 1st-point agenda sang bag-o nga PNP Chief nga amo ang enhanced management of police operations.
english: Josefino Ligan, the rapid response is still on the 1st-point agenda of the new PNP Chief which is enhanced management of police operations.

text: Pahayag sini, adlaw-adlaw sa gihapon ang simulation exercise ukon simex para masiguro nga makadul-ong sang madasig kag epektibo nga pag-responde sa mga emerhensya kag kun may public safety concerns.
english: He said the simulation exercise or simex is still conducted daily to ensure that it can deliver a quick and effective response to emergencies and public safety concerns.

text: Kaangot naman sa internal discipline sa mga pulis, ginpaathag sang regional director nga wala siya nanamian sa nangin liderato kag superbisyon sang anay hepe sang Janiuay Municipal Police Station nga si Police Captain Hector Ayagan.
english: Regarding internal discipline among the police, the regional director explained that he is not satisfied with the leadership and supervision of former Janiuay Municipal Police Station chief Police Captain Hector Ayagan.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa ginpa-islan niya ini kasunod sang iya ginhimo nga inspeksyon.
english: This is why he had it replaced following his inspection.

text: Ginsaylo si Ayagan sa Iloilo Police Provincial Office Headquarters; samtang nagbulos naman si Police Captain Marlon Perez bilang hepe sang Janiuay.
english: Ayagan was transferred to the Iloilo Police Provincial Office Headquarters; while Police Captain Marlon Perez took over as Janiuay chief.

text: Duha ka empleyado sang city hall ang patay kag lima ang pilason sa shooting incident sa Silay City, Negros Occidental subong nga adlaw ang eleksyon.
english: Two city hall employees were killed and five others injured in a shooting incident in Silay City, Negros Occidental on election day.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nagapangape ang mga biktima sang ginpaulanan sang luthang sang mga suspek nga sakay sang van.
english: According to reports, the victims were having coffee when the suspects in the van opened fire.

text: Ginpahayag nga yara sa duty ang mga biktima para mag- monitor sang ano man nga vote buying incidents sa lugar.
english: The victims were reportedly on duty to monitor any vote buying incidents in the area.

text: Gintumod naman nga suspek ang isa ka punong barangay.
english: A barangay captain was identified as the suspect.

text: Naglunsar naman sang hot pursuit operation batok sa suspek.
english: A hot pursuit operation was launched against the suspect.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa ospital ang mga pilason.
english: The injured remain in hospital.

text: Nagtumbo sa kalipay ang Filipino professional boxer nga si Eumir Marcial matapos nakasulod na sa semifinals sang men’s 80kg weight class sa boksing sa 19th Asian Games!
english: Filipino professional boxer Eumir Marcial jumped for joy after entering the semifinals of the men's 80kg weight class in boxing at the 19th Asian Games!

text: Sigurado naman nga makadala si Marcial sang bronze medal sa pagpauli sa Pilipinas matapos sini gintumba ang kasumpong nga si Weerapon Jongjoho sa second round sa quarterfinals.
english: Marcial is sure to bring a bronze medal home to the Philippines after he knocked out his opponent Weerapon Jongjoho in the second round of the quarterfinals.

text: Antes ang knockout, duha-duha ang kadalag-an para kay Marcial matapos nga nalutos ini sa first round bangud sa nagtagasak nga pagtupa sang sumbag sang iya kasumpong sa iya nga nawong nga rason nga gin-isipan siya sang referee sang walo ka segundos.
english: Before the knockout, the victory was in doubt for Marcial after he lost in the first round due to his opponent's punch falling on his face which caused the referee to count him for eight seconds.

text: Gin-ako ni Marcial nga nagpakuno-kuno lamang siya nga masarangan niya ang kusog ni Jongjoho agud nga indi pag-untaton ang sambuwa, apang sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, nahilo siya sang nagtupa ang inumol sini sa sentro gid sang iya nga nawong.
english: Marcial admitted that he only pretended to be able to handle Jongjoho's strength in order not to stop the fight, but in fact, he said, he was poisoned when his sword fell in the center of his face.

text: Indi hamak nga mas mataas kag mas daku ang Thai suno pa kay Marcial.
english: Marcial said Thai is taller and bigger.

text: Pag-abot sa second round, ginsiling sang Pinoy boxer nga samtang nagalantaw siya sa oras, ibubo na niya ang tanan kag tumbahon ang iya Thai opponent.
english: When it came to the second round, the Filipino boxer said that while he was watching the clock, he would pour everything and knock out his Thai opponent.

text: Makit-an kun paano sini gin-set up kag ginpeke ang straight punch, nakapangita sang tyempo kag ginpatupa ang right hook nga nagtumba kay Jongjoho 14 segundos ang nabilin sa second round.
english: You can see how he set up and faked a straight punch, found time and landed a right hook that knocked Jongjoho down with 14 seconds left in the second round.

text: Bronze medalist si Marcial sa Tokyo Olympics sang 2021 kag bronze medalist man sa men’s 75kg sa Asian Games 2018 apang mas mataas nga weight class ang gin-intrahan sini subong nga edisyon sang Asiad.
english: Marcial was a bronze medalist at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021 and also a bronze medalist in the men’s 75kg at the 2018 Asian Games but he competed in a higher weight class this edition of the Asiad.

text: Sunod nga atubangon ni Marcial si Ahmad Ghousoon sang Syria sa semis.
english: Marcial will next face Ahmad Ghousoon of Syria in the semis.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang finalists lamang sa 80kg class sa Asiad ang makakuha sang pwesto para sa Paris Olympics sa 2024.
english: It is known that only the finalists in the 80kg class in Asiad will get a place for the Paris Olympics in 2024.

text: Magasaka na sa kumpetisyon sa 19th Asian Games subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 2, ang labing-una nga Olympic champion sang Pilipinas nga si Hidilyn Diaz.
english: The Philippines' first-ever Olympic champion Hidilyn Diaz will compete in the 19th Asian Games today, October 2.

text: Ang 32-anyos nga weightlifting star halin sa Zambonga City ang nagatuyo nga makakuha sang sunod-sunod nga gold medal matapos nga nabulsa man ang bulawan nga medalya sa Asian Games sa Jakarta sang 2018 sa 55-kg.
english: The 32-year-old weightlifting star from Zambonga City aims to win back-to-back gold medals after also pocketing the gold medal at the Asian Games in Jakarta in 2018 in the 55-kg category.

text: division.
english: division.

text: Apang subong nga adlaw, daku ang pagpanghangkat kay Diaz bangud magasaka ini sa 59-kg.
english: Today, however, Diaz faces a big challenge as he moves up to 59-kg.

text: women’s division bangud nga wala na sang 55kg.
english: women’s division because there is no 55kg.

text: sa Paris Olympics sa 2024.
english: at the Paris Olympics in 2024.

text: Kun balikan, sang nagligad nga sinemana, nagpasakop si Diaz sa amo nga division sa 2023 World Championships sa Riyadh apang nagpang-pito lamang ini sa ranking.
english: Last week, Diaz competed in the division at the 2023 World Championships in Riyadh but finished seventh in the ranking.

text: Sa sini nga kumpetisyon, tinguhaan sini nga makakuha sang slot para sa iya nga ika-lima nga sunod-sunod nga pag-qualify sa Olympiada.
english: In this competition, she will try to earn a slot for her fifth consecutive Olympiada qualification.

text: Ginkondena ni Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum ang ginpatuman ni US President Donald Trump nga 25% tariff sa imports halin sa Mexico.
english: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has condemned US President Donald Trump's 25% tariff on imports from Mexico.

text: Suno sa Mexican president, wala sang justification para sa amo nga taripa kag magabalos diri ang Mexico bangud apektado ang ila mga pumuluyo.
english: According to the Mexican president, there is no justification for the tariff and Mexico will retaliate because its citizens are affected.

text: Ang lihok ni Trump ang ginpatuman matapos ang inisyal nga 30-day nga pagpaiway sini sang tion nga nagapatigayon ang Mexican officials sang pagpakigsugilanon sa Washington.
english: Trump's move came after an initial 30-day suspension while Mexican officials were holding talks in Washington.

text: Gindeklarar ni Trump nga napaslawan ang Mexico, amo man ang China kag Canada nga maghimo sang tikang nga punggan ang pagsulod sang deadly fentanyl opioid kag ang mga precursor chemicals pasulod sa US.
english: Trump declared that Mexico, as well as China and Canada have failed to take steps to stop the entry of the deadly fentanyl opioid and its precursor chemicals into the US.

text: Suno kay Sheinbaum, magapagwa ini sang detalye sa sabat sang Mexico kalakip na ang retaliatory tariffs sa Domingo.
english: Sheinbaum said he will release details on Mexico's response including retaliatory tariffs on Sunday.

text: Sa bahin sang China, nagsabat ini paagi sa pagdugang sang taripa nga 10%-15% sa pila ka US imports umpisa sa Marso 10 kag ang serye sang ag-o nga export restrictions para sa designated US entities.
english: On the Chinese side, it responded by increasing tariffs of 10%-15% on some US imports starting March 10 and a series of new export restrictions for designated US entities.

text: Gindugang man sini nga nagpasaka na ini sang complaints sa World Trade Organization angot sa polisa ni Trump.
english: He added that he has already filed complaints with the World Trade Organization regarding Trump's policy.

text: Sa bahin naman sang  Canada, ginsiling ni Prime Minister Justin Trudeau nga magapatuman ini sang 25% tariffs sa C$30 billion nga balor sang US imports effective immediately.
english: As for Canada, Prime Minister Justin Trudeau said it will impose 25% tariffs on C$30 billion worth of US imports effective immediately.

text: Posible nga maglawig pa tubtub sa bulan sang Oktubre ang pagpatuman sang price ceiling nga P41 kada kilo sa regular milled rice kag 45 kada kilo sa well-milled rice.
english: The implementation of the price ceiling of P41 per kilo for regular milled rice and 45 per kilo for well-milled rice is likely to be extended until October.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban, may rekomendasyon na nga napasaka kay President kag Agriculture Secretary Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: According to Agriculture Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban, a recommendation has already been submitted to President and Agriculture Secretary Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: apang wala pa sang napaguwa nga desisyon kun aprubado na ang amo nga proposal.
english: but no decision has been issued on whether the proposal will be approved.

text: Pahayag pa ni Panganiban, mahimo magpabilin ang price cap bisan pa nga mag-umpisa na ang tag-alani sang humay ukon tubtub nga magbalik sa P38 kada kilo ang retail price sang bugas.
english: Panganiban said the price cap may remain in place even after the rice harvest begins or until the retail price of rice returns to P38 per kilo.

text: Mahimo man ini magpabilin suno sa iya samtang nga nagabulig ini sa mga konsumidor.
english: It can also stay, he said, while it helps consumers.

text: Septyembre 5 sang ginpatuman ang price cap kag sandig sa inisyal nga plano, ipatuman lamang ini sa sulod sang isa ka bulan.
english: The price cap was implemented on September 5 and according to the initial plan, it will only be implemented for one month.

text: May yara man sang P15,000 nga cash assistance nga ginhatag sa rice retailers nga apektado sang price ceiling.
english: There was also P15,000 cash assistance given to rice retailers affected by the price ceiling.

text: Apang gin-ako ni Panganiban nga subong, wala pa sang desisyon kun padayunon ang pagpanagtag sang ayuda pananglitan magapadayon man ang pagpatuman sang price ceiling.
english: However, Panganiban acknowledged that at present, there is no decision on whether to continue the distribution of aid if the implementation of the price ceiling will continue.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Panganiban ang baliskad sa una ginpahayag ni National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Arsenio Balisacan nga malapit na lang bawion ang price cap bangud madamo na ang naga-ani sang humay sa bulan sang Oktubre.
english: Panganiban's statement is contrary to National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Arsenio Balisacan's earlier statement that the price cap will soon be lifted because many people are already harvesting rice in October.

text: Matapos ang madinalag-on nga operasyon sang kapulisan sa pagdakop sang suspek nga nanghold-up sa SM City Iloilo sa Mandurriao, ginpabutyag ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang iya pasalamat kag suporta paagi sa personal nga pagbisita sa ICPO kag paghatag sang padya sa mga otoridad nga nagresolba sang insidente.
english: After the successful operation of the police to arrest the suspect who robbed SM City Iloilo in Mandurriao, Mayor Raisa Treñas expressed her gratitude and support by personally visiting the ICPO and giving rewards to the authorities who resolved the incident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Mayor Treñas, ginpahayag niya nga nagapasalamat gid ang alkalde sa kapulisan kag mga operating groups nga nangin epektibo sa pag-pin down sang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the mayor is grateful to the police and operating groups who were effective in pinning down the suspect.

text: Suno sa iya, dako gid nga bulig ang mga CCTV nga nahamtang sa SM parking area, nga nakabulig sa pagmonitor sang aktibidad sang suspek.
english: He said the CCTV cameras located in the SM parking area, which helped monitor the activities of the suspect, were a great help.

text: Ginpahanumdom man ni Fantilaga-Gorzal ang mga private sectors nga i-review ang ila security plans kag CCTV systems, bangud may yara sang existing ordinance nga nagamando sang pagpahamtang sang CCTV indi lang sa sulod sang establisemento kundi pati sa sawga ukon palibot sang lugar, kag dapat ‘high resolution’ ini.
english: Fantilaga-Gorzal also reminded the private sectors to review their security plans and CCTV systems, as there is an existing ordinance that mandates the installation of CCTV not only inside the establishment but also in the yard or surrounding area, and it should be 'high resolution'

text: Gin-anunsyo man nga may P50,000 nga reward para sa kapulisan ukon mga tawo nga nagbulig sa pagresolba sang insidente, bilang pagkilala sa ila serbisyo kag agud ma ‘boost’ ang morale sang mga otoridad.
english: A P50,000 reward was also announced for the police or people who helped resolve the incident, in recognition of their service and to boost the morale of the authorities.

text: Matandaan nga kagab-i, nagpadulong si Mayor Treñas sa opisina ni Iloilo City Police Office Director PCol.
english: Last night, Mayor Treñas visited the office of Iloilo City Police Office Director PCol.

text: Kim Legada kadungan sang pagkadakop sa suspek nga naghold-up kay Dr. Lulu Salinas sa SM City Iloilo car park kag nadakpan ang suspek sa Bo.
english: Kim Legada while arresting the suspect who robbed Dr. Lulu Salinas in SM City Iloilo car park and the suspect was arrested in Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz.
english: Obrero, Lapuz.

text: Ginpakita sang alkalde ang iya suporta sa kapulisan paagi sa personal nga presensya kag pagpakig-angut sa mga nagpatigayon sang operasyon kag ginpabutyag man nga importante ang koordinasyon sa tunga sang city government kag mga otoridad agud mapabaskog pa ang seguridad sa syudad.
english: The mayor showed his support to the police through his personal presence and interaction with those who conducted the operation and also expressed the importance of coordination between the city government and the authorities to further strengthen security in the city.

text: Gin-release ni Pope Francis ang iya Pope Video agud updan ang iya prayer intention sa bulan sang Marso nga nagapang-agda sa tanan nga magpangamuyo para sa mga pamilya nga nagaatubang sang krisis.
english: Pope Francis released his Pope Video to accompany his prayer intention for the month of March that invites everyone to pray for families facing crisis.

text: Kabahin sang panawagan ni Pope Francis amo nga magpangamuyo para sa mga naguba nga pamilya nga madiskubrehan nila ang bulong sa ila mga pilas paagi sa pagpatawad, pagdiskubre liwat sang regalo sang isa kag isa bisan sa ila mga kinalain kag kinaiya.
english: Part of Pope Francis’ call is to pray for broken families that they may discover healing to their wounds through forgiveness, rediscovering the gift of one another even in their differences and quirks.

text: Gin-record sang Pope ang audio para sa video antes siya gin-admit sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma sang February 14, kun sa diin padayon siya nga nagabaton sang treatment para sa bilateral pneumonia.
english: The Pope recorded the audio for the video before he was admitted to the Gemelli Hospital in Rome on February 14, where he continues to receive treatment for bilateral pneumonia.

text: Maga-abanse na ang pares nga sanday Alex Eala kag Francis Casey “Nino” Alcantara sa semifinals sang mixed doubles sang tennis sa 19th Asian Games.
english: Alex Eala and Francis Casey “Nino” Alcantara will advance to the semifinals of mixed doubles tennis at the 19th Asian Games.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos ang players sang Thailand nga sanday Luksika Kumkhum kag Maximus Jones, 6-4, 6-4, sa isa ka oras kag 19 minutos nga hampang sa quarterfinals sa Hangzhou, China.
english: This after defeating Thailand players Luksika Kumkhum and Maximus Jones, 6-4, 6-4, in an hour and 19 minutes match in the quarterfinals in Hangzhou, China.

text: Bangud sini, sigurado na sanday Eala kag Alcantara nga makapadala pauli sang bronze medal sa Asiad.
english: As a result, Eala and Alcantara are sure to send home a bronze medal at the Asiad.

text: Sunod nila nga atubangon ang Chinese Taipei sa amo nga event.
english: They will next face Chinese Taipei in the event.

Photo Courtesy: Philippine Sports Commission

Ang kadalag-an sang Filipino pair ang natabo pila ka oras lamang matapos nalutos ang 18-anyos nga si Eala sa tatlo ka oras nga women’s single tennis semis match kun sa diin nag-settle lamang ini sa bronze medal.
english:
Photo Courtesy: Philippine Sports Commission

The Filipino pair's victory came just hours after 18-year-old Eala was defeated in a three-hour women's single tennis semis match where she settled for the bronze medal.

text: Target sang Filipino players nga mabulsa ang gold medal sa mixed doubles event nga kun matabo amo ang mangin labing-una sa maragtas sang Pilipinas sa Asian Games.
english: The Filipino players target to pocket the gold medal in the mixed doubles event which if it happens will be the first in the history of the Philippines in the Asian Games.

text: Sang 1966, nakadaog ang Pilipinas sang silver medal paagi kanday Patricia Yngayo kag Federico Deyro.
english: In 1966, the Philippines won the silver medal with Patricia Yngayo and Federico Deyro.

text: Nagapamatok ang mga manufacturers sa tikang sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga i-postpone anay kag i-schedule lamang sa masunod nga tuig ang saka-presyo sa mga sardinas kag iban nga basic commodities.
english: Manufacturers are opposed to the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)'s move to postpone and schedule the price increase for sardines and other basic commodities for next year.

text: Suno kay Canned Sardines Association of the Philippines (CSAP) executive director Francisco Buencamino, ipahayag niya subong nga adlaw kay Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual ang iya nga rason kun ngaa nagapangindi sila sa amo nga plano.
english: Canned Sardines Association of the Philippines (CSAP) executive director Francisco Buencamino said he will explain today to Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual his reasons why they are rejecting the plan.

text: Suno kay Buencamino, apektado man ang manufacturers sang sardinas sang ginapatuman nga oil price hike, pagnubo sa balor sang peso, kag pagsaka sa presyo sang lata.
english: According to Buencamino, sardine manufacturers are also affected by the oil price hike, the depreciation of the peso, and the increase in the price of cans.

text: Ang suggested retail price (SRP) sang sardinas ang yara lamang sa P18.50 kada isa apang ang aktwal ang dapat nga yara sa P23 kag P24 kada lata suno pa sa opisyal.
english: The suggested retail price (SRP) of sardines is only P18.50 each but the actual price should be P23 and P24 per can, the official said.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga dapat mahatag man ang gobyerno sang fuel subsidies sa mga sakayan nga nagapangisda.
english: He also said the government should also provide fuel subsidies to fishing vessels.

text: “Fishing vessels and boats consume a lot of fuel.
english: “Fishing vessels and boats consume a lot of fuel.

text: The ice plants should also be given discounts.
english: The ice plants should also be given discounts.

text: It could help.
english: It could help.

text: There are ways.
english: There are ways.

text: I do not know how they can talk to MOPS or Mean of Platts Singapore on how to soften the changes (in the fuel prices) to address the unabated spike,” pahayag sini.
english: I do not know how they can talk to MOPS or Mean of Platts Singapore on how to soften the changes (in the fuel prices) to address the unabated spike,” it said.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang DTI and Industry nga 14 manufacturers sang basic necessities and prime commodities ang nag-file sang petisyon nga pasakaan ang presyo sang ila nga mga produkto.
english: Earlier, the DTI and Industry said 14 manufacturers of basic necessities and prime commodities filed a petition to increase the price of their products.

text: Sa tunga sang tensyon kag kahadlok nga dala sang pagpanghold-up nga nagluntad SM City Iloilo sa Mandurriao, ginpakita ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang iya simpatiya paagi sa personal nga pagpakig-angut sa pamilya sang suspek.
english: Amid the tension and fear brought about by the hold-up that occurred at SM City Iloilo in Mandurriao, Mayor Raisa Treñas expressed her sympathy through personal contact with the family of the suspect.

text: Kadungan sang ila pagbisita sa opisina ni Iloilo City Police Office Director PCol.
english: During their visit to the office of Iloilo City Police Office Director PCol.

text: Kim Legada, ginpabutyag sang alkalde ang iya kabalaka matapos gindakop ang suspek.
english: Kim Legada, the mayor expressed his concern after the arrest of the suspect.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagpamaba ni Mayor Treñas, ginpahayag niya nga ginmonitor sang alkalde ang insidente suno sa marching order nga dapat maresolba sa sulod sang 48 ka oras.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the mayor monitored the incident according to the marching order that should be resolved within 48 hours.

text: Sang ginpabalo sila sang ICPO, wala na sang pagduwa-duwa kag gilayon nga nagpadulong si Mayor Treñas sa headquarters.
english: When the ICPO informed them, Mayor Treñas did not hesitate and immediately went to the headquarters.

text: Gin-istorya ni Treñas ang suspek kun ngaa ginhimo ang krimen, kag nakig-istorya man siya sa utod, asawa, kag pamilya sang suspek.
english: Treñas told the suspect why he committed the crime, and he also spoke to the suspect's brother, wife, and family.

text: Suno pa kay Fantilaga-Gorzal, nangin emosyonal ang asawa sang suspek, kag gilayon nga ginlaygayan ni Mayor Treñas nga handa ang city government magbulig sa ila kun ano man ang ila kinahanglanon.
english: According to Fantilaga-Gorzal, the suspect's wife became emotional, and Mayor Treñas immediately advised that the city government is ready to help them whatever they need.

text: Apang ginpabutyag man sang alkalde nga dapat sabton sang bana sini ang iya ginhimo bangud may nabiktima.
english: But the mayor also said that her husband should answer for what he did because there was a victim.

text: Ginreport sang Holy See Press Office sa Vatican nga nagapabilin nga stable ang kondisyon ni Pope Francis.
english: The Holy See Press Office at the Vatican reported that Pope Francis remains in stable condition.

text: Suno sa Holy See, wala nakaeksperyensiya ang santo papa sang episodes sang respiratory failure ukon bronchospasm.
english: According to the Holy See, the pope has not experienced episodes of respiratory failure or bronchospasm.

text: Dugang pa, wala man sang hilanat ang Pope, nagapabilin nga alerto, nagakooperar sa mga therapies, kag nakahibalo sa nagakatabo sa iya palibot.
english: In addition, the Pope does not have a fever, remains alert, cooperates with therapies, and is aware of what is happening around him.

text: Nag-transition naman ini sa high-flow oxygen therapy kag nagpaidalom sa respiratory physiotherapy.
english: He transitioned to high-flow oxygen therapy and underwent respiratory physiotherapy.

text: May yara man sang ini scheduled non-invasive mechanical ventilation.
english: There was also ini scheduled non-invasive mechanical ventilation.

text: Pila sa aktibidad sini sa ospital amo ang pagpangamuyo kag pagpahuway kag nagbaton man ini sang Eukaristiya.
english: Some of his activities in the hospital were prayer and rest and he also received the Eucharist.

text: Ginsunog sang wala pa makilal-an nga mga indibidwal ang media service van sang former president sang Cagayan de Oro Press Club nga si Manuel Jaudian.
english: Unidentified individuals set fire to the media service van of former president of the Cagayan de Oro Press Club, Manuel Jaudian.

text: Natabo ini sa banwa sang Sagay sa Camiguin.
english: This happened in the town of Sagay in Camiguin.

text: Suno kay Jaudian, may nakit-an siya kag ang fire personnel sang plastic container kag ginhimo nga makeshift torch para sa ignition, emitting flammable vapor/odor.
english: According to Jaudian, he and the fire personnel found a plastic container and turned it into a makeshift torch for ignition, emitting flammable vapor/odor.

text: Gintawag naman ni Cagayan de Oro Press Club president Froilan Gallardo nga isa ka akto sang terorismo batok sa free press kag ginsiling nga indi sila magpapahog sa amo ng pagpang-atake.
english: Cagayan de Oro Press Club president Froilan Gallardo called it an act of terrorism against the free press and said they will not be threatened by the attack.

text: Natumba ang backhoe nga ginagamit sang Alpha & Omega Gen.
english: The backhoe used by Alpha & Omega Gen.

text: Contractor & Dev’t Corporation sa ginatukod nga flood control project sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Contractor & Dev't Corporation in the construction of flood control project in Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang Alpha and Omega ang isa sa siyam ka mga construction companies nga ginapanag-iyahan sang contractor nga si Sara Discaya.
english: Alpha and Omega is one of nine construction companies owned by contractor Sara Discaya.

text: Nahibaluan sang damlag lang, isa ini sa ginkuhaan sang lisensya sang Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB).
english: Recently, it was learned that it was one of those whose license was revoked by the Philippine Contractors Accreditation Board (PCAB).

text: Gamiton ni Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi ang Miss Universe stage agud matib-ong ang iya kawsa para sa mga kabataan.
english: Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi will use the Miss Universe stage to promote her cause for children.

text: Suno sa Filipino-Italian beauty queen, madugay na siya nga nagatrabaho kaupod sa isa ka organisasyon nga nagafocus sa pagtapna sang kagutom kag malnutrition sa mga kabataan.
english: According to the Filipino-Italian beauty queen, she has been working with an organization that focuses on preventing hunger and malnutrition among children.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nakadtuan niya ang nagkalain lain nga malayo nga lugar sa Pilipinas kag nabatian ang nagkalain lain nga istorya sang mga kabataan.
english: He also said that he has visited various remote areas in the Philippines and heard various stories of children.

text: Ginpasalig man sini ang pageant fans nga naka-set ang iya pinsar sa korona kag nakahanda siya indi lamang para sa pageant walk kag question-and-answer portion kundi sa tanan nga aspeto.
english: She also assured the pageant fans that her mind is set on the crown and she is ready not only for the pageant walk and question-and-answer portion but in all aspects.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini nga apat ka tuig ang iya ginhulat antes siya makaangkon sang maayo nga English speaking skills.
english: She shared that it took her four years to acquire good English speaking skills.

text: Ini bangud sa Italya siya nagdaku kag nagsaylo lamang sa Pilipinas sang 2018 kag ginpursue ang iya nga karera sa pageants paagi sa pagtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa Miss Earth stage.
english: This is because she grew up in Italy and only moved to the Philippines in 2018 and pursued her career in pageants by representing the Philippines on the Miss Earth stage.

text: Maga-compete si Celeste sa Enero 14, 2023 sa New Orleans, Louisiana, United States.
english: Celeste will compete on January 14, 2023 in New Orleans, Louisiana, United States.

english: If Celeste wins, she will be the fifth Miss Universe from the Philippines, after Catriona Gray who was crowned in 2018.

text: Magapakigkita ang pila ka mga myembro sang Kamara sa mga tiglawas nagikan sa oil industry agud nga makahimo sang win-win solution sa tunga sang asud-asud nga semana sang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong.
english: Some members of the House of Representatives will meet with representatives from the oil industry to come up with a win-win solution amid the weeks of rising fuel prices.

text: Ang imbitado sa pagsinapol sa Batasang Pambansa Complex sa Quezon City subong nga adlaw amo ang mga myembro sang House Committee on Energy, mga opisyal sang Department of Energy kag mga tiglawas sang industry groups nga Independent Philippine Petroleum Companies Association kag Philippine Institute of Petroleum.
english: Invited to the meeting at the Batasang Pambansa Complex in Quezon City today were members of the House Committee on Energy, Department of Energy officials and representatives of industry groups the Independent Philippine Petroleum Companies Association and the Philippine Institute of Petroleum.

text: Yara man ang mga representatives sang dalagku nga kumpaniya sang produktong-petrolyo diri sa pungsod kaangay sang Petron Corp., Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp., Chevron Philippines Inc., Total Philippines Corp.
english: Also present were representatives of major petroleum products companies in the country such as Petron Corp., Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp., Chevron Philippines Inc., Total Philippines Corp.

text: Apang sa amo nga pagsinapol suno sa natungdan, ang istoryahan amo ang paagi kag mga suhestyon kun paano mapahagan-hagan ang epekto sini sa Filipinos kag magpangita sang common ground sa areas kun sa diin may kontrol pa ang gobyerno.
english: However, during the meeting, he said, the discussion will focus on ways and suggestions on how to mitigate the impact of this on Filipinos and find common ground in areas where the government still has control.

text: Lakip sa ginalantaw nga posibilidad amo ang pag-review sang excise tax ukon ang value-added tax sa oil kag petroleum products — depende sa plano sang Malacañang kun mapasa na sang Kamara ang report pagkatapos sang ila nga meeting.
english: Among the possibilities being considered is the review of the excise tax or the value-added tax on oil and petroleum products — depending on Malacañang's plan when the House passes the report after their meeting.

english: Another plan is to convince manufacturers to postpone the implementation of price increases on basic food commodities as a result of the increase in the price of petroleum products.

english: It is known that the price increase to be implemented tomorrow is the 11th consecutive week that there is an increase in the price of fuel here in the Philippines.

text: Ginabanta nga 37 ka mga pasahero ang patay sa bungguanay sang duha ka depampasahero nga bus sa highway sa Bolivia.
english: At least 37 passengers have been killed in a collision between two passenger buses on a highway in Bolivia.

text: Lakip sa mga napatay ang 5 ka Peruvian nationals, isa ka 3-anyos nga German national nga bata, kag 7 ka menor de edad.
english: Among the dead were 5 Peruvian nationals, a 3-year-old German national child, and 7 minors.

text: May 41 naman ka iban pa ang pilason.
english: Forty-one others were injured.

text: Ginpahayag nga hubog ang driver sang isa ka bus nga posible nangin rason sang aksidente.
english: The driver of a bus was reportedly drunk which may have caused the accident.

text: Indi pa maathag nalakip sa mga napatay ang mga driver sang duha ka bus.
english: It is not clear whether the drivers of the two buses were among the dead.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Ini naman ang ginakabig nga pinakamalala nga aksidente sa Bolivia subong nga tuig.
english: This is considered the worst accident in Bolivia this year.

text: Nagtipon subong nga Undas ang madamo nga mga tagasuporta sang pamilya Aquino agud mag-hatag sang bulak sa pantyon sang mga nagtaliwan nga mga lider sa pungsod nga nakahamtang sa Manila Memorial Park sa Sucat, Parañaque.
english: Many supporters of the Aquino family gathered this Undas to lay flowers at the graves of the late leaders of the country located at the Manila Memorial Park in Sucat, Parañaque.

text: Magkaupod ang pantyon nanday anay Pres.
english: The graves of former Pres.

text: Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III, anay Pres.
english: Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III, former Pres.

text: Corazon “Cory” Aquino, kag anay Senador Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., nga lunsay mga importante nga papel sa kasaysayan sang demokrasya sa Pilipinas.
english: Corazon “Cory” Aquino, and former Senator Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., both of whom played important roles in the history of democracy in the Philippines.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 1, nasiplatan ang pagdugok sang mga tagasuporta nga nagdala sang nasari-sari nga bulak bilang pagselebrar kag pagdumdom sa mga Aquino.
english: Today, November 1, there was a gathering of supporters who brought various flowers in celebration and remembrance of the Aquinos.

text: Magluwas sa mga indibidwal nga offer, manotisyar man ang duha ka bugkos sang bulak nga naghalin kay Pres.
english: Aside from the individual offers, two bouquets of flowers from Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Jr., bilang simbolo sang respeto sa mga anay lider.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Jr., as a symbol of respect for former leaders.

text: Ang pamilya Aquino ang kilala sa ila kontribusyon sa pagpabalik sang demokrasya sa pungsod, halin sa sakripisyo ni Ninoy Aquino sang panahon sang diktadurya, tubtob sa liderato ni Cory Aquino bilang una nga babayi nga presidente sang Pilipinas, kag ang administrasyon ni Noynoy Aquino nga nagtutok sa kampanya batok korapsyon.
english: The Aquino family is known for their contributions to the restoration of democracy in the country, from Ninoy Aquino's sacrifice during the dictatorship, to Cory Aquino's leadership as the first female president of the Philippines, and the Noynoy Aquino administration's focus on the anti-corruption campaign.

text: Sa pihak sang kasaysayan sang pulitika sa tunga sang mga Aquino kag Marcos, ang pag-offer sang bulak halin sa subong nga Presidente ang ginalantaw sang iban bilang tikang padulong sa pagrespeto sa nagliligad.
english: Despite the political history between the Aquinos and the Marcoses, the flower offering from the current President is seen by some as a step towards respect for the past.

text: Nadiskubrehan sang Iloilo City Government nga wala sang Mayor’s Permit ang flood control projects nga ginapatigayon sang duwa ka mga kompaniya nga ginapanag-iyahan sang mag-asawa nga Sara kag Pacifico Discaya.

english: The City Treasurer's Office is continuing its on-site monitoring and inspections of infrastructure projects in the city to ensure that contractors secure proper permits and comply with the law.

english: According to the mayor, this initiative is being done to protect the public interest and ensure that all government projects in the city are legal and proper.

text: Nag-develop na sa bagyo ang isa ka low pressure area (LPA) sa guwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: A low pressure area (LPA) outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) has developed into a typhoon.

text: Sa latest bulletin sang state weather bureau, nakit-an ang tropical depression sa kalayuon nga 1,425 kilometers nasidlangan sang northeastern Mindanao.
english: In the latest bulletin of the state weather bureau, the tropical depression was found at a distance of 1,425 kilometers east of northeastern Mindanao.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 45 km/h kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 55 km/h. Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 15 km/h.

Magasulod ini sa PAR buwas sa aga ukon sa hapon kag kun diri na sa Pilipinas, pagatawgon ini nga Bagyo Tino.
english:
It brought winds of 45 km/h and gusts of up to 55 km/h. It is moving westward at a speed of 15 km/h.

It will enter the PAR tomorrow morning or afternoon and when it is here in the Philippines, it will be called Typhoon Tino.

text: Sa sulod sang PAR, magahulag si Tino pa-nakatundan samtang yara sa Philippine Sea.
english: Within the PAR, Tino will move westward while in the Philippine Sea.

text: Sa forecast track, ang sentro sini maga-landfall sa Caraga ukon sa Eastern Visayas sa Martes sang aga.
english: According to the forecast track, its center will landfall in Caraga or Eastern Visayas on Tuesday morning.

text: Magatabok ini sa Visayas kag Palawan sa tunga-tunga sang Martes kag Myerkules; kag pagkatapos, magatuhaw liwat sa West Philippine Sea sa Myerkules sang aga ukon sa hapon.
english: It will cross the Visayas and Palawan between Tuesday and Wednesday; and thereafter, reappear in the West Philippine Sea on Wednesday morning or late afternoon.

text: Magabaskog si Tino samtang yara sa Philippine Sea kag mahimo makalab-ot sa typhoon category sa Martes.
english: Tino will strengthen while in the Philippine Sea and could reach the typhoon category on Tuesday.

text: Base sa intensity forecast, ang pinakamataas nga wind signal ang mahimo magdangat sa Wind Signal No.
english: Based on the intensity forecast, the highest wind signal may reach Wind Signal No.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, manubo ang tyansa nga mangin bagyo ang LPA nga diri sa sulod sang PAR.
english: On the other hand, the LPA has a low chance of becoming a typhoon within the PAR.

text: Sa kabug-usan, ang bilog nga Visayas ang maka-eksperyensya sang magal-umon nga may mga lapta-lapta nga pag-ulan ukon thunderstorms bangud sa Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).
english: Overall, the entire Visayas will experience cloudy weather with patchy rain or thunderstorms due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).

text: Posible nga malab-ot pa ang Pilipinas sa South America agud lamang nga maka-import sang bugas.
english: It is possible that the Philippines will reach South America just to import rice.

english: A statement was released that the two officials are looking into the possibility of rice importation but no details were added.

english: 2.33 million metric tons of rice have been imported this year, 4.46 percent from Thailand and 89.85 percent from Vietnam.

text: Naagaw na sang Pilipinas sa China ang pwesto sa nagapanguna nga rice importer sa bilog nga kalibutan!
english: The Philippines has taken over from China as the world's leading rice importer!

text: Sandig sa report sang United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) nga may titulo “Grain: World Markets and Trade”, gin-project nga ang importasyon sang bugas sa Pilipinas ang magadangat sa 3.8 million metric tons sa marketing year 2023-2024 samtang ang imports naman sang China ang maganubo sa 3.5 million metric tons.
english: According to the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) report titled “Grain: World Markets and Trade”, rice imports in the Philippines are projected to reach 3.8 million metric tons in the marketing year 2023-2024 while China's imports will decrease to 3.5 million metric tons.

text: Sa amo man nga report, ginpahayag sang ahensya nga ginapunggan anay sang Pilipinas ang rice importation subong nga tuig bangud sa nagapanglakaak nga presyo sang bugas nga resulta sang rice export ban sang India kag Vietnam.
english: In the same report, the agency said the Philippines is temporarily restricting rice importation this year due to the rising price of rice as a result of the rice export ban by India and Vietnam.

text: Kun basehan ang amo gihapon nga report, ang global price sang bugas subong amo na ang pinakamataas sa sulod sang 15 ka tuig kasunod sang pagpatuman sang India sang export ban policy.
english: Based on the same report, the global price of rice is now the highest in 15 years following the implementation of India's export ban policy.

text: Ang India amo ang naga-suplay sang ginabanta 40% sa global rice trade apang gin-ban na sini ang pag-export sang non-basmati white rice sang Hulyo nga amo ang rason sang pagsaka sa presyo kag pagnubo sang suplay.
english: India supplies approximately 40% to the global rice trade but had already banned the export of non-basmati white rice in July leading to a spike in prices and a drop in supply.

text: Ang Thailand kag Vietnam naman ang nagapanguna nga ginakuhaan sang Pilipinas sang imported rice subong nga 2023.
english: Thailand and Vietnam are the Philippines' main sources of imported rice in 2023.

text:
Base sa Septyembre 7 nga data sang Bureau of Plant Industry, ang rice imports ang nakadangat na sa 2.33 million metric tons kun sa diin 4.46 percent ang halin sa Thailand kag 89.85 percent ang halin sa Vietnam.#

english:
