text: Ginpaabot ni Raisa Treñas ang iya pagkadismaya sa flood mitigation structure sa Mohon, Arevalo matapos nga personal nga ginbisita ang lugar kaupod si Oton Mayor Sofronio L. Fusin Jr.
english: Raisa Treñas expressed her disappointment with the flood mitigation structure in Mohon, Arevalo after personally visiting the area with Oton Mayor Sofronio L. Fusin Jr.

text: Suno sa iya, daku ang parte sang suba nga gin-okupar sang ginpatindog nga istruktura para kuno sa bike lane kag sa pag-agi sang ambulance, apang indi man ini mahimo magamit bangud sang madamo nga obstructions sa tunga.
english: He said a large part of the river was occupied by the structure that was supposedly built for the bike lane and the passage of the ambulance, but it could not be used because of the many obstructions in the middle.

text: Ginpahayag ni Treñas nga ila subong gina-review ang mga proyekto agud makita kun may scientific basis kag kun ini bala ang nagapadugang sang pagbaha.
english: Treñas said they are now reviewing the projects to see if there is a scientific basis and if it increases flooding.

text: Dugang pa niya, masubo ang sitwasyon sang mga pumuluyo nga nagaantos, kag daku ang epekto sini indi lamang sa syudad kundi lakip man ang mga kabanwahanan nga malapit sa Arevalo
english: He added that the situation of the residents who are suffering is sad, and it has a huge impact not only on the city but also on the towns near Arevalo.

text: Nakahanda nga maghatag ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sang standard nga basehan sa lubong para sa mga imol base sa idalom sang Free Funeral Services Act o Republic Act No.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is ready to provide a standard funeral basis for the poor based on the Free Funeral Services Act or Republic Act No.

text: Suno kay Director Edwin Morata ng DSWD Crisis Intervention Program, gintalana sang ahensya ang standard nga balor sang burial assistance matapos maaprubahan ang Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) ng nasambit nga layi.
english: According to Director Edwin Morata of the DSWD Crisis Intervention Program, the agency set the standard value of burial assistance after approving the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the said law.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Morata nga tinutuyo sang layi nga mahatagan sang disente nga lubong ang mga pamilya nga wala sang enough nga kwarta.
english: Morata also said the law aims to provide a decent burial to families who do not have enough money.

text: Lakip na diri ang libre nga serbisyo sa funeral parlors, chapel services, transportasyon, cremation, kag burial.
english: This includes free services at funeral parlors, chapel services, transportation, cremation, and burial.

text: Para naman sa mga luyag nga mag-avail sang bulig, kinahanglan lang magsumiter sang valid ID, death certificate, funeral contract, kag social case study report hlin sa sa mga social worker.
english: For those who wish to avail of assistance, only need to submit a valid ID, death certificate, funeral contract, and social case study report from the social workers.

text: Dugang pa sang opisyal nga possible makuha sang pamilya ang bulig sa mismo sa adlaw sang application kun kumpleto ang mga dokumento.
english: The official added that it is possible for the family to get the assistance on the day of the application if the documents are complete.

text: Arestado ang ginatudlo nga source sang mga nauna nga nadakpan nga drug suspects sa buybust operation sa distrito sang Jaro subong lamang nga gab-i sa Brgy.
english: The alleged source of the previously arrested drug suspects in a buybust operation in Jaro district was arrested last night in Brgy.

text: Cuartero, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Cuartero, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ginkilala ang arestado kay alyas “Peter”, 34-anyos, isa ka panday kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The arrested was identified as alias “Peter”, 34, a carpenter and resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer in charge sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka sachet sang ginasuspetsahan nga shabu ang nabakal sa operasyon kag 7 pa gid ka mga sachet ang na-recover sa arestado.
english: Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer in charge of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, said one sachet of suspected shabu was bought during the operation and seven more sachets were recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa kabug-usan, may yara sang 8 ka sachet ang nakumpiskar nga may kabug-aton nga ginabulubanta masobra 120 gramos kag may standard drug price nga ₱816,000.00.
english: In total, 8 sachets of suspected shabu weighing more than 120 grams and with a standard drug price of ₱816,000.00 were seized.

text: Suno kay PCapt.
english: According to PCapt.

text: Gimeno nga sa ila pag-imbestiga sa arestado ginpahayag sang mga nakakilala sini sa iya nga mapisan kag mabuot ini siya apang iya ginsulod ang pagnegosyo nga pagbaligya sang illegal nga droga.
english: Gimeno said that during their investigation of the arrested, those who knew him said that he was hardworking and kind but he entered the business of selling illegal drugs.

text: Dugang pa ni PCapt.
english: PCapt.

text: Gimeno nga wala ka balo ang iya pamilya sini sa iya illegal nga ginahimu.
english: Gimeno said his family is not aware of his illegal activities.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang ICPS 9 ang mga nadakpan nga arestado kag posible magapangatubang sang kaso nga pagpalapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspects are now in the custody of ICPS 9 and may face charges of violating Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Wala gid sang bisan isa nga nabulsa nga medalya ang Pilipinas sa 2023 International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) World Championships sa Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
english: The Philippines did not pocket a single medal at the 2023 International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) World Championships in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

text: Sa 71-kilogram women’s division, nagpang-19 lamang ang Southeast Asian gold medalist nga si Kristel Macrohon.
english: In the 71-kilogram women’s division, Southeast Asian gold medalist Kristel Macrohon finished 19th.

text: Wala naman sang rank sa kumpetisyon ang SEA Games gold medalist kag Asian and world junior champion nga si Vanessa Sarno bangud apisar nakatapos sa iya nga snatch category, wala na ini nakadayon sa clean and jerk bangud sa iya nga injury.
english: SEA Games gold medalist and Asian and world junior champion Vanessa Sarno did not rank in the competition because despite finishing her snatch category, she did not continue in the clean and jerk due to her injury.

text: Ang Olympic gold medalist nga si Hidilyn Diaz ang nagpang-pito lamang sa 59-kilogram category sang women’s division, samtang nagpang-walo naman ang isa pa ka Tokyo Olympian nga si Elreen Ando.
english: Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz finished only seventh in the 59-kilogram category of the women's division, while another Tokyo Olympian, Elreen Ando, ​​finished eighth.

text: Sunod nga preparahan sang Pinoy weightlifters ang 19th Asian Games sa Hangzhou, China nga balantayan na subong nga bulan.
english: The Filipino weightlifters will next prepare for the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, China which will be held this month.

text: Ginsuyaan sang Russia ang resulta sang byahe ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ilabi na kasunod sang ila pagbaisay ni President Donald Trump.
english: Russia has criticized the outcome of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's trip to the United States of America, especially following his dispute with President Donald Trump.

text: Suno kay Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova, isa ka “complete political and diplomatic failure” ang pagbisita ni Zelensky sa Washington.
english: Russian foreign ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova said Zelensky’s visit to Washington was a “complete political and diplomatic failure.”

text: Pahayag sang Russian official, bangud sa malain nga aktwasyon ni Zelensky sa White House, ginakumpirma lang sini nga siya ang pinakadelikado nga pamahog sa kalibutan.
english: The Russian official said that because of Zelensky's bad actions in the White House, it only confirms that he is the most dangerous threat in the world.

text: Gintawag man niya ini nga “irresponsible warmonger” ukon tawo nga nagahaylo nga mangin agresibo batok sa iban nga pungsod ukon grupo.
english: He also called him an “irresponsible warmonger” or a person who incites aggression against another country or group.

text: Gin-akusaran man sang Russia si Zelensky nga “obsessed” ini sa gyera.
english: Russia has also accused Zelensky of being “obsessed” with the war.

text: Suno pa kay Zakharova, magapabilin kag indi magbag-o ang military goals sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Zakharova said Russia's military goals in Ukraine will remain unchanged.

text: Matandaan nga matapos ang natabo sa White House, maisog nga nagtindog ang lideres sang iban nga mga nasyon ilabi na sa Europa agud nga suportahan si Zelensky.
english: It can be recalled that after the incident at the White House, the leaders of other countries, especially in Europe, bravely stood up to support Zelensky.

text: Lakip sa nag-post sang ila suporta amo ang Germany, France, Spain, Poland kag the Netherlands nga isa-isa man nga ginpasalamatan sang Ukrainian leader.
english: Among those who posted their support were Germany, France, Spain, Poland and the Netherlands who were also thanked by the Ukrainian leader one by one.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapadayaw sang Moscow nga mas may padaog sila sa Ukraine sa gyera, kag kapoy na kag kulang sa hinganiban ang army sang kaiping nga pungsod.
english: Moscow is known to boast that it has more victory over Ukraine in the war, and the neighboring country's army is tired and underarmed.

text: Nag-umpisa ang full-scale offensive sang Russia sa Ukraine sadtong 2022.
english: Russia’s full-scale offensive in Ukraine began in 2022.

text: Nagpaalam na ang Filipino-American NBA Utah Jazz player nga si Jordan Clarkson sa basketball fans nga nagbantay gid sa Gilas Pilipinas sa FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023.
english: Filipino-American NBA Utah Jazz player Jordan Clarkson has said goodbye to basketball fans who have been watching Gilas Pilipinas closely at the FIBA ​​Basketball World Cup 2023.

text: Sa iya Instagram post, nagpakigbahin ang Gilas frontrunner sang mga laragway nga kuha sa amo nga tournament.
english: In his Instagram post, the Gilas frontrunner shared pictures taken during the tournament.

text: May caption ini nga, “world cup!
english: It was captioned, “world cup!

text:
love, see yall again.”

Isa si Clarkson sa top scorers sa points per game category subong nga tournament nga naunahan lamang sang Dallas Mavericks star nga si Luka Doncic sang Slovenia.
english:
love, see yall again.”

Clarkson is one of the top scorers in the points per game category this tournament, ahead of only Dallas Mavericks star Luka Doncic of Slovenia.

text: Sa katapusan nga hampang sang Pilipinas sa classification phase batok sa China, indi man malimtan ang nagasingkal nga performance sang Jazz superstar nga may 34 puntos kun sa diin 24 puntos ang ginbubo sa third quarter nga may apat ka sunod-sunod nga tres.
english: In the Philippines' last game in the classification phase against China, the Jazz superstar's furious performance with 34 points was not forgotten, with 24 points poured in the third quarter with four consecutive threes.

text: Sa press conference, ginpakigbahin man sini nga indi ini ang katapusan nga tuig nga magahampang siya para sa Pilipinas sa World Cup.
english: In the press conference, he also shared that this is not the last year he will play for the Philippines in the World Cup.

text: Mapinasalamaton ang 23-anyos Filipino-Cypriot big man nga si AJ Edu sa FIBA World Cup debut sini kaupod ang Gilas Pilipinas.
english: 23-year-old Filipino-Cypriot big man AJ Edu is grateful for his FIBA ​​World Cup debut with Gilas Pilipinas.

text: Sa iya Facebook post, ginpahayag sini nga nga “blessing” para sa iya ang pagtiglawas sa world stage apisar sang mga pagpanghangkat kag injuries.
english: In his Facebook post, he said that it is a “blessing” for him to represent the world stage despite the challenges and injuries.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga kampanya sang Gilas subong nga tournament, nagtupa si Edu sa Top 10 sa World Cup group phase sa rebounding nga may team-best nga 8.6 kada hampang apisar nga siya ang ikaduha nga pinalamharon nga Gilas player sunod kay Kai Sotto.
english: In the Gilas' overall campaign this tournament, Edu dropped into the Top 10 in the World Cup group phase in rebounding with a team-best 8.6 per game despite being the second youngest Gilas player after Kai Sotto.

text: Nagpangatlo man siya sa scoring sang Gilas nga may 8.2 points kun sa diin nauna lang sanday Jordan Clarkson (26.0) kag Dwight Ramos (13.2).
english: He also finished third in scoring for the Gilas with 8.2 points, ahead of Jordan Clarkson (26.0) and Dwight Ramos (13.2).

text: Sa 21-puntos nga abanse sang Gilas sa China sa katapusan nga hampang sa classification round, nagtapos man si Edu nga may 10 rebounds, lima ka puntos, kag tatlo ka assists.
english: With the Gilas holding a 21-point lead over China in the final game of the classification round, Edu also finished with 10 rebounds, five points, and three assists.

text: Lakip sa gin-report ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Among those reported by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa iya pagbalik diri sa Pilipinas halin sa 43rd ASEAN Summit sa Indonesia amo ang free trade agreement (FTA) nga pirmado na sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag South Korea.
english: on his return to the Philippines from the 43rd ASEAN Summit in Indonesia is the free trade agreement (FTA) that has been signed between the Philippines and South Korea.

text: Ini ang ginalauman nga magapabakod pa sang relasyon sang duha ka pungsod pag-abot sa investment kag makahatag sang dugang nga trabaho para sa Filipinos.
english: This is expected to further strengthen the relationship between the two countries in terms of investment and provide more jobs for Filipinos.

text: Ini nga kasugtanan ang madugay na nga ginanegosyar — antes pa man nagtuhaw ang Covid-19 pandemic — kag amo ang ginalauman nga magabuhin sang taripa para sa pili nga mga produkto.
english: This agreement has been negotiated for some time — even before the emergence of the Covid-19 pandemic — and is what is expected to reduce tariffs for select products.

text: Nahibaluan nga lab-ot sa $15.44 billion ukon P876.7-billion ang bilateral trade sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag South Korea sa sulod lamang sang 2022.
english: It is known that bilateral trade between the Philippines and South Korea reached $15.44 billion or P876.7-billion in 2022 alone.

text: Ang amo nga pungsod amo ang ika-apat nga pinakadaku nga trading partner sang Pilipinas sandig sa data sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).
english: The country is the Philippines' fourth largest trading partner according to data from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).

text: Ang nagapanguna nga gina-export sang Pilipinas sa South Korea amo ang integrated circuits, semiconductors, kag ang saging.
english: The Philippines' top exports to South Korea are integrated circuits, semiconductors, and bananas.

text: Matapos nangin kontrobersyal kag gintawag nga isa ka sahi sang scam, nagpaguwa na sang official statement ang Miss Planet International kag nagpahayag nga indi na madayon ang kumpetisyon sa Uganda sa Nobyembre 19 subong nga tuig.
english: After becoming controversial and being called a scam, Miss Planet International has issued an official statement and announced that the competition will not be held in Uganda on November 19 this year.

text: Suno sa organisasyon, patigayunon na lamang ang pageant sa Cambodia sa Enero 2023.
english: According to the organization, the pageant will be held in Cambodia in January 2023.

text: Nagpaathag man ang organisasyon nga indi madayon ang Finals and Preliminary competitions bangud sang kapaslawan sang host organizers nga mag-comply kag mag-meet sa requirements agud matigayon ang event.
english: The organization also explained that the Finals and Preliminary competitions will not be held due to the failure of the host organizers to comply and meet the requirements to hold the event.

text: Nag-sorry man ang organisasyon sa natuga sini nga inconvenience.
english: The organization also apologized for the inconvenience caused.

text: Antes sini, pila na ka mga kandidata ang nagwithdraw lakip na si Herlene Budol nga tiglawas sang Pilipinas.
english: Earlier, several candidates withdrew including Herlene Budol, the representative of the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag man sang talent manager ni Herlene nga si Wilbert Tolentino nga nangin traumatic ang ila eksperyensya.
english: Herlene's talent manager, Wilbert Tolentino, also said that their experience was traumatic.

text: Pila pa ka mga kandidata halin sa iban nga pungsod ang nagsiling nga scam ang pageant kag naggastuhan lang sila kag nag-uyang sang tyempo sa ila pagpadulong sa Uganda.
english: Several other contestants from other countries said the pageant was a scam and they just spent money and wasted time on their way to Uganda.

text: Indi magpangayo sang pasaylo si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky kay US President Donald Trump kay Vice President JD Vance matapos ang ila pagbaisay sa White House.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky will not apologize to US President Donald Trump to Vice President JD Vance after an argument at the White House.

text: Suno kay Zelensky, gina-respeto niya ang presidente kag ang mga pumuluyo sang Amerika kag nagapati siya nga wala man siya sang ginhimo nga malain.
english: Zelensky said he respects the president and the American people and believes he did nothing wrong.

text: Pahayag ni Zelensky, mas maayo kuntani ang dalagan sang diskusyunay kun wala sang mga camera kag katapo sang media sa ila atubang.
english: Zelensky said the discussion would have gone better without cameras and members of the media in front of them.

text: Suno pa sa iya, pareho nga indi maayo sa US kag Ukraine ang natabo.
english: He said that both the US and Ukraine are not good at what happened.

text: Nagapati naman ini nga masalbar pa ang ila relasyon ni Trump.
english: He believes that his relationship with Trump can be saved.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa amo nga meeting, ginhangkat ni Zelenskiy si Trump bangud sa paghumok sini kay Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: During that meeting, Zelenskiy challenged Trump for softening up on Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Ginbatuan man ni Zelensky ang claims ni Trump nga napudpod na ang mga syudad sa Ukraine sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera, apang nagsiling naman si Trump nga gusto na ni Putin nga maghimo sang kasugtanan.
english: Zelensky also rejected Trump's claims that Ukrainian cities had been destroyed during the three-year war, but Trump said Putin wanted to make a deal.

text: Gina-insister ni Trump nga dapat mangin mas mapinasalamaton si Zelenskiy, kag ginsilingan man niya ini nga naga-gamble sa World War III bisan pa nga nagakawad-an na ini sang mga soldado.
english: Trump insists Zelenskiy should be more grateful, and he also told him he was gambling on World War III even as it was losing soldiers.

text: Nagasal-ot man si Vice President Vance kag nagsiling nga wala sang pagtahod si Zelensky bangud nagkadto ini sa White House agud lamang nga iinsister ang iya nga posisyon.
english: Vice President Vance also interjected and said that Zelensky was disrespectful because he went to the White House just to insist on his position.

text: Ginapilit naman ni Trump nga mahimo magsulod sa deal ang Ukraine, bangud kun indi, indi na magsuporta ang US.
english: Trump insists that Ukraine can enter the deal, because otherwise the US will not support it.

text: Ini nga meeting ang natabo antes kuntani ang pagpirma sang duha ka lider sa natural resources agreement.
english: The meeting took place before the signing of the natural resources agreement between the two leaders.

text: Ginpahayag nga wala ini nadayon, nagbiya si Zelensky sa White House, kag nakanselar man ang naka-schedule kuntani nga news conference.
english: It reportedly failed, Zelensky left the White House, and the scheduled news conference was canceled.

text: Nagapatuman ang gobyerno sang hugot nga pagbantay sa mga patyo, terminal, kag mga dalanon para masiguro ang kaluwasan kag kahilwayan sang publiko sa pagsaulog sang Pyesta Minatay.
english: The government is implementing strict surveillance in courtyards, terminals, and roads to ensure the safety and freedom of the public during the celebration of the Feast of the Dead.

text: Antes magbiyahe padulong sa South Korea para sa APEC Summit, ginmanduan ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Before traveling to South Korea for the APEC Summit, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered the

text: ang mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga magbantay kag maghatag sang bulig sa mga pasahero.
english: government agencies to monitor and provide assistance to passengers.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, ginsiguro sang DSWD nga handa ang mga field offices kag may yara sang relief goods kag pagkaon para sa mga posible nga ma-stranded.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the DSWD has ensured that field offices are ready and have relief goods and food for those who may be stranded.

text: Samtang, ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nagasiguro nga wala sang pagtaas sa presyo kag padayon ang price monitoring.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is ensuring that there is no price increase and continues to monitor prices.

text: Ginpahayag ni Castro nga apisar yara sa APEC si Marcos Jr., padayon nga ginaprioridad sang gobyerno ang kaluwasan kag kaayuhan sang publiko sa Pyesta Minatay.
english: Castro said that despite Marcos Jr.'s presence in APEC, the government continues to prioritize the safety and welfare of the public during Fiesta Minatay.

text: Nagdangat sa 95% sang rice retailers sa pungsod suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA) ang naga-comply sa ginmandu ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture (DA), 95% of rice retailers in the country are complying with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s directive.

text: nga price ceiling sa bugas.
english: price ceiling on rice.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Director for Legal Services Willie Ann Angsiy, nagapadayon ang ahensya sa pagpalapta sang impormasyon sa non-compliant nga rice retailers.
english: Agriculture Director for Legal Services Willie Ann Angsiy said the agency continues to disseminate information to non-compliant rice retailers.

text: Ini agud mapahibalo man sa ila nga may subsidiya nga ihatag bilang kumpensasyon sa ila nga mapierde nga income bangud sa price cap.
english: This is to inform them that there is a subsidy that will be given as compensation for their lost income due to the price cap.

text: Pasalig sini, ihatag gid ang ayuda sa kondisyon nga naga-comply lang sa price ceiling nga P41 per kilogram para sa regular-milled rice kag P45 per kilogram para sa well-milled rice.
english: He assured that the assistance will be given on condition that they comply with the price ceiling of P41 per kilogram for regular-milled rice and P45 per kilogram for well-milled rice.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) nga makabaton ang rice retailers sang tubtub sa P15,000 nga subsidiya.
english: Earlier, the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) announced that rice retailers will receive up to P15,000 in subsidies.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagapakig-angot ang ahensya sa pribado nga sektor agud masigurado ang suplay tubtub sa pagsugod sang tag-alani sa Oktubre.
english: He also said the agency is working with the private sector to ensure supply until the start of the harvest season in October.

text: Igatiglawas sang isa ka Ilongga ang bug-os nga pungsod Pilipinas sa masunod nga edition sang Miss Teen International pageant sa India.
english: An Ilongga will represent the entire Philippines in the next edition of the Miss Teen International pageant in India.

text: Ini amo si Angel Jed Latorre, 17, nga nangibabaw sa 14 ka iban pa nga aspirants sa 2022 Miss Teen International Philippines nga ginpatigayon sa Tanghalang Pasigueño sa Pasig City.
english: This is Angel Jed Latorre, 17, who topped 14 other aspirants in the 2022 Miss Teen International Philippines held at Tanghalang Pasigueño in Pasig City.

text: Tumandok si Angel sang Bo.
english: Angel is a native of Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz District sa Iloilo City kag isa ka Senior High School student sa University of San Agustin.
english: Obrero, Lapuz District in Iloilo City and a Senior High School student at the University of San Agustin.

text: Nakuha man ni Angel ang iban pa ka awards kaangay sang Pageantry Fanatics Queen, Press Choice Award, Best in Talent, Best in Swimsuit, kag Best in Intro Video.
english: Angel also won other awards such as Pageantry Fanatics Queen, Press Choice Award, Best in Talent, Best in Swimsuit, and Best in Intro Video.

text: Madumduman nga sang ginpatigayon ang Miss World Philippines 2022, gintiglawas man sini ang Lambunao, Iloilo sa national pageant.
english: It can be recalled that when Miss World Philippines 2022 was held, she also represented Lambunao, Iloilo in the national pageant.

text: Natapos man ang ginkabig ‘fairytale run’ sang Latvia subong nga FIBA World Cup 2023 apang indi na mapanas ang rekord sini sa tournament nga mahimo malabawan pa gid sa masunod nga mga edisyon sang hinampang.
english: Latvia's fairytale run in the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 has also come to an end but its record in the tournament cannot be erased, which could be surpassed in the coming editions of the game.

In the quarterfinals, the undefeated team Germany almost shook their shoulders due to the strength of the Latvians but the game ended, 81-79, in favor of the Germans at the Mall of Asia Arena tonight.

Even Germans forward Johannes Thiemann admitted that he prayed that seven-year NBA veteran David Bertans would not score a three as the match ended.

text: “I was praying.
english: “I was praying.

text: I was really praying that he (Bertans) misses that shot,” suno kay Thiemann nga naglaragway sang kampanya sang Latvia bilang “unbeliavable” subong nga tuig.
english: I was really praying that he (Bertans) misses that shot,” said Thiemann who described Latvia’s campaign as “unbelievable” this year.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Latvia man ang may pinaka-manubo nga rank sa walo ka mga teams nga nag-abanse sa final phase diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Latvia also had the lowest rank among the eight teams that advanced to the final phase here in the Philippines.
