text: Mas nadugangan ang paglaum sa pag-recover ni Pope Francis bangud sa amat-amat pa gid nga pag-improve sang iya kondisyon.
english: Pope Francis' recovery is expected to increase as his condition gradually improves.

text: Sa update sang Vatican kaina sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas, ginsiling nga sang aga oras sa Roma, nagpaidalom ang Pope sa respiratory physiotherapy.
english: In an update from the Vatican yesterday morning Philippine time, it was said that in the morning Rome time, the Pope underwent respiratory physiotherapy.

text: Sa hapon, pagkatapos sang physiotherapy session, nagpangamuyo ini sa chapel sa private apartment sa 10th floor kun sa diin nagbaton ini sang Eucharist, kag nag-diretso na sa mga ulubrahon.
english: In the afternoon, after the physiotherapy session, he prayed in the chapel in the private apartment on the 10th floor where he received the Eucharist, and went straight to work.

text: Bisan may parte sa statement nga naga-improve ang kondisyon sang Pope, ginsiling nga kumplikado gihapon ang pangkabug-usan nga clinical picture kag kinahanglan pa ang masunod nga mga inadlaw para nga maathagan gid ang prognosis.
english: Although there is a part of the statement that the Pope's condition is improving, it said that the overall clinical picture is still complicated and it will take the next few days to clarify the prognosis.

text:
Yari ang statement sang Holy See nga posted sa Vatican News:

“The Holy Father’s clinical condition is confirmed to be improving again today.
english:
Here is the Holy See’s statement posted to Vatican News:

“The Holy Father’s clinical condition is confirmed to be improving again today.

text: He alternated high-flow oxygen therapy with a Ventimask.
english: He alternated high-flow oxygen therapy with a Ventimask.

text: Due to the complexity of the clinical picture, further days of clinical stability are needed to clarify the prognosis.
english: Due to the complexity of the clinical picture, further days of clinical stability are needed to clarify the prognosis.

text: In the morning, the Holy Father underwent respiratory physiotherapy, alternating it with rest.
english: In the morning, the Holy Father underwent respiratory physiotherapy, alternating it with rest.

text: In the afternoon, after an additional physiotherapy session, he spent time in prayer in the chapel of his private apartment on the 10th floor, where he received the Eucharist.
english: In the afternoon, after an additional physiotherapy session, he spent time in prayer in the chapel of his private apartment on the 10th floor, where he received the Eucharist.

text:
He then engaged in work activities.”

Ang communiqué to journalists sang Huwebes sang aga ang nagsiling man nga nakatulog sang maayo ang pope, nakabangon gikan sa kama, kag nagpadayon sa treatment sa iya nga armchair.
english:
He then engaged in work activities.”

The communiqué to journalists on Thursday morning also said the pope slept well, got out of bed, and continued treatment in his armchair.

text: Ginkumpirma man ugaling sang Holy See Press Office nga ang Jubilee Audience sa Sabado, Marso 1, ang kanselado anay bangud sa kahimtangan sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: The Holy See Press Office also confirmed that the Jubilee Audience on Saturday, March 1, was canceled due to the condition of the 88-year-old Pope.

text: Ini na ang iya pang-14 nga gab-i sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma samtang ginasuprer ang severe respiratory infection nga nag-trigger sang mga kumplikasyon.#
english: This is his 14th night at the Gemelli Hospital in Rome while suffering from a severe respiratory infection that triggered complications.

text: Nagdangat sa 45 ka mga Chinese aircraft ang nagpalapit sa Taiwan sa sulod sang isa lamang ka adlaw.
english: A total of 45 Chinese aircraft approached Taiwan in just one day.

text: Ini ang pinakamataas nga numero sang aircraft sang Beijing nga na-monitor sang isla subong nga tuig, magluwas pa sa 14 ka warships nga nasiplatan malapit man sa Taipei.
english: This is the highest number of Beijing aircraft monitored by the island this year, in addition to 14 warships also spotted near Taipei.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang Taiwan defense ministry matapos gin-anunsyo nga nagpatigayon ang China sang combat drill lakip ang aircraft kag warship kag “live-fire exercises” sa kalayuon nga 40 nautical miles (74 kilometres) halin sa south sang Taiwan.
english: Taiwan's defense ministry confirmed this after it announced that China had conducted combat drills including aircraft and warship and live-fire exercises at a distance of 40 nautical miles (74 kilometers) south of Taiwan.

text: Ginlaragway naman ini sang Taipei nga tuman ka makatalagam kag isa ka paglapas sa international norms.
english: Taipei has described it as extremely dangerous and a violation of international norms.

text: Sunod naman nga ginbali sang China ang pahayag sang Taiwan kag nagdepensa nga isa lamang ka “routine training” ang ila nga ginhimo.
english: China later rejected Taiwan's statement and defended that it was only a routine training.

text: Sang Martes, matandaan nga nadakpan man sang Taiwan ang cargo chip sang China nga gina-suspetsahan nga nagapang-utod sang subsea telecoms cable nga ginagamit sa Penghu island group sang Taipei.
english: On Tuesday, Taiwan also seized a Chinese cargo chip suspected of cutting a subsea telecoms cable used in Taipei's Penghu island group.

text: Ginakabalak-an sang Taiwan ini nga tikang sang China sa pagpang-utod sang communication links bangud posible nga padayunon ini sa tuyo nga sakupon ang teritoryo.
english: Taiwan is concerned about China's move to cut off communication links because it is likely to continue with the aim of annexing the territory.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa man ang Taiwan sa nagapasaka sang tension sa tunga sang US kag China, bangud ang US amo ang pinakadaku kag pinakaimportante nga backer kag arms supplier sang Taiwan.
english: Taiwan is also one of the sources of tension between the US and China, as the US is Taiwan's largest and most important backer and arms supplier.

text: Apang sa Cabinet meeting sa Estados Unidos, nagpamalibad na si US President Donald Trump nga magkomento kun tugutan sang US ang China nga kontrolon ang Taiwan paagi sa paggamit sang pwersa.
english: But at a Cabinet meeting in the United States, US President Donald Trump refused to comment on whether the US would allow China to control Taiwan by force.

text: Suno kay Trump, indi siya magkomento diri kag indi niya luyag ibutang ang iya kaugalingon sa amo nga posisyon.
english: Trump said he would not comment here and did not want to put himself in that position.

text: Ginsiling sini nga maayo ang iya relasyon kay Chinese President Xi Jinping kag padayon nga gina-abi-abi sang Washington ang maayo nga relasyon sa Beijing.
english: He said he has good relations with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Washington continues to welcome good relations with Beijing.

text: Apang pahayag sini, bisan gusto sang US ang mayo nga relasyon sa China, indi siya magpasugot nga hingalitan sila kaangay sang ginhimo anay kay former President Joe Biden.
english: But he said that although the US wants good relations with China, it will not allow them to be harmed as was done to former President Joe Biden.

text: Ginapahayag sang Land Transportation Office Region 6 nga illegal kag ginakabig nga colorum ang operasyon sang mga Angkas Rider sa siyudad sang Iloilo, bangud wala pa sang franchise nga ginahatag sa ila.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region 6 says the operation of Angkas Riders in Iloilo City is illegal and considered colorum, because they have not yet been given a franchise.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jeck Conlu, Assistant Regional Director sang Land Transportation Office Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga bisan sa Manila, ‘pilot testing’ pa lang ang operasyon sang Angkas Rider.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jeck Conlu, Assistant Regional Director of the Land Transportation Office Region 6, said that even in Manila, the operation of the Angkas Rider is still being pilot tested.

text: Suno sa iya, isa pa ini sa mga isyu nga wala pa naresolba sa Metro Manila, kag subong may yara na sang mga angkas rider sa iban nga lugar lakip na ang Iloilo.
english: He said this is another issue that has not been resolved in Metro Manila, and now there are riders in other places including Iloilo.

text: Gindugang pa ni Conlu nga ang pilot testing sang Angkas Rider applicable lang sa Metro Manila, kag ginakinahanglan pa sang layi agud matagaan sang kita sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board.
english: Conlu added that the pilot testing of the Angkas Rider is only applicable in Metro Manila, and is still required by law to provide revenue to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga ang ahensya lang nga makahatag sang franchise nga amo ang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB), gani kun madakpan ang mga rider nga wala sini, ginakabig sila nga colorum.
english: He said the only agency that can issue franchises is the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB), so if riders are caught without it, they are considered colorum.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga Angkas Rider ginakabig nga salakyan sang mga naga-ubra sa dis oras sang kagab-ihon, pakadto sa ulubrahan ukon magpauli sa gab-i, kag sang mga residente nga luyag magsugo ukon magpabakal sang mga kinahanglanon pareho sang pagkaon, bulong, kag mga gamit sa emerhensiya.
english: It is known that Angkas Riders are considered as vehicles by those who work at night, going to work or going home at night, and by residents who want to order or buy necessities such as food, medicine, and emergency supplies.

text: Ginapahanumdom sang Land Transportation Office ang publiko nga maghalong sa pagpili sang salakyan, agud malikawan ang risgo sa dalanon.
english: The Land Transportation Office is reminding the public to be careful when choosing a vehicle, to avoid risk on the road.

text: Maga-abanse na sa semifinals ang Canada matapos gintumba si Luka Doncic kag ang Slovenia, 100-89, sa knockout quarterfinals match sa FIBA World Cup 2023 sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City.
english: Canada will advance to the semifinals after knocking off Luka Doncic and Slovenia, 100-89, in the knockout quarterfinals match at the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang Canadians ang powerhouse team nga Serbia sa semis sa Byernes, Septyembre 8, samtang magasambuwa naman ang teams sang Germany kag ang USA sa pihak nga bahin sang bracket para sa final four.
english: The Canadiens will next face powerhouse Serbia in the semis on Friday, September 8, while Germany and the USA will face off on the other side of the bracket for the final four.

text: Nagpanguna sa North Americans ang Oklahoma City Thunder star nga si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander nga may 31 puntos, 10 ka rebounds, apat ka assists, kag duha ka steals.
english: Oklahoma City Thunder star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander led the North Americans with 31 points, 10 rebounds, four assists, and two steals.

text: Sa third quarter nagbubo sang pwersa ang star-studded squad paagi kanday Alexander, RJ Barrett, kag Kelly Olynyk nga nagpasaka sa 77-61 lead sang Canada halin sa makahalawat-hawat nga 50-50 nga skor sa halftime.
english: In the third quarter the star-studded squad poured in energy through Alexander, RJ Barrett, and Kelly Olynyk to lift Canada’s lead to 77-61 from a breathtaking 50-50 halftime score.

text: 7:06 ang nabilin sa oras sa hampang sang ginpaguwa ang Canadian star nga si Dillon Brooks bangud sa disqualifying foul, apang amo na lamang ang gahod sang fans sang pila ka ginutlo lamang ang nakaligad, 6:37 ang nabilin sa oras, ginpaguwa man si Doncic bangud sang iya ikaduha nga technical foul.
english: 7:06 was left in the game when Canadian star Dillon Brooks was ejected for a disqualifying foul, but that was the only noise from the fans when just a few moments later, 6:37 left, Doncic was also ejected for his second technical foul.

text: Antes nag-guwa sa quarterfinal match, nakatipon pa ang Dallas Mavericks stars sang 26 puntos, lima ka assists, kag apat ka rebounds para sa Europeans.
english: Before exiting the quarterfinal match, the Dallas Mavericks stars collected 26 points, five assists, and four rebounds for the Europeans.

text: Atubangon sini ang Lithuania sa Huwebes sa pagsugod sang consolation playoffs nga amo ang magatumod kun ano nga pungsod ang pang-lima tubtub pang-walo subong nga tournament.
english: It will face Lithuania on Thursday in the start of the consolation playoffs that will determine which country will finish fifth to eighth in the tournament.

text:
Duha ka NBA stars ang ginpaguwa antes pa man matapos ang bakbakanay sang Canada kag Slovenia sa quarterfinal match sang FIBA World Cup 2023 sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City subong nga gab-i.

Sa fourth quarter sang una nga nagguwa ang Houston Rockets kag Canadian star nga si Dillon Brooks bangud sang disqualifying foul, samtang nagsunod naman ang fan-favorite nga Dallas Mavericks star kag ginalantaw kuntani nga potential MVP nga si Luka Doncic bangud sang iya ikaduha nga technical foul.
english:
Two NBA stars were released before the end of the clash between Canada and Slovenia in the quarterfinal match of the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City tonight.

In the fourth quarter, the Houston Rockets and Canadian star Dillon Brooks first exited due to a disqualifying foul, while fan-favorite Dallas Mavericks star and potential MVP Luka Doncic followed due to his second technical foul.

text: Nagtapos si Doncic nga may 26 puntos sa 8-of-20 shooting, lima ka assists, kag apat ka rebounds, samtang si Brooks naman ang may yara sang 14 ka puntos, tatlo ka rebounds, kag tatlo ka assists sa iya 28 minutos nga hampang.
english: Doncic finished with 26 points on 8-of-20 shooting, five assists, and four rebounds, while Brooks had 14 points, three rebounds, and three assists in his 28 minutes of play.

text: Sa katapusan sang sambuwa, nagpangibabaw ang Canada, 100-89, nga amo ang ila labing-una nga pagtapak sa FIBA World Cup semifinals.
english: At the end of the match, Canada prevailed, 100-89, which was their first appearance in the FIBA ​​World Cup semifinals.

text: Atubangon sini ang Serbia sa semifinals samtang maga-atubangay naman ang Germany kag ang USA sa pihak nga bracket.#
english: It will face Serbia in the semifinals while Germany and the USA will face each other in the other bracket.

text: Na-validate na sang Land Transportation Office Region 6 ang pagkilala sa driver sang isa ka angkas rider nga ginreklamo sang pasahero, matapos nga ginhatagan sang impormasyon ang ahensya halin mismo sa biktima.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region 6 has validated the identity of the driver of a rider complained by the passenger, after the agency was given information from the victim himself.

text: Ginapadayon subong ang proseso agud matutukan ang reklamo kag masiguro ang hustisya para sa pasahero.
english: The process is now underway to focus on the complaint and ensure justice for the passenger.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jeck Conlu, Assistant Regional Director sang LTO-6, ginpahayag niya nga na-contact na nila ang biktima kag base sa mga detalye nga ginhatag sini, gin-check nila sa system kag na-identify man ang driver.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jeck Conlu, Assistant Regional Director of LTO-6, said they have already contacted the victim and based on the details provided by him, they checked the system and identified the driver.

text: Suno sa iya, taga-Aklan ang amo nga driver.
english: He said the driver is from Aklan.

text: Gindugang pa ni Conlu nga matapos ang pagproseso sang “Show-cause order”, ipadala ini sa address sang driver.
english: Conlu added that after the processing of the show-cause order, it will be sent to the driver's address.

text: May kahigayunan man ang driver nga magpadulong sa opisina sang LTO agud magpahayag sang iya sabat sa reklamo.
english: The driver also has the opportunity to go to the LTO office to express his response to the complaint.

text: Ginpabutyag sang LTO nga padayon ang ila pagmonitor sa mga reklamo nga may kaangtanan sa public safety.
english: The LTO said it continues to monitor complaints related to public safety.

text: Patay ang 46 ka mga tawo sa pagtibusok sang military aircraft sa Sudan.
english: Forty-six people were killed in the crash of a military aircraft in Sudan.

text: Ginakabig na ini subong nga isa sa pinakamaka-mamatay nga crash sa amo nga pungsod sa northeastern Africa sa nagligad nga duha ka dekada.
english: It is now considered one of the deadliest crashes in that northeastern African country in the past two decades.

text: Natabo ang pagtibusok sang Antonov aircraft sa isa ka residential area sa Omdurman kun sa diin magluwas sa mga napatay, may 10 man nga napilasan.
english: The Antonov aircraft crashed in a residential area in Omdurman where besides the dead, there were also 10 injured.

text: Nagkalaguba man ang pila ka mga balay sa Karrari district of Omdurman.
english: Several houses were also damaged in the Karrari district of Omdurman.

text: Suno sa military sang Sudan, nalakip ang armed forces personnel kag mga sibilyan sa casualties.
english: According to the Sudanese military, armed forces personnel and civilians were among the casualties.

text: Nalakip man ang senior military officers kag aircraft crew.
english: Also included were senior military officers and aircraft crew.

text: Ginapahayag nga pakadto ang aircraft sa Red Sea city of Port Sudan kun sa diin nahamtang ang military-backed government.
english: The aircraft was reportedly heading to the Red Sea city of Port Sudan where the military-backed government is located.

text: Nahibaluan nga pigado ang aviation record sang Sudan.
english: It is known that Sudan has a poor aviation record.

text: Sang 2020, patay man ang 16 ka mga tawo sa pag-crash sang military plane nga Russian Antonov An-12 sa western region of Darfur.
english: In 2020, 16 people were also killed in the crash of a Russian Antonov An-12 military plane in the western region of Darfur.

text: Sang 2003, may civilian Sudan Airways plane man nga nagtibusok kun sa diin 116 ang patay kag isa ka bata nga lalaki lamang ang nakaluwas.
english: In 2003, a civilian Sudan Airways plane also crashed, killing 116 people and surviving only one boy.

text: Ikaw na bala ang masunod nga most beautiful girl in the universe?
english: Are you the next most beautiful girl in the universe?

text: Ginbuksan na sang Miss Universe Philippines ang applications para sa 2023 pageant!
english: Miss Universe Philippines has now opened applications for the 2023 pageant!

text: Dapat nga at least 18 to 27 years old, female, kag Filipino citizen ang aplikante.
english: Applicants must be at least 18 to 27 years old, female, and Filipino citizen.

text: Wala man sang specific minimum height requirement para sa screening process sa sini nga edition.
english: There is also no specific minimum height requirement for the screening process in this edition.

text: Suno pa sa announcement, mahimo maka apply ang beauty queens bisan ano pa ang ila nga civil status, lain sa kinaandan nga pageant kun sa diin ginabutang gid nga dapat wala nakasal kag wala nakaagi busong ang beauty queen.
english: According to the announcement, beauty queens can apply regardless of their civil status, unlike the usual pageant where it is stipulated that the beauty queen must not be married and not pregnant.

text: Ini matapos ginkumpirma ni Paula Shugart, presidente sang Miss Universe organization, nga ang 72nd edition sang pageant ang magapahanugot na sa mga iloy kag mga asawa nga mag-intra sa kumpetisyon.
english: This comes after Paula Shugart, president of the Miss Universe organization, confirmed that the 72nd edition of the pageant will allow mothers and wives to participate in the competition.

text: Mahimo ma fill out sang aspiring beauty queens ang application form kag i-send ang accomplished copy sa contact@missuniverseph.com not later than January 29, 2023, 11:59 pm.
english: Aspiring beauty queens can fill out the application form and send the accomplished copy to contact@missuniverseph.com no later than January 29, 2023, 11:59 pm.

text: Ang nagauyat subong sang Miss Universe Philippines title amo si Celeste Cortesi sang Pasay kag amo ang magatiglawas sang Pilipinas sa 71st international pageant sa United States sa maabot nga Enero.
english: The current holder of the Miss Universe Philippines title is Celeste Cortesi of Pasay and will represent the Philippines in the 71st international pageant in the United States in January.

text: Umpisa subong nga adlaw, Mayo 3, 2025, yara na sa full alert status ang Philippine National Police (PNP) bilang preparasyon sa palaabuton nga eleksyon sa Mayo 12.
english: As of today, May 3, 2025, the Philippine National Police (PNP) is on full alert status in preparation for the upcoming May 12 elections.

text: Suno kay PNP chief Rommel Marbil, yara na sa ground ang ila mga tinawo.
english: According to PNP chief Rommel Marbil, their personnel are already on the ground.

text: Ginmanduan niya ang mga pulis nga hugtan ang pagbantay agud masiguro ang safe nga eleksyon.
english: He directed the police to tighten vigil to ensure safe elections.

text: Kapin sa 120,000 ka mga pulis ang gin-assign sa pagbantay sa masobra 37,000 ka mga voting centers sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: More than 120,000 police officers have been assigned to guard more than 37,000 voting centers across the country.

text: Nagpanawagan man si Marbil sa publiko nga magkooperar sa pagdula sang sin-o man nga nagaplano nga magtublag sa eleksyon.
english: Marbil also called on the public to cooperate in eliminating anyone planning to disrupt the election.

text: Gina-imbitaran ni Pres.
english: Invites Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos ang mga nagtambong sang APEC CEO Summit nga makiugyon sa ASEAN Summit nga patigayinon sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Bongbong Marcos urged the participants of the APEC CEO Summit to agree to the ASEAN Summit to be held in the Philippines next year.

text: Suno sa Presidente, igaduso sang Pilipinas ang mas mapag-on nga koneksyon sang APEC kag ASEAN pinaagi sang pagpabaskog sang mga polisa, institusyon, kag oportunidad para sa tanan nga pungsod.
english: The President said the Philippines will push for stronger connections between APEC and ASEAN by strengthening policies, institutions, and opportunities for all countries.

text: “We welcome our partners from across the region and we invite the business community to join us in shaping a connected, resilient, and opportunity-driven Asia-Pacific,” pahayag sang Presidente.
english: “We welcome our partners from across the region and we invite the business community to join us in shaping a connected, resilient, and opportunity-driven Asia-Pacific,” the President said.

text: Ipinag-utos ng lokal na pamahalaan ng Carles ang pansamantalang pagsasara ng Tangke (Saltwater Lagoon) sa Barangay Gabi, Gigantes Sur,Carles, lloilo.
english: The local government of Carles has ordered the temporary closure of the Saltwater Lagoon in Barangay Gabi, Gigantes Sur, Carles, Loilo.

text: Ito ay mula Setyembre 1 hanggang Setyembre 30, 2025, alinsunod sa Executive Order No.
english: This is from September 1 to September 30, 2025, in accordance with Executive Order No.

text: 94, Series of 2025 na nilagdaan ni Mayor Arnold Betita II.
english: 94, Series of 2025 signed by Mayor Arnold Betita II.

text: Layon ng naturang kautusan na mapangalagaan ang likas na ganda at kalikasan ng Tangke, bigyang-daan ang natural nitong rehabilitasyon, at tiyakin ang kaligtasan ng mga turista lalo na sa panahon ng Habagat kung kailan malalakas ang alon sa bungad ng lagoon.
english: The order aims to preserve the natural beauty and nature of Tangke, speed up its natural rehabilitation, and ensure the safety of tourists especially during the Habagat season when the waves at the mouth of the lagoon are strong.

text: Ayon pa sa alkalde, bahagi ito ng pangako ng munisipyo sa sustainable tourism at pangangalaga ng kalikasan, upang manatiling buhay at maipamana pa sa susunod na henerasyon ang mga yaman ng Carles.
english: According to the mayor, this is part of the municipality's commitment to sustainable tourism and environmental protection, so that the resources of Carles can remain alive and be passed on to the next generation.

text: Nanawagan ang LGU sa mga turista, stakeholders, at lokal na katuwang na makiisa para sa ligtas at responsableng pamamasyal, kasabay ng pagpapanatili ng kagandahan ng Tangke Lagoon.
english: The LGU calls on tourists, stakeholders, and local partners to unite for safe and responsible visitation, while maintaining the beauty of Tangke Lagoon.

text: Napilitan nga magpanaog sa trono ang reigning champions nga Espanya matapos ginlutos sang Canada, 88-85, sa makahalawat-hawat nga second round sang FIBA World Cup 2023 sa Indonesia Arena sa Jakarta.
english: Reigning champions Spain were forced to step down after being defeated by Canada, 88-85, in the thrilling second round of the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 at the Indonesia Arena in Jakarta.

text: Nagtingob-pwersa ang NBA stars nga sanday Dillon Brooks sang Houston Rockets kag Shai Gilgeous-Alexander sang Oklahoma City Thunder agud nga kuhaan sang korona ang defending champions sa do-or-die game sa Group L showdown.
english: NBA stars Dillon Brooks of the Houston Rockets and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of the Oklahoma City Thunder joined forces to dethrone the defending champions in a do-or-die game in the Group L showdown.

text: Sa first half sang hampang, halos isa ka tikang na lang kag makalab-ot ang Espanya sa knockout phase bangud sa 10 nga abanse sa Canadians, 48-38.
english: In the first half of the game, Spain was almost one step away from reaching the knockout phase thanks to a 10-point lead over the Canadians, 48-38.

text: Pagkatapos sang third quarter, nasimhutan na sang Spanish players ang kadalag-an, 73-61, apang sang duha ka minutos na lang ang nabilin sa sambuwa, naglain ang dalagan sang puntos.
english: After the third quarter, the Spanish players smelled the victory, 73-61, but with only two minutes left in the game, the score changed.

text: Nagpasulod sang tres si Gilgeous-Alexander nga nagpanubo sang lead sang Espanya, 78-77.
english: Gilgeous-Alexander hit a three to cut Spain's lead to 78-77.

text: Nagsaka sa tres puntos ang abanse sang Spain paagi sa duha ka free throws ni Willy Hernangomez, apang nag-assist liwat si Gilgeous-Alexander para makapasulod si Brooks sang tres nga amo ang nagpa-patas sa skor sang 1:19 minuto na lamang ang nabilin sa oras.
english: Spain's lead increased to three points with two free throws by Willy Hernangomez, but Gilgeous-Alexander assisted again for Brooks to score a three that tied the score with 1:19 minutes left on the clock.

text: 44 segundos ang nabilin sa fourth quarter sang naghilinugyaw ang tanan sa step-back jumper ni Gilgeous-Alexander nga amo ang naghatag sa Canada sa ila labing-una nga abanse sa second half, 82-80.
english: 44 seconds left in the fourth quarter when everyone cheered for Gilgeous-Alexander's step-back jumper that gave Canada its first lead of the second half, 82-80.

text: May duha pa free throws si Gilgeous-Alexander, kag 15 segundos ang nabilin sang nagdugang sang duha ka puntos ang Espanya.
english: Gilgeous-Alexander had two more free throws, and Spain added two points with 15 seconds left.

text: 13 ka segundos ang nabilin sa match-up sang duha ka free throws ang ginbuy-an ni Gilgeous-Alexander para mapasaka ang lead sang Canada, 86-82.
english: 13 seconds left in the match-up when Gilgeous-Alexander unleashed two free throws to increase Canada's lead, 86-82.

text: Lima ka segundos ang nabilin, daw indi na makalantaw ang players sa bench bangud nagdugang pa sang tres puntos ang Spain paagi kay Santiago Aldama rason nga isa na lang ang abanse sang Canada.
english: With five seconds left, the players on the bench seemed unable to watch as Spain added three more points through Santiago Aldama to give Canada one lead.

text: Sang 4.5 segundos ang nabilin sa hampang, na-foul si Gilgeous-Alexander kag nakapasulod sang duha ka free throws para sa Canadians.
english: With 4.5 seconds left in the game, Gilgeous-Alexander was fouled and made two free throws for the Canadiens.

text: Nagtuyo pa nga makapasulod sang tres si Alex Abrines para sa Espanya apang nag-igu lamang sa ring, nag-expire ang time kag naghilinugyaw ang Canadian fans sa Arena.
english: Alex Abrines tried to score three for Spain but it hit the ring, time expired and the Canadian fans in the Arena cheered.

text: Nagpanguna si Gilgeous-Alexander sa Canadians nga may 30 points sa 7-of-12 shooting kag may seven assists.
english: Gilgeous-Alexander led the Canadiens with 30 points on 7-of-12 shooting and had seven assists.

text:
Si Brooks naman ang may yara sang 22 points, samtang si RJ Barrett ang may yara sang 16 puntos

3-2 ang rekord sang Spain sa Group L kag amo ini ang labing-una nga tion nga wala sila nakasulod sa quarterfinals sa World Cup halin sang 1994.
english:
Brooks had 22 points, while RJ Barrett had 16 points

Spain’s record in Group L is 3-2 and it is the first time since 1994 that they have missed the quarterfinals at the World Cup.

text: Tanan nga Top 4 teams sa nagligad nga World Cup ang napaslawan man nga maka-abanse sa Final Phase: wala nakasulod sa tournament ang runner-up nga Argentina, nabilin sa classification round ang bronze-medalist nga France, samtang nalutos naman sa second round sa kamot sang Slovenia ang fourth placer nga Australia.
english: All the Top 4 teams in the last World Cup also failed to advance to the Final Phase: runner-up Argentina did not qualify for the tournament, bronze-medalist France was left in the classification round, while fourth placer Australia lost in the second round at the hands of Slovenia.

text: Kumpleto naman subong ang maga-sambuwa sa final phase nga ginalakipan sang Italy, Serbia, USA, Lithuania, Germany, Slovenia, kag ang debutant nga Latvia.
english: Italy, Serbia, USA, Lithuania, Germany, Slovenia, and debutant Latvia are now complete.

text: Padayon nga nakitaan sang improvement ang kondisyon ni Pope Francis sa ika-13 nga adlaw sini sa pagtinir sa ospital sa Roma.
english: Pope Francis' condition continues to improve on his 13th day in a hospital in Rome.

text: Suno sa Vatican, naresolba na ang isyu sa kidney sang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: According to the Vatican, the 88-year-old Pope's kidney issue has been resolved.

text: Ginpanas sini ang kahangawa sang publiko matapos gin-report sang weekend nga magluwas nga kritikal ang kondisyon sini, may nakita man nga “mild kidney insufficiency” nga ginbalak-an nga magresulta sa kidney failure.
english: He dispelled public concern after it was reported over the weekend that besides being in critical condition, he was also found to have “mild kidney insufficiency” which was feared to result in kidney failure.

text: Suno pa sa Holy See, wala na sang panibag-o nga respiratory crises nga natabo sa Santo Papa.
english: According to the Holy See, there have been no new respiratory crises in the Pope.

text: Base naman sa CT scan sa iya dughan, may normal evolution sa inflammation sa iya nga baga.
english: Based on the CT scan of his chest, there was a normal evolution of inflammation in his lungs.

text: Wala na ginmensyonar sa statement kun yara pa sa critical condition si Pope Francis.
english: The statement did not mention whether Pope Francis is still in critical condition.

text: Bisan nga may improvement, ginsiling sa statement sang Vatican nga guarded sa gihapon ang iya prognosis.
english: Despite the improvement, the Vatican said in a statement that his prognosis is still guarded.

text:
Yari ang kabug-usan nga statement sang Holy See:

“The Holy Father’s condition has shown a slight further improvement over the past 24 hours.
english:
Here is the Holy See’s full statement:

“The Holy Father’s condition has shown a slight further improvement over the past 24 hours.

text: The mild kidney insufficiency observed in recent days has subsided.
english: The mild kidney insufficiency observed in recent days has subsided.

text: A chest CT scan carried out last night showed a normal progression of the lung inflammation.
english: A chest CT scan carried out last night showed a normal progression of the lung inflammation.

text: Blood tests conducted today confirmed the improvement seen yesterday.
english: Blood tests conducted today confirmed the improvement seen yesterday.

text: The Holy Father remains on high-flow oxygen therapy but has not experienced any asthma-like respiratory episodes today.
english: The Holy Father remains on high-flow oxygen therapy but has not experienced any asthma-like respiratory episodes today.

text: Respiratory physiotherapy is continuing.
english: Respiratory physiotherapy is continuing.

text: Despite the slight improvement, his prognosis remains guarded.
english: Despite the slight improvement, his prognosis remains guarded.

text:
This morning, the Holy Father received the Eucharist, and in the afternoon, he resumed his work.”

Padayon naman ang pagbisita kag pagtipon sang mga tumuluo sa Gemelli Hospital kag sa St.
english:
This morning, the Holy Father received the Eucharist, and in the afternoon, he resumed his work.”

Faithful continue to visit and gather at Gemelli Hospital and St.

text: Peter’s Square para sa prayer vigil agud nga ipangamuyo ang ikaayong lawas sang Pope.
english: Peter’s Square for a prayer vigil to pray for the health of the Pope.

text: Naka-deploy na ang halos yara sa 5,308 ka frontline personnel halin sa 16 nga distrito ng Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) bilang kabahin sang ila Oplan Biyaheng Ayos: Tigkalalag 2025.
english: Nearly 5,308 frontline personnel from the 16 districts of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) have already been deployed as part of their Oplan Biyaheng Ayos: Tigkalalag 2025.

text: Suno sa PCG, may yara sang 23,320 outbound passengers kag 17,388 ka inbound passengers sa tanan nga port sang pungsod.
english: According to the PCG, there were 23,320 outbound passengers and 17,388 inbound passengers across all ports of the country.

text: Agud masiguro naman ang safety kag maayo nga biyahe, nagpatigayon man ang mga ini sang inspeksyon sa 323 nga mga barko kag 34 motor boat.
english: To ensure safety and smooth sailing, they also conducted inspections on 323 ships and 34 motor boats.

text: Magluwas diri, nak-heightened alert man ang tanan nga station, kag sub-station sang PCG halin Oktubre 30 tubtob Nobyembre 4, kadungan sang ginalauman nga pagdamo sang mga pasahero para sa adlaw sang mga Santo, kag adlaw sang mga Patay.
english: In addition, all stations and sub-stations of the PCG were also heightened alert from October 30 to November 4, in line with the expected increase in passengers for All Saints' Day and Day of the Dead.

text: Nagahilibion ang isa ka babayi nga naga-apply para sa iya TIN ID agud makakuha sang trabaho matapos ginpahayag nga ginpakitaan sang indi manami nga batasan sang isa ka BIR employee sa Novaliches.
english: A woman who applies for her TIN ID to get a job is crying after she was allegedly shown bad behavior by a BIR employee in Novaliches.

text: Base sa video, tuman ang pagkadismaya sang babayi bangud nag-ekspektar ini sang manami nga pagtratar bangud government employee ang nag-asikaso sa iya, apang napaslawan ini bangud daw kaangay nga wala sang gana kag suplada ang BIR employee.
english: According to the video, the woman was very disappointed because she expected good treatment because the government employee took care of her, but she failed because the BIR employee seemed to be rude and stubborn.

text: Nagpabulig ang babayi bangud makapila ka beses nga may error sa iya online application para sa TIN ID rason nga nagpadulong gid ini sa ila talatapan.
english: The woman asked for help because there were several errors in her online application for TIN ID so she went to their office.

text: Ginhambalan sini ang BIR employee nga magpahuway anay kay daw wala ini sa modo, butang nga ginkaakig sang BIR employee kag ginsinggitan ini.
english: He told the BIR employee to rest because he seemed to be in a bad mood, which made the BIR employee angry and shouted at him.

text: Sa karon, terminated na sa trabaho ang nasambit nga BIR employee matapos gin-report sang customer kag gindagdagan man ini sang ahensya sang show cause order.
english: The said BIR employee has now been terminated from his job after the customer reported him and the agency also added a show cause order.

text: Bangud sa narumpag nga kisame sa opisina sang Sangguniang Panlungsod Secretariat, ginpabutyag ni Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog nga tuyo niya ipatawag ang contractor sang legislative building.
english: Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog said she intends to summon the contractor of the legislative building.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Mabilog, importante gid nga istoryahan ini kaupod ang mga city councilors bangud kabahin ini sang public safety.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Mabilog said it is important to discuss this with the city councilors because it is part of public safety.

text: Ginpahayag man sang konsehal nga kinahanglan imbestigahan ang proyekto nga gingastuhan sang pondo sang pumuluyo, kag siguruhon nga wala sang sub-standard nga materyales nga gin-usar.
english: The councilor also said that the project that was financed by the people's funds should be investigated, and ensure that no sub-standard materials were used.

text: Ginpanindugan niya nga dapat may accountability kag transparency agud masiguro nga hilway ang building para sa tanan nga empleyado.
english: He insisted that there should be accountability and transparency to ensure that the building is safe for all employees.

text: Kun may plano ka nga magbyahe sakay sa eroplano sa masunod nga bulan, dapat na nga mag-preparar sang mas daku-daku nga budget bangud sang ginalauman nga mas mataas nga plete kasunod sang saka sa fuel surcharge nga aprubado sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB).
english: If you plan to travel by plane next month, you should prepare a bigger budget due to the expected higher fares following the increase in fuel surcharge approved by the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB).

text: Suno sa CAB, halin sa Level 4, pataason sa Level 6 sa Septyembre ang fuel surcharge nga mahimo sukton sang airlines halin sa mga pasahero.
english: According to the CAB, from Level 4, the fuel surcharge that airlines can charge passengers will be increased to Level 6 in September.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 6, magabayad ang mga byahero sang fuel surcharge nga P185 tubtub sa P665 para sa domestic trips kag P610.37 tubtub sa P4,538.4 para sa international flights.
english: Under Level 6, passengers will pay a fuel surcharge of P185 to P665 for domestic trips and P610.37 to P4,538.4 for international flights.

text: Nahibaluan nga tatlo ka bulan na halin sang Hunyo nga yara lang sa Level 4 ang fuel surcharge nga buot silingon, mas barato ang bayad sa mga eroplano.
english: It is known that the fuel surcharge has been at Level 4 for three months since June, which means that the fares on airlines are cheaper.

text: Mahimo i-apply sang airlines ang fuel surcharge sa presyo sang ticket sang customers agud mahagan-hagan ang kapyerdehan halin sa price fluctuations sa jet fuel.
english: Airlines can apply the fuel surcharge to customers' ticket prices to mitigate losses from price fluctuations in jet fuel.

text: Nagalalaw man ang entertainment industry sa South Korea matapos nalakip ang isa ka young actor sa mga napatay sa natabo nga Halloween crowd surge.
english: The entertainment industry in South Korea is also in mourning after a young actor was among those killed in the Halloween crowd surge.

text: Ginkumpirma sang talent agency ni Lee Ji-han nga nadala siya sa 154 nga ginbawian sang kabuhi sa amo nga insidente sa Itaewon sang Oktubre 29.
english: Lee Ji-han's talent agency confirmed that he was among the 154 killed in the incident in Itaewon on October 29.

text: 24 anyos pa lang si Lee kag ang iya nga showbiz debut amo ang 2017 variety show nga Produce 101 Season 2.
english: Lee is only 24 years old and made his showbiz debut in the 2017 variety show Produce 101 Season 2.

text: Ang iya naman nga first acting gig amo ang 2019 web drama nga Today Was Another Nam Hyun Day.
english: His first acting gig was the 2019 web drama Today Was Another Nam Hyun Day.

text: Ginapahayag nga isa siya kuntani sa cast sang isa ka upcoming drama series nga magaumpisa sa January, 2023 kag ginapahayag nga naka-umpisa naman siya sa pag-shoot para kuntani sa amo nga series.
english: He is reportedly supposed to be one of the cast of an upcoming drama series that will start in January, 2023 and is said to have started shooting for the series.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang mensahe sang simpatiya ang iban nga mga artista lakip na ang iya nga Produce 101 cast mates.
english: Other actors, including his Produce 101 cast mates, sent messages of sympathy.

text: Nagkapan ang isa ka sakayan nga may sakay nga mga pasahero sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: A boat carrying passengers capsized in the waters of Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Base sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, halin sa mainland Concepcion ang sakayan kag padulong na sa isla sang Baliguian.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, the boat was heading from mainland Concepcion to Baliguian Island.

text: Pag-abot sa porsyon nga sakop sang Botlog kag Malangabang Island, ginhampak ini sang dalagko nga balod nga rason nga nagkapan.
english: When it reached the portion of Botlog and Malangabang Island, it was hit by large waves that caused it to capsize.

text: Karga sang sakayan ang kapin 10 ka pasahero kag may bata pa nga sakay.
english: The boat was carrying more than 10 passengers and a child.

text: Nagkalaanod naman ang mga ginkompra nga mga baligya sang mga pasahero.
english: The goods bought by the passengers were washed away.

text: Maswerte naman nga may naglabay nga isa ka sakayan kag nahingagaw nga masalbar ang mga biktima.
english: Fortunately, a boat passed by and managed to rescue the victims.

text: Nakuhaan sang illegal nga droga ang 15-anyos nga menor de edad sa ginpatigayon nga buy bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9 sa Brgy.
english: A 15-year-old minor was recovered with illegal drugs in a buy bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9 in Brgy.

text: Maria Cristina, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Maria Cristina, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo si Alyas Bert, residente sang Brgy.
english: The subject was identified as Bert, resident of Brgy.

text: San Isidro, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: San Isidro, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., hepe sang Police Station 9, iya ginpahayag nga natigayon nila maka-transaksyon ang subject paagi sa online kag suno sa iya ulihi na nga nahibaluan nga menor de edad ang subject.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Eduardo Siacon Jr., chief of Police Station 9, said they were able to transact with the subject online and he said it was later learned that the subject was a minor.

text: Naglab-ot sa isa ka semana ang monitoring sa subject kun sa diin wala ini sang previous nga record.
english: The subject was monitored for a week and had no previous record.

text: Wala naman gintuad sang subject kun diin ini nagakuha sang supply kag direkta ini nga nagakadto sa iya ang ginabaligyaan sang illegal nga droga.
english: The subject did not confess where he got the supply and said he went directly to the illegal drug shop.

text: Natigayon nga makuha sa iya paghinakop ang 3 tanan nga gramo sang suspected shabu nga may standard drug price nga 20,400.
english: Three grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P20,400 were recovered from the suspect.

text: Sa subong, yara ini sa kustodiya sang balay dalayunan matapos ginturn- over sang kapulisan samtang nga ginahulat ang resulta sang drug test.
english: He is currently in the custody of the inn after being turned over by the police while awaiting the result of the drug test.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan kun sin-o ang mga koneksyon sang menor de edad.
english: Police are still investigating the minor's connections.

text: Magalibot ang team sang Department of Agriculture (DA) agud mag-inspect sang mga warehouse sa tunga sang alegasyon nga may manipulasyon sa stocks agud nga ma-justify ang pagsaka sa presyo sang bugas sa pungsod.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) team will go around to inspect warehouses amid allegations of manipulation of stocks to justify the increase in rice prices in the country.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary and deputy spokesman Rex Estoperez, sa idalom sang Rice Tariffication Law ukon Republic Act 11203, wala na sang regulatory powers ang National Food Authority nga mag-inspeksyon sa warehouses, apang ang Department of Agriculture ang may yara gihapon sang gahum nga magbisita sa rice storage facilities.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and deputy spokesman Rex Estoperez, under the Rice Tariffication Law or Republic Act 11203, the National Food Authority no longer has regulatory powers to inspect warehouses, but the Department of Agriculture still has the power to visit rice storage facilities.

text: Ang pagbisita sa mga pasilida ang himuon sang DA-Inspectorate and Enforcement Office sa pagpanguna ni Assistant Secretary James Layug.
english: The visit to the facilities will be conducted by the DA-Inspectorate and Enforcement Office led by Assistant Secretary James Layug.

text: Ginpahayag ni Estoperez nga may nakit-an nga saka sa presyo sang bugas bangud sa ulihi pa nga bahin sang Septyembre ukon sa temprano nga bahin sang Oktubre magaumpisa ang ani sang humay.#
english: Estoperez said there is an increase in the price of rice because the rice harvest will start in late September or early October.

text:
Nag-skor ang Los Angeles Lakers guard nga si Austin Reaves sang 15 puntos para sa national team samtang may tag-13 puntos naman sanday Jalen Brunson kag Anthony Edwards para pangunahan ang Estados Unidos nga tumbahon ang Greece, 109-81, sa Group C.

Ang Greece amo kuntani ang gina-konsiderar nga pinakadaku nga kasumpong sang US sa group phase bangud nagapang-siyam ini sa FIBA standings.
english:
Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves scored 15 points for the national team while Jalen Brunson and Anthony Edwards each had 13 points to lead the United States to knock off Greece, 109-81, in Group C.

Greece was supposed to be considered the biggest opponent of the US in the group phase as they are ninth in the FIBA standings.

text: Ginalantaw nga daku nga epekto ang kadulaan sang Greek star nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo nga rason kun ngaa wala nasarangan sang pungsod ang pwersa sang rising NBA stars sang US.
english: The loss of Greek star Giannis Antetokounmpo is expected to have a huge impact on the country's ability to cope with the strength of rising NBA stars in the US.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang American team si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson kag ang team sang Jordan sa Myerkules, Agusto 30.
english: The American team will next face Rondae Hollis-Jefferson and the Jordan team on Wednesday, August 30th.

text: Daku nga mga papel ang tungdan sang mga Pinoy sa ginabantayan nga 30th anniversary special sang “Beauty and the Beast” sang Disney!
english: Filipinos will play big roles in Disney's highly anticipated 30th anniversary special of “Beauty and the Beast”!

text: Magluwas nga ang Filipino-American R&B singer nga si H.E.R. ang napilian nga magdala sang papel ni Belle, Pinoy man ang magadala sa papel sang inventor nga si Maurice ukon ang tatay ni Belle!
english: Besides Filipino-American R&B singer H.E.R. who is chosen to play the role of Belle, Filipino will play the role of inventor Maurice or Belle's father!

text:
Ini amo ang Filipino-American actor nga si Jon Jon Briones nga nag-star man sa television shows nga “Ratched” kag “Star Trek: Picard.” May voice roles man ini sa “Trese” kag “Transformers: EarthSpark,” kag sunod man nga mabatian sa “The Last Voyage of Demeter.”

Ini nga special ang maga-feature sang never-before-seen musical performances, brand new costumes, kag set designs nga inspired sang original French fairytale kag igaperform sang cast ang mga ambahanon halin sa original 1991 animated film sa atubang mismo sang live audience sa Disney Studios!
english:
This is Filipino-American actor Jon Jon Briones who also starred in the television shows “Ratched” and “Star Trek: Picard.” She also had voice roles in “Trese” and “Transformers: EarthSpark,” and will next be heard in “The Last Voyage of Demeter.”

This special will feature never-before-seen musical performances, brand new costumes, and set designs inspired by the original French fairytale and will have the cast perform songs from the original 1991 animated film right in front of a live audience at Disney Studios!

text: Ang Grammy-winning singer nga si H.E.R. ang una nga Afro Filipina nga maga-portray sa isa ka Disney princess, bangud kun matandaan, yara man anay ang legendary actress nga si Lea Salonga apang nagserbe lamang ini bilang singing voices para kanday Jasmine kag Mulan para sa ila Disney Films.
english: Grammy-winning singer H.E.R. the first Afro Filipina to portray a Disney princess, because if you remember, there was also the legendary actress Lea Salonga but she only served as singing voices for Jasmine and Mulan for their Disney Films.

text: Balantayan man sa sini nga anniversary special ang singer nga si Josh Groban bilang si Beast, Joshua Henry bilang Gaston, kag EGOT winner nga si Rita Moreno bilang narrator.
english: The anniversary special will also feature singer Josh Groban as Beast, Joshua Henry as Gaston, and EGOT winner Rita Moreno as narrator.

text: Yara man ang veteran comedian nga si Martin Short, Tony winner nga si David Alan Grier, country-pop singer nga si Shania Twain, Leo Abelo Perry bilang teacup Chip, kag Rizwan Manji bilang LeFou.
english: There’s also veteran comedian Martin Short, Tony winner David Alan Grier, country-pop singer Shania Twain, Leo Abelo Perry as teacup Chip, and Rizwan Manji as LeFou.

text: Balantayan ang “Beauty and the Beast: A 30th Celebration” sa Disyembre 15 sa Estados Unidos.
english: Watch “Beauty and the Beast: A 30th Celebration” on December 15 in the United States.

text: Patay sa pagpangluthang sang riding-in-tandem ang isa ka anay kagawad sang barangay sa Candiis, Badian, Cebu.
english: A former barangay kagawad was shot dead by a riding-in-tandem in Candiis, Badian, Cebu.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nag-abot sa lugar ang duha ka lalaki nga sakay sa motorsiklo kag gintiro ang biktima.
english: According to reports, two men on a motorcycle arrived at the scene and shot the victim.

text: Isa sa ginalantaw nga motibo sa krimen amo ang personal nga away kag ang pagserbe man sang biktima bilang barangay coordinator nga nagasuporta sa isa ka kandidato sa banwa.
english: One of the motives behind the crime is a personal fight and the victim's service as a barangay coordinator supporting a candidate in the town.

text: Padayon naman nga ginahibalo kun may yara sang CCTV sa lugar agud makabulig sa pagdakop sa mga suspek.
english: It is still being investigated whether there is CCTV in the area to help arrest the suspects.

text: Ginpagwa sang Office of the Ombudsman ang mga kopya sang mga desisyon sang anay nga mga Ombudsman nga sanday Conchita Carpio-Morales kag Samuel Martires may kaangtanan sa anay dismissal order batuk kay Senador Joel Villanueva.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman released copies of the decisions of former Ombudsmen Conchita Carpio-Morales and Samuel Martires regarding the former dismissal order against Senator Joel Villanueva.

text: Madumduman nga gintawag ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla nga isa ka “secret decision” kag misteryoso ang 2019 ruling ni Martires nga nagbaliskad sa una nga mandu ni Morales nga magpahalin kay Villanueva sa serbisyo publiko.
english: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla called Martires' 2019 ruling that overturned Morales' initial order to remove Villanueva from public service a “secret decision” and mysterious.

text: Ini kaangot sa alegasyon nga P9.7 milyon nga pork barrel anomalies samtang kongresista pa si Villanueva sang CIBAC Party-list.
english: This is in connection with the allegation of P9.7 million pork barrel anomalies while Villanueva was still a congressman of the CIBAC Party-list.

text: Sa desisyon ni Martires, ginsiling nga kulang sa ebidensya agud mapamatud-an ang pagkaulamid ni Villanueva sa gin-alegar nga sayop nga paggamit sang pondo.
english: In Martires' decision, it was said that there was a lack of evidence to prove Villanueva's involvement in the alleged misuse of funds.

text: Suno sa report sang NBI, napat-od nga palsipikado ukon ginpeke ang pirma sang senador sa pila ka dokumento.
english: According to the NBI report, it was determined that the senator's signature on some documents was forged.

text: Dugang pa diri, wala man sang ebidensya nga nagpakita nga nagbenepisyo si Villanueva ukon iban pa nga mga respondent sa nasambit nga kwarta.
english: In addition, there was no evidence to show that Villanueva or other respondents benefited from the said money.

text: Sa baylo, ginrekomendar sang Ombudsman nga palawigon pa ang imbestigasyon agud makilala kon sin-o ang responsable sa pagpangpeke sang mga dokumento.
english: Instead, the Ombudsman recommended that the investigation be extended to identify who was responsible for the forgery of documents.

text: Ginpasugtan naman ni Remulla nga ipaguwa sa publiko ang mga desisyon para sa benepisyo sang publiko kag agud malikawan ang mga tsismis.
english: Remulla agreed to make the decisions public for the benefit of the public and to avoid rumors.

text: Sa pihak sang iya ginabatyag, ginsapol ni Pope Francis ang mga senior colleagues sa ospital agud istoryahan ang pila ka mga isyu.
english: Despite his feelings, Pope Francis met with senior colleagues at the hospital to discuss some issues.

text: Ang 88-anyos nga santo papa ang yara na sa iya ka-13 nga adlaw sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma, ang pinakamalawig nga pagtinir sa ospital sa sulod sang iya malapit 12 ka tuig nga papacy.
english: The 88-year-old pope is now in his 13th day at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, the longest hospital stay of his nearly 12-year papacy.

text: Suno sa Vatican, nagakaon sang normal kag nagahulag-hulag man ang santo papa sa pihak sang iya pagpabilin sa kritikal nga kondisyon bangud sa double pneumonia.
english: According to the Vatican, the pope is eating normally and moving around despite remaining in critical condition due to double pneumonia.

text: Suno sa Vatican, nagsapol si Pope Francis sa iya second-in-line nga si Cardinal Pietro Parolin, kag sa deputy ni Parolin.
english: According to the Vatican, Pope Francis met with his second-in-line Cardinal Pietro Parolin, and Parolin’s deputy.

text: Ila gindiskusyunan ang pila ka pending cases para sa sainthood.
english: They discussed some pending cases for sainthood.

text: Gin-anunsyo man sang Vatican ang bag-o nga appointments nga kinahanglan sang approval sang papa.
english: The Vatican also announced new appointments that require papal approval.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagatrabaho si Francis gikan sa ospital samtang padayon naman ang mga aktibidad sang Vatican sa pihak sang kondisyon sang santo papa.
english: Francis is working from the hospital while Vatican activities continue despite the pope's condition.

text: business continues apace during his illness.
english: business continues apace during his illness.

text: Patay ang apat nga construction workers kag anom ka iban pa ang pilason matapos ang pag-collapse sang highway overpass sa South Korea.
english: Four construction workers were killed and six others injured after a highway overpass collapsed in South Korea.

text: Kalakip sa napatay ang duha ka Chinese kag lima ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon sa aksidente nga natabo sa Cheonan, Seoul.
english: Among the dead were two Chinese and five others in critical condition in the accident that occurred in Cheonan, Seoul.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon nga hinali lang nag-collapse ang towering deck sang overpass kag ini ang nahulog.
english: According to initial investigation, the towering deck of the overpass suddenly collapsed and fell.

text: Wala naman sang pasahero kag mga salakyan nga nakaparada malapit sa construction site.
english: There are no passengers and vehicles parked near the construction site.

text: Gilayon naman nagpatawag sang imbestigasyon si Acting Interior and Safety Minister Koh Ki-dong sa natabo nga insidente.
english: Acting Interior and Safety Minister Koh Ki-dong immediately called for an investigation into the incident.

text: Samtang nagalawig ang FIBA World Cup 2023, labi nga ginapamatud-an sang Team USA nga sila ang ‘team to beat’ sa sini nga edition.
english: As the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 progresses, Team USA is proving more and more that they are the ‘team to beat’ in this edition.

text:
Nag-skor ang Los Angeles Lakers guard nga si Austin Reaves sang 15 puntos para sa national team samtang may tag-13 puntos naman sanday Jalen Brunson kag Anthony Edwards para pangunahan ang Estados Unidos nga tumbahon ang Greece, 109-81, sa Group C.

Ang Greece amo kuntani ang gina-konsiderar nga pinakadaku nga kasumpong sang US sa group phase bangud nagapang-siyam ini sa FIBA standings.
english:
Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves scored 15 points for the national team while Jalen Brunson and Anthony Edwards each had 13 points to lead the United States to knock off Greece, 109-81, in Group C.

Greece was supposed to be considered the biggest opponent of the US in the group phase as they are ninth in the FIBA standings.

text: Ginalantaw nga daku nga epekto ang kadulaan sang Greek star nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo nga rason kun ngaa wala nasarangan sang pungsod ang pwersa sang rising NBA stars sang US.
english: The loss of Greek star Giannis Antetokounmpo is expected to have a huge impact on the country's ability to cope with the strength of rising NBA stars in the US.

text: Sunod nga atubangon sang American team si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson kag ang team sang Jordan sa Myerkules, Agusto 30.
english: The American team will next face Rondae Hollis-Jefferson and the Jordan team on Wednesday, August 30th.

text: Naospital ang kapin 20 ka mga tawo sa Balasan matapos naglain ang pamatyag kag ginpatihan nga bangud ini sa ila ginkaon nga isda nga bansa ukon barracuda.
english: More than 20 people in Balasan were hospitalized after feeling unwell and believed to be caused by eating barracuda.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jingky Delgado, fish vendor sa Balasan Public Market, iya ginpahayag nga ginkompra nila ang isda sa Estancia kag ginbaligya sa ila pwesto sa Balasan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jingky Delgado, fish vendor at the Balasan Public Market, said they bought the fish in Estancia and sold it at their place in Balasan.

text: Suno sa iya, may mga suki sila nga nagaluto sa karinderiya nga nagbakal sang kinihad sang amo nga isda.
english: He said they had customers who cooked in the cafeteria who bought the fish.

text: Pahayag ni Delgado, sila mismo ang nagluto man sang amo nga isda sa ila balay kag matapos sila nagkaon, nakaeksperyensiya sila sang pagpalanuka, nagsakit ang tiyan kag nabudlayan sila nga maghulag.
english: Delgado said they cooked the fish themselves at home and after they ate, they experienced vomiting, stomach pain and difficulty moving.

text: Suno kay Delgado, lima gid sila sa ila pamilya ang naglain ang pamatyag.
english: According to Delgado, five members of their family were affected.

text: Dugang ni Delgado, ang ido nga nakakaon sang isda ang nagmasakit man.
english: Delgado said the dog that ate the fish also became ill.

text: Nadala naman sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources ang sample sang isda para ipaidalom sa eksaminasyon.
english: The sample of the fish was taken to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources for examination.

text: Sa data naman sang Jesus M Colmenares District Hospital sa Balasan, 24 tanan ang ginpangdala sa amo nga ospital matapos nagkaon sang amo nga isda.
english: According to the Jesus M Colmenares District Hospital in Balasan, 24 people were brought to the hospital after eating the fish.

text: Nagpangayo naman sang pasaylo si Delgado bangud sa natabo.
english: Delgado apologized for the incident.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, nagpagwa sang advisory ang Balasan Care Facility sa tanan nga pumuluyo nga maglikaw anay sa pagkaon sang amo nga isda nga dalagko kag predatory bangud ini ang mahimo magtuga sang ciguatera fish poisoning (CFP).
english: Following the incident, the Balasan Care Facility issued an advisory to all residents to avoid eating the large and predatory fish as it can cause ciguatera fish poisoning (CFP).

text: Iloilo City — Ipinahayag ni Konsehal Rex Marcus Sarabia na limitado lamang ang kapangyarihan ng City Council pagdating sa imbestigasyon kaugnay ng umano’y ghost project sa Batiano River, at iginiit na dapat ang ICI ang manguna sa pagsisiyasat.
english: ILOILO CITY — Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia said the City Council has limited powers when it comes to the investigation into the alleged ghost project in the Batiano River, and insisted that the ICI should take the lead in the investigation.

text: Matatandaan na sa ginanap na People’s Meeting noong nakaraang linggo, sinagot ni Congresswoman Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda ang mga tanong ng mga residente at nilinaw na walang ghost project na nagaganap sa lungsod.
english: It can be recalled that in the People's Meeting held last week, Congresswoman Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda answered the questions of the residents and clarified that there is no ghost project going on in the town.

text: Gayunman, binigyang-diin ni Sarabia na ang nasabing People’s Meeting ng kongresista at ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) ay isa lamang general statement para sa publiko at hindi direktang tumutugon sa isyu ng pagbaha sa lungsod.
english: However, Sarabia stressed that the said People's Meeting of the congressman and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is only a general statement for the public and does not directly address the issue of flooding in the city.

text: Dagdag pa ng konsehal, hindi malinaw ang mga paliwanag na ibinigay ng DPWH at ng opisina ng Lone District Representative, dahilan upang manatiling palaisipan sa mga mamamayan ang tunay na kalagayan ng mga proyekto sa Batiano River.
english: The councilor added that the explanations given by the DPWH and the office of the Lone District Representative are not clear, causing the people to remain confused about the true status of the projects in the Batiano River.

text: Bilang hamon, mariing sinabi ni Sarabia na handa siyang “magpa-utod sang ulo” kung mapapatunayang mayroong aktuwal na natapos na proyekto sa naturang lugar.
english: As a challenge, Sarabia said he is ready to “cut off his head” if it is proven that there is an actual completed project in the area.

text: Magakit-anay ang actor-host nga si Vhong Navarro kag ang model nga si Deniece Cornejo sa korte sa Taguig City para sa arraignment sa kaso nga rape nga gin-file sang model batok sa aktor.
english: Actor-host Vhong Navarro and model Deniece Cornejo will meet in court in Taguig City for the arraignment in the rape case filed by the model against the actor.

text: Naka-schedule ang hearing karon sa hapon sa Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 69.
english: The hearing is scheduled for this afternoon at the Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 69.

text: May yara man sang separado nga kaso sang acts of lasciviousness nga gin-file si Cornejo batok kay Vhong ukon Ferdinand Navarro.
english: Cornejo also has a separate acts of lasciviousness case filed against Vhong or Ferdinand Navarro.

text: Suno kay Atty. Alma Mallonga, legal counsel ni Navarro, himuon sang kampo ang tanan nga legal means para sa dismissal sang kaso batok kay Vhong.
english: According to Atty. Alma Mallonga, Navarro's legal counsel, said the camp will pursue all legal means for the dismissal of the case against Vhong.

text: May yara sang motion nga gin-file sa Korte Suprema nga nagatuyo nga untaton ang proceedings sa trial court bangud sa kakulangan sang legal basis.
english: A motion was filed in the Supreme Court seeking to stay the proceedings in the trial court for lack of a legal basis.

text: Madumduman nga gin-akusaran ni Deniece ni Vhong nga nag-rape sa iya sa sulod sang iya nga condominium unit sang Enero 22, 2014.
english: Deniece accused Vhong of raping her inside his condominium unit on January 22, 2014.

text: Sang Septyembre 19, nagsurrender si Vhong sa National Bureau of Investigation matapos nga nagpaguwa ang Branch 116 sang Taguig Metropolitan Trial Court sang warrant of arrest sa acts of lasciviousness case nga ginfile man ni Deniece sang 2014.
english: On September 19, Vhong surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation after Branch 116 of the Taguig Metropolitan Trial Court issued a warrant of arrest in the acts of lasciviousness case also filed by Deniece in 2014.

text: Nagbayad si Vhong sang P36,000 para sa temporaryo nga kahilwayan, apang wala pa diri natapos bangud napilitan si Vhong nga magpabilin sa kustodiya sang NBI bangud may isa pa ka arrest warrant nga naguwa nga amo ang kaso sa rape nga gin-isyu sang Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 69 kun sa diin wala sang gina-rekomendar nga pyansa.
english: Vhong paid P36,000 for his temporary release, but it was not over because Vhong was forced to remain in the custody of the NBI because another arrest warrant was issued for rape issued by the Taguig Regional Trial Court Branch 69 where no bail is recommended.

text: Nag-expire na ang road closure permit sang proyekto sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office sa JM Basa Street, nga ginahimo subong sang contractor, suno kay Councilor Johnny Young, Chairman sang Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works.
english: The road closure permit of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office project on JM Basa Street, which is currently being carried out by the contractor, has expired, according to Councilor Johnny Young, Chairman of the Committee on Engineering, Construction and Public Works.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Young, ginpahayag niya nga nangayo sang extension ang contractor sang proyekto apang gin-kwestyon niya ang pagka-delay sang trabaho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Young said the contractor asked for an extension of the project but he questioned the delay in the work.

text: Ginplano niya nga ipatawag liwat ang contractor agud istoryahan ang posibilidad sang extension kag klaruhon ang timeline sang proyekto.
english: He planned to call the contractor back to discuss the possibility of an extension and clarify the project’s timeline.

text: Ginpabutyag man sang konsehal nga dapat natapos na ini sang nagligad nga tuig antes pa mag-abot ang Paskwa kag Dinagyang Festival, apang wala ini natuman.
english: The councilor also expressed that it should have been completed last year before the Paskwa and Dinagyang Festival, but it was not fulfilled.

text: Padayon nga ginatutukan sang komite ang isyu agud masiguro nga indi madugayan pa ang kahimtangan sang dalanon.
english: The committee continues to focus on the issue to ensure that the road condition is not prolonged.

text: Gina-uyatan sang former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Best Import nga si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson ang pinakamataas nga scoring output sa single game sang nagapadayon nga FIBA World Cup 2023.
english: Former Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Best Import Rondae Hollis-Jefferson holds the highest single game scoring output of the ongoing FIBA ​​World Cup 2023.

text: Nakatipon ini sang 39 points, nine rebounds kag four assists apang nalutos sa gihapon ang iya team nga Jordan batok sa New Zealand sa group match sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: He collected 39 points, nine rebounds and four assists but his team Jordan still lost to New Zealand in the group match at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Si Hollis-Jefferson ang naka-skor sang ulihi nga siyam ka puntos para sa Jordan lakip na ang four-point play sang dies minutos na lamang ang nabilin sa regulation rason nga nagpatas ang skor kag may ginhatag nga extra period.
english: Hollis-Jefferson scored the last nine points for Jordan including a four-point play with 10 minutes left in regulation to tie the score and award an extra period.

text: Diri na kag nagbawi ang Kiwis sa overtime kag nakuha ang kadalag-an, 95-87, kasunod sang ila una nga kalutusan sa USA.
english: The Kiwis recovered in overtime to win, 95-87, following their first loss to the USA.

text: Ini naman ang ikaduha nga kalutusan sang Jordan matapos nga napierde man sa kamot sang Greece sa imbukada nga hampang sa Group C. Isa ang Jordan sa Asian teams sa World Cup kaupod sa Pilipinas, China, Japan, Iraq, kag Lebanon.
english: This is Jordan's second defeat after losing to Greece in the opening match of Group C. Jordan is one of the Asian teams in the World Cup along with the Philippines, China, Japan, Iraq, and Lebanon.

text: Ang Asian team nga makakuha sang best standing amo ang hatagan sang slot para sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: The Asian team with the best standing will be awarded a slot for the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Nagpaathag sa mga konsumidor sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation sa nagluntad nga unscheduled power interruption kaina sang aga.
english: MORE Electric and Power Corporation explained to consumers the unscheduled power interruption that occurred this morning.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Fil Sonza Jr., manager system operation sang MORE Electric and Power Corporation, iya ginpahayag nga nakit-an sang talatapan sa ila linya nga kinahanglan may insaktuhon kon sa diin, mahimo i-reroute ang floating current.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Fil Sonza Jr., manager system operation of MORE Electric and Power Corporation, said the office found in their line that there needs to be a proper place where the floating current can be rerouted.
